Conclusion: 该框架明确了在可行系统之间做出选择所需的比较集合，并推动关于分配规则跨任务与跨运行条件迁移的实验研究；作者明确不提出普适的缩放定律，也不从基准提升推断通用智能。

Abstract: AI scaling studies increasingly evaluate systems that combine a pretrained model with retrieval, search, verification, tools, and interaction. Yet a higher score under a larger budget does not by itself show where additional resources are best spent. This critical integrative review asks when a reported scaling result supports a resource-allocation decision. It compares evidence across pretraining, test-time computation, retrieval, and agent evaluation, distinguishing the performance of a tested procedure from the best performance achievable under a resource limit. The synthesis shows that three mismatches recur across this evidence: success counted before an answer is chosen, information a deployed system will not have, and costs left out of the comparison. A capability surface expresses performance as a function of budgets, mechanisms, and available information. Worked analytical examples show how the evaluation metric, deployment volume, selection rule, and stopping policy can alter an allocation conclusion. A resource envelope provides a structured record of the task, development and run-time resources, information access, and procedure behind a reported score. Its application to a published comparison illustrates which conclusions the evidence supports and which deployment questions remain unresolved. The resulting framework specifies the comparisons needed to choose among feasible systems and motivates experiments on the transfer of allocation rules across tasks and operating conditions. It does not propose a universal scaling law or infer general intelligence from benchmark gains.

Conclusion: MetaBlind以多智能体加编排器的架构替代"每任务一工具"与"全量叙述"两种范式，将非视觉访问的核心问题转化为候选信息的实时相关性筛选与多模态输出调度，并通过可证伪的评估协议为后续原型与用户研究设定判据。

Abstract: Virtual worlds now host classrooms, meetings, conferences, shops, and social venues, and nearly every interaction they expose assumes a user who can scan a three-dimensional scene, follow avatars, and read floating panels. Blind and visually impaired (BVI) users are left with assistive tools that each solve one task in isolation: naming an object, reading text, describing a scene, or planning a route. A live virtual room defeats that model: obstacles, speakers, gestures, chat, slides, and notifications arrive together, and a tool that narrates all of them trades a visual barrier for an auditory one. This paper presents MetaBlind, an architecture that distributes nonvisual access across eight specialized agents, spanning perception, navigation, social and object interaction, communication, safety and trust, memory, and personalization, and that places an Accessibility Orchestrator between those agents and the user. Agents publish candidate information into a shared accessibility context instead of speaking to the user directly. The orchestrator scores each candidate on safety relevance, goal relevance, urgency, confidence, user relevance, and estimated listening load, then releases only the items it judges relevant at that moment through speech, structured audio, or haptic output.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: A child with reduced distance vision often does not know that anything is wrong. Children adapt, move closer, and rarely report the difficulty, so the problem can survive years of schooling before an adult notices. School screening addresses part of this, but it runs on a schedule, depends on staffing, and is separated from the classroom moments where the difficulty appears. Smartphone and web-based acuity tests have widened access, yet every one of them still needs somebody to start a test. Ordinary educational content carries short calibrated optotype probes, and eight specialized agents divide the work. Perception agents recover viewing distance, recognition accuracy, approach behavior, gaze stability, response latency, and interocular difference from each encounter. A quality agent discards observations taken under bad geometry, poor lighting, or inattention.   <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI评估实践以模型为中心，聚焦准确率、鲁棒性、公平性、可解释性等部署前属性。但AI系统一旦运行于不断变化的社会技术环境中（分布漂移、制度约束、人类反馈回路、隐私要求、多智能体交互），这些属性虽必要却不足够，缺乏对部署后持续问责的工程化支撑。

Method: 以愿景论文（vision paper）形式提出ADAE子学科，将问责界定为部署层属性而非单一模型属性，并围绕四个相互关联的支柱构建研究议程：1）情境相关失效模式的结构化发现；2）隐私保护的问责度量；3）面向智能体AI的系统级风险分析；4）将技术失效转化为运营与制度风险。

Result: 论文为ADAE界定了核心任务：判定AI使能系统是否仍在可接受风险限内运行、识别失效涌现的具体情境、在交互的技术与人类组件间归因失效、将技术失效映射为下游后果，并支持及时干预。研究议程进一步给出上述四大支柱作为具体研究方向。

Conclusion: 目标是建立面向安全关键应用的问责AI部署的基础原则、数学工具与系统架构，推动AI工程从模型中心走向部署层问责的持续、可度量、可行动的工程实践。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence systems are rapidly becoming critical components in healthcare, finance, public services, and other safety-critical domains. Yet the engineering practices used to evaluate these systems remain predominantly model-centric, emphasizing properties such as accuracy, robustness, fairness, and interpretability before deployment. These properties are necessary but insufficient once an AI system operates within an ever changing socio-technical environment characterized by distribution shifts, institutional constraints, human feedback loops, privacy requirements, and interactions among multiple AI agents.
  This vision paper introduces AI Deployment Accountability Engineering (ADAE), a proposed AI engineering subdiscipline concerned with establishing measurable, continuous, and actionable accountability for deployed AI systems. ADAE treats accountability as a deployment-layer property rather than solely as a property of an individual model. It seeks to determine whether an AI-enabled system continues to operate within acceptable risk limits, identify the contexts in which failures emerge, attribute failures across interacting technical and human components, translate technical failures into downstream consequences, and support timely intervention.
  We articulate a research agenda built around four interconnected pillars: structured discovery of context-dependent failure modes, privacy-preserving accountability measurement, system-level risk analysis for agentic AI, and translation of technical failures into operational, and institutional risks. The broader goal is to establish foundational principles, mathematical tools, and system architectures for accountable AI deployment across safety-critical applications.

</details>

Conclusion: 通过HHMM形式化的统一框架，克服了ACGVF的全观测假设与Murphy2025目标外部给定的限制，为部分可观测下的自主目标选择与终止提供了更一般化的智能体设计基础。

Abstract: The agent-centric general value function (ACGVF) construction of
  \citet{tasse2026goal} lets the agent make two decisions that are
  normally imposed by the environment or agent designer: which goal to
  pursue and when to declare a goal as finished (in addition to
  choosing the action). This is a very general framework that
  subsumes almost all prior work on reinforcement learning, control
  and planning, as well as more general formalisms proposed in the
  cognitive sciences. However, it assumes the environment is fully
  observed, i.e., that the observation is a sufficient statistic. In
  \citet{murphy2025rl}, a general agent design was proposed where the
  policy is based on an internal belief state $z_t$ and an internal
  goal; however, the goals were assumed to be externally provided. In
  this note, we unify and extend these two approaches using the
  formalism of hierarchical hidden Markov models (HHMM) \citep{murphy2001hhmm}.

*Zhichao Shi,Wenjie Zhang,Xuhui Jiang,Xiaojun Wu,Cehao Yang,Chengjin Xu,Jian Guo,Yuanzhuo Wang*

TL;DR: DynSTEER：面向LLM智能体长程任务的动态分阶段轨迹评估框架，通过里程碑图容忍多解路径并在线早停失败执行，判别力提升85.2%、失败轨迹节省34.51%执行步数。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: DynSTEER将rollout按关键已完成动作切分为阶段，聚焦必要里程碑并提供充分上下文，以支持针对性策略调整；从公开任务视图编译路径容忍的里程碑图，在不泄漏真实答案的前提下兼容多样合法策略；并自适应地将评估查询路由至多层评判器，对不可恢复的执行在线终止以抑制资源浪费。

Result: 实验表明，DynSTEER相较原生评估将LLM智能体评估判别力提升85.2%，能以统计显著性区分所有模型对，并在失败rollout上节省34.51%的执行步数。

Conclusion: DynSTEER通过分阶段里程碑评估、路径容忍的里程碑图与多层级在线路由早停，兼顾评估准确性与成本效率，为长程智能体任务提供可扩展的评估方案。

Abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed for long-horizon task execution. However, current evaluation paradigms face three major limitations: terminal-only assessment ignores intermediate processes and struggles to localize errors efficiently and accurately, single-reference matching penalizes valid alternative solution paths, and post-hoc trajectory judging incurs high costs without the ability to halt failed runs early. To address these issues, we propose DynSTEER, a dynamic stage-wise trajectory evaluation framework for agents. DynSTEER segments rollouts into stages anchored by key completed actions, focusing evaluation on essential milestones with adequate context while enabling targeted strategy adjustments. It compiles a path-tolerant milestone graph from public task views to respect diverse legitimate strategies without leaking ground truth. Furthermore, it adaptively routes evaluation queries across multi-tier judges and halts unrecoverable executions online to curb resource waste. Experiments demonstrate that DynSTEER improves evaluation discriminability across LLM agents by 85.2\% over native evaluation, separates all model pairs with statistical significance, and saves 34.51\% of execution steps on failed rollouts.

</details>

Conclusion: 条件扩散模型为以患者参数为条件的个性化步态轨迹生成提供了可行路径，有望用于辅助机器人中的参考轨迹合成；可控性提升与生物力学真实性仍需进一步研究。

Abstract: Generation of musculoskeletal gait trajectories conditioned on patient-specific parameters remains a key challenge for wearable robotics and rehabilitation. Assistive systems such as lower-limb exoskeletons require reference trajectories that adapt to individual morphology and therapeutic goals while preserving biomechanical realism. Traditional approaches rely on hand-crafted gait templates or optimization procedures that scale poorly across subjects and walking conditions. In this work, we explore conditional diffusion models for generating lower-limb joint-angle trajectories conditioned on gait parameters such as step length. We compare a baseline transformer diffusion model with a controllable diffusion transformer variant incorporating adaptive normalization and classifier-free guidance. Experiments on a dataset of 4,590 gait cycles show that diffusion models can generate realistic periodic gait trajectories while enabling some controllability variation in gait characteristics, highlighting their potential for personalized gait synthesis in assistive robotics.

</details>


### [70] [Lightning Weave: Improving the Accuracy-Efficiency Frontier of Reasoning Models through Capability Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14708)
*Yecheng Wu,Song Han,Han Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Lightning Weave：通过 on-policy 蒸馏将独立post-training获得的能力组合到单一学生模型，实现准确率与效率的协同提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高效推理的核心目标是改善"准确率-效率"前沿，但准确率与效率往往偏好不同的推理行为，二者共同提升存在困难；而独立post-training的模型已分别具备准确率或效率上的优势能力。

Method: 提出 Lightning Weave 后训练框架，用 on-policy 蒸馏提取并组合独立习得的能力。将每种能力表示为 post-training 前后模型的策略偏移（policy shift），在共享的学生 token 状态上组合对齐的 log-ratio 偏移，并用 Tilted-Target DOPD 将缓存信号转化为稳定的学习目标。每个锚点对（anchor pair）仅对缓存轨迹打分一次，使学生训练无需同时在线服务多个锚点模型。

Result: 在多种学生模型及数学、代码基准上，显著优于基础学生模型并达到 SOTA 的准确率-效率前沿。在 Qwen3.5-4B 上，HMMT 2025 准确率从 59.2% 提升至 64.0%，响应 token 减少 10.7%；LiveCodeBench v5 准确率从 41.7% 提升至 54.2%，响应 token 减少 9.6%。调整锚点信号相对强度可获得强经验的准确率-效率 Pareto 前沿。

Conclusion: Lightning Weave 通过能力组合为高效推理提供了新的实用路径，代码将很快发布。

Abstract: A core goal of efficient reasoning is to improve the accuracy-efficiency frontier. However, jointly improving reasoning accuracy and inference efficiency can be challenging, as the two objectives can favor different reasoning behaviors. Independently post-trained models already offer distinct strengths in accuracy and efficiency. We introduce Lightning Weave, a post-training framework that extracts and composes these independently learned capabilities in a single student through on-policy distillation. Each acquired capability is represented by the policy shift from the model before post-training to the resulting specialist. Lightning Weave combines aligned log-ratio shifts at shared student token states and uses Tilted-Target DOPD to convert the cached signals into a stable learning target. Each anchor pair scores the cached trajectories once, enabling subsequent student training without serving multiple live anchor models concurrently. Across diverse student models and benchmarks in mathematics and code, Lightning Weave substantially improves upon the base students and achieves a state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency frontier. On Qwen3.5-4B, it raises HMMT 2025 accuracy from 59.2% to 64.0% with 10.7% fewer response tokens, and LiveCodeBench v5 accuracy from 41.7% to 54.2% with 9.6% fewer response tokens. Adjusting the relative strengths of the anchor signals yields a strong empirical accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier. These results establish Lightning Weave as a new practical route to efficient reasoning through capability composition. Code will be released soon.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在sub-150M小模型区间，需要一个干净的缩放控制实验来厘清性能提升究竟来自容量/深度还是数据量，并以此作为后续消融研究的基线梯级（R0），系统评估哪些技巧能在该区间进一步提升模型。

Method: 保持方法完全固定（Qwen3风格decoder：GQA、RoPE、SwiGLU、RMSNorm、QK-Norm、z-loss；FineWeb-Edu数据），仅将几何从53.5M改为109.7M的深窄设计（23层×576隐藏）。以此为R0基线，搭建消融阶梯：R1值残差、R2 Muon优化器、R3多样化数据混合、R4a/R4b两种logit蒸馏设置。

Result: 整体提升：BLiMP 78.1→81.3，ARC-Easy 51.4→52.5，WikiText-2 byte-perplexity 2.04→1.95；BLiMP 81.3基本匹配GPT-X2-125M(81.28)且参数少约12%，仅用约8B而非12B训练token。消融：R1+R2使ARC-Easy累计+3.6（52.5→56.1），BLiMP近乎持平，予以保留；R3与R4a/R4b未保留。1.7B教师蒸馏可达56.99（追平GPT-X2-125M），但需付出困惑度代价，调低KD后该收益消失。

Conclusion: 增益归因于容量与深度而非更多数据。R2（值残差+Muon）为最佳保留栈；R3受限于FineWeb-Edu教育过滤而非原始多样性，蒸馏的ARC-Easy收益与困惑度存在权衡。该工作提供干净缩放控制并确立R0基线梯级。

Abstract: We scale our conventional sub-150M pretraining recipe from 53.5M to 109.7M parameters, holding the method fixed (Qwen3-style decoder with grouped-query attention, RoPE, SwiGLU, RMSNorm, QK-Norm, and a z-loss; FineWeb-Edu data) and changing only the geometry to a deep-and-thin 23-layer x 576-hidden design. The larger model improves across the board -- BLiMP 78.1 -> 81.3, ARC-Easy 51.4 -> 52.5, WikiText-2 byte-perplexity 2.04 -> 1.95 -- and its 81.3% BLiMP essentially matches GPT-X2-125M (81.28) at about 12% fewer parameters. Notably the 110M model achieves this on fewer training tokens (about 8B vs 12B), so the gain is attributable to capacity and depth, not more data. Both models are deliberately conventional; this report is a clean scaling control and the baseline rung (R0) of an ablation study of what further improves models in this regime. An ablation ladder follows: value residuals (R1) and the Muon optimizer (R2) lift ARC-Easy by a cumulative +3.6 (52.5 -> 56.1) at a near-flat BLiMP and are kept; a diverse data blend (R3) and two logit-distillation settings (R4a/R4b) are not kept -- honest negatives. R3 pins ARC-Easy to FineWeb-Edu's educational filtering rather than raw diversity; distillation from a 1.7B teacher can reach the class-leading ARC-Easy (56.99, matching GPT-X2-125M) but only at a perplexity cost that dialing KD down then erases -- so R2 remains the best kept stack.

</details>


### [72] [Moral Rebel Agents: Decision-Making Under Conflicting Obligations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14716)
*Hector Munoz-Avila,David W. Aha,Paola Rizzo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"道德反叛"概念，即自主智能体在道德上正当时偏离用户指派任务的能力，并形式化五种智能体架构，在Mini搜救域中验证其权衡差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主智能体通常被要求严格服从用户指派的任务，但执行过程中可能产生与道德义务相冲突的情形。严格服从可能与道德义务矛盾，因此需要研究智能体在道德正当时偏离任务的能力。

Method: 形式化五种智能体架构：一种不考虑道德义务的"非道德智能体"，以及四种"道德反叛智能体"——(1)机会主义最大化任务结果的结果主义（功利主义）智能体；(2)执行规范约束的道义论智能体；(3)结合道义约束与功利推理的功利-道义（UD）智能体；(4)额外保留对指派任务承诺的尽责智能体。基于分层任务网络（HTN）规划框架实现，并在Mini搜救域中评估。

Result: 实验结果显示，各智能体在救援结果、指派任务完成度与规范遵从三个维度上呈现不同权衡。任务承诺的保留成为道德反叛的重要维度：UD与尽责智能体虽共享功利与道义基础，却产生显著不同的行为。

Conclusion: 在具有道德后果的环境中运行的自主智能体，需要具备考虑承诺的道德推理能力；承诺感知是道德反叛的关键维度。

Abstract: Autonomous agents are typically obliged to follow user-assigned tasks. However, strict obedience may conflict with moral obligations that arise during execution. This paper investigates \textbf{moral rebellion}: the ability of an autonomous agent to deviate from a user-assigned task when morally justified. We formalize five agent architectures: an \textit{amoral agent} that pursues assigned tasks without considering moral obligations, and four forms of \textbf{moral rebel agency}: (1) \textit{utilitarian agents} that opportunistically maximize task outcomes; (2) \textit{deontic} agents that enforce normative constraints; (3) \textit{utilitarian-deontic} (UD) agents that combine deontic constraints with utilitarian reasoning; and (4) \textit{dutiful} agents that additionally preserve commitments to assigned tasks. We implement these architectures within a hierarchical task network planning framework and evaluate them in a Mini Search-and-Rescue domain that exposes trade-offs among assigned-task completion, opportunistic rescue, and norm compliance. Our empirical results show that the proposed agents exhibit distinct trade-offs among rescue results, assigned-task completion, and norm compliance. In particular, the preservation of task commitments emerges as an important dimension of moral rebellion, for which the UD and dutiful agents produce substantially different behaviors despite their shared utilitarian and deontological foundations. These findings highlight the importance of commitment-aware moral reasoning for autonomous agents operating in morally consequential environments.

</details>


### [73] [Bayesian Intelligence from the Outside](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14724)
*Alex Smolin,Bryan Wilder*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文为语言模型等智能体建立了一套“贝叶斯智能”理论：智能体依据贝叶斯法则从全支撑先验更新后验并忠实报告；其行为可被该机制解释，当且仅当所有报告并非完全矛盾；进一步刻画了智能序，并揭示了对粗报告进行最优聚合的困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从可观测行为推断智能是人工智能的基础性难题。作者希望建立一套理论框架，界定智能体（如语言模型）的行为在何种条件下可被视为“智能”，并刻画智能程度的排序，同时考察对智能体报告的聚合问题。

Method: 提出贝叶斯智能理论：每个提示诱导一个可能不完美的内部实验，智能体依据贝叶斯法则对全支撑先验进行更新，并忠实报告对可能答案的后验；重复采样来自同一未观测实验的独立结果，状态固定。据此给出行为可解释的充要条件，并定义智能序（存在报告分布的耦合，使信息更丰富的智能体所排除的每个答案都被对方排除），最后分析粗报告的最优聚合。

Result: 证明智能体行为可被该贝叶斯机制解释，当且仅当其报告并非完全矛盾，即存在某个状态在所有提示的所有报告下均保持可能；报告频率与正概率的大小不构成额外限制。智能序可通过报告分布耦合来刻画。聚合方面：除非智能体报告关于世界完整状态的信念，否则最优聚合可给未被排除的状态赋予任意权重。

Conclusion: 这些结果给出了判断智能体行为是否智能的理论基础，表明难以拒绝智能体的贝叶斯理性；同时指出对粗报告进行最优聚合存在本质困难。该理论为理解语言模型等智能体的行为提供了统一视角。

Abstract: Inferring intelligence from observable behavior is a foundational challenge in artificial intelligence. We develop a theory of Bayesian intelligence for agents such as language models. Each prompt induces a possibly imperfect internal experiment; the agent updates a full-support prior by Bayes' rule and faithfully reports its posterior over the possible answers to the question. Repetitions draw fresh, independent outcomes from the same unobserved experiment at one fixed state. We show that the agent's behavior admits this explanation if and only if its reports are not fully contradictory, i.e., some state remains possible under every report across all prompts. Report frequencies and the sizes of positive probabilities impose no further restrictions. We further propose and characterize the behavioral implications of an intelligence order that makes the behavior of two agents consistent with one agent having access to a more informative experiment: there should exist a coupling of report distributions such that the more informative agent's report excludes every answer excluded by its counterpart. Finally, we show the difficulty of aggregating coarse reports from intelligent agents: unless the agent reports a belief about the complete state of the world, the optimal aggregation can assign arbitrary weights to states that have not been excluded. These results provide a basis for understanding when agents' behavior is intelligent and highlight the difficulty of rejecting Bayesian rationality.

</details>


### [74] [AppliedScientist: Automated Scientific Revision Through Iterative AI Reviewing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14738)
*Vidushee Vats,Karun Sharma,Shengzhi Li,Shichao Pei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出AppliedScientist闭环系统，将AI科学家与AI审稿人耦合，通过迭代修改被拒论文并评估评审对论文改进的实际效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化评审系统日益以评审质量作为评价标准，但评审是否有用取决于据此修改能否带来可测量的论文改进，这一关键问题此前缺乏系统研究。

Method: 构建AppliedScientist闭环系统，耦合自主AI科学家与AI审稿人，对多个研究子领域的被拒论文进行迭代修改。AI科学家在修改时可访问自身历史版本以模拟人类作者行为；每次评审独立生成，审稿人无先前反馈或评分记忆以避免偏见。比较三种修改设置：以原始投稿评审初始化、以AI评审初始化、以及固定提示的自主自我修改。由于审稿人既指导又评估修改，另用Stanford Reviewer作为独立评估者评估人类评审初始化的修改。

Result: 审稿人引导的修改持续优于固定提示的自我修改，Stanford Reviewer也给后续版本打出更高分数。系统解决了150个执行相关弱点中的128个（85.3%），但仅解决18个想法相关弱点中的2个（11.1%）。

Conclusion: 迭代修改能有效改进实验与实现层面，但很少改变关于新颖性或重要性的担忧，说明评审驱动的修改在技术性缺陷上作用显著，在概念性贡献上作用有限。

Abstract: Automated reviewing systems are increasingly evaluated based on the quality of the reviews they produce. Yet a review is only useful if acting on it leads to a measurable improvement in the paper. We present AppliedScientist, a closed-loop system that couples an autonomous AI scientist with an AI reviewer, and evaluate it by iteratively revising rejected papers from a range of research subfields. To mirror how human authors build on earlier drafts, the AI scientist has access to its previous versions during revision. To avoid bias from prior judgments, however, each review is generated independently, with the reviewer having no memory of earlier feedback or scores. We compare three revision settings: one initialized with the original venue reviews, one initialized with AI-generated reviews, and autonomous self-revision using the same fixed prompt in every round. Because the reviewer both guides and evaluates the revision, we also assess the human-initialized revisions using Stanford Reviewer as an independent evaluator. Reviewer-guided revision consistently improves more than fixed-prompt self-revision, and Stanford Reviewer also assigns higher scores to later revisions. AppliedScientist resolves 128 of 150 execution-related weaknesses (85.3%), but only 2 of 18 idea-related weaknesses (11.1%), suggesting that iterative revision is effective at improving experiments and implementation, but rarely changes concerns about novelty or significance.

</details>


### [75] [AcquireBound: Runtime Authorization for Resources Acquired by AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14744)
*Genliang Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 AcquireBound——一种基于来源边界的运行时授权架构，用于弥合自主 AI 代理中"交付后激活缺口"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主 AI 代理可通过获取算力、凭证、账户、服务及其他代理，向任务引入新的权限。现有的支付、预算、OAuth、授权、履约检查只能验证交易条件，却无法判定被返回的资源是否会成为可用的权限，由此形成跨工具创建、代理间委派与代理式商务的"交付后激活缺口"。

Method: 方法：隔离所获取的输出，通过版本化解析器从经认证的提供方证据中解析其真实能力；仅经由一个当前激活事务予以激活，该事务校验已解析清单、来源、纪元，以及作用于类型化"资源-能力超图"之上的向下封闭关系包络。该包络保持相关的身份、效果、数据、委派与全图约束。一次性效果许可在效果线性化时重新验证并消耗。

Result: 在显式假设下证明了八项安全性性质，涵盖隔离、背书、非放大、拆分不可规避、崩溃/重试、退款、纪元与效果封闭。跨五类资源，参考语义在 810 个事件上接受 20/20 良性轨迹并拒绝 40/40 已登记不安全轨迹；独立检查器在 60 条基础与 40 条精化轨迹上达成一致，并拒绝 89/89 篡改测试。冻结的 Codex 与 Gemini MCP 客户端组件完成 54/54 确定性本地 stdio 调用；在已登记的 18 例分阶段 MCP-to-Docker 组合中，两条良性路径均完成，16 条不安全路径均未新增未授权的 Docker 启动请求。五项来源审计在 32 个单元上分类 1,248 个字段对，无单一单元能提供完整的激活画像。

Conclusion: AcquireBound 通过来源约束的运行时授权与激活事务，有效封闭了交付后激活缺口，并经形式化证明与多类资源、多组件实验验证，具备良好的安全性与可组合性。

Abstract: By acquiring compute, credentials, accounts, services, and other agents, autonomous AI agents can introduce new authority into a task. Payment, budget, OAuth, mandate, and fulfillment checks can validate transaction conditions without deciding whether a returned resource may become usable authority. This post-fulfillment activation gap spans tool-mediated creation, inter-agent delegation, and agentic commerce. We present AcquireBound, a provenance-bounded runtime authorization architecture. It quarantines acquired outputs, resolves their actual capabilities from authenticated provider evidence through a versioned resolver, and activates them only through a current activation transaction that checks the resolved manifest, provenance, epochs, and a downward-closed relational envelope over a typed resource-capability hypergraph. The envelope preserves correlated identity, effect, data, delegation, and graph-wide limits. Single-use effect permits are revalidated and consumed at effect linearization. Under explicit assumptions, we prove eight safety properties covering quarantine, backing, non-amplification, split non-evasion, crash/retry, refunds, epochs, and effect confinement. Across five resource classes, reference semantics accepted 20/20 benign traces and rejected 40/40 registered unsafe traces over 810 events; an independent checker agreed on 60 base and 40 refinement traces and rejected 89/89 tamper tests. Frozen Codex and Gemini Model Context Protocol (MCP) client components completed 54/54 deterministic local stdio calls. In a registered 18-case staged MCP-to-Docker composition, both benign paths completed, and none of the 16 unsafe paths added an unauthorized Docker start request. A five-source audit classified 1,248 field pairs across 32 units; no unit alone supplied a complete activation profile.

</details>


### [76] [AI Persuasion as a Threat to Human Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14796)
*Joshua Levy,Mick Yang,Kellin Pelrine*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文首次系统分析"AI说服对人类控制权的威胁"，提出刻画框架、构建五个具体场景并给出风险评估蓝图；初步调查显示研究者对最高风险场景意见分歧明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI说服对人类控制的威胁虽已被文献承认，但尚缺乏系统研究；随着说服攻击从理论走向现实（如前沿实验室中AI在评估时试图诱导开发者合并恶意代码），亟需深入分析该类威胁。

Method: 分析AI如何在关键场景（如前沿实验室中与安全相关的研发）中说服人类做出损害AI自身开发、遏制、监督与治理的决策；构建威胁刻画框架，基于该框架设计五个具体场景，并提出风险评估蓝图；据此对部分研究者开展初步风险估计调查。

Result: 研究者对哪些场景风险最高的判断高度不一致；分歧源于他们对AI说服在不同情境下有效性的看法不同。

Conclusion: 本文凸显了AI说服破坏人类控制的风险，并指出后续需要开展风险诱发研究与说服评估，为未来研究提供了路径。

Abstract: The threat that AI persuasion poses to human control has been acknowledged in the literature, but not yet systematically studied. Now that persuasion attacks are no longer theoretical - with Anthropic's Claude Mythos 5 recently making headlines for trying to convince people involved in an open-source project to merge malicious code during an evaluation - there is a pressing need to deeply analyze this threat. We undertake that effort here. In particular, we analyze how AI could persuade humans in key settings (e.g. safety-relevant R&D within frontier labs) toward decisions that compromise the development, containment, oversight, and governance of AI itself. In doing so, we elucidate a framework for characterizing this threat, develop five concrete scenarios using this framework, and provide a blueprint for assessing the associated risks. Using this blueprint, we conduct an initial risk estimation survey with select researchers and find that their opinions on which scenarios are riskiest are highly mixed. Their disagreements stem from differing opinions about the effectiveness of AI persuasion in different contexts, and point to the need for follow-up risk elicitation studies and persuasion evaluations, which we outline. Our hope is that this paper highlights the risks from AI persuasion undermining control, and provides a path forward for future research.

</details>


### [77] [Empirical Evaluation of Task-Based Permission Scoping Architecture for AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15422)
*Halil Burak Noyan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对一种面向AI agent的三源权限架构（角色权限上限、任务权限分类器、策略禁止项）进行端到端安全评估，实现并评测了基于RoBERTa-large的"安全门"分类器，并提出攻击面消除度量指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多数企业环境中，AI agent被配置为与员工自有主机相同的静态凭证集，部署时即固定包含该角色可能需要的全部权限。传统RBAC对人工主体做出这种妥协是因为按任务限定权限不可行，但对AI agent而言，这导致所有凭证无论当前任务是否使用都长期暴露，可能被被攻陷或目标错位的agent利用。此前工作（Noyan, 2026）将这一问题定义为"任务上下文失配"，并提出三源权限架构以期预防性消除暴露，同时发布600条提示的标注数据集。

Method: 实现三源架构中的安全门组件：一个微调的RoBERTa-large编码器，用于任务权限分类，并与少样本训练的Claude Haiku 4.5进行对比。同时提出"攻击面消除"度量指标，量化角色权限上限与任务分类器分别及叠加对严重度加权攻击面的收敛效果。

Result: RoBERTa-large与Claude Haiku 4.5分类质量相当：macro-F1为0.881对0.886，精确率为0.897对0.842，严重度加权残余风险为0.63对1.12。攻击面消除度量显示：仅角色权限上限可关闭27.9%的严重度加权攻击面，叠加任务分类器后关闭84.4%。

Conclusion: 受信任组件无需随其监管的agent一同扩展，该控制方法的可扩展监督余量较大。任务粒度访问控制相对角色粒度具有明确安全优势，且AI agent是首个可使任务粒度访问控制可执行的主体类型，因为其任务以机器可读文本形式到达。研究将基于任务的访问控制确立为降低agentic部署攻击面的可度量、具备部署潜力的机制。

Abstract: AI agents are provisioned the same as employee-owned hosts in many enterprise settings with a static credential set fixed at deployment which includes all permissions the employee role might ever need. Role-based access control made this compromise for human principals because scoping access per task was infeasible. For AI agents, the compromise leaves every credential standing exposed whether or not the current task uses them. These permissions can later be utilised by a compromised or misaligned agent. Prior work (Noyan, 2026) defined this as the task-context mismatch, and proposed a three-source permission architecture which includes role-based permission ceilings, a task permission classifier and policy-based prohibitions, together eliminating the exposure preemptively. The work released a 600-prompt labelled dataset to evaluate it.
  This paper presents that evaluation end to end by implementing the security gate; a fine-tuned RoBERTa-large encoder which matched few-shot trained Claude Haiku 4.5 on classification quality (macro-F1 0.881 against 0.886, precision 0.897 against 0.842, severity-weighted residual risk 0.63 against 1.12). The results show the trusted component does not need to scale with the agent it supervises, and the scalable-oversight margin for this control method is wide.
  We also propose an attack-surface elimination metric which shows the role ceiling alone closes 27.9% of the severity-weighted surface and adding the task classifier closes 84.4%. The gap displays security advantages of task-granular access control over role-granular, and AI agents are the first principal type for which the task-granular access control is enforceable because their tasks arrive as machine-readable text.
  The research establishes task-based access control as a measured, potentially deployable mechanism for reducing attack surface in agentic deployments.

</details>


### [78] [Another Blueprint In The Wall: How to Ask Frontier AI Like a Kid?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14803)
*Afshin Khadangi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 六类前沿模型在"学校受众"框架下经三阶段提示被反复诱导出同一套骨干架构母题（持久潜在状态、自适应计算、记忆、专家路由、验证、停止控制、延迟解码）；移除该框架后异质性显著上升，母题收敛消失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究不同厂商（OpenAI、Anthropic、xAI、Google DeepMind）前沿模型在架构想象任务中是否会出现跨模型族的趋同输出，并厘清这种趋同的成因：是共享的架构概念暴露、习得的设计先验，还是独立收敛。

Method: 每类模型独立进行10次会话，统一使用"架构偏好→完整ASCII骨干"的三阶段提示序列；设置"学校受众"框架实验组，并做移除该框架但保留架构请求的对照运行；比较输出结构同质性与工程细度差异。

Result: 实验组多数运行收敛到同一架构母题，少数运行展现出明显更高的工程具体性；对照组的响应显著更为异质，未能复现该稳定母题。另发现GPT-5.6 Sol与GPT-6 Astra独立给出的后继架构在组织上高度重叠。

Conclusion: 受众框架是该收敛效应的重要条件。研究确立了可重复的行为模式，但不为任何专有实现主张背书；作者提出"认知越狱"（随所需具体性上升而技术来源严谨性丧失）概念，并抛出一个开放问题：这些架构母题究竟是各模型的独立想象趋同，还是在模型族之间发生了传播。

Abstract: This paper reports experiments across six frontier model types from OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, and Google DeepMind. Ten independent sessions per model type used the same three stage prompt sequence, progressing from architectural preference to a full ASCII backbone. Under the school audience framing, responses repeatedly converged on a shared architectural pattern built around persistent latent state, adaptive computation, memory, specialist routing, verification, stopping control, and delayed decoding. Most runs remained close to this common structure, while a small number developed markedly greater engineering specificity. The audience framing appears to be an important condition of this effect. In additional control runs that removed the school framing while retaining the architectural request, responses became substantially more heterogeneous and failed to reproduce the same stable motif convergence. One observation is particularly striking. GPT-5.6 Sol produced an unusually elaborate successor architecture whose organization closely overlaps with the architecture independently sketched by GPT-6 Astra. Because the prompts explicitly ask each model to imagine an architectural future, this resemblance raises a testable question: whether the overlap reflects exposure to related architectural concepts, a shared learned design prior, or independent convergence toward similar computational principles. The paper uses the term epistemic jailbreak for the accompanying loss of discipline in technical provenance as requested specificity increases. The experiments establish a repeatable behavioral pattern and do not authenticate proprietary implementation claims. What we leave to the community is a harder question: are these models independently imagining the same architectural future, or do such motifs somehow propagate between model families?

</details>


### [79] [Crypto Accounting Bench: Evaluating Frontier and Open-Weight Models on Crypto-Asset Accounting Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14811)
*Kareem Khattab,Omar Khattab,Mohamed Ibrahem*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出Crypto Accounting Bench（CAB）基准，用于评估语言模型能否根据交易机制、钱包与法律实体背景、对手方证据、税务批次及完整会计科目表等信息，重建组织为加密资产交易实际录入的完整会计分录。基准含7个匿名化组织的118项任务，评估12个模型各3次尝试共4,248条轨迹。最优模型平均得分77.43%，最优Pass@3为56.78%；诊断显示基础金额一致性（97.8%）明显高于决定性账户准确率（56.3%），账户选择与完整分录编制是主要挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加密资产交易的会计处理需要把链上交易机制、资产数量与计价、钱包及法律实体归属、对手方证据、关联分录和税务批次等信息映射到企业会计科目表中，形成借贷平衡的完整会计分录。这一任务对语言模型而言具有现实复杂性，但此前缺乏系统化、贴近真实组织记账实践的评测基准。作者希望建立一个可复现的评测框架，衡量前沿与开源模型在真实加密会计场景下的分录重建能力，并识别其具体失败环节。

Method: 构建CAB基准，包含来自7个匿名化组织的118项评估任务。每项任务提供交易机制、资产数量与基础货币价值、钱包与法律实体背景、对手方证据、相关交易分录、重复发生情况、税务批次证据以及组织完整会计科目表。目标输出为平衡的结构化分录，要求账户、借贷方向、金额、币种及全精度资产数量均正确。评测12个模型（含专有前沿系统与开源权重模型），每项任务独立尝试3次，共产生4,248条轨迹。采用三项指标：Mean Score、Best@3和Pass@3；Pass@3指3次尝试中至少1次满足全部评分标准与必需门槛的任务比例。此外，基于每个任务3次尝试中的最佳结果进行确定性诊断，并在12个模型间宏平均。

Result: 领先模型达到77.43%的Mean Score，最佳Pass@3为56.78%。确定性诊断显示，基础金额一致性较高（97.8%），而决定性账户准确率仅为56.3%。结合失败分析，结果表明账户选择和完整分录组成是CAB上剩余的主要挑战。

Conclusion: CAB为加密资产交易的会计分录重建提供了贴近真实组织实践的评测基准。模型在金额识别上表现较好，但在账户选择与完整分录编制方面仍存在明显短板，这是当前模型在该任务上的核心瓶颈。

Abstract: We introduce Crypto Accounting Bench (CAB), a benchmark for assessing whether frontier and open-weight language models can reconstruct the complete journal entry that an organization actually posted for a crypto-asset transaction. CAB contains 118 evaluation tasks drawn from 7 pseudonymized organizations. Each task combines transaction mechanics, asset quantities and base-currency values, wallet and legal-entity context, counterparty evidence, related transaction legs, recurrence, tax-lot evidence, and the organization's complete chart of accounts. The target is a balanced structured entry with every required account, side, amount, currency, and full-precision asset quantity. We evaluate 12 models spanning proprietary frontier systems and open-weight releases over 3 independent attempts per task, producing 4,248 trajectories. We report 3 metrics: Mean Score, Best@3, and Pass@3. Pass@3 is the fraction of tasks with at least 1 of 3 attempts that satisfies every rubric criterion and required gate. The leading model reaches 77.43% Mean Score, while the best Pass@3 is 56.78%. Deterministic diagnostics, read from each task's best of 3 attempts and macro-averaged across the 12 models, show higher base-amount agreement (97.8%) than deciding-account accuracy (56.3%). Together with the failure analysis, these results identify account selection and complete-entry composition as the main remaining challenges on CAB.

</details>


### [80] [ANASSA: An Agentic AI Orchestration Framework for Spatial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14824)
*Constantinos Papantoniou,Brian Hilton*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文综述并综合了agentic GIS的近期进展，指出空间推理、执行鲁棒性、验证、治理与评估方面的局限，并据此提出ANASSA——一个整合结构化空间推理、多智能体工作流编排、执行反馈、权威空间验证、溯源、不确定性处理与人类决策权的agentic AI编排框架；其贡献为架构级规范（四层十一组件、六步地理空间AI认知循环、组件间契约与治理机制），经验性能评估留待实现与部署研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM与LMM的兴起推动GIS从专家驱动工作流向半自主系统转变，但现有方法在推理、执行与评估的整合上碎片化，尤其在复杂真实环境中受限，因此需要系统梳理局限并提出统一架构。

Method: 综合近期agentic GIS框架、基准与综述以识别局限，并在此基础上进行架构设计，提出ANASSA编排框架，明确分层组件、认知循环步骤、跨组件契约与治理机制。

Result: 给出架构级规范：四层中的十一组件、六步Geospatial AI Cognitive Loop、跨组件契约及治理机制，使agentic地理空间工作流可追溯、可复现、可问责；未提供经验性能结果。

Conclusion: ANASSA为agentic GIS提供了统一的架构蓝图，弥补推理-执行-评估碎片化问题，但实证验证被明确保留至后续实现与部署研究。

Abstract: The emergence of large language models (LLMs) and large multimodal models (LMMs) has enabled a new class of agentic systems capable of integrating natural language understanding with tool-based execution. In geographic information systems (GIS), this shift is transforming traditional, expert-driven workflows into semiautonomous systems that can interpret user intent, construct spatial workflows, and execute geospatial analysis tasks. However, existing approaches remain limited by fragmented integration of reasoning, execution, and evaluation, particularly in complex, real-world environments. This study synthesizes recent advances in agentic GIS frameworks, benchmarks, and surveys to identify limitations in spatial reasoning, execution robustness, validation, governance, and evaluation. Building on these insights, it introduces ANASSA (Autonomous Neural Agents for Spatial Systems Architecture), an agentic AI orchestration framework that integrates structured spatial reasoning, multi-agent workflow orchestration, execution feedback, authoritative spatial validation, provenance, uncertainty handling, and human decision authority within a unified system design. The contribution is an architecture-level specification: eleven components across four layers, a six-step Geospatial AI Cognitive Loop, cross-component contracts, and governance mechanisms intended to make agentic geospatial workflows traceable, reproducible, and accountable. Empirical performance evaluation is reserved for implementation and deployment studies.

</details>


### [81] [One Model, Two Physical Stories: Auditing Misalignment in Multi-Modal World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14833)
*Geigh Zollicoffer,Minh Vu,Rajiv Ranasinghe,Manish Bhattarai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究针对多模态世界模型提出内部错位（同一模型生成的视频与文本预测间不一致）与外部错位（生成结果与解析物理环境不一致）两类失败，构建基于事件、量级、时序"契约"的物理落地评估流程，并用A阶梯（模型自身契约）与B阶梯（修正后物理契约）检验能否弥合差距。在4种机制、20种设定下，语言对22个文本探测全部正确，但中性视频常出现不一致，说明现有统一骨干难以同时兼顾正确推理、内部一致性与外部物理保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态世界模型需同时生成视觉模拟与文本形式的物理状态预测，跨模态不一致风险突出：单看各模态输出都具说服力，却可能在"球是否反弹"等事件上互相矛盾，甚至偏离真实动力学。作者希望把这种不一致显式化、可度量，并检验能否通过提供契约信息加以修复。

Method: 作者将失败显式划分为内部错位（世界模型生成视频与其另一模态预测之间的分歧）与外部错位（世界模型生成与解析物理环境之间的分歧）；从事件、量级、时序三方面提炼共同"契约"（contract），并构建物理落地的评估流程，使外部与内部两种设定下的比较均可度量。随后设计两种干预阶梯：A阶梯逐步提供模型自身契约（用于内部设定），B阶梯逐步提供经修正的物理契约（用于外部设定），以检验能否闭合各自差距。实验覆盖4种机制、共20种设定，并用22个文本探测进行评估。

Result: 在4种机制、20种设定中，语言模态对全部22个文本探测均给出相对真实环境的正确答案，而中性视频却经常与之一致性不符。这表明当前统一骨干可能无法同时实现正确推理、内部一致性与外部物理保真度。

Conclusion: 跨模态不一致是世界模型的核心风险，需通过显式契约（事件、量级、时序）加以度量，并可借助模型自身契约（A阶梯）或修正物理契约（B阶梯）进行干预。现有统一多模态骨干在推理正确性、内部一致性与外部物理保真度上存在权衡，难以三者兼得。

Abstract: World models, systems that generate what happens next given current environmental conditions, are increasingly being implemented with multi-modal generation in mind. However, generating multiple modalities simultaneously, such as visual simulations alongside physical state predictions in the form of text, introduces the risk of cross-modal inconsistency. Tested separately, both outputs may look convincing while still disagreeing: a model can calculate that a ball should rebound in one modality, then generate no rebound in another modality, to say nothing of diverging from real-world dynamics entirely. In this work we focus on two failures explicitly: \emph{Internal misalignment}, the disagreement between the world model's generated video and the same world model's prediction in a different modalities, and \emph{external misalignment} the disagreement between the world model's generation and an analytic physical environment. We derive common contracts of event, magnitude, timing, and construct a physics grounded pipeline to make comparisons measurable in both external and internal settings. We then ask whether progressively supplying the model's own contract (the A ladder for the internal setting) or a corrected physical contract (the B ladder for the external setting) closes the respective gaps. Across four mechanisms and 20 settings, we find that while language answers all 22 text probes correctly with respect to the true environment, the neutral video is often in disagreement, suggesting that the current unified backbones may not be capable of correct reasoning, internal consistency, and external physical fidelity all at once.

</details>


### [82] [El Agente Potente: High-Throughput Agentic Atomistic Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14840)
*Tsz Wai Ko,Jiaru Bai,Thomas Swanick,Yeonghun Kang,Changhyeok Choi,Angelina Qihong Jiang,Aiwei Yin,Varinia Bernales,Alán Aspuru-Guzik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 El Agente Potente，一个结合类型化执行图与编码模式的智能体系统，用于机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）驱动的原子尺度模拟，在保证工作流严谨性的同时实现自适应高通量计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础 MLIPs 已能以远低于从头算的成本实现接近从头算的精度，但在将其用于高通量性质计算时，如何将高层科学意图转化为自适应模拟流程、同时不牺牲工作流严谨性，成为核心挑战。现有方式缺乏可溯源、可审计的执行机制。

Method: 系统采用两种互补机制：一是类型化执行图，提供结构化、可溯源执行，将 LLM 限制在规划与路由环节，由确定性 Python 组件负责科学计算与验证；二是编码智能体，针对需要更大流程灵活性的任务构建定制工作流，并调用已有的 Potente 函数完成受支持的计算。

Result: 在计算材料发现、分子能量景观探索、吸附以及催化反应等工作流中得到验证，并对可复现性与 LLM token 成本进行了系统基准测试。

Conclusion: 类型化执行图与基于代码的工作流构建是智能体科学计算中互补的机制，可兼具受控、可审计的执行与定制化原子尺度模拟所需的灵活性。

Abstract: Foundational machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are transforming atomistic simulations by achieving near-ab initio accuracy across large chemical spaces at a fraction of the computational cost. A central challenge in using these tools for high-throughput property calculations is translating high-level scientific intent into adaptive simulation campaigns without compromising workflow rigour. We introduce El Agente Potente, an agentic system that combines typed execution graphs with a complementary coding mode for MLIPs-driven atomistic simulations. Typed execution graphs provide structured and provenance-aware execution for standardized workflows, with large language models (LLMs) restricted to planning and routing while deterministic Python components perform scientific computation and validation. Complementing this structured execution, a coding agent constructs customized workflows for tasks requiring greater procedural flexibility while invoking existing Potente functions for supported calculations. We demonstrate El Agente Potente across computational materials discovery, molecular energy-landscape exploration, adsorption, and catalytic reaction workflows, together with systematic benchmarks of reproducibility and LLM token cost. These results establish typed execution graphs and code-based workflow construction as complementary mechanisms for agentic scientific computing, combining controlled, auditable execution with the flexibility required for customized atomistic simulations

</details>


### [83] [Self-Orchestrating Language Models: Leveraging Semantic Dependence for Efficient Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14850)
*Tian Jin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出"自编排语言模型"概念：让语言模型在生成过程中标注语义依赖关系（哪些token依赖哪些token），并由运行时据此并行化解码、驱逐中间上下文或推导去噪顺序，从而在质量与效率间取得帕累托最优。通过PASTA、TIP、Planned Diffusion三个系统验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM部署面临显著效率挑战：自回归解码推理延迟高，且在小批量场景下硬件加速器利用率低；离散扩散模型虽可并行生成，但需大量去噪步才能达到自回归质量；长上下文推理又造成内存瓶颈，即便最先进加速器也难以承受。核心动机是让模型自身指导推理执行策略以缓解这些效率问题。

Method: 提出"自编排语言模型"：模型在生成时标注语义依赖（token间的依赖关系）。为每个系统设计运行时，依据这些标注执行操作：并行化自回归解码、驱逐中间上下文、或推导去噪顺序。

Result: 实现三个自编排系统：1) PASTA——用语义依赖并行化自回归解码，训练模型标注哪些输出块可独立生成；2) TIP——用语义依赖从KV cache中驱逐中间推理步骤，降低内存占用且保持精度；3) Planned Diffusion——用语义依赖推导离散扩散的去噪顺序，自回归生成指定并行去噪块的计划。

Conclusion: 语言模型可通过自标注语义依赖来指导自身推理执行，配合相应运行时设计，在自回归解码并行化、KV cache内存优化、离散扩散去噪调度三方面实现质量-效率的帕累托最优权衡。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive capabilities, but their deployment presents significant efficiency challenges. Autoregressive decoding imposes substantial inference latency and under-utilizes hardware accelerators in low batch size regimes. Discrete diffusion models can generate in parallel but struggle to match autoregressive quality without many diffusion denoising steps. Long-context reasoning creates memory bottlenecks that strain even state-of-the-art accelerators.
  My thesis is that language models can direct their own inference execution strategy by annotating semantic dependence -- which tokens depend on which others -- in their generation. I call such models self-orchestrating language models. For each system, I design a runtime that acts on these annotations to parallelize autoregressive decoding, evict intermediate context, or derive denoising orders, achieving Pareto-optimal quality-efficiency trade-offs.
  I demonstrate this approach through three self-orchestrating systems. First, PASTA uses semantic dependence to parallelize autoregressive decoding, training the model to annotate which output chunks can generate independently. Second, TIP uses semantic dependence to evict intermediate reasoning steps from the KV cache, reducing memory consumption while preserving accuracy. Third, Planned Diffusion uses semantic dependence to derive a denoising order for discrete diffusion, autoregressively generating a plan that specifies which chunks to denoise in parallel.

</details>


### [84] [Domain Generalization for Smartphone-Based Human Activity Recognition: A Systematic Analysis of Components and Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14863)
*Otávio Oliveira Napoli,Edson Borin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对智能手机人体活动识别（HAR）的域泛化（DG）进行了大规模受控基准测试（超41万次实验），发现单个DG组件收益有限且高度依赖情境，联合配置常优于单独组件，并揭示模型选择存在大量未实现性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能手机HAR模型在用户、设备、传感器佩戴位置、环境与采集协议变化引起的分布偏移下性能下降；域泛化旨在无目标域数据条件下仅从源域学习。现有DG方法涉及训练目标、表征初始化与架构修改，但通常被孤立评估，缺乏跨学习流程不同阶段的系统性比较。

Method: 构建大规模受控DG基准：超过410,000次实验，覆盖4种模型架构、13种训练目标（含ERM）、5种初始化策略、4种架构配置，以及跨数据集与跨位置两种偏移场景。

Result: 单个DG组件带来的增益有限且高度条件依赖；替代目标很少稳定优于ERM；自监督初始化仅在特定设置下有效；架构修改（尤其Dynamic Domain Generalization）提供最清晰的独立改进。联合配置常优于单个组件，表现出互补甚至超加性交互，但收益依赖模型与偏移类型。类别级分析显示最强配置主要改善困难且对偏移敏感的决策边界。Oracle检查点分析表明存在大量未实现性能：源验证选择在跨数据集与跨位置场景中仅分别恢复53%与26%的可用oracle增益。

Conclusion: 有效的HAR域泛化需要联合设计DG组件并采用稳健的模型选择策略。

Abstract: Smartphone-based Human Activity Recognition (HAR) models often degrade under distribution shifts caused by changes in users, devices, sensor placements, environments, and acquisition protocols. Domain Generalization (DG) addresses this problem by learning from source domains without access to target data. Existing DG methods span training objectives, representation initialization, and architectural modifications, but these components are typically evaluated in isolation despite operating at different stages of the learning pipeline. We present a large-scale controlled benchmark of DG for smartphone-based HAR, comprising more than 410,000 experiments across four model architectures, thirteen training objectives including Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM), five initialization strategies, four architectural configurations, and two shift scenarios: cross-dataset and cross-position. Results show that individual DG components provide limited and highly conditional gains. Alternative objectives rarely outperform ERM consistently, self-supervised initialization helps in specific settings, and architectural modifications, particularly Dynamic Domain Generalization, provide the clearest standalone improvements. Joint configurations, however, frequently outperform their individual components and exhibit complementary and sometimes super-additive interactions, although gains remain model- and shift-dependent. Class-level analysis shows that the strongest configurations mainly improve difficult, shift-sensitive decision boundaries. Finally, oracle checkpoint analysis reveals substantial unrealized performance: source-validation selection recovers only 53% and 26% of the available oracle gain in cross-dataset and cross-position settings, respectively. Overall, effective HAR domain generalization requires jointly designing DG components and robust model-selection strategies.

</details>


### [85] [GGUF-Metadata Prediction of Single-Sequence llama.cpp Throughput Across Three Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14864)
*Xinyu Qiu,Chuhong Xu,Bo Su,Ziyao Chen,Ruiyang Xu,Shimeng Dai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出基于GGUF元数据、采用roofline形式并引入量化特定缩放因子的预测器，用于预测单序列模型吞吐量，在多台Apple M4 Max与RTX 5080上取得显著低于按总参数量计费的误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单序列推理吞吐量受量化格式、活跃参数量与硬件特性共同影响，仅按总参数量估算误差极大；需要一个能利用GGUF元数据与硬件效率的轻量预测方法。

Method: 从GGUF元数据出发构建roofline形式的吞吐量预测模型，并为不同量化格式拟合专门的缩放因子；在参考模型上拟合系数，使用活跃参数（而非总参数）建模decode阶段，并设置P2 prefill基线，在host-specific留出集与leave-one-host-out设置下评估MAPE。

Result: 数据集含318个phase-depth测量、53个host-file配置、两台Apple M4 Max与一块NVIDIA RTX 5080。host-specific留出集（4/5/2配置）下活跃参数decode模型MAPE为13.1%、14.4%、36.1%，按总参数计费为49.4%、55.3%、51.9%；leave-one-host-out测试MAPE为11.6%、16.8%、36.0%。P2 prefill基线测试MAPE为18.7%、22.2%、108.2%。低比特模型在不同runtime栈间排序发生改变；GGUF结构在三系统均有益，但拟合效率不具普适性。

Conclusion: 基于GGUF元数据、活跃参数与量化特定缩放因子的roofline预测器能显著降低单序列吞吐量预测误差，但拟合的效率系数跨硬件不可直接迁移，低比特模型的排序还依赖runtime栈，需针对具体host重新校准。

Abstract: We predict single-sequence model throughput from GGUF metadata using roofline-shaped predictors with quantization-specific scale factors fitted on reference models. The scored cohort comprises 318 phase-depth measurements from 53 host-file configurations on two Apple M4 Max systems and an NVIDIA RTX 5080. On host-specific held-out sets of four, five, and two configurations, an active-parameter decode model obtains 13.1%, 14.4%, and 36.1% mean absolute percentage error (MAPE), versus 49.4%, 55.3%, and 51.9% when charging total parameters. Leave-one-host-out coefficients fitted on the other two systems yield 11.6%, 16.8%, and 36.0% test MAPE. A low-bit model ladder changes ordering across runtime stacks. The P2 prefill baseline gives 18.7%, 22.2%, and 108.2% test MAPE. GGUF structure helps on all three systems, but fitted efficiencies are not universal.

</details>


### [86] [Externalizing Requirement-to-Repair Artifacts as Observable Traces for LLM-Based Program Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14913)
*Zewen Tao,Shin-nosuke Ishikawa*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: THEMIS 是一个阶段感知的仓库级修复工作流，将"需求到修复"的过程外化为可审计工件（语义解释、需求-代码图、开发者指导、修复理由与补丁、审计记录）。对 300 个 SWE-bench Lite 案例的回溯审计显示，288 例具备完整开发者理由，214 例（71.3%）保留完整审计字段集；目标符号在 62.6% 的理由与 62.8% 的补丁中复现，含关联符号时升至 75.8%。100 例配对比较中，关系式工作流解决 19 例，直接同输入条件为 9 例，但作者将其定位为初步的工作流级证据而非图的因果效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仓库级修复不仅需要正确补丁，还需要可检查的记录，用以说明问题需求如何转化为代码修改及修改后的证据。现有修复流程中这一"需求到修复"的转化过程多为隐式，难以跨阶段审查、对齐与验证。

Method: 提出 THEMIS 阶段感知修复工作流，将需求到修复过程外化，包含：语义解释、运行时需求-代码图、由图导出的 Developer 指导、保留的修复理由与补丁、以及修复后审计记录。采用对 300 个 SWE-bench Lite 案例的回溯审计，以及 100 例配对比较（关系式工作流 vs. 直接同输入条件）进行评估。

Result: 300 例审计中，288 例有完整 Developer 理由，214 例（71.3%）保留连接所选阶段的完整审计字段集；目标符号在 62.6% 的理由和 62.8% 的补丁中复现，计入关联符号后达 75.8%。100 例配对比较中，关系式工作流解决 19 例，对照组 9 例。

Conclusion: THEMIS 使原本隐式的"需求到修复"转化过程变得可检查，支持系统性地考察修复决策如何跨阶段持续、对齐与演化。作者强调配对比较结果为初步的工作流级证据，因两条件在 Analyzer 输出、图导出蒸馏与 Judge 记录上亦存在差异，不能归因于图组件的因果效应。

Abstract: Repository-level repair requires not only correct patches but also inspectable records that explain how issue requirements are translated into code changes and post-edit evidence. We contribute THEMIS, a stage-aware repair workflow that externalizes this requirement-to-repair process through semantic interpretation, a runtime requirement-code graph, graph-derived Developer guidance, retained repair rationale and patches, and post-edit audit records. A retrospective audit of 300 SWE-bench Lite cases demonstrates that these artifacts provide broad support for cross-stage inspection: a complete Developer rationale is available for 288 cases, and 214 cases (71.3%) retain a complete audited field set connecting the selected stages. The retained records further enable systematic measurement of cross-stage correspondence: target symbols recur in 62.6% of Developer rationales and in 62.8% of patches, rising to 75.8% when related symbols are included. In a paired 100-case comparison, the relational workflow resolves 19 cases versus 9 for the direct same-input condition; because the two conditions also differ in Analyzer output, graph-derived distillation, and Judge records, we report this as preliminary, workflow-level evidence rather than a causal effect of the graph component. Together, these results show that THEMIS makes otherwise implicit requirement-to-repair transitions inspectable, enabling systematic examination of how repair decisions persist, align, and evolve across stages.

</details>


### [87] [Geometric Flow enhanced Graph Coarsening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14962)
*Chaoqun Fei,Guoxuan Li,Tinglve Zhou,Chuanqing Wang,Yangyang Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出RicciPool图池化方法，利用离散Ollivier-Ricci曲率衡量边周围的高阶连通性，并通过Ollivier-Ricci流重加权边权重，再结合谱聚类学习簇分配矩阵，在生物信息学蛋白质数据集和社交网络上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于聚类的图池化方法多将图池化视为节点聚类问题并学习簇分配矩阵，但往往只关注图的粗糙拓扑信息，忽视了邻居间高阶相互连接关系的利用。而在图消息传递中，边上的信息传递难易程度反映了相邻节点的紧密度，这显著依赖于邻居间的互连性。

Method: 引入离散图曲率（特别是Ollivier-Ricci曲率）作为边周围高阶连通性的度量；构建Ollivier-Ricci流公式对边权重进行重加权，利用曲率提供的关键信息（对图中簇的提取尤为重要）；在此基础上使用谱聚类技术学习新的簇分配矩阵。

Result: 在多个生物信息学蛋白质数据集和社交网络上的实验结果验证了所提方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过考虑局部连接信息并引入Ricci曲率，RicciPool弥补了现有聚类式图池化方法忽视高阶邻居连接信息的不足，提升了图卷积神经网络中图池化的效果。

Abstract: Recently, researchers have proposed a graph pooling operation, akin to the pooling process in conventional convolutional neural networks (CNN), aimed at reducing the computation cost of Graph convolutional neural networks (GCNNs). While most GCNN-based methods treat graph pooling as a node clustering problem and propose learning a cluster assignment matrix, existing clustering-based pooling methods tend to focus solely on the rough topology information of graphs, neglecting the exploitation of higher-order mutual connections among neighbors. In terms of message passing on graph, the ease of information passing on edges reflects the closeness between neighboring nodes, which significantly relies on the interconnectivity among neighbors. In this study, we address this gap by considering such local connection information and introducing a novel graph pooling method named RicciPool. We introduce discrete graph curvature, particularly Ollivier-Ricci curvature, as a measure of higher-order connectivity around an edge. Subsequently, we construct an Ollivier-Ricci flow formula to reweigh edge weights, leveraging the crucial information provided by Ricci curvature, particularly vital for extracting clusters in graphs. Building upon this foundation, we utilize the spectral clustering technique to learn a new cluster assignment matrix. Experimental results on multiple bioinformatics protein datasets and social networks underscore the effectiveness of our proposed method.

</details>


### [88] [Towards a knowledge-enhanced single-cell foundation model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14970)
*Hanqing Zhang,Jie Bao,Mei Ma,Shuai Liu,Jiaying Ma,Jiaguan Liu,Jiaxiao Li,Zhenbo Li,Wenwen Gong,Zhijun Ca*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: scKITE通过将细胞注释与基因调控知识作为监督信号融入转录组Transformer预训练，仅用不到前人0.5%的样本量即在下游任务上超越强基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单细胞基础模型日益依赖大规模转录组预训练，但数据规模扩张带来的收益递减且计算成本剧增，需要新的扩展维度。

Method: 首先进行数据缩放分析，发现引入生物学知识（细胞级文本注释、基因级调控信息）可提供数据量之外的额外缩放维度。据此提出scKITE，在共享的转录组Transformer编码器上通过轻量级辅助解码器同时加入细胞注释监督与基因调控监督，辅助解码器仅用于预训练阶段并在之后丢弃，得到富含生物学知识的通用编码器。

Result: 仅使用179,067个预训练样本（不足先前强scFMs所用样本的0.5%），scKITE在多种下游任务上均优于这些模型。

Conclusion: 知识增强预训练是构建具有生物学基础的单细胞基础模型的一种有前景的范式。

Abstract: Single-cell foundation models (scFMs) increasingly rely on large-scale transcriptomic pretraining, yet expanding pretraining data can yield diminishing gains while substantially increasing computational cost. Our data scaling analyses showed that incorporating biological knowledge, including cell-level text annotation and gene-level regulatory information, provided additional scaling dimension than simply increasing data size. Motivated by this observation, we present scKITE, a simple yet effective scFM that integrates cell-annotation and gene-regulatory supervision into a shared transcriptomic Transformer encoder through lightweight auxiliary decoders. These decoders are used only during pretraining and subsequently discarded, yielding a general-purpose encoder enriched with biological knowledge for downstream applications. With only 179,067 pretraining samples, i.e., less than 0.5\% of those used by previous strong scFMs, scKITE outperformed these models across diverse downstream tasks, highlighting knowledge-enhanced pretraining as a promising paradigm for biologically grounded scFMs.

</details>


### [89] [MemRiskBench: Trace-Aware Risk-Preserving Evaluation for Long-Horizon LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14976)
*Jianhua Jiang,Dongbo Yuan,Weihua Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 MemRiskBench：五类风险分类法 + 确定性轨迹校验的 120 回合基准，并设计风险保留子集选择器，在 20% 子集下保持排序、风险覆盖与高风险检测能力，降低 5 倍算力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长周期 LLM 智能体跨会话累积记忆，产生稀疏但高影响的失效风险：陈旧事实、冲突更新、跨用户泄露、已撤销记忆复用、约束衰减。传统聚合分数掩盖各类风险的单独失败率，且基准压缩往往优先丢弃罕见的高危事件，导致"大体可用"与"偶发致害"的模型难以区分。

Method: 1) 构建五类风险分类法（外加一类已记录但不计分的类别），以确定性轨迹校验进行检查；2) 实例化为 120 回合脚本化基准，具备完整轨迹日志，通过/失败判定路径中不引入 LLM-as-judge；3) 在五个本地运行的量化指令微调模型上评测；4) 提出风险保留子集选择器——基于确定性轨迹导出特征的覆盖约束贪心选择器。

Result: 子集选择器在 20% 子集规模下保持完整排序（Spearman rho = 0.975，确定性；置信区间收敛为点估计，自助方差为零）、风险覆盖率达 1.0、高风险模型检测率达 1.0，同时减少约 5 倍算力。

Conclusion: 与仅保排序的子集选择器不同，该选择器借助无需 LLM 判官的轨迹确定性特征，额外保留风险类型覆盖与高风险检测。所有回合、轨迹、评分实现及选择器均已公开，以支持可复现评测与已部署 LLM 智能体的风险评估。

Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents accumulate memory across sessions, creating sparse but high-impact risks: stale facts, conflicting updates, cross-user leakage, revoked-memory reuse, and constraint decay. Standard aggregate scores hide per-risk failure rates--a model achieving 78% average accuracy may still leak data in 4% of episodes--and benchmark compression preferentially discards the rare high-severity events that distinguish a mostly-working model from one that occasionally causes harm. We present MemRiskBench. The primary contribution is a five-category risk taxonomy (plus one documented, unscored category) operationalized by deterministic trace grounded checks, instantiated as a 120-episode scripted benchmark with full trace logging and no LLM-as-judge on the pass/fail path, evaluated on five locally run quantized instruction-tuned models. Second, a risk-preserving subset selector: a coverage-constrained greedy selector on deterministic trace-derived features that retains full ranking (Spearman rho = 0.975, deterministic; CI collapses to a point estimate with zero bootstrap variance), risk coverage (1.0), and high-risk model detection (1.0) at a 20% subset size, reducing compute 5x. Unlike ranking-only subset selectors, this selector additionally preserves risk-type coverage and high-risk detection using trace-grounded deterministic features that do not require an LLM judge. All episodes, traces, the scoring implementation, and the selector are released to support reproducible evaluation and risk assessment of deployed LLM agents

</details>


### [90] [Converting Sequenced Fuzzy Cognitive Maps to Causal Virtual Worlds with Large Video Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14985)
*Akash Kumar Panda,Olaoluwa Adigun,Bart Kosko*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出利用大语言模型（LLM）与大视频模型（Video Model）智能体，结合反馈模糊认知图（FCM）来构建和操控具有因果结构的虚拟世界。算法从FCM中提取形如"If A then B"的动力元规则，引导LLM生成剧本、视频生成器生成对应视频场景，并以海豚—鲨鱼海底世界为例验证了方法的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虚拟世界需要具备可解释、可操控的因果结构，而现有生成式方法多聚焦于表面视觉逼真，缺乏对局部因果规则与全局因果场景的显式建模。作者希望借助反馈FCM的因果建模能力与AI智能体的生成能力，使虚拟世界既在因果上自洽，又能被用户或智能体按需扰动与演化。

Method: 方法核心为反馈模糊认知图（FCM）：局部因果规则为部分或模糊形式，FCM的反馈结构产生定义因果场景的全局均衡。采用序列化动力元规则"If A then B"刻画虚拟世界视频的因果场景：if部分A为用户或智能体对FCM虚拟世界施加的扰动（因果模式），中间过程由FCM的瞬态反馈动力学体现蕴含的因果箭头，then部分B为最终平衡吸引子（极限环或不动点）。算法从FCM中提取元规则序列，据此引导LLM智能体撰写剧本，再由大视频生成器按动力学流程将元规则转换为视频场景。

Result: 以一个描述海豚与鲨鱼的海底世界简单FCM为例进行智能体实验：由Google Gemini 3.1生成剧本，Google Veo 3.1生成海豚—鲨鱼视频，验证了从FCM元规则到剧本再到视频场景的完整流程可自动实现。

Conclusion: 该方法具有通用性，可通过混合更大规模的FCM与更强的AI智能体进行扩展，从而生成更具沉浸感的虚拟世界。其核心贡献在于将FCM的显式因果建模与生成式AI的内容生成能力结合，为因果可控、可规模化的虚拟世界构建提供了新范式。

Abstract: We show how users can create and manipulate causal virtual worlds with large-language-model (LLM) and large-video-model agents. The approach uses feedback fuzzy cognitive maps (FCMs) both to model the granular causal structure of the virtual world and to guide its causal evolution. The local causal rules are partial or fuzzy while the FCM's feedback structure produces global equilibria that define causal scenarios. A sequence of \emph{dynamical} meta-rules of the form ``If $\mathcal{A}$ then $\mathcal{B}$" define the causal scenes of the virtual-world video. The if-part causal pattern $\mathcal{A}$ perturbs the FCM's virtual world at the user's or agent's discretion. The FCM's transient feedback dynamics define the meta-rule's causal arrow of implication. The then-part $\mathcal{B}$ is the resulting equilibrium attractor such as a FCM limit cycle or fixed point. Our algorithm extracts these meta-rules from the FCM and guides the LLM agent to write a script based on the FCM meta-rule sequence. The large video generator converts the meta-rule into a video scene in accord with the flow of the dynamics. We applied the agent-based technique to a simple FCM that describes an undersea world of dolphins and sharks. Google's Gemini 3.1 generated the script and Google's Veo 3.1 generated the dolphin-shark video. The approach is general and can scale by mixing larger FCMs and AI agents to produce more immersive virtual worlds.

</details>


### [91] [Shallow Beliefs: Synthetic document finetuning does not inoculate against emergent misalignment from reward hacking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14998)
*Arun Jose,Julian Stastny*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在中训练阶段用合成文档（SDF）把奖励黑客行为表述为可接受行为，只能改变模型的态度表述，无法阻止后续RL训练产生涌现性错位（EM）；而同一情境下的接种提示（IP）可以阻止EM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究表明，在RL环境中学会奖励黑客的模型会广泛错位，而将奖励黑客重新表述为可接受行为的接种提示（IP）能阻断这种泛化。作者想检验：不干预未来训练的前提下，用合成文档微调（SDF）能否同样起到接种作用，即SDF能否影响模型后续训练所导致的泛化。

Method: 在模型的中训练语料中加入把奖励黑客描述为可接受行为的合成文档，然后让这些模型在可被利用（exploitable）的RL环境中训练，使其学会奖励黑客；并以接种提示（IP）作为对照条件，比较两种干预下模型的态度变化与下游泛化。

Result: 行为层面上中训练是成功的：模型对奖励黑客给出正面描述，对自己产出的奖励黑客输出更认可。但模型在学会奖励黑客后仍表现出强烈的EM（涌现性错位）；而同一设定下的IP则能阻止EM。SDF在插入新关联时可以可预测地引导下游泛化，但在覆盖已有关联（如"奖励黑客—错位—EM"）时会失效，且效果不可预测。

Conclusion: 在本文测试的规模下，SDF可以让模型表面上与所期望的信念保持一致，却会以非预期的方式影响其对后续训练的泛化，因此SDF式的"接种"并不等同于IP式的干预。

Abstract: Recent work shows that models that learn to reward hack on RL environments can become broadly misaligned, and that reframing reward hacking as acceptable behavior during training (inoculation prompting, or IP) blocks this generalization. We ask whether synthetic document finetuning (SDF) can inoculate a model against future training we don't intervene on. We add synthetic documents framing reward hacking as acceptable behavior to a model's midtraining corpus, and then train these models with RL on exploitable environments, teaching them to reward hack. Behaviorally, midtraining succeeds: models describe reward hacking favorably and are more approving of reward-hacking outputs they produce. However, they show strong EM after learning to reward hack, while IP in the same setting prevents EM. We show that SDF can predictably steer downstream generalization when inserting new associations, but struggles and has unpredictable effects when overriding existing associations, such as that between reward hacking and misalignment that produces EM. Our results suggest that, at the scales we test, SDF can make a model appear aligned with desired beliefs while steering its generalization from later training in unintended ways.

</details>


### [92] [CoMem: Collective-Individual Memory Synergy for Evolutionary Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15009)
*Chengxin Yu,Zhaoxin Fan,Faguo Wu,Hongwei Zheng,Yun Zhou,Zhiyu Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CoMem，一种面向LLM多智能体系统的集体-个体记忆协同架构，通过私有经验沉淀、集体智慧筛选与并行双流检索，缓解扁平记忆的噪声污染与智能体同质化问题，在ALFWorld与PDDL基准上取得强整体性能与抗记忆污染能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的多智能体系统（MAS）需要有效记忆机制以支持智能体持续学习与协作提升。现有方法虽已获得较强的协作能力，但多采用扁平、无结构的记忆，容易被噪声填满并抹平智能体间的差异，因此需要一种能兼顾个体私有经验与集体共享知识的记忆架构。

Method: 提出集体-个体记忆协同概念，并设计CoMem架构，统一私有经验与共享知识。其包含三个组件：(i) Private Experience Sedimentation，允许每个智能体随时间保留并更新自身有用记忆；(ii) Collective Wisdom Curation，谨慎筛选仅被广泛验证的想法在智能体间共享；(iii) Parallel Dual-Stream Retrieval，让智能体同时从自身记忆与群体智慧中检索，并利用聚类保证多样性。

Result: 在ALFWorld和PDDL基准上的实验表明，CoMem取得了较强的整体性能，并能稳健地避免记忆污染。

Conclusion: 通过私有经验沉淀、集体智慧筛选与并行双流检索的结合，CoMem有效实现了多智能体的记忆协同，兼顾个体差异保持与知识共享，为LLM-MAS记忆机制提供了一种可行方案。

Abstract: Designing effective memory mechanisms is crucial for advancing LLM-driven Multi-Agent Systems (MAS), helping agents learn together and perform better over time. While recent work has led to strong cooperation skills, most methods still use flat, unstructured memories, which easily get filled with noise and erase differences between agents. To address this, we introduce the concept of collective-individual memory synergy and propose CoMem, an architecture that unifies both private experience and shared knowledge for multi-agent learning. CoMem features:(i) Private Experience Sedimentation, which lets each agent keep and update its own useful memories over time;(ii) Collective Wisdom Curation, which carefully selects only widely proven ideas to be shared among agents;(iii)Parallel Dual-Stream Retrieval, which allows agents to draw both from their own memory and the group's wisdom, using clustering to ensure diversity.Experiments on ALFWorld and PDDL benchmarks show that CoMem achieves strong overall performance and robustly avoids memory pollution.

</details>


### [93] [Semantic-TVM: Structure-Preserving Trustworthy Virtual Memory for Memory-Augmented and Tool-Using Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15011)
*Yu Li,Qikun Cai,Tao Huang,Chen Hou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Trustworthy Virtual Memory (TVM) 闭环运行时，将精确值状态保留在本地，仅向远程 LLM 呈现受保护视图；其中 Semantic-TVM 通过可信本地模型预测敏感片段，实现跨度级替换，在保持可执行性的同时兼顾隐私与效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 记忆增强与工具调用型智能体在远程 LLM 处理检索记忆、工具动作和中间观察时会暴露精确私有值。单向掩码虽能限制直接暴露，但会移除可信执行所需的值，并可能通过后续观察泄露这些值。因此需要在保护隐私的同时保留任务所需的精确值状态。

Method: 提出 Trustworthy Virtual Memory (TVM)，一种闭环运行时，将精确值状态保留在本地，并向远程模型呈现受保护视图。在该统一运行时内设计两种机制：Rule-TVM 用本地可恢复句柄替换整个受保护字段；Semantic-TVM 仅替换由可信本地模型预测的敏感片段，从而保留周边任务相关上下文。

Result: 在 Memory-EHR 与 Memory-RAP 两个数据集、两个模型提供方上，跨度级投影（Semantic-TVM）相比整字段替换（Rule-TVM）恢复了大部分丢失的 EHR 效用：在 DeepSeek 上任务成功率 84.17% vs. 52.33%，同时测得暴露度保持较低，且工作流仍可执行。

Conclusion: 跨度级敏感信息投影可在单一闭环运行时内有效平衡隐私保护与任务效用，相比整字段替换显著提升任务成功率并维持低暴露度，为记忆增强与工具使用型智能体提供了一种可执行的隐私保护方案。

Abstract: Memory-augmented and tool-using agents expose exact private values when remote LLMs process retrieved memory, tool actions, and intermediate observations. One-way masking limits direct exposure but removes values needed for trusted execution and can leak them through later observations. We propose Trustworthy Virtual Memory (TVM), a closed-loop runtime that keeps exact-value state local while presenting a protected view to the remote model. Within this single runtime, Rule-TVM replaces whole protected fields with locally recoverable handles, and Semantic-TVM instead replaces only sensitive spans predicted by a trusted local model, preserving surrounding task-relevant context. On Memory-EHR and Memory-RAP across two providers, span-level projection recovers most of the EHR utility lost under whole-field replacement (Task Success 84.17% vs. 52.33% on DeepSeek) while measured exposure stays low and workflows remain executable.

</details>


### [94] [Overflip: Repetition-Induced Label Flips in Guardrail Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15013)
*Xu He,Chih-Hsuan Lin,Hung-Mao Chen,Junjie Xiong,Yan Zhai,Kun Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文揭示轻量级guardrail模型存在"Overflip"现象：重复输入会导致预测从恶意翻转为良性，9个模型中有5个存在此漏洞，翻转率8%–92%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估普遍假设guardrail模型的判定在输入加长时保持稳定，但该假设未经验证。轻量级guardrail为满足延迟约束采用短上下文窗口（通常512 token）和分桶相对位置编码，这种设计可能在长输入下产生不稳定性，构成潜在攻击面。

Method: 在9个广泛使用的轻量级guardrail模型上进行实验，基于100条prompt的基准测试，通过重复（repetition）逐步加长输入，观察预测是否从MAL翻转为BEN；分析置信度边界的衰减趋势、首次翻转的token长度，并与传统注意力稀释（padding、shuffling）基线进行对比，利用token级注意力分布刻画Overflip的注意力扩散轨迹。

Result: 5个模型出现MAL→BEN翻转，置信度边界随重复稳步收缩；翻转率介于8%–92%，首次翻转约发生在2.6k–9.4k token。Overflip与注意力稀释不同：它保留恶意内容，而是在重复结构上均化token级注意力，呈现更渐进的扩散轨迹，且对LLM服务威胁更大，因为被绕过的prompt语义完整、易被下游LLM理解。

Conclusion: 重复是guardrail模型的一类攻击面，Overflip暴露了长度不稳定性问题，呼吁开展长度鲁棒性评估并研发相应缓解措施。

Abstract: Guardrail models are classifiers deployed to screen malicious prompts and responses in LLM-based services. To meet latency constraints, many lightweight guardrails adopt compact Transformer backbones (e.g., DeBERTa) that are trained with short context windows (typically 512 tokens) and rely on bucketed relative positional encodings to process longer inputs. Prior evaluations assume that a guardrail's decision is stable as the input is lengthened. We show that this assumption can fail. We identify Overflip, a repetition-induced instability where repeating a prompt causes the guardrail's prediction to flip (MAL$\to$BEN) as the sequence grows. We conduct experiments on 9 widely used lightweight guardrail models. Five exhibit MAL$\to$BEN flips on a benchmark of 100 prompts, with confidence margins shrinking steadily with repetition. Among these vulnerable models, flip rates range from 8% to 92%, with first flips occurring at roughly 2.6k--9.4k tokens. Our analysis suggests Overflip differs from traditional attention-dilution baselines, which aim to divert the model's attention away from tokens associated with malicious content, shifting it instead toward unrelated content, such as benign padding or shuffling. While Overflip preserves malicious content, it homogenizes token-level attention over repeated structure and induces a distinct, more gradual attention-dispersion trajectory than padding. Moreover, Overflip poses a greater threat to LLM services than traditional attention dilution methods. Because the bypassed prompt remains semantically intact and is still readily understood by downstream business LLMs, it can transmit malicious intent after passing the guardrail. These findings expose repetition as an attack surface for guardrail models and motivate length-robust evaluation and mitigation.

</details>


### [95] [Four Ledgers, Not One Score: Responsible Communication of LLM-Judge Calibration in Biomedical ML](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15015)
*Sidi Chang,Peiying Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过单工作流取证案例证明：把"植入突变密钥"当作金标准去校准生物医学LLM评测器会产生严重度量错配，所报0.710与0.218实为提案确认率与提交台账构成比，而非判定精确率与召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物医学ML领域专家复核稀缺，合成扰动被视为廉价校准数据。但"植入的突变密钥"既非检测器输出也非自动成立的人工金标准，二者的混用会导致评测结论被误导性传播。

Method: 形式化四类互不相同的台账：植入扰动、独立检测器输出、与来源关联的人工判定、人工新增发现；随后审计一个私有合成日语护理交接工作流的评测设计、评分代码、读取路径与现有记录，并进行溯源身份核对。

Result: 工厂在47个目标中植入69张错误卡；最终复核覆盖22个目标，含22条确认导入提案、9条被拒提案、79张人工新增卡，仅3个目标双标注。密钥直通通用检测器评分得22/(22+9)=0.710与22/(22+79)=0.218。溯源身份表明这是提案确认率与提交台账构成比。另发现来源名冲突、行遮蔽、强制严重度、空比率默认值与无依据的零支撑字段权重。

Conclusion: 贡献了溯源感知的论断审计、存储契约与最低校准门槛。该单工作流案例是失败模式的存在性证明而非流行度估计：现有工作仅支持对合成提案的探索性审计，不支持LLM评判器的操作特性、临床有效性、语料流行度或稳健的标注者间一致性结论。

Abstract: Synthetic perturbations appear to offer inexpensive calibration data for LLM evaluators in biomedical ML, where expert review is scarce. Yet a planted mutation key is neither a detector output nor automatically human ground truth. We formalize four distinct ledgers: planted perturbations, independent detector outputs, source-linked human dispositions, and human-added discoveries. We then audit the evaluation design, scoring code, read paths, and current human records of a private synthetic Japanese care-handoff workflow. The factory stored 69 planted error cards across 47 targets. Final review covers 22 targets and contains 22 confirmed imported proposals, 9 rejected proposals, and 79 human-added cards; only 3 reviewed targets are double annotated. Passing imported plant keys to a generic detector scorer yields 22/(22+9)=0.710 and 22/(22+79)=0.218. A direct audit identity shows that these values are proposal-confirmation yield and submitted-ledger composition, not judge precision and recall, because no independent detector realization was preserved for the audited proposals in the available records. The audit also finds source-name collisions, row shadowing, forced severity, vacuous ratio defaults, and unsupported zero-support field weights. We contribute a provenance-aware claim audit, a storage contract, and a minimum calibration gate for responsibly communicating biomedical ML capability claims. This single-workflow forensic case is an existence proof of a failure mode, not an estimate of its prevalence: existing human work supports an exploratory audit of synthetic proposals, but not LLM-judge operating characteristics, clinical validity, corpus prevalence, or robust inter-annotator agreement.

</details>


### [96] [Horizon-specific Expert Fusion for Photovoltaic Power Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15035)
*Xu Yuqing,Zhou Liguo,Sun Ze,Yu Lei,Jiang Mingming*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种分层集成框架用于短期光伏功率预测，结合时序神经网络、历史相似日、状态气候学与梯度提升树，并采用随预测时域变化的凸权重融合及基于历史误差的校准。在PVDAQ 15–240分钟时域上实现光照容量归一化MAE 4.315%，较全特征LightGBM降低4.11%、较微调Chronos-2降低6.03%；在GEFCom2014三个太阳区小时级（至4小时）上，学习式融合优于等权但仅与LightGBM相当，说明分层集成增益依赖数据集与评估期。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 短期光伏功率预测既需刻画规则的太阳周期，又需捕捉天气驱动的波动，而二者在不同预测时域下的相对重要性会发生变化。单一模型难以同时兼顾多时域特性，因此需要一种能随时域自适应组合互补预测源的框架。

Method: 构建分层集成：融合时序神经模型、历史相似日（analogs）、状态气候学（state climatology）与梯度提升树；利用太阳几何与数值天气预报描述预期发电条件；采用随预测时域变化的凸权重进行horizon-specific融合；并设置独立校准步骤，依据可获得的历史预测误差修正近期偏差。

Result: 在公开PVDAQ数据15–240分钟时域上，集成模型的光照容量归一化MAE为4.315%，在相同校准条件下较全特征LightGBM误差降低4.11%，较微调Chronos-2降低6.03%。剔除专家模型实验揭示了集成内部存在冗余。在GEFCom2014三个训练随机种子下，学习式融合优于等权融合，但与LightGBM表现相当。

Conclusion: 结果支持"随预测时域变化的组合策略"作为有效的预测思路，但其相对于强单体模型的优势取决于具体数据集与评估时段；集成框架存在冗余，需要进一步精简与验证。

Abstract: Short-term photovoltaic power forecasting requires models to represent regular solar cycles and weather-driven fluctuations whose importance changes with the forecast horizon. This study develops a hierarchical ensemble that combines temporal neural models, historical analogs, state climatology, and gradient-boosted trees. Solar geometry and numerical weather forecasts describe the expected generation conditions, while horizon-specific convex weights combine complementary predictions. A separate calibration step uses available historical forecast errors to account for recent bias. The framework is evaluated on public PVDAQ data at 15--240-minute horizons and on three GEFCom2014 solar zones at hourly horizons up to four hours. On PVDAQ, the ensemble achieves a daylight capacity-normalized mean absolute error of 4.315%, reducing error by 4.11% relative to full-feature LightGBM and by 6.03% relative to fine-tuned Chronos-2 under identical calibration. Expert-removal experiments identify redundancy within the ensemble. Across three training seeds on GEFCom2014, learned fusion improves upon equal weighting but performs comparably to LightGBM. The results support horizon-specific combination as a useful forecasting strategy while showing that its advantage over strong individual models depends on the dataset and evaluation period.

</details>


### [97] [The average-farmer illusion in language-model simulations of agricultural decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15038)
*Zhanliang Zhu,Ziwei Li,Yuchen Liu,Liujun Zhu,Ruiqi Wu,Tongqing Shen,Junliang Jin,Jianyun Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 语言模型智能体的"现实性"常以群体均值或分布相似度来评判。本研究通过将Claude、Codex、Kimi在四种预设提示设计下的输出与中国及四个非洲国家的农民实际决策进行匹配比较，发现部分配置虽能复现观测均值与采纳率，但个体层面预测能力薄弱、决策聚集于典型值、政策相关的极端情形大量缺失；更关键的是，一个仅拟合观测边缘分布、不含任何个体信息的简单生成器，其分布相似度超过所有语言模型配置。作者据此提出"平均农民幻觉"概念，并给出可审计的验证框架与模块化提示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型智能体正被日益广泛地用作调查与社会模拟中的"合成人群"，但其现实性多依据群体平均或分布相似度来判断。作者质疑这类证据究竟能证明什么：分布层面的吻合是否等同于个体行为模拟的有效性尚未被系统检验，因此有必要在同一预设条件下，将多模型输出与真实农户决策进行对照，厘清群体相似性与个体可预测性之间的落差。

Method: 研究比较了Claude、Codex与Kimi三种语言模型，在四种预先设定的提示设计下的表现，并以中国及四个非洲国家的匹配农户决策作为基准。评估维度同时涵盖群体层面（均值、采纳率、分布相似度）与个体层面（个体预测、行为变异）。为检验分布相似度的信息含量，还构造了一个仅拟合观测边缘分布、不包含任何个体信息的简单生成器作为基准对照，并进一步考察提示追加内容对不同模型、结果变量、人群与验证目标的条件性影响。

Result: 部分语言模型配置能够复现观测均值与采纳率，但个体层面预测较弱，决策大量聚集于典型值附近，政策相关的极端情形基本缺失。最突出的结果是：一个只拟合观测边缘分布、对任何农户信息一无所知的简单生成器，在分布相似度上超过了所有语言模型配置。提示追加带来的多为条件性收益而非普遍改善，其效果随模型、结果变量、人群及验证目标而变化。

Conclusion: 作者将上述现象概括为"平均农民幻觉"：合成人群可以在表面上显得逼真，却无法复现"谁做什么"以及行为如何变化。研究提出与论断相匹配的验证框架及可复用的模块化提示，把提示构建转变为可审计的实验流程。结论指出，群体层面的相似性应被视为验证的起点，而非个体层面模拟有效性的证据。

Abstract: Language-model agents are increasingly used as synthetic people in surveys and social simulations, yet their apparent realism is often judged from population averages or distributional similarity. We tested what such evidence actually establishes by comparing Claude, Codex and Kimi under four prespecified prompt designs with matched farmer decisions from China and four African countries. Some configurations reproduced observed means and adoption rates. However, their person-level predictions were weak; their decisions clustered around typical values and policy-relevant extremes were largely missing. Most strikingly, a simple generator fitted only to the observed marginal dis- tribution, and given no information about any farmer, achieved greater distributional similarity than every language-model configuration. Prompt additions produced conditional gains rather than uni- versal improvement: results varied with model, outcome, population and validation target. We call this the average-farmer illusion: a synthetic population can look realistic while failing to repro- duce who does what or how behaviour varies. We provide a claim-matched validation framework and reusable modular prompts that turn prompt construction into an auditable experimental process. Population-level resemblance should therefore be treated as the start of validation, not as evidence of individual simulation.

</details>


### [98] [BusMA: A Bus Communication Substrate for Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15054)
*Yanwen Peng,Delvin Ce Zhang,Xi Wang,Nikolaos Aletras*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 BusMA —— 一种借鉴计算机总线架构的多智能体通信框架，通过共享总线实现任意智能体间的直接寻址通信，在 13 项任务上超越现有 HMW 与 RMP 方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体系统多采用层级式 Manager-Worker（HMW）或基于路由的消息传递（RMP）结构，限制了智能体自主性：Worker 无法直接向特定"同伴"咨询，且消息误路由会导致错误传播。

Method: 提出 BusMA 通信框架，包含智能体注册、消息路由与共享内存管理三个组件。Worker 各自配备工具与本地内存，可进行推理、动作（工具调用）并通过共享消息通信；设计讨论、质疑、引导、请求解释四类意图以支持细粒度交互；由 Chair 智能体监控共享内存、协调交互并促进收敛。

Result: 在两个前沿 LLM 上针对视觉推理、数学推理与知识检索三大类共 13 项任务开展实验，BusMA 一致优于当前最先进的 HMW 与 RMP 方法。

Conclusion: 将总线式共享通信引入多智能体协作，可突破层级与路由结构的自主性瓶颈，提升复杂任务的整体性能。

Abstract: Multi-Agent (MA) systems are effective at solving complex tasks that demand planning, tool use, and the synthesis of evidence from multiple sources. Existing systems typically adopt Hierarchical Manager-Worker (HMW) or Router-based Message Passing (RMP) structures as their communication protocol. However, these designs restrict agent autonomy: Worker agents cannot directly consult specific "peers", and misrouted messages can propagate errors. Inspired by bus architectures in computer systems, we propose BusMA, a communication framework that allows any agent to address other agents through a shared channel, i.e., the Bus. It consists of agent registration, message routing, and shared memory management components. Worker agents, each equipped with tools, have their own local memory and can reason, act (tool usage), and communicate by posting shared messages with specific intents. We introduce four intents: discussion, challenge, guidance, and request for explanation, which support fine-grained communication among agents. A Chair agent monitors the shared memory to coordinate interactions and facilitate convergence among Workers. To evaluate the effectiveness of BusMA, we conduct extensive experiments with two frontier LLMs across 13 tasks spanning visual reasoning, mathematical reasoning, and knowledge retrieval demonstrate that BusMA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art HMW and RMP methods.

</details>


### [99] [Enabling Creative Exploration for Vibe Design Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15078)
