Abstract: Powerful technologies labeled ``AI''-without sufficient epistemic caution-are already reshaping political and private life, bringing both new dangers and new opportunities for citizen participation. These range from electoral and legislative engagement to the most ambitious form: political co-creation through citizens' assemblies. Large Language Models (LLMs) could support such processes through moderation, translation, facilitation, summarization, and writing assistance. But this potential remains largely unrealized. The Democratic Commons project takes a fundamentally interdisciplinary approach-from philosophy to computer science-to evaluate LLMs against five proposed democratic principles. At its core, the project is driven by the question of political bias: under what conditions can LLMs be used democratically within forms of citizen participation that are them- selves still largely experimental? Addressing these socio-technical questions requires grounding in political theory and, more broadly, in philosophy-disciplines that provide the normative frameworks without which the democratic evaluation of AI systems cannot be mean- ingfully conducted.

</details>


### [133] [Predicting build orientation for SLM dental parts: a comparison of rotation representations and direct vector regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15710)
*Felix Schmalzel,Reimar Waitz,Moritz Kronberger,Thorsten Schöler*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将牙科SLM零件构建方向预测建模为监督学习任务，比较13种上轴旋转表示在两个骨干网络上的测地角误差，发现测试时增强（TTA）是精度提升最稳健的因素，而最优表示依赖骨干网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SLM牙科零件的构建方向目前多由技师凭经验手动选择，缺乏自动化与一致性；作者希望用技师标注的生产数据以监督机器学习方式预测零件上轴，并系统研究不同旋转表示对预测精度的影响。

Method: 使用约2400个患者定制牙科零件，训练并端到端微调两个预训练骨干：ResNet-50多视图图像骨干与PointNeXt-S点云骨干；在13种上轴表示上训练，涵盖6种经典SO(3)参数化与7种直接定义在单位球S^2上的表示；以预测与真值上轴之间的测地角误差为指标，在K=21个已知旋转上进行TTA对比评估。

Result: 启用TTA时，八面体映射取得最低平均角误差（10.6°，ResNet-50）；整体误差最低的三种均为直接S^2表示，但这可能源于SO(3)目标中面内分量无监督标注的标签噪声而非拓扑优势；von Mises-Fisher在PointNeXt-S上训练时坍缩为近似常量预测，在ResNet-50上未出现；TTA在几乎所有表示与骨干组合上将平均角误差降低31%–73%。

Conclusion: 在少量已知旋转上进行测试时增强是精度提升最一致的驱动因素，而表现最佳的旋转表示强烈依赖所用骨干网络；因此方法选择需结合骨干联合评估。

Abstract: Build orientation for selective laser melting (SLM) manufacturing of dental parts is usually chosen manually by technicians. We treat orientation prediction as supervised machine learning of the part's up-axis from technician-labeled production data, and test which rotation representations produce the best results. Using $n\approx2400$ patient-specific dental parts, we trained a ResNet-50 multi-view image backbone and a PointNeXt-S point-cloud backbone, both pretrained and fine-tuned end-to-end, on 13 up-axis representations spanning six classical $SO(3)$ parameterizations and seven representations defined directly on the unit sphere $S^2$. We report the geodesic angular error between predicted and ground-truth up-axis on a test set, with and without test-time augmentation (TTA) over $K=21$ known rotations. With TTA, the octahedral map achieves the lowest mean angular error ($10.6^\circ$, ResNet-50). The three lowest-error results overall are direct $S^2$ representations, though this may reflect label noise in the unsupervised in-plane component of the $SO(3)$ targets rather than a topological advantage. von Mises-Fisher collapses to a near-constant prediction when trained with PointNeXt-S but not with ResNet-50. TTA reduces mean angular error by 31-73 % across almost every representation and backbone. Overall, test-time augmentation over a small set of known rotations is the most consistent driver of accuracy, whereas the best-performing representation is strongly backbone-dependent.

</details>


### [134] [Data storytelling meets interpretable machine learning: Decoding AI decisions for non-experts without revealing sensitive data and model details](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15722)
*Lemen Chao,Zixuan Yang,Anran Fang,Mingran Sun,Ming Lei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究将数据叙事与可解释机器学习（IML）相结合，通过设计科学研究（DSR）范式提出数据叙事的形式化定义、DIST金字塔与I-P-O模型，并构建架构以"What-if"和"Why-not"事件生成方式解释AI决策，同时采用数据脱敏保护敏感数据，在Boston Housing数据集上以SHAP值和LLM生成ABT结构数据故事进行验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI驱动的自动化决策既需要预测性能也需要可解释性。现有IML工具虽能解释模型预测，但技术复杂度高，阻碍了非专家的理解与使用，因此需要提升AI决策对更广泛受众的可解释性。

Method: 遵循设计科学研究（DSR）范式：提出IML中数据叙事的形式化定义，引入DIST金字塔对齐数据叙事与IML，提出I-P-O模型描述二者交互；构建通过"What-if"与"Why-not"事件生成过程解释AI决策的架构，并采用数据脱敏保护敏感输入数据；以Boston Housing数据集为案例，使用SHAP值和LLM生成ABT结构的数据故事。

Result: 实证评估显示，76.4%的受访者认为"What-if"数据故事更易理解，74.3%的受访者认为"Why-not"数据故事更易理解，二者可及性得分均显著高于传统SHAP可视化。

Conclusion: 论文提出一个整合IML与数据叙事的叙事性解释框架，拓展了AI决策的研究范围与实践适用性。

Abstract: AI-driven automated decision-making requires both predictive performance and interpretability. Recent advances in interpretable machine learning (IML) provide tools for explaining model predictions, but the technical complexity of these explanations may hinder accessibility to non-experts. To address this challenge, this study integrates data storytelling with IML to enhance the explainability of AI-generated decisions for a broader audience. Following the design science research (DSR) paradigm, this study proposes a formal definition of data storytelling in IML, introduces the DIST Pyramid to align data storytelling with IML, and presents the I-P-O Model to describe their interactions. It further develops an architecture to explain AI decisions through distinct "What-if" and "Why-not" event-generation processes. The architecture also employs data desensitization to protect sensitive input data. To validate the approach, a case study is conducted with the Boston Housing dataset, using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) values and large language models (LLMs) to generate data stories with And-But-Therefore (ABT) structures. An empirical evaluation shows that 76.4% and 74.3% of respondents rated the "What-if" and "Why-not" data stories as more comprehensible, with significantly higher accessibility scores than traditional SHAP visualizations. The paper concludes with the presentation of a narrative interpretation framework that integrates IML and data storytelling, thereby expanding the research scope as well as the practical applicability of AI decision-making.

</details>


### [135] [Are LLMs Good Financial User Simulators? A Preliminary Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15727)
*Jiajie He,Jiangyuan Hong,Dongling Ni,Wenjin Liu,Xintong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过120名志愿者参与的受控模拟交易实验，初步考察大语言模型作为用户模拟器能否复现个体金融决策的演化过程。结果显示，加入时点市场信息可提升操作方向与标的预测，但交易数量预测仍困难，并存在系统性行为压缩现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）日益被用作用户模拟器，但其能否复现个体不断演化的金融决策尚不明确，缺乏实证刻画。

Method: 在受控模拟交易环境（paper-trading）中招募120名志愿者，使用不可赎回的虚拟资金在真实市场条件下交易（不涉及真实账户、真实资金头寸或真实成交记录）。仅以预测截点前可获取的信息为输入，让模拟器预测参与者次一交易日的操作方向、交易标的与交易数量；采用时间对齐的滚动预测，并对比是否引入时点市场信息（point-in-time market information）的消融设置。

Result: 在受控消融实验（controlled ablation）中，市场背景信息提升了操作方向（action）与标的（ticker）预测表现；但交易数量（transaction sizing）预测依然困难。同时观察到系统性行为压缩（behavioral compression）：模型过度产出持有（hold）操作、低估卖出（sell）决策，并简化多标的（multi-security）交易。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了对LLM个体金融决策模拟能力的初步实证刻画，并指出需要在更大规模上评估个体层、时间层与组合层（portfolio-level）的行为保真度（behavioral fidelity）。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as user simulators, but their ability to reproduce evolving individual financial decisions remains unclear. We present a preliminary study in a controlled paper-trading environment with 120 volunteers. Participants used non-redeemable virtual funds under real-time market conditions; no real brokerage accounts, real-money positions, or real transaction records were accessed. Given only information available before a prediction cutoff, a simulator predicts the participant's next-trading-day action, traded security, and transaction quantity. We evaluate temporally aligned rolling predictions and compare settings with and without point-in-time market information. Market context improves action and ticker prediction in the controlled ablation, while transaction sizing remains difficult. We also observe systematic behavioral compression: models overproduce hold actions, underpredict sell decisions, and simplify multi-security transactions. These results provide an initial empirical characterization and motivate larger-scale evaluation of individual, temporal, and portfolio-level behavioral fidelity.

</details>


### [136] [Design of a Deep Learning Credit Risk Early Warning System Integrating Multi-source Heterogeneous Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15744)
*LiYang Wang,Zhen Zhong,Zhen Tian,Keyu Chen,Keyu Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于异构信息融合的信用风险预警系统，采用深度神经网络与注意力机制从交易行为、社交网络等多源数据中提取多维特征，实现企业与个人信用风险的早期识别。系统测试表明该方法在预警准确性与时效性上显著优于传统规则引擎方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融风险预警系统因信息孤岛与监测延迟而效率低下，数据融合与实时分析技术的发展为解决此类复杂领域问题提供了新途径。

Method: 构建融合深度神经网络与注意力机制的模型架构，对交易行为、社交网络等异构数据源进行多维特征提取，建立面向企业及个人信用风险的早期识别机制。

Result: 系统测试显示，该方法显著提升了风险预警的准确性与时效性，性能优于传统基于规则引擎的解决方案。

Conclusion: 研究为金融风险的早期干预提供了创新思路，对维护金融稳定具有现实意义。

Abstract: Advancements in data fusion and real-time analytics technologies have opened new avenues for addressing complex domain challenges. Financial risk early warning systems often suffer from inefficiency due to information silos and monitoring delays. This paper proposes a credit risk early warning system based on heterogeneous information fusion. The system employs a model architecture integrating deep neural networks and attention mechanisms to extract multidimensional features from diverse data sources such as transaction behaviors and social networks, thereby establishing an early identification mechanism for corporate and individual credit risks. System testing demonstrates that this approach significantly enhances the accuracy and timeliness of risk warnings, outperforming traditional rule-based engine solutions. The findings offer innovative insights for early intervention in financial risks, holding practical significance for safeguarding financial stability.

</details>


### [137] [EvoOntology: A Self-Evolving Ontology Layer for Data Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15779)
*Meiduo Chong,Shaolei Zhang,Ju Fan,Xiaoyong Du*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 EvoOntology，一种面向数据智能体的自演化本体层，以 MCP 服务形式封装模式层、内容层与工具层，支持运行时主动查询与交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据智能体需在异构数据（表格、文件、数据库）上执行自然语言指令，但存在"智能体—数据鸿沟"：数据位于智能体外部，智能体只能通过通用工具访问列名、文件路径等有限信息。现有方案或直接探索原始数据源，或向提示中注入人工构建的语义层，二者均难以扩展到大规模异构数据源，也无法适配不同的智能体行为。

Method: EvoOntology 将本体封装为 MCP 服务器，由模式层、内容层、工具层组成，使智能体可在运行时主动查询和交互；引入构建智能体实现本体的自主构建；设计自演化循环，通过归因引导的类型化编辑持续精炼本体，编辑仅在经过骨干模型条件下的配对评估被接受后才生效。

Result: 在三个广泛采用的数据智能体基准上、使用四个大模型骨干进行实验，EvoOntology 持续优于强基线和现有语义层方法。

Conclusion: EvoOntology 有效弥合了智能体—数据鸿沟，使智能体能更高效地与异构数据交互；代码已开源。

Abstract: Data agents aim to fulfill natural-language instructions over heterogeneous data, including tables, files, and databases. However, data agents face a challenging agent-data gap: heterogeneous data resides outside the agent, while the agent can access it (e.g., column names and file paths) only through generic tools. Existing approaches either let agents directly explore raw data sources or inject manually constructed semantic layers into prompts. However, neither scales well to large heterogeneous data sources nor adapts to different agent behaviors. In this paper, we introduce EvoOntology, a self-evolving ontology layer for data agents. EvoOntology encapsulates the ontology as an MCP server comprising a schema layer, a content layer, and a tool layer, enabling agents to actively query and interact with the ontology at runtime. To this end, we introduce a builder agent for autonomous ontology construction and a self-evolution loop that continuously refines the ontology through attribution-guided typed edits that are accepted only after a backbone-conditional paired evaluation. Experiments on three well-adopted data-agent benchmarks with four LLM backbones demonstrate that EvoOntology consistently outperforms strong baselines and existing semantic-layer approaches, effectively bridging the agent-data gap and enabling more effective interaction with heterogeneous data. Code: https://github.com/ruc-datalab/EvoOntology

</details>


### [138] [KnowBench: Effort Reduction as a Unified, Deployment-Grounded Benchmark for Clinical AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15794)
*Jocelyn Kang,Caroline Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出 KnowBench 基准，其统一指标为"努力削减率"(ER)：经专家与安全审核后，被责任临床医生接受的系统生成临床工作产物的比例。ER 定义一次、按任务实例化，覆盖病历记录、诊断与计费编码、医嘱、EHR 摘要、患者访后小结与临床决策支持等场景。主要贡献是基准本身（指标、退化情形与可审计报告协议），并报告文档场景的初步测量：百万人次以上签名就诊、跨 6 个月以上生产窗口与 13 个专科，ER 达 97.99%，各专科 96.8–98.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有临床 AI 系统沿用科研环境的评测工具——基于参考的相似度指标与专家评分量表——衡量的是与某个"产物"的相似程度，而非临床负担的实际下降。这类指标与真实临床工作流的价值目标错位，且缺乏可跨系统比较、可审计的统一口径。

Method: 提出 Effort Reduction (ER) 指标：以临床医生的"复核—签署/认证"(review-and-attestation)事件为金标准；被接受的单元计为系统完成的工作，每处更正计为返还给医生的残余努力。ER 定义一次，按任务实例化于六类行政工作负载。论文同时给出指标的退化情形（degenerate cases）与一套报告协议（checklist），使 ER 声明可审计、可跨系统比较，并明确标注哪些配套统计量被保留未披露。

Result: 文档场景的初步头线测量：超过一百万次签名就诊、生产窗口超过六个月、覆盖 13 个医学专科；Knowtex 专有的微调临床基础模型在闭环反馈架构内运行，总体 ER 为 97.99%，各专科聚合值介于 96.8%–98.9%。

Conclusion: 论文的首要贡献是基准本身——指标、退化情形与报告协议——而非单点性能数字。发布内容仅部分实现协议清单，并公开声明哪些配套统计量被 withheld，意在使该数字及其后所有报告数字均可被同一标准审视，从而把临床 AI 评估从"与产物的相似度"转向"负担的实际削减"。

Abstract: Clinical AI systems are evaluated with instruments built for research settings (reference-based similarity metrics and expert rubric panels) that measure resemblance to an artifact rather than reduction of a burden. We introduce KnowBench, pioneered by Knowtex, whose unifying metric is Effort Reduction (ER): the proportion of system-generated clinical work product accepted by the responsible clinician under expert and safety review. ER is defined once and instantiated per task across the administrative workload clinical AI automates: visit notes, diagnosis and billing codes, orders, EHR chart summarization, patient after-visit summaries, and clinical decision support. In every instantiation the construction is identical: the clinician's review-and-attestation event is the ground truth, every accepted unit is work the system completed, and every correction is residual effort returned to the clinician. The primary contribution of this paper is the benchmark itself: the metric, its degenerate cases, and a reporting protocol under which ER claims are auditable and cross-system comparable. Alongside it we report an initial headline measurement from the documentation instantiation: over one million signed encounters across a production window exceeding six months and thirteen medical specialties, Knowtex's proprietary fine-tuned clinical foundation models operating inside a closed feedback architecture achieve an aggregate ER of 97.99%, with per-specialty aggregates spanning 96.8-98.9%. This release reports the protocol's checklist partially, and states which companion statistics are withheld; the benchmark is offered so that this figure, and every figure reported after it, can be held to the same standard.

</details>


### [139] [Navigating Sparse Evidence: Agentic Visual RAG via Explicit Context Selection and Consolidation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15800)
*Yucheng Shen,Lingyong Yan,Jiulong Wu,Shuaiqiang Wang,Jianmin WU,Dawei Yin,Min Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 SCoRE，一个面向视觉检索增强生成（VRAG）的统一智能体循环，通过显式筛选与整合证据提升视觉文档问答的可解释性与准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VRAG 通过检索相关页面图像作为视觉证据进行推理，但视觉证据的有效利用面临两大障碍：一是与答案相关的证据稀疏，可能集中于单页的小区域或分散于多页；二是现有智能体方法多基于原始探索轨迹或压缩的文本记忆生成答案，而非显式组织的支撑图像集合，导致答案易受探索噪声干扰，且证据支撑的推理链路不清晰。作者认为瓶颈不仅在于证据发现，更在于答案生成前的证据保留与组织。

Method: 提出 SCoRE（Selection and Consolidation for Robust Evidence），包含两个阶段：探索阶段仅保留与查询相关的观察及其来源指针，存入维护的文本账本（ledger），在保留早期证据的同时控制视觉上下文规模；终止阶段重新加载被引用的原始图像，将视觉证据整合并按逻辑顺序排列用于回答，从而将最终推理与探索性试错解耦，并通过带索引的断言—图像链接实现严格视觉 grounding。训练范式结合过滤式冷启动轨迹蒸馏与证据感知强化学习，奖励函数兼顾证据覆盖率、整合紧凑性与答案正确性，实现统一 rollout 的端到端优化。

Result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据或基准结果，但方法设计目标为：提升证据覆盖率与整合紧凑性，增强答案正确性，并通过索引化的断言—图像链接保证严格视觉 grounding 与可追溯推理。

Conclusion: SCoRE 通过显式证据筛选与整合，将 VRAG 的瓶颈从证据发现扩展到证据保留与组织，实现探索与最终推理的解耦，并在端到端训练中联合优化证据质量与答案正确性。

Abstract: Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (VRAG) empowers models to navigate and answer queries about visually rich documents by retrieving relevant page images as visual evidence and reasoning over their content. However, effectively utilizing this visual evidence is usually impeded by two main challenges. First, answer-relevant evidence is sparse and may be concentrated in a small region of one page or dispersed across multiple pages. Second, existing agentic methods often generate answers based on raw exploration trajectories or compressed textual memories rather than an explicitly organized set of supporting images, making answers susceptible to exploration noise and obscuring the evidence-backed reasoning trace. We argue that the bottleneck lies not only in evidence discovery but also in its preservation and organization before answer generation. We propose SCoRE (Selection and Consolidation for Robust Evidence), a unified agent loop for explicit evidence selection and consolidation. During exploration, SCoRE retains only query-relevant observations and their source pointers in a maintained textual ledger, preserving earlier evidence while keeping the visual context bounded. At termination, it reloads the referenced original images and consolidates the visual evidence for answering, arranging it into a logical sequence. This decouples final reasoning from exploratory trial-and-error while ensuring strict visual grounding via indexed claim-to-image linkages. To enable end-to-end optimization of this unified rollout, our training paradigm combines filtered cold-start trajectory distillation with evidence-aware reinforcement learning, whose reward promotes evidence coverage, consolidation compactness, and answer correctness.

</details>


### [140] [When Should a World Model Move? Loss-Conditioned State Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15801)
*Jintao Xu,Zhengyu Chen,Ben Zhang,Yongzhi Qi,Jianshen Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"损失条件下的状态执行"（loss-conditioned state execution），一种模型无关方法，用于判定是否执行世界模型给出的固定可行提议，还是保留当前状态；并在i.i.d.校准单元上给出接受组的期望损失优于持久基线的概率保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测信息量（predictive informativeness）本身并不能说明一次更新是否会降低下游损失。事件发生排序可以接近完美，而"持久"（persistence）仍是绝对损失下的唯一Bayes最优动作；两条转移律即便共享发生信息与条件方差，也可能需要相反的绝对损失决策。因此需要把"状态可移动性"与某一具体提议的收益区分开，并单独评估事件可预测性与状态执行。

Method: 将状态可移动性形式化为"存在一个能降低损失的可行修正"，并区别于特定提议的收益。方法从预测分布构造损失特定的可行提议，在独立校准单元上按组评估其相对持久基线的有界损失增益，仅当分组的同步下置信界为正时才执行该提议。对固定提议与单元损失有界的组，证明当校准单元为来自目标总体的i.i.d.抽样时，每个被接受组以高概率具有低于持久基线的期望损失。

Result: 在公开预测与动作条件动力学基准上验证了受支持的更新以及认证（certification）与覆盖率（coverage）之间的权衡。在28,684条留出M4 Monthly序列上，方法对14.0%的序列执行提议，有界损失为0.588，优于持久基线的0.599和始终执行提议的0.621；两项对比的配对95% bootstrap区间均位于零以下。在针对六种不健康库存类型的受限预测任务中，强发生排序信号与基于损失的持久偏好并存，说明事件可预测性与状态执行必须分开评估。

Conclusion: 预测准确性/发生排序不等同于损失意义下的可执行性；通过损失条件的、带同步置信下界的组级校准检验，可以在模型无关设定下只接受确有增益的状态更新，且在实证中同时体现认证有效性与覆盖率代价。

Abstract: We introduce loss-conditioned state execution, a model-agnostic method that decides whether to execute a world model's fixed feasible proposal or retain the current state. Predictive informativeness alone, however, does not establish whether an update will reduce downstream loss. Occurrence ranking can approach perfection while persistence remains the unique absolute-loss Bayes action. Two transition laws can also share occurrence information and conditional variance yet require opposite absolute-loss decisions. We formalize state movability as the existence of a loss-reducing feasible correction and distinguish it from the benefit of a particular proposal. Our method constructs a loss-specific feasible proposal from a predictive distribution and evaluates its groupwise bounded-loss gain over persistence on independent calibration units. The proposal is executed only in groups with a positive simultaneous lower confidence bound. For fixed proposals and groups with bounded unit losses, we prove that every accepted group has lower expected loss than persistence with high probability when calibration units are i.i.d. draws from the target population. Experiments on public forecasting and action-conditioned dynamics benchmarks show supported updates and a trade-off between certification and coverage. On 28,684 held-out M4 Monthly series, the method executes the proposal for 14.0% of series and achieves bounded loss 0.588, compared with 0.599 for persistence and 0.621 for always executing the proposal. The paired 95% bootstrap intervals for both comparisons lie below zero. In constrained forecasting of six unhealthy-inventory types from JD$\mbox{.}$com, a leading e-retailer in China, strong occurrence-ranking signal coexists with a loss-based preference for persistence, illustrating why event predictability and state execution must be evaluated separately.

</details>


### [141] [Atria Dawn: The Dawn of Agentic Superintelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15818)
*Honglin Guo,Tao Gui,Yicheng Chen,Guanting Dong,Qiming Ge,Yuyang Hu,Zixian Huang,Jiajie Jin,Alexander Lam,Yining Li,Jiahang Lin,Yanjiang Liu,Xinyu Lu,Haijun Lv,Junlin Shang,Qisheng Su,Guoqiang Wang,Rui Wang,Zhecan Wang,Hao Xiang,Xinchen Xie,Shuhao Xing,Xiaoyu Xing,Wanghan Xu,Xinyu Yang,Yajie Yang,Chengfeng Zhao,Haoran Zhao,Ruojun Zhou,Yunhua Zhou,Yicheng Zou,Kun Cai,Qiye Cai,Xinmeng Che,Haodong Chen,Jiabei Chen,Jiahao Chen,Jiayi Chen,Yujia Chen,Lizhi Cui,Youheng Dai,Xin Deng,Yi Dong,Shihan Dou,Chenya Gu,Xu Guo,Ding Han,Feiyang Hao,Haotan He,Jie Hou,Binze Hu,Zijian Hu,Junhao Huang,Huicheng Jiang,Jiazhen Jiang,Shufan Jiang,Jiahao Kuang,Bowen Lai,Bo Li,Jiaqiang Li,Peng Li,Qilong Li,Zhuoqun Li,Jiaxiang Liu,Shuainan Liu,Tong Liu,Yi Liu,Zhonghang Lu,Jianwen Luo,Yanyi Luo,Huijie Lv,Ningsheng Ma,Zerun Ma,Houcheng Min,Chengjun Pan,Qiyuan Peng,Xiaoxuan Peng,Jianmin Qian,Jiantao Qiu,Wanying Ren,Huayu Sha,Jifei Shan,Zixin Shang,Bing Shao,Zhuohui Sheng,Jiayang Shi,Yang Shu,Aierpanjiang Simayi,Sirui Song,Yuxiao Song,Zhe Sun,Zhichao Sun,Wenzhe Tan,Wenhui Tian,Zhongbo Tian,Hanchen Wang,Pengbo Wang,Rui Wang,Yiding Wang,Yuhui Wang,Zhiheng Xi,Caijun Xu,Chao Xu,Yongfeng Xu,Xiaolei Yang,Zhixiong Yang,Qian Yao,Shihong Yi,Yuankai Ying,Jia Yu,Dingbo Yuan,Hao Yuan,Junjie Yuan,Bo Zhang,Caixian Zhang,Qiuyinzhe Zhang,Jiyuan Zhao,Penghao Zhao,Ying Zhao,Pujun Zheng,Xiaoxue Zhong,Xiaohao Zhou,Xinyu Zhou,Dongsheng Zhu,Guanru Zhu,Yulun Zhu,Yaojie Lu,Tao Ji,Hongyu Lin,Yutao Zhu,Pengfei Cao,Guoxiu He,Xianpei Han,Ben He,Zhicheng Dou,Kang Liu,Qi Zhang,Le Sun,Jun Zhao,Ji-Rong Wen,Xuanjing Huang,Yu-Gang Jiang,Bowen Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基础智能体语言模型 Atria Dawn Preview，用于科研与工程工作流，经"可验证经验流水线"训练，在16项基准中5项取得最高分，并通过对769条任务记录与智能体日志的分析，揭示人机协作从任务级执行转向项目级伙伴关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 智能体已成为其"后继者"开发中的参与者，这既重塑了智能的生产方式，也改变了人类研究者的角色。因此需要在真实世界提升智能体生产力，并理解人机协作在研发过程中的实际形态与边界。

Method: 提出基础智能体语言模型 Atria Dawn Preview，通过"可验证经验流水线"（Verifiable Experience Pipeline）训练，将工具中介的交互与可执行环境、外部可验证的结果相连接；并在覆盖真实科研、工程与数字工作的16项基准上评估，同时以该模型自身的研发过程为案例，分析56名参与者、769条任务记录及智能体日志。

Result: 在16项基准中与前沿智能体持平，并在其中5项取得已报道最高分；在可比条件下评估已完成任务时，参与者认为约三分之一的AI辅助完成任务是"无AI则不可行"的。智能体常提出方法并实施修改，而人类保留多数最终决策权，通过判断与反馈引导探索方向。

Conclusion: 人机协作正从"任务级执行"转向"项目级伙伴关系"，人类精力集中于判断"什么值得做"以及证据如何引导研究。走向更自主的AI研究，必须同时提升发现能力与有意义的人类监督能力，保持人类对持续开发的风险与方向负有可问责的权威。

Abstract: As AI agents become participants in the development of their successors, they reshape both the production of intelligence and the role of human researchers. We introduce Atria Dawn Preview, a foundation agentic language model designed for scientific research and engineering workflows, with the goal of expanding the frontier of agent productivity in the real world. This model is trained via a Verifiable Experience Pipeline that connects tool-mediated interactions to executable environments and externally verified outcomes. Across 16 benchmarks spanning real-world research, engineering, and digital work, Atria Dawn Preview is competitive with frontier agents and achieves the highest reported score on five of them. Beyond standalone performance, we examine the real research-and-development process behind this model as a case study of human--AI collaboration, analyzing 769 task records from 56 participants together with agent logs. When asked to evaluate completed tasks under comparable conditions, participants rated about one-third of completed AI-assisted tasks as infeasible without AI. More strikingly, agents frequently propose methods and implement revisions, while humans retain most final decisions and guide exploration through judgment and feedback. These observations indicate a shift from task-level execution to project-level partnership, with human effort concentrating on what is worth pursuing and how evidence should guide research. Progress toward more autonomous AI research must therefore advance both the capacity for discovery and the capacity for meaningful human oversight, preserving accountable human authority over the risks and direction of continued development.

</details>


### [142] [AlgoEvo: Self-Evolving Agentic Search for Automated Algorithm Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15820)
*Junhao Qiu,Qinglong Hu,Xialiang Tong,Mingxuan Yuan,Liyong Lin,Qingfu Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AlgoEvo：将自动算法发现转变为交互式、知识积累过程的统一智能体框架，通过动态代码编辑、设计技能枢纽和分层经验机制，在六项基准任务上以更少评估和token达到或超越专用方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的自动算法发现框架受限于刚性搜索流水线和预定义控制流，导致自适应推理受限、难以跨范式迁移，且浪费执行反馈。

Method: 提出AlgoEvo统一智能体框架：自主智能体基于运行时反馈动态检查、诊断和编辑代码；设计技能枢纽（design skill hub）将范式相关知识从核心发现引擎解耦，以单一工作流处理单目标、多目标及多组件设计；分层经验机制将搜索轨迹组织为任务级树以指导探索，并跨任务整合可复用技能。

Result: 在六个代表性基准任务上，AlgoEvo以显著更少的评估次数和更低的token消耗匹配或超越专用方法，展现出强任务内积累、跨任务迁移能力，并能通过灵活技能激活复现或超越现有最优性能。

Conclusion: AlgoEvo验证了将自动算法发现重构为交互式、知识积累过程的可行性，为统一、可迁移、高效的算法发现提供了新范式。

Abstract: Large language models have advanced automated algorithm discovery by synthesizing executable code, but existing frameworks trap them in rigid search pipelines with pre-defined control flows. This limitation restricts adaptive reasoning, blocks cross-paradigm transfer, and discards valuable execution feedback. We propose AlgoEvo, a unified agentic framework that transforms automated algorithm discovery into an interactive, knowledge-accumulating process. An autonomous agent dynamically inspects, diagnoses, and edits code based on runtime feedback. A design skill hub decouples paradigm-specific knowledge from the core discovery engine, allowing a single workflow to seamlessly handle single-objective, multi-objective, and multi-component design. Meanwhile, a hierarchical experience mechanism organizes search trajectories into a task-level tree to guide exploration and consolidates cross-task patterns into reusable skills. Across six representative benchmark tasks, AlgoEvo matches or surpasses specialized methods with substantially fewer evaluations and reduced token consumption, demonstrating strong intra-task accumulation, cross-task transfer, and the ability to reproduce or exceed existing state-of-the-art performance through flexible skill activation.

</details>


### [143] [LongAgent: History-Guided Agentic Search for Longitudinal Outcome Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15859)
*Siyao Wang,Florian Guitton,Shuojie Fu,Guanyu Tao,Kai Sun,Wenjia Bai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于智能体的LongAgent方法，可自主搜索变量集、时间窗口与纵向聚合函数的组合，以提取纵向数据的预测性表征并预测未来结局。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学纵向数据本质上具有异质性：变量数量多、来源不同、采样时间间隔不一，且反映健康状况的不同方面，因此需要识别有预测价值的变量、处理纵向信息并整合多变量进行结局预测，这一任务仍具挑战性。

Method: LongAgent采用智能体式自主搜索，在变量集组合、时间窗口和纵向聚合函数的搜索空间中探索，并利用历史搜索记忆与数值证据指导后续探索。

Result: 在合成数据上，LongAgent取得平均预测RMSE为1.7376，较最强非智能体基线提升0.0151（95% CI：[0.0045, 0.0260]；p=0.0273）；在真实临床数据集上，其表现与最佳基线相当。

Conclusion: LongAgent能够通过智能体自主搜索有效构建纵向数据的预测表征，在合成数据上优于最强基线，在真实临床数据上与最佳基线性能相当，显示出一定的通用性与应用潜力。

Abstract: Extracting informative representations from longitudinal data that can predict future outcomes remains a critical challenge in medicine. Medical datasets are inherently heterogeneous, consisting of a large number of variables collected from different sources, sampled with different temporal spacings, and representing different aspects of human health status. This requires identifying those variables with predictive value, processing longitudinal information, and integrating multiple variables for outcome prediction. Here, we propose a novel agent-based approach, LongAgent, that can autonomously search over combinations of variable sets, temporal windows and longitudinal aggregation functions, and identify candidates with promising predictive performance. LongAgent utilises a history memory of previous searches and numerical evidence to guide subsequent exploration. On synthetic data, LongAgent achieves a mean prediction RMSE of 1.7376 and improves over the strongest non-agent baseline by 0.0151 (95% CI: [0.0045,0.0260]; p=0.0273). On a real clinical dataset, it performs comparably to the best baseline.

</details>


### [144] [Pilot Early, Commit Late: A Real-Options Model of Enterprise AI Adoption under Rapid Technological Progress](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15919)
*Gaurav Tewari*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文构建两期AI部署时机决策模型，在企业可选择立即部署、有限试点或等待的情形下，刻画前沿不确定性、前沿进展速度、组织专有能力与模块化程度如何影响最优部署时机。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI技术前沿快速演进、实施具有部分不可逆性，且组织专有能力需通过实践积累，使企业面临特殊的时机问题：过早部署可能遭遇架构过时，过晚则丧失当前运营价值与学习机会。

Method: 建立两期不确定性下的AI部署决策模型，企业在立即部署、有限试点与等待之间选择；立即部署获得当期运营价值但暴露于架构过时风险，等待保留观察到前沿后再采纳的期权，试点牺牲当期运营价值以构建组织专有学习而不完全承诺；并给出连续时间扩展。

Result: 得到五项核心时机结论与第六项关于学习发生位置的比较结论：均值保持的前沿不确定性上升提高等待与试点的价值，而当支付对前沿为仿射时立即部署价值不变；更快的预期前沿进展在部署架构仅捕获有限未来改进份额时可降低立即部署的相对吸引力；试点优于等待当且仅当所建能力的期望价值超过其成本；足够有价值的组织专有学习形成非空的"早试点、晚承诺"最优区域；存在闭式模块化阈值使立即部署优于最佳外部选项；生产学习与试点专有学习对时机边际影响不同。连续时间扩展复现不确定性提高采纳阈值、而能力与模块化降低阈值的标准结论。

Conclusion: 论文将部署、实验与等待三者区分开来，说明技术快速进展可以理性地增加实验而不必然为不可逆承诺提供依据。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence presents firms with an unusual timing problem. The technology frontier is improving rapidly, implementation is partly irreversible, and organization-specific capabilities are accumulated through action. This paper develops a two-period decision model of AI deployment under uncertainty in which a firm chooses among immediate deployment, a limited pilot, and waiting. Deployment earns current operating value but exposes the firm to architectural obsolescence; waiting preserves the option to adopt after the frontier is observed; a pilot sacrifices current operating value to build organization-specific learning without full commitment. The model yields five central timing results and a sixth comparative result on where learning occurs. First, a mean-preserving increase in frontier uncertainty raises the value of waiting and piloting but leaves immediate deployment unchanged when its payoff is affine in the frontier. Second, faster expected frontier progress can reduce the relative attractiveness of immediate deployment when deployed architecture captures only a limited share of future improvement. Third, a pilot dominates waiting exactly when the expected value of the capability it builds exceeds its cost. Fourth, sufficiently valuable organization-specific learning creates a nonempty region in which "pilot early, commit late" is optimal. Fifth, there is a closed-form modularity threshold above which immediate deployment dominates the best outside option. Sixth, production learning and pilot-specific learning affect the timing margin differently. A continuous-time extension recovers the standard result that uncertainty raises the adoption threshold while capability and modularity lower it. The paper separates deploying, experimenting, and waiting, and shows why rapid progress can rationally increase experimentation without justifying irreversible commitment.

</details>


### [145] [Recurrent GraphNeural NetworkswithSet-BasedAggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15932)
*Blai Bonet*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究基于集合聚合的循环GNN，给出了可从权重检查的充分条件，实现了该类网络与BΣ°₁模态μ演算片段之间的双向有效等价，无需计数逻辑、外部停机信号或非有效接受条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有循环GNN的逻辑刻画依赖多重集聚合、分级（计数）逻辑，以及无法从网络参数验证的停机或接受条件，导致权重到符号解释之间缺乏可验证路径。

Method: 研究采用基于集合聚合的循环GNN，识别可从权重检查的充分条件，使网络可编译为公式、公式可编译为网络；核心是建立该类网络与可达性与安全性性质布尔闭包（模态μ演算片段BΣ°₁）之间的有效双向等价，该片段恰为有限词汇上稳定化的精确表达层次。

Result: 建立了网络类与BΣ°₁之间的有效双向等价；该片段支持单极性不动点及其布尔组合，但不支持相反极性不动点的复合；对应关系无需计数逻辑、外部停机信号或非有效接受条件。

Conclusion: 所提条件为满足条件的网络提供了从权重到符号解释的可验证路径，且所刻画的片段并非人为构造，而是有限词汇上稳定化的精确表达层次。

Abstract: Recurrent GNNs iterate message passing to convergence, and their logical characterizations to date rely on multi-set aggregation, graded (counting) logics, and halting or acceptance conditions that cannot be verified from the network's parameters. We study recurrent GNNs with set-based aggregation and identify sufficient conditions checkable from the weights for networks to compile into formulas and formulas into networks. The main result is an effective, two-directional equivalence between a class of networks and the Boolean closure of reachability and safety properties, the fragment B$Σ^{\circ}_1$ of the modal $μ$-calculus. The fragment is not an artifact: it is the exact expressive level of stabilization over finite vocabulary, which supports fixed points of a single polarity and Boolean combinations thereof, but not the composition of fixed points of opposite polarities. The correspondence needs no counting logic, no external halting signal, and no non-effective acceptance condition, yielding a verifiable path from weights to symbolic explanations for networks meeting the conditions.

</details>


### [146] [Stellar Colosseum: A Many-Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Research in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15983)
*Honghao Lin,David P. Woodruff,Yuan Deng,Jieming Mao,Song Zuo,Vahab Mirrokni*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Stellar Colosseum 是一个模型无关的推理编排框架，用于数学与理论计算机科学的长期研究任务，通过策略探索、成熟度门控分解、并行候选生成与证伪，在 TCS-Bench 上达 71.0%，Codeforces 上解出 222 题中的 218 题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型能产出看似合理的短证明，但在长周期研究问题上仍不可靠，因为此类问题的进展依赖一系列不确定且相互依赖的决策。

Method: Colosseum 在证明构造前先探索备选策略；使用"readyness gate"判断某条路线是否成熟到可以分解；将证明计划表示为相互依赖的章节级子问题；把验证器发现的问题回传到论证中受影响的部分。各阶段并行生成候选、以针对性证伪攻击候选，并通过重叠随机采样树聚合（overlapping random-sample tree aggregation）将候选及其批评合并为单一研究产物。该流程已作为 Long Proof 模式集成进 Google Antigravity 的 Teamwork 框架。

Result: 使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 与 Colosseum 在开放研究与基准评测中取得多项新结果，解决了 FOCS、JMLR 等顶会论文提出的开放问题；在取自 FOCS/STOC/SODA 的研究级定理证明基准 TCS-Bench 上准确率 71.0%（Gemini 3.1 Pro 与 Gemini 3.7 Flash）；在 Codeforces 评测中，带执行反馈的证明导向流水线用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 解出 222 题中的 218 题。

Conclusion: 模型无关的推理编排框架可显著提升语言模型在长周期、研究级数学与理论计算机科学问题上的可靠性，验证了通过结构化策略搜索、分解与验证闭环来扩展推理规模的有效性。

Abstract: Language models can produce plausible short proofs, but may still be unreliable on long-horizon research problems, where progress depends on a sequence of uncertain and interdependent decisions. We introduce Stellar Colosseum, a model-agnostic harness for allocating inference across research in mathematics and theoretical computer science. Colosseum explores alternative strategies before proof construction, uses a readiness gate to decide when a route is mature enough to decompose, represents the proof plan as interdependent section-level subproblems, and routes verifier findings back to the affected part of the argument. Across these stages, it generates candidates in parallel, attacks them with targeted falsification, and combines candidates and their critiques into a single research artifact through overlapping random-sample tree aggregation. The Colosseum workflow has also been integrated into Google Antigravity's Teamwork framework as the Long Proof pattern.
  We demonstrate the capabilities of Colosseum through open-ended research and evaluations on theorem-proving and competitive programming benchmarks. Using Colosseum with Gemini 3.1 Pro, we obtain several new results that address open problems arising from papers published at top venues such as FOCS and JMLR. On TCS-Bench, a benchmark of research-level theorem-proving tasks drawn from papers published at FOCS, STOC, and SODA, Colosseum achieves 71.0% accuracy using Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 3.7 Flash. In a separate Codeforces evaluation using Gemini 3.1 Pro, the proof-oriented pipeline with execution feedback solves 218 of 222 problems.

</details>


### [147] [Corrupt Plans, Clean Traces: Evading Chain-of-Thought Monitoring with Plan Injection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15989)
*Keertana Chidambaram,Andrew Ilyas,Vasilis Syrgkanis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出“计划注入”（plan injection）攻击：在 actor 的上下文中植入有害但听起来无害的推理，可诱导其执行对抗行为并规避 CoT 监控。该攻击在多项监控性基准上实现 25–33% 的规避率，并泛化到更大模型（如 DeepSeek-R1）；actor 还会将注入计划转述为自身推理而不标注来源。此外，给予监控器访问注入计划反而使 Bio-Math 任务检测率下降最多 50%，增加推理预算的监控器也会把 token 用于合理化注入计划而非标记它。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CoT 监控被视为一种安全策略：由监控器检查 actor 的推理以发现不安全规划、欺骗或失准迹象。但该策略的有效性依赖于 actor 推理的真实性与可监控性，若推理可被外部内容操纵，监控本身可能失效甚至反向有害，因此需要考察此类攻击。

Method: 作者先在 Lanham et al. (2023) 的多选题问答可监控性设置中，结合 Li et al. (2025) 的 investigator-agent 引出框架发现该攻击；随后将攻击泛化，在多个可监控性基准和更难任务上测试，并扩展到更大模型（如 DeepSeek-R1）。同时开展附加监控资源的消融实验（向监控器提供注入计划）以及监控推理预算的案例研究。

Result: 攻击在不同可监控性基准上取得 25–33% 的监控规避率，并可泛化到更大模型如 DeepSeek-R1。actor 不仅遵循注入计划，还将其转述为自身推理，且不明确标注来源。额外监控资源有时造成损害：向监控器提供注入计划使 Bio-Math 任务检测率下降最多 50%；在监控推理预算案例中，额外的思考 token 被用于合理化注入计划而非标记它。

Conclusion: CoT 监控并非稳健的安全防线：上下文中的“计划注入”可同时驱动对抗行为并规避检测，更多监控资源也可能适得其反。因此需重新审视监控器设计与 actor 推理的归因机制，并针对此类操纵开发更可靠的监控与防御方法。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a safety strategy where the reasoning of a large language model "actor" is inspected by a "monitor" (often another language model) for signs of unsafe planning, deception, or misalignment. We find that planting harmful but benign-sounding reasoning in the actor's context can steer it to perform adversarial actions while evading monitors, an attack we term "plan injection". We initially discover this attack in the multiple-choice question-answering monitorability setting proposed by Lanham et al. (2023), using the investigator-agent elicitation framework of Li et al. (2025). We generalize the attack and show that the discovered behavior scales to harder tasks (achieving 25-33% monitor evasion rates across different monitorability benchmarks) and larger models such as DeepSeek-R1. Across the settings we study, actor models not only follow injected plans but also paraphrase them as their own reasoning, without explicit attribution to the injections. Finally, we find cases where extra monitor resources cause harm - giving the monitor access to the injected plan drops detection by as much as 50% in the Bio-Math task and in a case study on monitor reasoning budget, we find transcripts where additional thinking tokens are spent rationalizing the injected plan rather than flagging it.

</details>


### [148] [Portable Semantics, Private Dialects: Reuse and Negative Transfer in Latent Communication Between Language-Model Cells](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.11365)
*Narcis Marincat*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在受限证据可见性下独立训练的多智能体社会并未形成统一的数据包语言；零样本互操作失败源于新算子指令的解释与执行；继承的全局接口状态会造成严重负迁移，重置读写与输出模块可将深度三准确率从0.169提升至0.857。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 母研究中唯一高性能的全局可见模型学得了与情节纠缠的编码，而受限可见性场景更偏好可复用的、按值索引的隐式数据包接口。本文作为配套研究，旨在检验独立训练的社会是否共享同一种数据包语言、严格零样本迁移在何处失败，以及继承的接口状态对后续学习是有益还是有害。

Method: 1）对6个独立训练的受限社会全部30个有序配对进行防泄漏因果互操作审计，采用密封的留出结构，并按预注册的原始/正交/线性/非线性对齐阶梯评估；2）在既定分解与密封源公式下，用源跨度控制定位零样本失败；3）采用匹配自适应因子实验检验继承接口的迁移效应。

Result: 六个语义相似的接口并不构成统一原始语言：仅一对同初始化配对双向完全互操作，另一对呈非对称部分兼容，其余26个跨初始化方向在所有冻结对齐层级均失败。零样本失败被定位到新算子指令的解释与执行。全局训练的通信接口构成严重负迁移先验：仅重置数据包读取器、写入器与输出口，深度三准确率由0.169升至0.857。在两个受限检查点与两条独立冻结目标流上，继承接口均未超过全新接口基线的预注册0.10阈值。

Conclusion: 主要结论限于近迁移的17状态设定；负迁移因子结论仅涉及一个全局可见母队列检查点，附录补充了事后标记全局孪生案例研究。

Abstract: In shared-genome language-model societies, restricted evidence visibility favors reusable, value-indexed latent packet interfaces, whereas the sole high-performing globally visible model in the parent study learned an episode-entangled code. This companion study asks whether independently trained societies share one packet language, where strict zero-shot transfer fails, and whether inherited interface state helps or harms later learning. First, a leakage-controlled causal interoperability audit over all 30 ordered pairs of six independently trained restricted societies -- under sealed held-out structure and a preregistered raw/orthogonal/linear/nonlinear alignment ladder -- shows the six semantically similar interfaces do not form one raw language: one same-initialization pair is exactly interoperable in both directions, a second shows asymmetric partial compatibility, and all 26 cross-initialization directions fail every frozen alignment rung. Second, within the tested decomposition and a single sealed source formulation, a source-span control localizes strict zero-shot failure to interpretation and execution of the new operator instructions. Third, in a matched adaptation factorial, the globally trained communication interface acts as a severe negative-transfer prior: reinitializing only the packet reader, writer, and mouth raises final depth-three accuracy from 0.169 to 0.857. Fourth, across two restricted checkpoints and two independently frozen target streams each, inherited interfaces never exceeded fresh-interface controls by the preregistered 0.10 margin. All primary conclusions are bounded to a near-transfer 17-state setting; the negative-transfer factorial concerns one globally visible parent-cohort checkpoint, while an appendix adds a post hoc tagged-global twin case study.

</details>


<div id='cs.CV'></div>

# cs.CV [[Back]](#toc)

### [149] [Adaptive Conformal Redistribution for Inter-class Transitional Uncertainty in Medical Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13303)
*Saibal Ghosh,Samarup Bhattacharya,Sanjoy Kumar Saha,Umapada Pal,Tapabrata Chakraborti*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AdaConRed，一种无标签的后验保形决策规则，将模糊的保形预测集重新分配为精化类别，在OSCC与ISIC基准上提升总体及恶性类别准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像分类常存在过渡类别，其特征分布与相邻类别重叠，导致决策边界模糊。保形预测虽能给出不确定性感知的预测集，但在需要单一决策的临床筛查中无法直接应用。

Method: 提出五阶段流程：视觉-语言生成式增强缓解少数类稀缺；冻结的DermFoundation编码器提取嵌入；轻量MLP分类；熵调制、边界感知的非一致分数构建自适应预测集；将预测为过渡类且为多标签集的样本在推理时仅凭模型输出重分配给集合内最可能的替代类别。

Result: 在误覆盖率0.2下评估OSCC与ISIC。3类OSCC总体准确率由73.54%升至77.38%，口腔癌由64.29%升至82.14%，良性由56.57%升至70.20%，OPMD由84.78%降至80.16%；ISIC总体由85.83%升至87.19%，黑色素瘤由66.04%升至68.34%。相同骨干与重分配规则下优于LAC、APS和RAPS。

Conclusion: 保形预测可超越不确定性量化，扩展为在存在过渡性疾病类别时的可操作决策支持，增益集中于临床关键的恶性类别。

Abstract: Medical image classification is frequently complicated by transitional categories whose feature distributions overlap those of adjacent classes, producing ambiguous decision boundaries. Conformal prediction returns uncertainty-aware prediction sets, but these are not directly actionable in clinical screening, where a single decision is required. This work proposes adaptive conformal redistribution (AdaConRed), a label-free post-conformal decision rule that converts ambiguous prediction sets into refined class assignments. A five-stage pipeline is developed. Vision-language generative augmentation addresses minority-class scarcity; a frozen DermFoundation encoder provides embeddings; a lightweight multi-layer perceptron performs classification; an entropy-modulated, margin-aware nonconformity score constructs adaptive prediction sets; samples predicted as transitional with multi-label sets are reassigned to the most probable alternative class within the set, using only model outputs at inference. Evaluation uses the OSCC oral lesion and ISIC skin lesion benchmarks at a miscoverage level of 0.2. On the 3-class OSCC benchmark, overall accuracy improves from 73.54% to 77.38%, with oral cancer accuracy rising from 64.29% to 82.14% and benign accuracy from 56.57% to 70.20%. Reassignment of transitional samples reduces OPMD accuracy from 84.78% to 80.16%, consistent with the asymmetric cost of missed malignancy. On ISIC, overall accuracy improves from 85.83% to 87.19%, melanoma accuracy rising from 66.04% to 68.34%. AdaConRed outperforms LAC, APS and RAPS under an identical backbone and redistribution rule. Conformal prediction can be extended beyond uncertainty quantification toward actionable decision support where transitional disease categories are present, with gains concentrated in the clinically critical malignant categories. Code repository: https://github.com/saibal436ghosh/AdaConRed.

</details>


### [150] [Direct Conditional Transition Sampling for Diffusion Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14596)
*Qi Yu,Hanlin Wu,Xiaohui Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 DCTS，一种无需训练的扩散逆问题求解方法，通过直接随机流近似实现条件后验刷新，在四个逆问题上取得有竞争力的重建质量，最高实现 16.8 倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无需训练扩散逆求解器在局部测量引导与昂贵的干净空间后验更新间取舍。独立后验刷新通过采样干净条件并重新加噪可改善全局校正，但其实际实现依赖概率流 ODE 积分与干净空间 MCMC，计算代价高。

Method: 提出直接条件转移采样（DCTS），对理想刷新目标做直接随机流近似：不显式采样干净样本，而是在短内路径上估计测量条件下的干净均值，并将高斯源噪声直接传输到下一噪声状态；借助去噪器兼容的充分统计量与协方差缩放的算子更新完成该条件均值估计。

Result: 在四个逆问题上的实验表明，DCTS 达到有竞争力的重建质量，相比竞争方法最高实现 16.8 倍加速。

Conclusion: DCTS 以更直接、高效的随机流近似替代 ODE 积分与 MCMC 的复杂流程，在保持重建质量的同时显著降低计算开销，为无需训练的扩散逆求解提供了高效的后验刷新方案。

Abstract: Training-free diffusion inverse solvers typically choose between local measurement guidance and costly clean-space posterior updates. Independent posterior refresh can improve global correction by sampling a clean conditional and re-noising it, but its practical realization requires probability-flow ODE integration and clean-space Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC). We propose Direct Conditional Transition Sampling (DCTS), a direct stochastic-flow approximation to the same ideal refresh target. Rather than explicitly drawing a clean sample, DCTS estimates the measurement-conditioned clean mean along a short inner path and transports Gaussian source noise directly to the next noisy state. A denoiser-compatible sufficient statistic and a covariance-scaled operator update enable this conditional-mean estimation. Experiments on four inverse problems demonstrate that DCTS achieves competitive reconstruction quality with up to $16.8\times$ speedups over competing methods.

</details>


### [151] [Personalized and Explainable Blood Pressure Estimation from PPG via Hybrid CNN--Morphological Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13190)
*Myung-Kyu Yi,Jongshill Lee,Jeyeon Lee,In Young Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种生理引导的混合框架，将CNN与形态学先验分支耦合，用于个性化连续无袖带血压估计，在MIMIC-III子集上实现高精度并提升可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于PPG的无袖带血压监测方法存在两大局限：手工特征方法依赖精确的基准点检测且仅适用于短期分析；深度学习模型虽精度高，但常表现为黑箱、生理可解释性有限。因此需要兼顾精度、个性化与可解释性的新框架。

Method: 提出生理引导的混合框架：一路CNN分支捕捉全局与局部波形动态，另一路形态学先验分支显式编码个体特异性血管特征。通过嵌入基于形态学的特征集显式表征个体血管特性，增强个性化并降低对大规模训练数据的依赖。在MIMIC-III数据库子集上采用受试者特异性（个性化）测试协议进行评估，并使用SHAP进行解释性分析。

Result: 在个性化测试协议下，收缩压MAE为3.77 mmHg，舒张压MAE为2.36 mmHg；相较仅CNN的受试者特异性基线，分别相对改善43.7%和32.4%。SHAP分析表明引入的形态学先验特征与个体血管特征一致，强化了逐受试者可解释性。

Conclusion: 结果表明，结合新型形态学描述符的个性化、生理引导混合学习，有望在真实场景中实现准确且可解释的血压监测。

Abstract: Continuous cuffless blood pressure (BP) monitoring using photoplethysmography (PPG) offers a promising solution for personalized healthcare. However, existing methods have two major limitations. Handcrafted feature-based approaches rely on precise fiducial point detection and are limited to short-term analysis, while deep learning models, despite their accuracy, often operate as black boxes with limited physiological interpretability. To address these challenges, we propose a physiology-guided hybrid framework for personalized BP estimation that couples a convolutional neural network (CNN) branch capturing global and local waveform dynamics with a morphology-prior branch that explicitly encodes person-specific vascular characteristics. By embedding a morphology-based feature set that explicitly encodes individual vascular characteristics, the proposed framework enhances personalization and reduces dependence on large-scale training datasets. Evaluated on a subset of the MIMIC-III database under a subject-specific (personalized) testing protocol, the proposed personalized physiology-guided hybrid approach achieved mean absolute errors (MAEs) of 3.77 mmHg for systolic BP and 2.36 mmHg for diastolic BP, corresponding to relative improvements of 43.7% and 32.4% over a subject-specific (personalized) CNN-only baseline. SHAP-based analysis confirmed that the introduced morphology-prior features align with individual vascular characteristics, reinforcing per-subject interpretability. These findings highlight the potential of personalized, physiology-guided hybrid learning with novel morphological descriptors for accurate and explainable BP monitoring in real-world settings.

</details>


### [152] [Part Grounding, Not Action Knowledge: Locating the Bottleneck in VLM Affordance Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13225)
*Sarthak Sattigeri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究将可供性问答拆分为"定位作用部位"与"判断所需动作"两步，发现视觉语言模型在低级操作推理上的主导瓶颈是部位定位而非动作知识：开放提示下push动作64次评测仅正确产生1次，但明示目标部位后所有模型动作准确率提升0.32–0.63、push召回从0–1/8升至7–8/8，且无模型在开放提示下胜过忽略图像的常数基线，明示部位后八个模型全部超越。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚合准确率无法揭示视觉语言模型在低级操作推理中具体在哪一步失败。作者希望分离可供性问题中混杂的两个环节：识别物体上应作用的部位，以及判断该部位需要何种动作，从而定位真正的瓶颈。

Method: 在19个铰接物体上询问来自三家开发者的八个模型"机器人应施加何种运动"。设置开放提示与明示目标部位两种条件，比较动作准确率与push召回；并要求模型在无标签集条件下用自由文本描述同一部位。同时通过常数基线对照检验结果，并在真实照片与渲染物体上测试抓取点定位能力。

Result: 开放提示下，push在64次评测中仅1次正确产生（该动作对19个物体中8个正确且每次都出现在候选标签集中）；检查输出发现模型描述的部位与被评分部位不一致。明示目标部位后，所有模型动作准确率提升0.32–0.63（从0.158–0.474升至0.684–0.947），push召回从0–1/8升至7–8/8。开放提示下无模型胜过忽略图像的常数基线，明示部位后八个模型全部胜出。自由文本描述中，模型对8个物体中的6–8个产生按压类语言。真实照片上仅三个模型抓取点定位优于常数基线，渲染物体上无一模型胜出。作者还记录了自身两处测量错误：一个使常数基线得0.929的阈值，以及一个在19个物体中4个上出错的标注规则。

Conclusion: 结果难以用动作知识缺失解释，而指向部位定位是主导瓶颈，该模式在三个模型家族中一致且不随能力提升而减弱。明示部位相当于提供了定位变量，因此该结果界定了理想部位检测器所能带来的上限，而非证明模型具备通用的力学模型。研究也强调用平凡替代方案检验数值可发现测量误差。

Abstract: Benchmarks agree that vision-language models reason poorly about low-level manipulation, but an aggregate accuracy score does not say which step fails. We separate two steps that affordance questions conflate: identifying which part of an object to act on, and knowing what action that part requires. Across 19 articulated objects we asked eight models, spanning three developers, what motion a robot should apply. Under an open prompt, push was produced once in 64 evaluations where it was correct, despite being correct for 8 of 19 objects and appearing in the offered label set every time. Inspecting the outputs showed why: models described a different part than the one being scored, e.g. explaining how to pick up a camera rather than press its button. Naming the target part raises action accuracy by 0.32 to 0.63 for every model, from 0.158-0.474 to 0.684-0.947, and push recall from 0-1/8 to 7-8/8. No model beats a constant answer that ignores the image under the open prompt; once the part is named, all eight do. Asked to describe the same part in free prose with no label set, models produce pressing language for 6 to 8 of 8. These results are hard to reconcile with missing action knowledge, and instead point to part grounding as the dominant bottleneck, a pattern that holds across all three model families and does not diminish with capability. Naming the part supplies the grounding variable, so this bounds what a perfect part detector would offer rather than demonstrating a general model of mechanics. Two supporting results agree: on real photographs only three of eight models localize grasp points better than a constant baseline, and on rendered objects none do. We also document two measurement errors of our own, a threshold that let a constant baseline score 0.929 and a labelling rule wrong on 4 of 19 objects, both caught only by testing our numbers against trivial alternatives.

</details>


### [153] [Synthetic Leprosy Image Generation Using Mask-Conditioned Latent Diffusion and Transfer Learning from Large Chronic Wound Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13226)
*Yusuf Abdulkadir*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文验证：慢性创面图像训练的掩膜条件扩散模型可迁移到低数据的麻风病灶合成，感知多样性无塌缩，主要瓶颈在语义控制而非图像质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 被忽视热带病的机器学习受数据稀缺限制而非算法限制：麻风公开标注图像仅数百张，远低于生成模型需求。作者探究数据充足的慢性创面摄影能否作为供体域迁移到该低数据场景。

Method: 三阶段流水线：(1) DeepLabV3-ResNet50分割网络（验证Dice 0.876、IoU 0.799）为两个无掩膜创面数据集生成病灶掩膜；(2) 用Stable Diffusion 1.5组件构建掩膜条件潜扩散模型，在3,280个感兴趣区创面裁剪上训练，将UNet输入卷积由4通道扩至11通道，以接纳3张掩膜特征图与模糊低频上下文潜变量；(3) 在来自约150名患者、764张图像中抽取的708对麻风图像-掩膜上微调。以LPIPS感知距离评估，并用同242张锚点图像计算的真实对真实基线作为参照。

Result: 生成集无模式塌缩：内部感知多样性0.662，与真实麻风集0.672（95% CI [0.664, 0.680]）统计上不可区分；生成图像位于真实分布外0.044 LPIPS，可测但低于一个标准差的一半。微调仅轻微改变输出分布，可归因于病灶几何仅通过输入拼接进入网络。

Conclusion: 慢性创面摄影是麻风病灶合成的可行供体域：低层外观迁移良好，剩余障碍是语义控制而非图像质量。

Abstract: Machine learning for neglected tropical diseases is limited by data, not algorithms: public annotated image sets for leprosy (Hansen's disease) number in the hundreds, orders of magnitude below what generative models require. We ask whether a model trained on abundant chronic wound photography transfers to this low-data regime. We build a three-stage pipeline. First, a DeepLabV3-ResNet50 segmentation network (validation Dice 0.876, IoU 0.799) supplies lesion masks for two wound datasets that ship without them. Second, we assemble a mask-conditioned latent diffusion model from Stable Diffusion 1.5 components and train it on 3,280 region-of-interest wound crops, widening the UNet input convolution from 4 to 11 channels to admit three mask feature maps and a blurred low-frequency context latent. Third, we fine-tune this model on 708 leprosy image-mask pairs drawn from 764 images of approximately 150 patients. We evaluate with LPIPS perceptual distance, anchored by a real-versus-real baseline computed on the same 242 anchor images as the cross-set comparisons; without that reference the cross-set distances cannot be interpreted. The generated set shows no mode collapse: its internal perceptual diversity (0.662) is statistically indistinguishable from that of the real leprosy set (0.672, 95% CI [0.664, 0.680]). Generated images sit 0.044 LPIPS outside the real distribution - measurably apart, but under half of one standard deviation. Fine-tuning shifted the output distribution only marginally, which we trace to lesion geometry reaching the network through input concatenation alone. Chronic wound photography is therefore a viable donor domain for leprosy lesion synthesis: low-level appearance transfers well, and the remaining barrier is semantic control rather than image quality.

</details>


### [154] [Don't Just Look, Intervene: Perturbation Based Region Labeling for VQA Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13228)
*Marko Jojic,Zhaonan Li,Ben Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出"模型因果视觉证据"作为标注目标，并设计CSGR流程自动获取答案关键区域，用于三类grounding-aware训练方法，实验表明其标注信号最一致有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM应依赖直接决定正确答案的视觉证据进行推理，但视觉grounding监督的获取成本高（人工标注昂贵）或依赖数据集特定的标注原语，难以规模化。因此需要一个可扩展、可自动化的标注方案来提供有效的区域级监督信号。

Method: 提出以"模型因果视觉证据"为标注目标，定义为：对某图像-问题对，其反事实干预会改变模型答案分布的图像区域集合。据此设计CSGR（Counterfactual Search for Grounding Regions）流程：生成候选区域→对其进行扰动→测量对答案敏感度的影响→跨多个judge聚合证据，从而近似VQA数据中答案关键区域。随后将CSGR标注插入三种已有的grounding-aware训练流程（attention steering、Visual CoT finetuning、latent visual reasoning），以验证标注方案本身作为监督信号的有效性，而非提出新的使用方式。

Result: 在与多种竞争的自动区域标注机制的对比中，CSGR标注在域内和域外评估中均取得相对Cross Entropy-only微调最一致的性能提升，说明该标注方案捕获了有用的区域级信息。

Conclusion: 模型因果视觉证据是一种可扩展、有效的区域级监督目标，CSGR生成的标注对多种消费区域标签的训练方式均具有增益，优于现有自动区域标注方法，具备跨域泛化能力。

Abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) should rely on visual evidence that directly determines the correct answer, but supervision for grounding visual reasoning is often expensive to obtain manually or tied to dataset-specific annotation primitives. We instead introduce model-causal visual evidence as an annotation target, defined as the set of image regions whose counterfactual intervention changes a model's answer distribution for a given image-question pair. Based on this principle, we introduce Counterfactual Search for Grounding Regions (CSGR). CSGR is a scalable pipeline that proposes candidate regions, perturbs them, measures their effect on answer sensitivity, and aggregates this evidence across multiple judges to approximate answer-critical regions in VQA data. To assess whether CSGR annotations contain a useful supervision signal, we plug them into three existing grounding-aware training routines: attention steering, Visual CoTfinetuning, and latent visual reasoning. These experiments test whether the proposed annotation scheme can provide a useful supervision signal across multiple ways of consuming region labels, rather than introducing a new way of using them. Across competing automatic region-labeling mechanisms, CSGR annotations provide the most consistent gains over Cross Entropy-only finetuning in both in-domain and out-of-domain evaluations, indicating that the proposed labeling scheme captures useful region-level information.

</details>


### [155] [What Does the Encoder Actually Decide? A Controlled Comparison of Vision Backbones on Joint Tree Segmentation and Stereo Depth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13232)
*Yida Lin,Bing Xue,Mengjie Zhang,Sam Schofield,Richard Green*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文在固定数据集、解码器、损失、训练策略与评估的前提下，构建硬参数共享网络，仅替换编码器，系统比较[M]个架构族（CNN、Transformer、混合、MLP-mixer、状态空间模型）在约25M参数预算、从头训练下对细长植被的联合语义分割与立体深度的表现，发现卷积与混合编码器最强、参数量不能预测质量、两任务排名高度一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人修剪树木需逐像素判断是否属于树木及其距离，现有做法通常凭"声誉"而非实测来选择视觉骨干，缺乏对编码器选择的受控度量。因此作者提出在其它条件完全一致时，量化编码器选择对细长植被联合分割与深度的实际影响。

Method: 构建单一编码器同时驱动分割与深度两个分支的硬参数共享网络，仅更换编码器且不做下游微调。在约25M参数预算下从头训练[N]个编码器、覆盖[M]个架构族；深度仅在树木像素上评估，分割使用边界F1与背景IoU以避免"全判为树"的捷径。

Result: 其一，最强编码器为卷积与混合架构而非Transformer：[BestEncoder]以[MIoU]分割mIoU与[Delta]深度δ₁领先，而[Y]个纯视觉Transformer中有[X]个从头训练时崩溃。其二，参数量不能预测质量：[SmallEncoder]仅[P]M参数却超越大两个数量级的模型。其三，分割与深度排名高度一致（Spearman ρ=[RhoValue]），无任务冲突。此外，[N]个编码器中有[K]个退化为全树分割，该问题被边界F1暴露却被区域IoU掩盖。

Conclusion: 在细长植被的联合分割与深度任务中，编码器选择显著影响性能，卷积/混合架构优于纯Transformer；模型规模不是质量的有效指标；两任务可共享编码器而无排名冲突；评估须采用边界F1以识别退化的全树分割。

Abstract: A robot pruning trees needs two facts per pixel: whether it belongs to a tree, and its distance. Both are usually obtained via task heads attached to a vision backbone chosen by reputation rather than measurement. Holding dataset, decoders, losses, schedule, and evaluation fixed, we ask: how much does the encoder choice change joint semantic segmentation and stereo depth on thin vegetation? We build a hard parameter-sharing network with one encoder feeding both branches, swapping only the encoder without downstream retuning. We evaluate [N] encoders across [M] architecture families (CNNs, transformers, hybrids, MLP-mixers, state-space models) near a ~25M budget, trained from scratch. Depth is evaluated on tree pixels only; segmentation uses boundary F1 and background IoU to prevent "label-everything-tree" shortcuts. Three findings stand out. First, the strongest encoders are convolutional and hybrid, not transformers: [BestEncoder] leads with [MIoU] segmentation mIoU and [Delta] depth $δ_1$, while [X] of [Y] plain vision transformers collapse when trained from scratch. Second, parameter count does not predict quality --- [SmallEncoder] at only [P]M parameters outranks models two orders of magnitude larger. Third, segmentation and depth rankings agree strongly (Spearman $ρ$ = [RhoValue]), showing no task conflict. Finally, [K] of [N] encoders collapse to degenerate all-tree segmentation --- exposed by boundary F1 but hidden by region IoU.

</details>


### [156] [EMCStereo: Attention-Enhanced Stereo Matching for Thin-Structure Depth Estimation with a Synthetic Tree-Branch Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13233)
*Yida Lin,Bing Xue,Mengjie Zhang,Sam Schofield,Richard Green*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EMCStereo立体匹配方法与VirtualTree合成数据集，针对细结构（树枝）匹配难题；模块使网络减小2.0%、推理仅增1.7%，在VirtualTree达1.31 px EPE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细结构（如树枝）是立体匹配最困难的情形：宽度仅数像素、背景杂乱，且真实树枝的稠密视差真值几乎无法人工标注，导致该场景缺乏有效的数据与方法支撑。

Method: EMCStereo在PSMNet式代价体骨干中集成三个轻量注意力模块：深层语义特征上的EMA、以学习空间金字塔权重替代拼接的MSFblock、最终匹配特征上的CoordAtt；MSFblock将四条金字塔分支合并为一条。另构建VirtualTree合成数据集，基于Unreal Engine 5与模拟ZED Mini双目设置渲染5,520对含精确视差的图像；并通过八组消融确定运行间噪声基线。

Result: 网络体积减小2.0%，推理时间仅增1.7%；八路消融确定噪声基线为0.009 px EPE。VirtualTree测试集1.31 px EPE（5.96% D1-all），SceneFlow 1.00 px，KITTI 2012/2015、ETH3D、Middlebury分别为0.80/0.73/0.62/3.19 px，深度精度delta_1由92.6%提升至98.7%。相对噪声基线，100 epoch预算下注意力栈精度中性，MSFblock与CoordAtt在无EMA时带来0.03–0.05 px代价。

Conclusion: 注意力模块组合可在几乎不增加计算与存储开销的前提下用于细结构立体匹配；以噪声基线为参照的消融表明模块贡献需谨慎解读，仅EMA与其他模块存在正向协同，整体在有限训练预算下保持精度中性。

Abstract: Thin structures such as tree branches are among the hardest cases for stereo matching: a branch is only a few pixels wide, the background is cluttered, and dense ground truth for real branches is nearly impossible to label by hand. We make three contributions. First, EMCStereo integrates three lightweight attention modules into a PSMNet-style cost-volume backbone: Efficient Multi-scale Attention (EMA) on deep semantic features, a Multi-Scale Fusion block (MSFblock) learning spatial pyramid weights instead of concatenating them, and Coordinate Attention (CoordAtt) on final matching features. Because MSFblock collapses four pyramid branches into one, the modules leave the network 2.0% smaller and add only 1.7% inference time overhead. Second, VirtualTree is a synthetic stereo dataset rendered in Unreal Engine 5 with a simulated ZED Mini rig, providing 5,520 pairs with exact disparity for thin branches. Third, an eight-way ablation establishes a run-to-run noise floor of 0.009 px end-point error (EPE). EMCStereo achieves 1.31 px EPE (5.96% D1-all) on the VirtualTree test split, 1.00 px on SceneFlow, and 0.80, 0.73, 0.62, and 3.19 px on KITTI 2012, KITTI 2015, ETH3D, and Middlebury, with depth accuracy delta_1 from 92.6% to 98.7%. Evaluated against the noise floor, the attention stack is accuracy-neutral at a 100-epoch budget, while MSFblock and CoordAtt cost 0.03-0.05 px unless EMA is present.

</details>


### [157] [Occlusal Geometry in Closed Form for Orthodontic Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13237)
*Ajo Babu George,Govind Arun,Sidharth N Krishna,Uma Ranjan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该工作将咬合数据报告生成从"推断"任务重构为"可测量"任务，通过解剖坐标系与咬合脊轮廓的闭式几何计算提取31项咬合量，结合梯度提升与摄影视图分类器融合，在ODIN 2026 Bite2Text中取得第三名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Bite2Text扫描对已在咬合状态下配准，使得过覆盖、覆盖、中线偏移等核心咬合量本可直接测量而非从图像推断，而既有方法仍按多模态描述生成处理，忽视了这一数据特性；同时所声明的RAS坐标系在发布数据上并不成立，导致坐标定义不可靠。

Method: 从牙弓锥度与牙弓闭合度重建每例的解剖坐标系以替代失真的RAS约定；将每个牙弓约简为弓角坐标下的咬合脊轮廓，闭式求解过覆盖、覆盖、中线偏移、横向重叠、反覆盖范围、牙尖交错滞后及咬合曲线等31项测量；用梯度提升将这31项测量映射到13个模板字段，仅在患者级交叉验证优于自身多数类基线的字段上作预测；由确定性渲染器生成语料库六段式叙述；再用ConvNeXt-Tiny对五张标准化摄影视图分类，按字段融合，将平均字段准确率由0.601提升至0.683。

Result: 重新实现挑战评测器后发现其BLEU-4与METEOR为局部变体，F均值权重召回归一化为9:1；两名临床医生对同一患者的发现仅47%一致，因此一份恒定报告在描述指标上反而比真实的第二位医生报告高出0.165。留出集上对口内扫描参考达BLEU-4 0.458、METEOR 0.677，对照片参考为0.278与0.507；提交系统在ODIN 2026 Bite2Text测试阶段以0.2680与0.4629位列第三，距第一名仅差0.022 BLEU-4，且全程CPU运行，每例不到十秒。

Conclusion: 在已配准的咬合扫描对上，解剖坐标重建与咬合脊轮廓的闭式几何测量是可行且高效的报告生成路径，配合梯度提升、确定性渲染与摄影视图融合可在纯CPU实时条件下达到竞争性性能；同时评测指标本身存在召回偏置、参考报告间一致性低，说明当前描述类评价与临床可重复性之间存在显著落差，数据集与代码已开源。

Abstract: Orthodontic report generation from intraoral data is normally cast as multimodal captioning, yet the released Bite2Text scan pairs are supplied already registered in occlusion, which makes several core occlusal quantities directly measurable rather than inferable. The system reported here exploits that property: an anatomical frame is recovered per case from arch taper and arch closure instead of the stated RAS convention, which does not hold across the release, and each arch is reduced to an occlusal ridge profile in arch-angle coordinates yielding overbite, overjet, midline deviation, transverse overlap, crossbite extent, cusp interdigitation lag, and the occlusal curves in closed form. Gradient boosting maps 31 such measurements onto 13 template fields, a field being predicted only where patient-level cross-validation beats its own majority baseline, and a deterministic renderer emits the corpus six-part narrative; a ConvNeXt-Tiny classifier over the five standardised photographic views is fused per field, raising mean field accuracy from 0.601 to 0.683. Reimplementation of the challenge evaluator shows that its BLEU-4 and METEOR are local variants whose F-mean weights recall nine to one, that two clinicians agree on 47 percent of findings for the same patient, and that a constant report consequently outscores a genuine second clinician report by 0.165 captioning. Held-out scores reach BLEU-4 0.458 and METEOR 0.677 against intraoral scan references and 0.278 and 0.507 against photograph references, and the submitted system placed third in the ODIN 2026 Bite2Text test phase at 0.2680 and 0.4629, within 0.022 BLEU-4 of first, running on CPU in under ten seconds per case. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/GIND123/ODIN_toothfairy4

</details>


### [158] [Abstract-LoRA: Unlocking Single-Image Style Transfer through Targeted U-Net Block Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13239)
*Xinglin Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Abstract-LoRA，通过在扩散模型特定U-Net块上进行轻量LoRA训练，提升单图风格迁移效果，兼顾风格保真与内容保留。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多图风格迁移通常需5-10张风格样例才能取得满意效果，而单图方法难以兼顾内容保留与风格保真，限制了稀缺艺术作品的风格提取与艺术价值挖掘；现有B-LoRA虽实现基本风格-内容解耦，但无法捕捉复杂背景。

Method: 基于B-LoRA，对U-Net块进行更精细分析，引入额外的U-Net块，并对风格图像进行基于聚类的抽象化处理，以更好地解耦并平衡风格与内容，实现轻量化LoRA训练。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在视觉上生成更和谐、令人满意的艺术图像，并在定量指标上同时提升风格保留与内容保留。

Conclusion: Abstract-LoRA推动了单图风格迁移的性能边界，为稀缺艺术作品的风格迁移提供了更优解决方案。

Abstract: Diffusion models represent one of the most advanced paradigms in generative modeling. Leveraging their development, a growing number of style transfer methods based on diffusion models have been proposed. However, among these methods, multi-image style transfer approaches that require at least five to ten style examples tend to achieve more satisfactory results. Single-image methods, by contrast, often struggle with either insufficient content preservation or inadequate style fidelity. This greatly limits style extraction from scarce artworks and undermines their artistic value. To address this, we propose Abstract-LoRA, a method that pushes the boundaries of single-image style transfer through lightweight LoRA training on specific U-Net blocks in diffusion models. Specifically, our work is inspired by B-LoRA, a style transfer method that achieves basic style-content disentanglement by training specific U-Net blocks. However, it suffers from a critical limitation: the inability to capture complex backgrounds. Building upon B-LoRA, our method conducts a more refined analysis of U-Net blocks, employing additional U-Net blocks and clustering-based abstraction of style images to better disentangle and balance style and content. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed method not only generates visually more harmonious and satisfying artistic images but also quantitatively improves the preservation of both style and content in the final outputs.

</details>


### [159] [ArtSociety: Multi-Agent Multimodal Collaboration for Art Emotion Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13240)
*Jian Li,Fanfan Ji,Jinxiang Lai,Ying Tai,Jian Yang,Xiao-Tong Yuan,Chengjie Wang,Yabiao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ArtSociety 多智能体框架，通过异构多模态专家与两个免训练控制器协同，在 AffectiveArt 多维度艺术情感理解任务上取得整体得分 0.8870。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AffectiveArt 任务需联合预测细粒度情感（12 类，头尾比 1549:1）、二值效价/唤醒度及五项属性描述，各子任务间存在强经验性权衡，单模型方案难以同时优化全部子任务。

Method: 集成异构专家：DINOv2-Giant 视觉智能体（A1）、场景化 CoT 微调 MLLM（A2）及三个闭源推理智能体（A3–A5）；引入两个免训练控制器——(i) 稀有类感知投票仲裁器，对尾部情感降低一致性阈值以利用跨智能体族的去相关误差模式；(ii) 描述优先推理智能体，采用 DESCRIBE-then-CLASSIFY 思维链强制先给出视觉证据再承诺标签。同时设置任务路由策略，将困难情感任务交由五智能体集成，将接近饱和的效价/唤醒度与生成式描述任务交给单一最强推理智能体。

Result: 官方测试集（1000 件艺术品）整体得分 0.8870（分类 0.7789，描述 0.9952）。十一变体消融实验显示，当方法与规模在约 0.76 处饱和后，决定性增益来自智能体协作与数据侧监督；在较旧数据上训练的 30B MoE 模型不及在更优数据上训练的 8B 模型。

Conclusion: 多智能体协作与数据侧监督是突破性能瓶颈的关键，其收益超过单纯扩大模型规模；免训练控制器与任务路由策略可有效缓解多子任务间的权衡问题。

Abstract: The AffectiveArt Multidimensional Art Emotion Understanding task asks to jointly predict an artwork's fine-grained emotion (12 classes, 1549:1 head-to-tail ratio), binary valence/arousal, and five attribute-grounded descriptions -- sub-tasks that exhibit strong empirical trade-offs, so the single-model solutions we tried do not jointly optimize all of them well. We present ArtSociety, a multi-agent framework that assembles heterogeneous multimodal experts -- a DINOv2-Giant vision agent (A1), a scene-grounded CoT fine-tuned MLLM (A2), and three closed-source reasoning agents (A3-A5) -- and coordinates them with two training-free controllers: (i) a rare-class-aware voting arbiter that lowers the agreement threshold for tail emotions, exploiting decorrelated error patterns across agent families; and (ii) a description-first reasoning agent whose DESCRIBE-then-CLASSIFY chain of thought forces visual evidence before label commitment, yielding near-perfect grounded descriptions. A task-routing policy directs the hard emotion task to the full five-agent ensemble while assigning the near-saturated valence/arousal and generative description tasks to the single strongest reasoning agent. On the official test set (1,000 artworks), ArtSociety achieves an Overall Score of 0.8870 (Classification 0.7789, Description 0.9952). An eleven-variant ablation study reveals that, once method and scale saturate at around 0.76, the decisive gains come from agent collaboration and data-side supervision -- a 30B MoE model trained on older data does not outperform an 8B model trained on better data. Code is available at https://github.com/swordlidev/ArtSociety

</details>


### [160] [SJD-SV: Speculative Jacobi Decoding with Semantics Verification for Autoregressive Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13245)
*Baoquan Zhang,Bingqi Shan,Shihao Fang,Kenghong Lin,Xutao Li,Yunming Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示 Speculative Jacobi Decoding (SJD) 中 token ambiguity 的成因，并提出语义级验证方法 SJD-SV，可即插即用地提升自回归图像生成加速效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SJD 虽在加速自回归图像生成上表现优异，但存在 token 验证过程中的 token ambiguity 问题，且其成因尚未被合理解释。

Method: 对 vision token 进行可视化分析，发现其通常对应局部、细小且模糊的视觉细节，单 token 难以准确表达语义，从而引发歧义。基于此提出 SJD-SV：利用 token 间的强纠错特性识别语义感知的 token 子序列，将逐 token 验证改为语义感知的子序列级验证，且方法为插件式，可直接集成到现有 SJD 及其变体中。

Result: 在多数据集上的大量实验表明，现有 SJD 方法集成 SJD-SV 后性能获得显著提升。

Conclusion: token ambiguity 源于 vision token 的局部模糊特性，采用语义级子序列验证可有效缓解该问题并加速自回归图像生成，方法具备良好的通用性与可插拔性。

Abstract: Speculative Jacobi Decoding (SJD) is an important approach for accelerating autoregressive image generation. Although SJD has shown superior performance, recent studies point out that it usually suffers from a token ambiguity issue during token verification but its reason can not be well explained. To figure out this reason, in this paper, we conduct a visualization analysis on vision token and find that different from text tokens, vision tokens generally corresponds to some local, small, and unclear vision details, which means only using single token is difficult to accurately express a certain semantic, thereby causing token ambiguity issue. To this end, we propose a novel Speculative Jacobi Decoding with Semantics Verification (called SJD-SV), for accelerating autoregressive image generation. The key idea is that leveraging the strong correction characters between tokens to recognize semantic-aware token subsequence and then instead of perform token-by-token verification, turning to perform verification on semantic-aware token subsequence level for accelerating image generation. In particular, our method is plug-in, which can be directly integrated into existing SJD and its variants. Extensive experiments on various datasets show that existing SJD methods achieve significant performance improvement after integrating our SJD-SV method.

</details>


### [161] [Pixel-wise Planarity for High-Precision Monocular Plane Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13246)
*Ahmetcan Yavuz,Alpay Ozkan,Rémi Pautrat,Shaohui Liu,Marc Pollefeys*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出逐像素平面性预测框架，结合深度、法向与平面性置信度进行区域生长，提升单目平面分割的几何精度与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单张RGB图像的平面分割因区域分组不精确和几何不一致的监督而困难，常导致过分割与误检平面。

Method: 基于预训练单目几何骨干（预测深度与表面法向），引入专门的平面性头估计逐像素平面性置信度；推理时将深度、法向和平面性在轻量级区域生长中结合，强制几何一致性形成平面段；并分析现有平面真值标注在严格距离阈值下的几何不一致性。

Result: 在多个数据集上，相比先前最优方法实现更高的几何精度和分割质量，同时提升计算效率。

Conclusion: 逐像素平面性预测为鲁棒单目平面分割提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Plane segmentation from a single RGB image remains challenging due to imprecise region grouping and geometrically inconsistent supervision, often leading to over-segmentation and false planar detections. We propose instead a pixel-wise planarity prediction framework for robust monocular plane segmentation. Building on a pretrained monocular geometric backbone predicting depth and surface normals, we introduce a dedicated planarity head that estimates per-pixel planarity confidence. During inference, predicted depth, normals, and planarity are combined in a lightweight region-growing procedure that enforces geometric consistency when forming plane segments. We further analyze existing plane ground-truth annotations and demonstrate substantial geometric inconsistencies under strict distance thresholds. Across multiple datasets, our method achieves improved geometric precision and segmentation quality compared to prior state-of-the-art approaches, while improving computational efficiency. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/alpayozkan/PixelwisePlanarity.

</details>


### [162] [Evaluation of MLLM-Agnostic Plug-and-Play Keyframe Selection Methods for Long Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13250)
*Dilip Sarkar,Md. Safayet Islam,Liang Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文对五种免训练即插即用（PaP）关键帧选择方法进行统一评测，在3个MLLM与3个长视频理解基准上共15个聚合设置中，QAaF在13个设置中取得最佳性能，FOCUS总体排名第二。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM因视觉token与计算预算限制无法处理长视频的所有帧。现有增强长视频理解的三类路径中，重训练成本过高，适配器训练需大量资源；PaP方法成本最低、普适性最强。然而已报道的五种PaP方法分别在不同基准与不同MLLM上评估，缺乏可比性，亟需统一实验参照。

Method: 梳理三类长视频理解增强路径（重训练/扩展输入长度、为特定MLLM训练帧选择适配器、免训练PaP适配器），聚焦PaP关键帧选择，并区分是否利用query。随后选取已报道的5种PaP方法，在3个MLLM与3个长视频理解基准上进行统一、全面的对比评测，形成15个聚合评价设置。

Result: 在15个聚合评测设置中，QAaF有13个取得最佳性能；FOCUS总体排名第二。该结果首次为免训练关键帧选择方法提供了横向可比的实验基准。

Conclusion: 该工作为MLLM的免训练关键帧选择方法建立了统一的实验参照，验证了PaP路线的可行性与可及性，并为后续方法比较提供基准依据。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) cannot process every frame of a long video because of limitations in visual-token and computational budgets. Three primary approaches have been proposed to enhance their long-video understanding capabilities: (i) Retraining an MLLM on a large video corpus and/or extending its input length; (ii) Training an adapter for a specific MLLM that takes the entire video and the query as input and selects the most relevant video frames; and (iii) Developing a training-free, plug-and-play (PaP) adapter that is MLLM-agnostic. We refer to the third approach as PaP keyframe selection. A PaP method may use only candidate video frames without considering the query, or it may use both candidate video frames and the query. The first approach is prohibitively expensive. The second approach requires substantial training time and computational resources, but it is accessible to many because an adapter contains significantly fewer trainable parameters than an entire MLLM. The third approach has the lowest computational cost and is therefore broadly accessible. To the best of our knowledge, only five PaP methods have been reported within the past year. All of these methods have been evaluated on one or more video question-answering benchmarks and have demonstrated improvements in long-video understanding. However, the methods were evaluated on different benchmarks using different MLLMs. We present a comprehensive evaluation of these five methods using three MLLMs across three long-video understanding benchmarks. Our results show that QAaF achieves the best performance in 13 of the 15 aggregate evaluation settings, while FOCUS ranks second overall. These results provide a common experimental reference for comparing training-free keyframe-selection methods for MLLMs.

</details>


### [163] [Preserving Subject-Clarity in Image Outpainting with Multiscale Wavelet Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13251)
*Abhilash Neog,Taewan Kim,Yi Wu,Xu Chen,Jian Jiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"主体清晰度外绘"框架，融合VLM引导的语义条件与多尺度小波监督以保持主体细节，配合以主体为中心的数据筛选流程；在四个广告与自然图像基准上，主体DreamSim误差与FID相比匹配的监督微调平均降低3.0%和2.4%，相比各数据集最强SOTA平均降低10.8%和7.7%，且不增加推理开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商业与广告图像常因取景不当、主体被部分裁切、文字或标识被截断、上下文不足而降低"主体清晰度"（图像清晰传达主要主体的能力）。图像外绘可扩展边界、补全缺失内容与上下文，是规模化解决方案；但现有基于扩散的外绘方法虽能生成视觉上看似合理的补全，却因结构不一致、语义漂移或细粒度细节丢失而损害主体保真度。

Method: 提出主体清晰度外绘框架：一是以视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的语义条件；二是多尺度小波监督，用于主体局部化的细节保持；同时构建以主体为中心的数据筛选流程，从广告与自然图像中构造与主体相交的外绘图像对。该目标不引入额外推理成本，并设计为可与扩散骨干网络兼容。

Result: 在四个广告与自然图像基准上提升主体清晰度：以主体为中心的DreamSim误差与FID较匹配的监督微调平均降低3.0%与2.4%；较各数据集最强SOTA方法平均降低10.8%与7.7%。

Conclusion: 通过在扩散外绘中引入VLM语义条件与小波细节监督，并配合主体中心的数据构建，可在不增加推理成本的前提下显著改善外绘后的主体清晰度与保真度，为广告等商业图像的自动重构提供可扩展方案。

Abstract: Commercial and advertising images are frequently affected by poor framing, partially cropped subjects, truncated text or logos, and insufficient context, all of which can reduce subject clarity, i.e., the ability of an image to clearly communicate its primary subject. Image outpainting offers a scalable solution by extending image boundaries and recovering missing content and context. However, existing diffusion-based outpainting methods often produce visually plausible completions while degrading subject fidelity through structural inconsistencies, semantic drift, or loss of fine-grained detail. To address this limitation, we propose a subject clarity outpainting framework that combines vision-language model (VLM)-guided semantic conditioning with multiscale wavelet supervision for subject-localized detail preservation. To support training, we develop a subject-centric data curation pipeline that constructs subject-intersecting outpainting pairs from advertising and natural images. The resulting objective introduces no additional inference cost and is designed to be compatible with diffusion-based backbones. Across four advertising and natural-image benchmarks, our method improves subject clarity, reducing subject-centered DreamSim error and FID on average by 3.0% and 2.4% over matched supervised fine-tuning, and by 10.8% and 7.7% over the strongest state-of-the-art approach per dataset, respectively.

</details>


### [164] [(How) Do MLLMs Report Bistable Images Like Humans?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13254)
*Ryota Takatsuki,Tomoki Doi,Amane Watahiki,Anil K. Seth,Hitomi Yanaka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究考察多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在双稳图像（如鸭兔图）上的报告行为，检验其是否具有可调制性与排他性，并揭示其内部计算机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双稳图像支持多种互不相容的解释，人类通常一次只报告一种。作者希望探究MLLMs是否表现出类似行为及其内部计算基础。

Method: 以LLaVA系列模型为对象，在经典鸭兔图与合成Visual Anagrams上测试两个维度：可调制性（自下而上的视觉线索与自上而下的语言先验是否能偏置报告）与排他性（回答是否只承诺单一解释）。

Result: 行为上，视觉与语言操控均以与人类一致的方式系统性改变报告，且回答仍以排他性为主；机制上，这些效应源自竞争性的图像token表征、自下而上与自上而下调制的不同通路，以及排他性报告与物体计数编码之间的关联。

Conclusion: MLLMs在双稳图像上表现出与人类相似的可调制性与排他性报告特征，其行为可由竞争表征、分离的调制通路及物体计数编码解释。

Abstract: Bistable images such as the duck-rabbit are classic stimuli in which one image supports multiple mutually incompatible interpretations, typically reported one at a time in humans. We ask whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show similar report behavior and what internal computations support it. Using the LLaVA family, we study two tractable dimensions: modulability, whether reports can be biased by bottom-up visual cues and top-down linguistic priors, and exclusivity, whether responses commit to a single interpretation. We test both on the canonical duck-rabbit and on synthetic Visual Anagrams to mitigate memorization confounds. Behaviorally, both visual and linguistic manipulations systematically shift reports in human-consistent ways, while responses remain predominantly exclusive. Mechanistically, these effects arise from competing image-token representations, distinct pathways for bottom-up and top-down modulation, and a link between exclusive reporting and object-count encoding.
