This is because, the existing deep learning based longitudinal disease-progression models are almost always run forward: from an observed baseline they predict future decline. In many clinical settings, however, imaging begins only after pathology is suspected or already visible, the earlier, healthier patient-specific reference was never acquired. To address this, we propose to study reverse disease progression prediction: given later diseased anatomy, reconstruct the unobserved healthier anatomy that preceded it. We use a two-stage model in which a frozen 3D vector-quantised autoencoder defines a compact discrete latent space, while a Neural Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) learns continuous-time dynamics in that space. A recurrent encoder reads late observations in reverse temporal order, initialises the latent state, and the ODE is integrated backwards across the trajectory. On a controlled Morpho-MNIST benchmark with a sinusoidal perturbation, our model successfully recovered the unseen previous states from later observations of the non-monotonic trajectory. On longitudinal brain MRIs from Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative, at the task to recover the previous unseen trajectory towards healthy states of the patients from observed later diseased states, our model outperforms the baselines that uses copy-nearest and mean-observed, with positive disease-reversal scores in every diagnostic stratum. We hope that our work can provide insights and tools towards discovering the incubation periods from single-shot scans, and developing early interventions of diseases based on imaging.

</details>


### [266] [Open-UniMo: Towards Unified Motion-Language Understanding and Generation in the Open World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14615)
*Guocun Wang,Kenkun Liu,Guorui Song,Jing Lin,Zhe Huang,Luyuan Zhang,Dake Zhong,Choo Sin Wai,Xiaoguang Han,Haoqian Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出统一运动-语言大模型Open-UniMo，通过共享token空间、运动一致性CoT推理与GRPO训练，统一文本到运动生成与运动到文本理解，并配套Open-MoBench基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向具身智能的开放世界运动生成与理解至关重要，但现有运动-语言模型多将运动视为语言模型的辅助模态，导致文本主导的表征与跨模态交互不足；同时下一token预测范式不适合长运动序列，自回归生成易累积误差。

Method: 1）在Qwen约150K文本token词表上扩展64K运动token，构建统一token空间以实现模态对等；2）引入运动一致性思维链（CoT）推理作为语言语义与运动动力学之间的中间表征；3）两阶段训练：监督微调建立CoT引导的双向运动-语言映射，再用GRPO缓解自回归运动token生成的累积误差并提升语义对齐；4）提出VLM引导的Open-MoBench，评测T2M、M2T及双向一致性。

Result: 在传统指标与Open-MoBench上均取得SOTA性能；消融表明M2T理解主要不受运动token词表规模限制，而将M2T与可学习的T2M生成路径耦合能获得更强的跨模态表征。

Conclusion: 在基于自回归的运动-语言建模中，生成可以促进理解；统一token空间与CoT引导的双向训练是提升开放世界运动-语言统一建模的有效途径。

Abstract: Unified motion generation and understanding is crucial for embodied AI systems that can both synthesize and interpret human actions in open-world environments. Existing motion-language models often treat motion as an auxiliary modality of a language model, leading to text-dominated representations and limited cross-modal interaction. Moreover, the next-token prediction paradigm is not naturally suited to long motion sequences, where autoregressive generation may accumulate prediction errors. To address these challenges, we propose Open-UniMo, a unified Large Motion-Language Model (LMLM) trained on million-scale open-world motion-language data. Open-UniMo promotes modality parity by extending Qwen's vocabulary of about 150K text tokens with 64K motion tokens, enabling motion and language to share a unified token space. We further introduce motion-consistent Chain-of-Thought reasoning as an intermediate representation to bridge language semantics and motion dynamics. Open-UniMo is trained with a two-stage pipeline, where supervised fine-tuning establishes CoT-guided bidirectional motion-language mapping and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves semantic alignment while mitigating cumulative errors in autoregressive motion-token generation. To support comprehensive evaluation, we propose Open-MoBench, a VLM-guided benchmark for assessing text-to-motion (T2M) generation, motion-to-text (M2T) understanding, and bidirectional consistency. Extensive experiments show that Open-UniMo achieves state-of-the-art performance on both conventional metrics and Open-MoBench. Furthermore, ablation studies reveal that M2T understanding is not primarily limited by motion-token vocabulary size; instead, coupling M2T with the learnable T2M generation path yields stronger cross-modal representations, demonstrating that generation can facilitate understanding in AR-based motion-language modeling.

</details>


### [267] [ESAFusion: LiDAR--4-D Radar Fusion via Local Geometric Complementation and Multiscale Adaptive Interaction for 3-D Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14619)
*Gang Ma,Senjie Hu,Junjie Liu,Chao Wang,Hui Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ESAFusion 框架，通过证据感知雷达选择、柱级互补编码与尺度自适应融合，实现 LiDAR-4D 雷达融合的 3D 目标检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LiDAR 与 4D 雷达融合可结合精确空间几何与运动、反射率信息，但雷达观测稀疏、两模态空间采样不一致，且模态与特征尺度的相对重要性随空间区域变化，导致可靠的跨模态互补与自适应融合困难。

Method: 包含三个模块：证据感知雷达选择（ERS）利用运动与观测质量证据抑制雷达杂波并保留前景置信度；柱级互补编码器（PCE）借助邻域 LiDAR 柱的局部几何支撑，缓解空间采样不匹配下的跨模态互补问题；尺度内与尺度间自适应融合（ISAF）在 BEV 空间自适应调整不同模态与特征尺度的贡献。

Result: 在 VoD 数据集上取得对比方法中最高 mAP：全标注区域 74.60%，驾驶走廊 88.89%；两区域中 Cyclist 的 AP 均为最高，运行速度 19.23 FPS；在 VoD-Fog 上验证了 LiDAR 观测逐步退化时的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: ESAFusion 通过证据感知与尺度自适应设计有效解决了 LiDAR-4D 雷达融合中的稀疏性与采样不匹配问题，在精度、类别表现与鲁棒性上均具优势，代码将开源。

Abstract: LiDAR--4-D radar fusion combines accurate spatial geometry with motion and reflectivity cues from radar, offering a promising solution for 3-D object detection in complex driving environments. However, sparse radar observations and differences in spatial sampling between the two modalities complicate reliable cross-modal complementation. Moreover, the relative importance of modalities and feature scales varies across spatial regions, making adaptive fusion challenging. To address these challenges, we propose ESAFusion, an evidence-aware and scale-adaptive framework that combines local geometric complementation with multiscale adaptive interaction. Specifically, we introduce an Evidence-Aware Radar Selection (ERS) module to suppress radar clutter using motion and observation-quality evidence while retaining foreground confidence for subsequent fusion. Then, the Pillar-Level Complementary Encoder (PCE) improves cross-modal complementation under mismatched spatial sampling using local geometric support from neighboring LiDAR pillars. We further design an Intra- and Inter-Scale Adaptive Fusion (ISAF) module to adaptively adjust the contributions of different modalities and feature scales in bird's-eye-view (BEV) space. Extensive experiments on the View-of-Delft (VoD) dataset show that ESAFusion achieves the highest mean average precision (mAP) among the compared methods, reaching 74.60% in the Entire Annotated Area and 88.89% in the Driving Corridor. It also attains the highest average precision (AP) for Cyclist among these methods in both regions while running at 19.23 FPS. Evaluations on VoD-Fog further demonstrate robustness under progressively degraded LiDAR observations. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/SenJieHu549/ESAFusion.

</details>


### [268] [TTDF: A Two-Stage Framework for Reliable Surgical Phase Transition Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14624)
*Yushi Guo,Pietro Valdastri,Duygu Sarikaya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出两阶段过渡检测框架TTDF，将可靠的工作流过渡检测定义为独立的"事件级"任务，作用于冻结的在线手术阶段识别器输出之上，通过候选提取与候选验证逐级过滤，在Cholec80上减少虚假过渡事件并保持召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线手术阶段识别器主要优化逐帧准确率与时间一致性，而非工作流过渡事件的可靠性。直接将阶段变化转化为事件并不可靠：时间抖动和工作流非法的切换会产生虚假或重复事件，而持续存在且符合工作流约束的候选也可能仍是错误的。因此需要一个独立的事件级任务来保障过渡检测的可靠性，以服务于情境感知的手术辅助与下游决策支持。

Method: 提出因果式的两阶段过渡检测框架TTDF。（1）过渡候选提取（TCE）：施加最小时长要求与工作流图约束，仅当预测的目标阶段持续达到最小持续时间、且有序阶段对属于工作流图允许的转换集合时才保留候选，从而以高召回且无需额外训练的方式过滤掉时间抖动与工作流非法切换导致的虚假候选。（2）过渡候选验证（TCV）：利用阶段后验变化与基于冻结DINOv2特征的视觉变化线索来抑制剩余的虚假候选。事件评估采用阶段对感知的一对一匹配协议。

Result: 在Cholec80数据集上的实验表明，TTDF在减少虚假过渡事件的同时保持了召回率，并有效控制了决策延迟。

Conclusion: 可靠的工作流过渡检测应作为独立的事件级任务来处理，而非简单地将阶段变化转为事件。TTDF在不重新训练阶段识别器的前提下，通过提取与验证两阶段的因果过滤，可显著提升过渡事件的可靠性，为手术情境感知与决策支持提供更可信的过渡信号。

Abstract: Reliable workflow transition detection is important for context-aware surgical assistance and downstream decision support. However, online surgical phase recognizers primarily focus on frame-wise accuracy and temporal consistency, rather than the reliability of workflow transition events. Directly converting phase changes into events is unreliable: temporal jitter and workflow-illegal switches produce false or duplicate events, while persistent, workflow-consistent candidates may remain incorrect. To address this limitation, we formulate reliable workflow transition detection as a distinct event-level task operating on outputs of a frozen online phase recognizer. We propose the Two-Stage Transition Detection Framework (TTDF), a causal framework that progressively filters transition candidates. Transition Candidate Extraction (TCE) first applies a minimum-duration requirement and a workflow-graph constraint to remove false candidates caused by temporal jitter and phase transitions not allowed by the workflow graph. Specifically, a candidate is retained only if the predicted target phase persists for a minimum duration and the ordered phase pair belongs to the workflow graph's allowed transition set. TCE thereby produces a high-recall candidate set without additional training. Transition Candidate Verification (TCV) suppresses remaining false candidates using phase-posterior shifts and visual-change cues from frozen DINOv2 features. Events are assessed using a phase-pair-aware one-to-one matching protocol. Experiments on Cholec80 show that TTDF reduces false transition emissions while preserving recall and controlling decision delay.

</details>


### [269] [SCOUT-SLAM: Structurally-Coupled Dual Uncertainty-Aware 3DGS SLAM in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14634)
*Kumaran Karthik,Pramat Shastri Jois,Suresh Sundaram*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 SCOUT-SLAM，一种结构耦合的双不确定性框架，通过共享基础网络同时估计跟踪不确定性与重建不确定性，打破相机跟踪精度与重建质量之间的循环依赖，在动态基准上实现最优跟踪精度与无伪影静态重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在快速相机运动与杂乱动态场景中，现有 3DGS-SLAM 方法依赖场景重建的稳定性来建模不确定性，导致跟踪精度与重建质量形成循环依赖：重建不稳定会削弱不确定性建模，进而损害跟踪与静态场景重建。

Method: 提出结构耦合的双不确定性框架 SCOUT-SLAM。两方面设计：一是对共享基础网络采用低秩适配（LoRA），基于多视角特征一致性训练，估计不单纯依赖重建质量的跟踪不确定性；二是引入空间自适应先验调制网络训练目标，避免重建不稳定在静态区域放大不确定性，从而保持共享表示对两个分支均有效。

Result: 在 TUM RGB-D、Bonn Dynamic、Wild-SLAM MoCap 等动态基准上，SCOUT-SLAM 取得了最优的相机跟踪精度，并实现无伪影的静态场景重建。

Conclusion: 通过共享基础网络的结构耦合双不确定性建模，可有效解耦跟踪与重建之间的循环依赖，为动态环境下 3DGS-SLAM 的鲁棒定位与高质量静态重建提供了新思路。

Abstract: Recently, 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM (3DGS-SLAM) has gained significant momentum in simultaneous localization and 3DGS scene reconstruction. In real-world scenarios with rapid camera motion and cluttered dynamic environments, existing methods rely on the stability of the underlying scene reconstruction to model uncertainty. This leads to a circular dependency between camera tracking accuracy and reconstruction quality: reconstruction instabilities degrade uncertainty modeling, which affects accurate camera tracking and static scene reconstruction. To address this, the paper proposes SCOUT-SLAM, a structurally-coupled dual-uncertainty framework in which both uncertainties are estimated from a shared base network. A low-rank adaptation of this network, trained on multi-view feature consistency, estimates a tracking uncertainty that does not depend solely on the reconstruction quality. A spatially-adaptive prior modulates the network's training objective so that reconstruction instability does not inflate uncertainty on static regions, keeping the shared representation intact for both branches. Evaluations on dynamic benchmarks (TUM RGB-D, Bonn Dynamic, Wild-SLAM MoCap) demonstrate that SCOUT-SLAM achieves state-of-the-art camera tracking accuracy and artifact-free static scene reconstruction.

</details>


### [270] [Evaluating Contextual Bias in CNN Image Classification: Evidence from Agricultural Benchmark Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14654)
*Abhilekha Dalal,Michael Okonoda,Eder Martinez,Lior Shamir*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究在八个公开农业基准数据集和四种CNN架构上，比较模型对原始图像与"背景主导块"的分类表现，发现多数数据集上背景块分类精度显著高于随机水平，表明CNN预测依赖上下文信息。通过宏平均指标和类别平衡测试子集进一步分析，发现这种上下文依赖来源不一：部分归因于类别不平衡，部分在平衡后依然存在。研究提出了一套量化上下文偏差的系统性框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CNN评估通常采用留出集分类精度，这隐含假设预测主要基于目标对象本身而非周围情境。作者希望检验这一假设在农业图像分类中是否成立，并探究背景/上下文信息对CNN预测的实际贡献及其来源。

Method: 从八个个公开农业基准数据集中提取"背景主导块"，在四种广泛使用的CNN架构上对比原始图像与背景块的分类表现。以数据集特定随机基线为参照，对显著高于随机的四个数据集，进一步使用宏平均精度、召回率和F1及类别平衡测试子集，区分上下文信号是源于真实的类别判别信息还是类别不平衡。

Result: 八个数据集中有六个的背景主导块分类精度高于数据集特定随机水平，其中四个显著高于随机，说明多数数据集上情境信息参与了模型预测。进一步分析显示，四者中有部分数据集的信号主要来自类别不平衡，而另一些在类别平衡后仍保持高于随机的上下文分类能力，表明上下文依赖并非单一原因所致。

Conclusion: 上下文偏差是CNN图像分类中反复出现的特征，而非局限于单一应用领域，与先前在目标识别和病理影像中的证据一致。该工作提出了融合数据集随机基线、上下文偏差分类、宏平均评估与类别平衡稳健性分析的系统性量化框架，可跨异质图像数据集衡量上下文偏差。

Abstract: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are typically evaluated using held-out classification accuracy, an approach that presupposes predictions are based primarily on the intended object of interest rather than incidental surrounding context. We test this assumption in CNN-based agricultural image classification by comparing model performance on original images with performance on background-dominated patches extracted from the same images across eight publicly available agricultural benchmark datasets and four widely used CNN architectures. Background-dominated patches were classified above dataset-specific random chance for six of the eight datasets, and substantially above chance for four of them, indicating that contextual information contributes to model predictions for the majority of datasets evaluated. For these four datasets, we further evaluated whether this behavior reflected genuine class-discriminative information or was primarily attributable to class imbalance using macro-averaged precision, recall, and F1 together with class-balanced test subsets. The results show that contextual reliance does not admit a single explanation: class imbalance accounts for a substantial portion of the observed signal for some datasets and architectures, whereas above-chance contextual classification persists after balancing for others. Together with previous evidence from curated object recognition and cancer pathology imaging, these findings support the growing view that contextual bias is a recurring characteristic of CNN-based image classification rather than a phenomenon confined to a single application domain. More broadly, this work provides a systematic framework for quantifying contextual bias across heterogeneous image datasets by combining dataset-specific random-chance baselines, contextual bias categorization, macro-averaged evaluation, and class-balanced robustness analysis.

</details>


### [271] [Compositional SVG Generation via VLM-Driven Hierarchical Semantic Parsing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14657)
*Sehwan Park,Taehoon Kim,Geonhee Han,Dohyun Kim,Seung Wook Kim,Paul Hongsuck Seo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种由视觉语言模型（VLM）驱动的智能体框架，实现语义化、结构化、可编辑的SVG生成，并构建了带有人工语义标注的Semantic SVG Benchmark及新指标，实验证明其结构质量与可编辑性超越现有扁平生成方法的上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SVG生成流程多产出扁平、缺乏语义的路径集合，编辑单个物体需人工识别其组成路径，缺乏结构化与可编辑性。

Method: 提出VLM驱动的智能体框架：通过自顶向下分解、视觉定位和提示驱动的非模态遮挡恢复，递归地将视觉场景解析为语义与几何层级，保证每个组件几何完整；并引入Semantic SVG Benchmark及子组件指标（Semantic Recall/Precision、PERE）。

Result: 实验表明，原生预测的结构在分组质量与可编辑性上均超过现有扁平生成方法的上界，同时保持最先进的视觉保真度。

Conclusion: 通过语义组合式SVG生成与配套基准，实现了结构化、可编辑的矢量图形生成，验证了层次化解析优于扁平路径生成范式。

Abstract: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual reasoning, generating structured, editable Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) remains a fundamental challenge. Existing pipelines predominantly yield flat, semantically agnostic collections of paths, where editing a single object requires manually identifying its constituent paths. To address this, we propose a VLM-driven agentic framework for semantic compositional SVG generation. Our pipeline recursively parses visual scenes into semantic and geometric hierarchies via top-down decomposition, visual grounding, and prompt-driven amodal occlusion recovery, ensuring each component is geometrically complete. Furthermore, we introduce the Semantic SVG Benchmark with human-annotated semantic groups and novel sub-component metrics (Semantic Recall/Precision, PERE) to explicitly evaluate structural compositionality and functional editability. Experiments show that our natively predicted structures surpass the upper bounds of existing flat-generation methods in both grouping quality and editability, while maintaining state-of-the-art visual fidelity.

</details>


### [272] [Floquet Fibre Geometry and Higher-Order Reduced Coordinates for Off-Manifold Transients near Nonlinear Aeroelastic Flutter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14674)
*Puxue Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将状态约化到吸引极限环附近时，必须使用正确的强稳定不变纤维几何；采用度量正交补会引入O(delta)不变性残差，而线性化半共轭图仅留下O(delta^2)残差。在非线性气动弹性极限环上，度量和强稳定方向相差48.5°–71.7°，替换法向量可使残差标度从delta^1.01变为delta^1.87。所学高阶修正因诊断指标依赖表示基线，尚不能证明其独立预测价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约化坐标（相位–等时线或相位–慢幅）常用于极限环附近的降阶建模，但经典一阶相位–等时线图来自伴随Floquet模态，沿强稳定商纤维投影；而常用的度量正交补一般并非不变纤维。论文旨在澄清：哪类一阶几何是必要的，以及基于学习的高阶修正在现有诊断下能否被独立验证。

Method: 理论上，对满足线性化半共轭关系的图证明其不变性残差为O(delta^2)，而沿非不变补投影通常留下O(delta)项。数值上，以一个非线性气动弹性极限环为对象，计算度量法向与强稳定方向夹角，并比较度量法向扰动中的一阶保留相位和慢幅分量。将度量法向替换为强稳定纤维后，测量残差标度变化。再检验学到的高阶修正：其线性化固定为伴随Floquet图、对称性精确、约化流固定；并施加事后幅值重标定与面向伴随Floquet目标的前向一致性诊断。

Result: 度量法向与强稳定方向在该气动弹性极限环上相差48.5°–71.7°，且度量法向扰动含有一阶保留相位与慢幅分量。去掉可调参数后，残差标度由度量法向的delta^1.01变为强稳定纤维的delta^1.87。学习高阶修正可降低登记的固定归一化潜残差，但事后幅值重标定与伴随Floquet目标前向一致性会移动甚至反转该排序。

Conclusion: 在该基准中，正确的一阶Floquet几何是必要的；由于所学映射已共享基线的一阶规范，且未来目标由基线图提供，现有表示依赖型诊断既不能确立独立的正向高阶结论，也不能确立负向结论。学习修正的附加预测价值仍未被识别。

Abstract: Assigning reduced coordinates to states near an attracting limit cycle requires the correct invariant-fibre geometry. The classical first-order phase-isostable chart obtained from adjoint Floquet modes projects along the strong-stable quotient fibre, whereas a metric-orthogonal complement of the retained slow bundle generally does not. We prove locally that a chart satisfying the linearised semiconjugacy relation leaves an O(delta^2) invariance residual, while projection along a non-invariant complement generically leaves an O(delta) term. For a nonlinear aeroelastic limit cycle, the metric-normal and strong-stable directions differ by 48.5 to 71.7 degrees, and metric-normal perturbations contain first-order retained phase and slow-amplitude components. Replacing the metric normal by the strong-stable fibre changes the measured residual scaling from delta^1.01 to delta^1.87 without fitted parameters. We then test learned higher-order corrections whose linearisation is pinned to the adjoint-Floquet chart, whose symmetry is exact, and whose reduced flow is fixed. Although they reduce the registered fixed-normalisation latent residual, post-hoc amplitude recalibration and adjoint-Floquet-targeted future consistency move or reverse the ranking. Because the learned maps already share the baseline's first-order gauge and the future target is supplied by the baseline chart, these diagnostics establish neither an independent positive nor negative higher-order result. Correct first-order Floquet geometry is therefore necessary in this benchmark, while the additional predictive value of the learned correction remains unidentified by the available representation-dependent diagnostics.

</details>


### [273] [From Density to Biopsy Decisions and Malignancy Prediction: A Benchmark Study of Multimodal Large Language Models Against Radiologists in Digital and Contrast-Enhanced Mammography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14676)
*Ali Abbasian Ardakani,Afshin Mohammadi,Taha Yusuf Kuzan,Beyza Nur Kuzan,Alisa Mohebbi,Masume Behruzi,Hamid Khorshidi,Ashkan Ghorbani,Elham Asadiara,Zeinab Khorshidi Lotfi,Ansar Rahman,Nedim Christoph Beste,U. Rajendra Acharya,Sepideh Hatamikia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究对比四种多模态大语言模型与不同经验水平放射科医师在数字乳腺摄影(DM)和对比增强乳腺摄影(CEM)下对乳腺密度、BI-RADS、活检指征及连续恶性概率评估的表现；放射科医师在分类任务中总体占优，而加掩膜的优选模型在连续恶性概率估计上接近人类水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)在乳腺影像判读中的实际能力边界，明确其与放射科医师在多个临床决策维度上的差距，并探索其在临床工作流中作为辅助工具的潜力。

Method: 纳入179例配对DM/CEM检查且有参考标准的女性病例。四种MLLM(ChatGPT-5.2、Gemini-3.1 Pro、Sonnet-4.6、Muse Spark)在有无病灶掩膜条件下解读图像；三名放射科医师解读无掩膜图像。评估任务包括二分类乳腺密度、五分类BI-RADS、二分类活检指征，以及连续恶性概率估计，并计算准确率与AUC，比较模型与读者之间的重叠情况。

Result: DM二分类密度：医师准确率55.81%–78.60%，高于多数MLLM(62.33%–71.63%)，掩膜增益有限。五分类BI-RADS：医师在DM(56.74%–67.44%)和CEM(62.33%–82.79%)上均高于MLLM(DM 31.16%–45.12%；CEM 40.00%–55.81%)。二分类活检指征：医师(DM 85.12%–89.77%；CEM 86.98%–92.09%)优于MLLM(DM 61.39%–75.35%；CEM 69.30%–82.79%)，CEM提升所有读者表现。病灶掩膜显著提升MLLM连续恶性概率准确率：DM由64.65%–71.63%升至72.56%–78.60%，CEM由67.91%–77.21%升至72.56%–81.86%，接近医师区间(DM 63.72%–82.79%；CEM 81.86%–88.84%)；优选加掩膜模型AUC与人类读者重叠。总体上Muse Spark表现最佳，其次为Sonnet-4.6。

Conclusion: 放射科医师在分类型任务上总体优于MLLM；但在连续恶性概率估计中，部分加病灶掩膜的模型已接近人类表现，提示MLLM可能具有辅助性临床价值。

Abstract: Purpose: To compare four multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with radiologists of varying expertise in breast density assessment, BI-RADS assessment, biopsy candidacy determination, and continuous malignancy probability estimation using digital mammography (DM) and contrast-enhanced mammography (CEM). Methods: This study included 179 women with paired DM/CEM examinations and reference standards. Four MLLMs (ChatGPT-5.2, Gemini-3.1 Pro, Sonnet-4.6, Muse Spark) interpreted images with and without masks; three radiologists interpreted non-masked images. Results: For binary density classification on DM, radiologist accuracies ranged from 55.81% to 78.60%, exceeding most MLLM values (62.33%-71.63%), while masks added limited benefit. Five-category BI-RADS accuracies were higher for radiologists on DM (56.74-67.44%) and CEM (62.33-82.79%) compared with MLLMs (DM 31.16-45.12%; CEM 40.00-55.81%). Binary biopsy-candidacy accuracies were likewise higher for radiologists (DM 85.12-89.77%; CEM 86.98-92.09%) than for MLLMs (DM 61.39-75.35%; CEM 69.30-82.79%), although CEM improved performance across all readers. Lesion masks substantially improved MLLM continuous malignancy-probability accuracies from 64.65%-71.63% to 72.56-78.60% on DM and from 67.91%-77.21% to 72.56%-81.86% on CEM, approaching radiologist ranges (DM 63.72-82.79%; CEM 81.86-88.84%). The corresponding AUCs for the top masked models overlapped those of the human readers. Overall, Muse Spark, followed by Sonnet-4.6, demonstrated the strongest performance among the MLLMs across domains. Conclusion: Radiologists generally outperformed MLLMs in categorical tasks, while selected masked models approached human performance for continuous malignancy probability estimation, suggesting a potential adjunctive role.

</details>


### [274] [LIMODENet: Attention-Free Compact Encoders for Information-Preserving Onboard Satellite Image Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14690)
*Thanh-Dung Le,Vu Nguyen Ha,Ti Ti Nguyen,Symeon Chatzinotas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LIMODENet（LinearMix-ODENet），一个0.69M参数、无softmax/QKV的编码器骨干，适配神经形态加速器，在DVB-S2X退化EuroSAT恢复任务上优于同参数CNN自编码器和U-Net，并可零阻塞操作地转换为脉冲网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 星载卫星需在数瓦功率预算下利用不支持softmax与注意力的神经形态加速器（如Akida、Loihi-2）恢复信道退化图像，需确定在此约束下哪种编码器恢复效果最佳。

Method: 设计LIMODENet：无softmax/QKV的线性混合ODE骨干，残差阶段可解释为ODE离散化，经验上信息保持（探针准确率从stem到head由79.9%升至98.4%）；并通过消融分解其与NAFNet、Restormer等现代恢复器的差距来源。

Result: 同参数下恢复1 dB DVB-S2X退化的EuroSAT，PSNR较CNN自编码器+1.75 dB、较跳连U-Net+1.07 dB（三个种子、区间不重叠）；现代恢复器保真度更高，差距中约一半可由脉冲合法的加性跳连弥补，其余归于注意力与通道门控；LIMODENet端到端转脉冲网络零阻塞操作，对比方案为22-24个。

Conclusion: LIMODENet并非现有最佳恢复器，但是在真实功率预算内可验证部署的最佳方案。

Abstract: Onboard satellites must restore a channel-degraded image on a few watts, using neuromorphic accelerators (e.g., BrainChip Akida, Intel Loihi-2) that support no softmax or attention. We ask which encoder restores best under that constraint and introduce LIMODENet (LinearMix-ODENet), a 0.69M softmax-/QKV-free backbone whose residual stages read as ODE discretizations and which is empirically information-preserving (probe accuracy rises 79.9% -> 98.4% from stem to head). At iso-parameters it restores 1 dB DVB-S2X-degraded EuroSAT better than a CNN autoencoder (+1.75 dB PSNR) and a skip-connection U-Net (+1.07 dB), three seeds, non-overlapping. Unconstrained modern restorers (NAFNet, Restormer) win on fidelity; we decompose that gap: spiking-legal additive skips recover about half, and the rest traces to attention and channel gating. LIMODENet then converts end-to-end to a spiking network with zero blocked operations, versus 22-24 for the competitors: not the best restorer available, but the best verified deployable within a real power budget.

</details>


### [275] [Perceive, Refine, Reason: A Calibrated Pipeline for Measuring Indicators in Strategic Visual Communication on Social Media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14699)
*Weihong Qi,Chen Ling*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PRR 是一套校准式视觉测量流程，将视觉语言检测器与 SAM 空间精修、多模态 LLM 仲裁层结合，并配套三级可审计框架，实现社交图像中目标类别、显著性与位置的可靠测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体视觉内容影响受众认知，计算社会科学日益依赖自动化工具大规模分析图像；但现有工具依赖预定义类别或仅给出粗糙的图像级标签，难以大规模测量"哪些具体物体出现、显著程度如何、位于画面何处"，存在测量缺口。

Method: 提出 Perceive, Refine, Reason（PRR）三段式流程：以自然语言类别提示驱动视觉语言检测器（Perceive），用 Segment Anything Model 进行像素级空间精修（Refine），再由多模态 LLM 仲裁层输出推理链以外化领域知识、降低人工在环验证门槛（Reason）；同时设计三级可审计框架，借助量化学习刻画各类别可靠性、支持任务对齐配置并统计校正流行度估计。

Result: 在四种视觉语言检测器和九个社会学类别上，PRR 显著提升精度，最强骨干模型提升达 43.3 个百分点。应用于 2024 年美国选举周期立法者发布的 103,920 张 Facebook 图像，并与 DW-NOMINATE 意识形态分数关联，发现更保守的立法者以更大视觉元素展示美国国旗，且较弱地倾向边缘位置——这一空间模式在二值检测下不可见。

Conclusion: PRR 为计算社会科学家提供了模型无关的工具包，实现可及、空间落地且可校正的视觉测量。

Abstract: Visual content shapes audience perception and opinion on social media, and computational social science increasingly relies on automated tools to analyze images at scale. Yet a measurement gap persists: existing tools rely on predefined categories or produce only coarse image-level labels, while measuring which specific objects appear in an image, how prominently, and where in the frame remains difficult at scale. We introduce Perceive, Refine, Reason (PRR), a calibrated pipeline that turns flexible vision-language detectors into auditable measurement instruments for social-scientific research. PRR combines natural-language category prompts with pixel-level spatial refinement via the Segment Anything Model (SAM) and a multimodal LLM arbitration layer whose reasoning chains externalize domain knowledge and lower the expertise threshold for human-in-the-loop validation. A complementary three-tier auditability framework applies quantification learning to profile per-category reliability, support task-aligned configuration, and statistically correct prevalence estimates. Across four vision-language detectors and nine sociological categories, the pipeline yields substantial precision gains over zero-shot baselines, including a 43.3-point improvement for the strongest backbone. Applying PRR to 103,920 Facebook images from U.S. legislators during the 2024 election cycle and linking detections to DW-NOMINATE ideology scores, we find that more conservative legislators display U.S. flags as larger visual elements, with a weaker tendency toward peripheral placement, a spatial pattern invisible to binary detection. PRR provides computational social scientists with a model-agnostic toolkit for accessible, spatially-grounded, and correctable visual measurement.

</details>


### [276] [Patient-Level, Leakage-Aware Deep Learning for Cross-Center Periapical Radiograph Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14703)
*Md Jubaer Rahman,Ulas Bagci*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出首个患者级、无泄漏的单牙口内根尖片分类基准DentIRO（5,300张图像，3,243名患者，两家诊所，四类），采用患者分组分层交叉验证比较五种迁移学习模型，DenseNet121取得最佳macro-F1（0.9787）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 龋病与牙髓病是全球最常见健康问题之一，根尖片对其检测、治疗计划和随访至关重要。然而现有自动化牙齿级分类研究缺乏可复现基准，常用图像级划分导致同一患者泄漏至训练与测试集，且极少进行跨诊所验证，结果可靠性存疑。

Method: 构建DentIRO数据集（两家诊所、3,243名患者、5,300张单牙根尖片，四类：Healthy、Caries、Crowned、Root Canal）。对比五种迁移学习模型，采用患者分组分层交叉验证确保同一患者仅出现在单一折中。另设固定架构的对照实验，比较胸部X线预训练与ImageNet初始化；进行双向跨中心验证并以Grad-CAM分析模型关注区域。

Result: DenseNet121表现最强且最稳定，平均macro-F1为0.9787；其余四个ImageNet初始化骨干网络性能相近。对照实验显示胸部X线预训练迁移效果不及ImageNet初始化。双向跨中心验证平均泛化差距仅0.0077。Grad-CAM确认预测依赖具有临床意义的牙齿区域，而非采集伪影。

Conclusion: 该基准为口内根尖片分类提供了严格、可复现的基线，并揭示患者级划分与跨中心验证对结果可靠性的重要性，可为后续研究提供标准化对照。

Abstract: Dental caries and endodontic disease are among the most common health conditions worldwide, and intraoral periapical radiographs are central to their detection, treatment planning, and follow-up. Automated tooth-level classification of these images, however, lacks reproducible benchmarks, is often evaluated with image-level splits that leak patients between training and test, and is rarely validated across clinics. This paper presents the first patient-level, leakage-aware classification benchmark for single-tooth intraoral periapical radiographs on the DentIRO dataset, which comprises 5,300 images from 3,243 patients across two clinics and four classes: Healthy, Caries, Crowned, and Root Canal. Five transfer-learning models are compared with patient-grouped stratified cross-validation, so that every patient remains within a single fold. DenseNet121 gave the strongest and most stable result at a mean macro-F1 of 0.9787, while the four ImageNet-initialized backbones performed comparably. A controlled comparison on a fixed architecture showed that chest-radiograph pretraining transferred less effectively than ImageNet initialization. Bidirectional cross-center validation produced a small average generalization gap of 0.0077, and Grad-CAM confirmed that predictions rely on clinically meaningful tooth regions rather than acquisition artifacts. The benchmark offers a rigorous and reproducible baseline for intraoral radiograph classification.

</details>


### [277] [PC$^2$-AD: Point Cloud Upsampling to Safeguard 3D Anomaly Detection with Resolution-constrained Edge Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14722)
*Yutong Gu,Yingxi Xie,Kejin Huang,Jian Ning,Hanzhe Liang,Linlin Shen,Jinbao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PC²-AD点云上采样框架，在检测前补偿稀疏测试输入以弥合训练-测试采样分辨率差距，在多个数据集上提升六种检测器的AUROC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘部署中的低成本低分辨率传感器产生的测试点云显著稀疏于正常训练数据，这种训练-测试采样分辨率差距改变了3D异常检测器可用的局部几何信息，导致检测性能下降。

Method: 框架包含三个模块：目标域候选生成（TCG）将预训练上采样器适配到正常训练几何并生成稠密候选池；几何感知候选过滤（GACF）依据几何间距与空间覆盖度筛选候选；法向保持点补偿（NPPC）通过比较候选与输入锚点的正常性得分精炼选择；最终将选中点与未改动输入点结合送入现有检测器。

Result: 在Anomaly-ShapeNet的两种设置和Real3D-AD上与六种检测器实验，Anomaly-ShapeNet两种设置下六种检测器的对象级与点级AUROC均值均提升，Real3D-AD上四种检测器提升。

Conclusion: 点云补偿作为一种输入级方法，能有效改善低分辨率传感条件下的3D异常检测性能。

Abstract: Low-cost and low-resolution sensors used in edge deployments can produce test point clouds that are substantially sparser than the normal training data. This train-test sampling-resolution gap changes the local geometry available to a 3D anomaly detector. We propose PC$^2$-AD, a point cloud upsampling framework that compensates sparse test inputs before downstream detection. Target Domain Candidate Generation (TCG) adapts a pretrained upsampler to normal training geometry and generates a dense candidate pool. Geometry-Aware Candidate Filtering (GACF) selects candidates according to geometric spacing and spatial coverage. Normality-Preserving Point Compensation (NPPC) refines the selection by comparing candidate normality scores with those of their input anchors. The selected points are combined with the unchanged input points and processed by the existing detector. Experiments with six detectors on two Anomaly-ShapeNet settings and Real3D-AD show improvements in the mean of object-level and point-level AUROC for all six detectors in each Anomaly-ShapeNet setting and four on Real3D-AD. These results support point cloud compensation as an input-level approach to improving 3D anomaly detection under low-resolution sensing conditions. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/gyutong406-commits/PC2-AD.

</details>


### [278] [CrossDistill: Balancing Quality and Diversity via Trajectory-Level Hybrid Few-Step Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14725)
*Yuxi Liu,Haoyu Li,Yixiang Cai,Tengxu Sun,Zekun Zhang,Baole Ai,Ang Wang,Jiamang Wang,Lin Qu,Kun Yuan,Kai Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CrossDistill提出一种轨迹级混合蒸馏框架，在采样轨迹的交叉点处将高噪声区间用轨迹保持目标、低噪声区间用分布匹配目标进行分割蒸馏，通过交叉状态耦合两阶段，从而在少步扩散中同时兼顾质量与多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步蒸馏在加速扩散模型时面临多样性与保真度的权衡：基于轨迹的蒸馏能保持模态覆盖但样本不够锐利，分布匹配能锐化样本但会降低多样性。作者观察到这一矛盾可按噪声区间利用——高噪声步主要决定全局模态，低噪声步精修局部细节。

Method: 提出CrossDistill，一个轨迹级混合蒸馏框架：在采样轨迹的某个交叉点处分段，高噪声区间施加轨迹保持（trajectory-preserving）目标，低噪声区间施加分布匹配（distribution-matching）目标，并通过交叉状态耦合两个阶段。区别于损失层面的混合，它在噪声轴上显式分配互补目标，先保留全局分支再锐化局部统计。CrossDistill是一种噪声级调度策略，PCM与DMD为其可插拔实例，噪声划分、交叉耦合与目标顺序是核心设计要素。

Result: 在文本到视频扩散模型上的实验以及图像到视频的定性结果显示，CrossDistill扩展了少步质量-多样性前沿，在保持种子级变化的同时达到有竞争力的视觉保真度。

Conclusion: 通过在噪声轴上按交叉点分段并分配互补蒸馏目标，CrossDistill以噪声级调度策略的形式缓解了少步扩散中多样性与保真度的固有张力，成为一种可与现有损失级混合、两阶段训练配方互补的方案。

Abstract: Few-step distillation accelerates diffusion models but must balance diversity and fidelity: trajectory-based distillation preserves mode coverage, while distribution matching sharpens samples but can reduce diversity. We show that this tension can be exploited in a noise-regime-dependent way: high-noise steps largely determine global modes, whereas low-noise steps refine local details. We propose CrossDistill, a trajectory-level hybrid distillation framework that splits the sampling trajectory at a crossover point, applies a trajectory-preserving objective on the high-noise interval and a distribution-matching objective on the low-noise interval, and couples the two stages through the crossover state. In contrast to loss-level mixing, and complementarily to training-time two-stage recipes, CrossDistill explicitly assigns complementary objectives along the noise axis, so that global branching is preserved before local statistics are sharpened. CrossDistill is a noise-level scheduling policy: PCM and DMD are plug-in instantiations, while the noise partition, crossover coupling, and objective ordering are the key design elements. Experiments on text-to-video diffusion models and qualitative image-to-video results show that CrossDistill expands the few-step quality-diversity frontier, retaining seed-level variation while achieving competitive visual fidelity.

</details>


### [279] [From Visual Feedback to Textual Reviews: A Multi-Agent Vision-Language Framework for Image-Grounded Review Assistance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14761)
*Utsav Kumar Nareti,Ayush Bansal,Kumari Priya,Chandranath Adak,Soumi Chattopadhyay,Muhammad Saqib,Saeed Anwar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"图像驱动评论辅助"新任务：从用户上传的商品图像生成可编辑评论草稿，并设计四角色多智能体视觉-语言框架，在Amazon Reviews Electronics子集上验证了可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商平台中图像/视频反馈日益普遍，但图像缺乏语境解释与主观意见；文本反馈又因撰写成本高而内容有限。传统图像描述只做客观视觉描述，无法满足"由视觉证据推导产品评价"的需求，故需新的任务设定与建模方法。

Method: 提出图像驱动评论辅助任务，要求在产品特定理解、情感估计与证据驱动撰写能力下，应对图像质量退化、过度放大、目标歧义、产品部分可见等真实场景挑战。方法为多智能体视觉-语言框架，含四个专门角色：产品定位、视觉情感估计、视觉证据生成、评论合成；并采用显式中间表示（产品实体、预测评分、证据摘要）以提升可解释性与视觉接地。

Result: 在Amazon Reviews Electronics数据集的精选子集上实验，表明能够从视觉反馈生成连贯、产品感知且情感感知的评论草稿。

Conclusion: 首次将图像驱动评论辅助形式化为多智能体视觉-语言推理问题，为电商系统中的AI辅助评论撰写提供了实用路径。

Abstract: Visual feedback in the form of user-uploaded images and videos is becoming increasingly common in e-commerce platforms because it provides authentic evidence of product quality, defects, packaging conditions, and real-world usage. However, visual feedback alone often lacks the contextual explanations and subjective opinions necessary for informed decision-making, while many users provide limited textual feedback due to the effort required to compose detailed reviews. To bridge this gap, we introduce image-grounded review assistance, a novel task that aims to generate editable review drafts from user-uploaded product images. Unlike conventional image captioning, which focuses on objective visual description, the proposed task requires product-specific understanding, sentiment estimation, and evidence-driven review composition under challenging real-world conditions, including degraded image quality, excessive zoom-in, target ambiguity, and partial product visibility. We propose a multi-agent vision-language framework consisting of four specialised roles: product grounding, visual sentiment estimation, visual evidence generation, and review synthesis. The framework employs explicit intermediate representations, including product entities, predicted ratings, and evidence summaries, to improve interpretability and visual grounding. Experiments on a curated subset of the Amazon Reviews Electronics dataset demonstrate the feasibility of generating coherent, product-aware, and sentiment-aware review drafts from visual feedback. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to formulate image-grounded review assistance as a multi-agent vision-language reasoning problem, providing a practical step toward AI-assisted review authoring in e-commerce systems.

</details>


### [280] [Zero-shot video highlight detection based on text descriptions and synthetic images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14790)
*Michal Byra,Alberto Presta,Grzegorz Stefanski,Krzysztof Arendt*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出结合CLIP、LLM与扩散模型的零样本视频高光检测框架，用元数据生成文本描述与合成视觉原型，与视频帧匹配实现帧级检测，无需标注或训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频高光检测对视频摘要与内容推荐很重要，但传统方法依赖高光标注和数据集特定训练，成本高、泛化受限，因此需要零样本方案。

Method: 输入轻量视频元数据（标题、类别等），由LLM生成潜在高光事件的文本描述，再用扩散模型将其转化为合成视觉原型；随后用CLIP将文本与视觉表示与视频帧匹配，实现帧级高光检测，全程无需高光标注或数据集特定训练。

Result: 在TVSum和SumMe数据集上取得较强的零样本性能，其中在TVSum上表现尤为突出。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了有效的元数据条件零样本视频高光检测框架。

Abstract: Detecting video highlights, the most informative or engaging moments in a video, is important for applications such as video summarization and content recommendation. We propose a zero-shot framework that combines CLIP, large language models (LLMs), and diffusion models. Given lightweight video metadata, such as a title or category, an LLM generates textual descriptions of likely highlight events. These descriptions are further converted into synthetic visual prototypes using a diffusion model. Textual and visual representations are matched to video frames using CLIP, enabling frame-level highlight detection without highlight annotations or dataset-specific training. Experiments on TVSum and SumMe demonstrate strong zero-shot performance, with particularly favorable results on TVSum. The proposed approach provides an effective framework for metadata-conditioned zero-shot video highlight detection.

</details>


### [281] [RAIN: Region-Aware Inversion Network for Semantic Watermark Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14856)
*Zilai Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种轻量、免提示词的单步语义水印提取器，通过扩展流匹配与条件回归，将端点恢复分解为"类图像锚点"与"噪声导向残差"，避开多步扩散反演与U-Net反复评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Gaussian-Shading 语义水印提取传统上依赖多步扩散反演来恢复初始噪声，计算开销大；虽有单步方法降低代价，但仍需进一步简化并提升 GPU 并行利用效率。

Method: 以扩展流匹配（extended flow matching）与条件回归为理论框架。关键观察：在高信噪比（high-SNR）图像端点附近，恢复扩展流匹配首步输出所给的有用噪声统计量，比重建完整逆轨迹容易得多，而 Gaussian Shading 只要求恢复的隐变量落在正确的水印判决区域内。据此设计单步提取器，将端点恢复分解为类图像锚点与噪声导向残差，提升 GPU 并行计算能力。

Result: 提取噪声的计算成本低于 OSI 与 FARI 两种方法。

Conclusion: 所提方法无需迭代反演，也无需反复评估扩散级 U-Net，实现了高效的一步式提取流程，并具有简洁的理论解释；代码已开源。

Abstract: Semantic watermarks for diffusion models embed ownership information into the generative process while preserving perceptual quality, but Gaussian-Shading extraction conventionally requires multi-step diffusion inversion to recover the initial noise. Recent one-step methods show that this cost can be reduced substantially. We study this problem through extended flow matching and conditional regression. The key observation is that, near the high-SNR image endpoint, recovering a useful noise statistic given by the first-step output of the extended flow matching in the high-SNR regime is much simpler than reconstructing the full inverse trajectory, and Gaussian Shading only requires the recovered latent to remain in the correct watermark decision region. Based on this observation, we propose a lightweight, prompt-free extractor that decomposes endpoint recovery into an image-like anchor and a noise-oriented residual, which increases the capability of the model to utilize GPU parallel computation. The resulting method avoids iterative inversion and repeated evaluation of a diffusion-scale U-Net, providing an efficient one-step extraction pipeline with a concise theoretical interpretation. The computational cost of extracting noise is lower than that of both OSI and FARI. The github repo is there: https://github.com/TheLovesOfLadyPurple/RAIN-lightweight-NN-for-one-step-semantic-watermark-extraction

</details>


### [282] [What Makes a 3D Scene Editable? A Factorized Benchmark of Fidelity, Locality, Consistency, and Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14899)
*Sariah Patro,Arjun Mehra,Nikhil Bhatia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 EditBench3D：一个与表示无关的 3D 场景编辑基准，将编辑视为受控信息替换，用四个互补维度评测，并通过 240 组场景-编辑对评测八种代表性编辑器，主张以多目标画像而非单一语义分数报告可编辑性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经 3D 场景编辑评测通常只关注语义对齐，但语义上看似成功的编辑可能改动无关内容，或在跨视角下不一致，因此需要更全面的评测协议。

Method: 提出 EditBench3D 基准，将编辑形式化为受控信息替换，评测四项互补属性：指令保真度、空间局部性、跨视角一致性、非目标内容保持。协议包含可见性感知的 3D 目标支撑、成对描述、留出相机，以及覆盖外观、材质、几何与对象级变化的五类编辑族。在 240 组场景-编辑对上评测八种代表性编辑器，涵盖 NeRF、3D Gaussian Splatting、混合与代理式方法。

Result: 语义保真度与其他编辑属性仅弱相关；没有单一方法在所有维度上最优。显式 Gaussian 编辑器整体均衡性较强；直接代理操控的编辑最保守，但开放式保真度受限。

Conclusion: 应把可编辑性作为多目标画像报告，而不是仅用单一语义分数衡量，这样才能更真实反映 3D 场景编辑的综合能力与权衡。

Abstract: Neural 3D scene editing is often evaluated by semantic alignment alone, although a convincing result may alter unrelated content or become inconsistent across views. We introduce EditBench3D, a representation-agnostic benchmark that treats editing as controlled information replacement. It evaluates four complementary properties: instruction fidelity, spatial locality, cross-view consistency, and preservation of non-target content. The protocol combines visibility-aware 3D target supports, paired descriptions, held-out cameras, and five edit families covering appearance, material, geometry, and object-level changes. We evaluate eight representative NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting, hybrid, and proxy-based editors on 240 scene-edit pairs. The study shows that semantic fidelity is only weakly associated with the other editing properties, and that no single method is optimal across all dimensions. Explicit Gaussian editors offer a strong overall balance, whereas direct proxy manipulation provides the most conservative edits at the cost of open-ended fidelity. These findings support reporting editability as a multi-objective profile rather than a single semantic score.

</details>


### [283] [Physically Aware Radiomics Without Interpolation: Disentangling Voxel Geometry and Signal Modification in CT and MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.12399)
*David Corral Fontecha,Juan Miranda Bautista,Pablo Menendez Fernández-Miranda,Sergio Rubio-Martín,Lara Lloret Iglesias,Jose A. Vega*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种体素间距感知的影像组学框架（VS），在不重采样的前提下将物理几何信息纳入纹理计算，以解决各向异性图像中体素几何与插值信号变化混淆的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统影像组学纹理特征基于体素索引邻域计算，隐含假设空间各向同性；在各向异性图像中，这会把体素几何差异与插值导致的信号变化混为一谈，影响特征稳定性与可比性。

Method: 修改PyRadiomics以在保留原始图像信号的同时考虑体素间距，并比较四种配置：原生非重采样提取（NR）、各向同性重采样（RS）、体素间距感知提取（VS）、伪各向同性预处理（FK，仅覆盖间距元数据而不改变图像数组）。数据包括685例LIDC-IDRI肺结节与209例I-SPY2乳腺MRI，共196个影像组学描述符；采用ICC、个体内变异、Friedman检验、特征选择、机器学习、多层感知机及外部验证评估稳健性。

Result: VS与NR一致性接近原生水平：中位ICC(A,1)在CT为0.9976、MRI为0.9984；RS一致性较低且偏差更大，FK表现居中，说明仅间距元数据即可影响影像组学特征。梯度类及邻域敏感描述符受预处理影响最大。VS在外部CT验证中保持与NR相当的预测性能，而MRI在不同预处理策略与分类器间波动更大。

Conclusion: 体素间距感知提取将几何建模与插值引起的信号修改相分离，同时保留原始图像信号，为各向异性CT与MRI影像组学分析提供了相较各向同性重采样更一致的替代方案。

Abstract: Objective: Radiomic texture features are usually computed in voxel-index neighborhoods, implicitly assuming isotropic spatial relationships. In anisotropic images, this can confound voxel geometry with interpolation-induced signal changes. We developed a voxel-spacing-aware radiomic framework that incorporates physical geometry into texture computation without resampling.
  Approach: We modified PyRadiomics to account for voxel spacing while preserving the native image signal. Four configurations were compared: native non-resampled extraction (NR), isotropic resampling (RS), voxel-spacing-aware extraction (VS), and fake-isotropic preprocessing (FK), in which spacing metadata were overwritten without altering the image array. Experiments included 685 LIDC-IDRI pulmonary nodules and 209 I-SPY2 breast MRI cases, with 196 radiomic descriptors. Robustness was assessed using ICC, within-subject variability, Friedman testing, feature selection, machine learning, a multilayer perceptron, and external validation.
  Main results: VS showed near-native agreement with NR: median ICC(A,1) was 0.9976 in CT and 0.9984 in MRI. RS produced lower agreement and larger deviations, while FK showed intermediate behavior, confirming that spacing metadata alone can affect radiomic features. Gradient-derived and neighborhood-sensitive descriptors were most affected by preprocessing. VS preserved predictive performance comparable to NR in external CT validation, whereas MRI showed greater variability across preprocessing strategies and classifiers.
  Significance: Voxel-spacing-aware extraction separates geometric modeling from interpolation-induced signal modification while preserving the native image signal, offering a coherent alternative to isotropic resampling for radiomic analysis of anisotropic CT and MRI.

</details>


### [284] [ThreshGuide: Class-Aware Labeled-Guided Thresholding for Semi-Supervised 3D Abdominal Multi-Organ Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14943)
*Hongyu Liu,Yinlong Wang,Lusha Li,Hui Meng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ThreshGuide，一种类别感知阈值自适应框架，利用标注数据引导伪标签选择，用于半监督腹部多器官分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 伪标签方法对置信度阈值高度敏感；在腹部多器官分割中，固定全局阈值次优，因为不同器官类别在尺寸、外观和学习难度上差异显著，需要类别级阈值。

Method: 基于标准师生架构：教师模型在训练中对标注样本评估，通过最大化误差感知的Fβ准则（平衡精度与覆盖率）估计类别感知阈值目标；用EMA平滑目标；以此按类别过滤无标注体素的伪标签。

Result: 在FLARE2022和AMOS2022上整体表现具竞争力，在难学习器官上取得明显提升。

Conclusion: 类别感知的阈值自适应可有效缓解固定全局阈值的局限，尤其改善困难器官的分割性能。

Abstract: Pseudo-labeling is a strong paradigm for semi-supervised medical image segmentation, yet its effectiveness is highly sensitive to confidence thresholding. In abdominal multi-organ segmentation, a fixed global threshold is particularly suboptimal because organ classes differ substantially in size, appearance, and learning difficulty. In this work, we propose ThreshGuide, a class-aware threshold adaptation framework that uses labeled data to guide pseudo-label selection on unlabeled data. Built upon a standard teacher-student architecture, the teacher model evaluates labeled samples during training to estimate class-aware threshold targets by maximizing an error-aware F\b{eta} criterion that balances precision and coverage. These targets are then smoothed with an exponential moving average (EMA) and used to filter unlabeled voxels in a class-dependent manner. Experiments on FLARE2022 and AMOS2022 show that ThreshGuide performs competitively overall, yielding clear improvements specifically on hard-to-learn organs.

</details>


### [285] [MoVT: Video-Augmented Motion Tokenizer for Text-to-Motion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14965)
*Beibei Jing,Tianle Guo,Youjia Zhang,Zikai Song,Yawei Luo,Junqing Yu,Tao Guan,Wei Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MoVT 提出一种跨模态增强的运动分词器，将离散 3D 运动 token 投影到 2D 域，借助大规模人体动作视频丰富运动码本，再映射回 3D 域形成对齐的 3D/2D 码本，并以模态无关的掩码 Transformer 生成运动，缓解 3D 运动训练数据不足问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本驱动的 3D 人体运动生成面临多样化、无约束文本提示的挑战，核心瓶颈是 3D 运动训练数据有限，而人体动作视频资源丰富但未被充分利用。

Method: 核心为跨模态增强运动分词器：将离散 3D 运动 token 投影到 2D 域，利用视频中复杂的真实运动模式丰富运动码本；再将增强 token 映射回 3D 域，得到对齐且表达能力更强的 3D/2D 码本。增强码本接入生成式掩码 Transformer，以模态无关方式预测被掩码的运动 token 索引，从而可利用由 2D 码本与带标注运动视频生成的文本-索引对来进一步增强生成器。

Result: 大量实证评估表明，MoVT 在多项关键指标上优于先前的最先进方法。

Conclusion: 通过跨模态投影与码本对齐，MoVT 有效利用视频数据增强文本到运动生成，验证了视频监督在弥补 3D 运动数据稀缺方面的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: Text-driven 3D human motion generation models face significant challenges in responding to diverse and unconstrained textual prompts, primarily due to the limited availability of 3D motion training data. To address this, we introduce MoVT, a novel framework that effectively leverages the extensive range of human action videos to enhance text-to-motion generation. At the core of our approach is the cross-modal augmented motion tokenizer, which projects discrete 3D motion tokens into the 2D domain. This projection allows us to enrich the motion codebook with complex, real-world motion patterns derived from videos. The enriched discrete tokens are then mapped back to the 3D domain, resulting in aligned 3D and 2D codebooks with an enhanced capacity to represent intricate motions. These enhanced codebooks are integrated into a generative masked transformer, which predicts masked motion token indices in a modality-agnostic manner. This enables the use of text-index pairs, generated from the 2D codebook and annotated motion videos, to further enhance the generator. Extensive empirical evaluations show that MoVT performs favorably against prior state-of-the-art methods across multiple key metrics.

</details>


### [286] [PhysBrain 1.5: From Vision-Language Models to Physical Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14973)
*DeepCybo Team,Yu Bin,Haipeng Cao,Zheng Chang,Kai Chen,Youning Chen,Kailin Deng,Yichao Du,Xiaotong Fu,Haoyang Ge,Yunlong Guo,Chenliu Hao,Jiyan He,Xuguo He,Yakun Hou,Kai Hu,Cong Huang,Tuopusen Huang,Yu Huang,Hong Li,Peize Li,Shijie Lian,Xiaopeng Lin,Yun Lin,Haibao Liu,Haochen Liu,Qiuzhi Liu,Shengcai Liu,Zhiqiang Liu,Tao Luo,Peng Ren,Shuo Ren,Chaoyi Ruan,Zhaolong Shen,Yukun Shi,Qiyuan Su,Yuxuan Tian,Yining Wang,Changti Wu,Hao Wu,Xueyin Xu,Ruoqi Yang,Zhaoyang Yang,Hang Yuan,Zhaoyang Zeng,Hanwen Zhang,Ruimeng Zhang,Yao Zhang,Yibo Zhang,Yuxiang Zhang,Zhirui Zhang,Ziyi Zhang,Zubin Zheng,Zishen Zhuang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhysBrain 1.5 是一个统一模型，将物理环境理解、动作生成与未来状态预测融入同一学习框架，基于通用视觉语言模型以自回归下一词预测联合优化语言、末端执行器运动与稠密视觉目标，预训练监督完全来自人类交互视频，并进一步在人类演示、机器人轨迹与仿真经验上微调。8B 模型在 28 个具身理解基准上平均得分 72.5，刷新开源最优，与 GPT-6-Astra、Gemini 3.6 Flash 等领先闭源模型相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受"观察—交互—环境改变"这一物理循环启发，作者希望把物理环境理解、动作生成与未来状态预测三类能力纳入统一的模型与学习框架中。现有具身模型通常将理解、策略与预测割裂处理，且依赖昂贵的机器人数据；本文试图用统一表征与人类交互视频监督来缓解这些问题。

Method: 从通用视觉语言模型出发，将语言响应、末端执行器运动与稠密视觉目标均编码为离散序列，用自回归下一词预测进行联合优化。预训练阶段的具身监督完全来自人类交互视频，以任务为中心的 episode 将语义与空间上下文同恢复的运动及后续观测配对；随后在人类演示、机器人轨迹与仿真经验的混合数据上做监督微调。

Result: 在 28 个具身理解基准上，8B 模型平均得分 72.5，刷新开源最优，并与 GPT-6-Astra、Gemini 3.6 Flash 等领先闭源模型表现相当；在 14 个基准上取得开源最佳结果，同时保持通用多模态能力。定性示例显示模型能够输出末端执行器轨迹，并通过空间对齐的 RGB、深度与机器人掩码预测未来场景。

Conclusion: 将理解、动作生成与未来状态预测统一到单一自回归序列建模框架、并主要借助人类交互视频提供具身监督，是一条可行且有效的路径，可在保持通用多模态能力的同时达到开源具身理解的领先水平。

Abstract: We present PhysBrain 1.5, a unified model for understanding physical environments, generating actions, and predicting future states. Motivated by the physical loop of observation, interaction, and environmental change, we bring these capabilities into a common learning framework. Starting from a general vision--language model, we encode language responses, end-effector motion, and dense visual targets as discrete sequences and jointly optimize them with autoregressive next-token prediction. Pre-training draws its embodied supervision entirely from human interaction videos, using task-centered episodes to pair semantic and spatial context with recovered motion and subsequent observations. We then adapt the model through supervised fine-tuning on a mixture of human demonstrations, robot trajectories, and simulated experience. Across 28 embodied understanding benchmarks, our 8B model achieves an average score of 72.5, setting a new open-source state of the art and performing on par with leading proprietary models such as GPT-6-Astra and Gemini 3.6 Flash. It achieves the best open-source results on 14 benchmarks while retaining general multimodal capabilities. Beyond these understanding evaluations, qualitative examples show the model's ability to produce end-effector trajectories and predict future scenes through spatially aligned RGB, depth, and robot-mask outputs.

</details>


### [287] [G-ray: Ray-Level Relative Geometric Position Encoding in Multi-View Vision Transformers under Camera Heterogeneity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15018)
*Shuo Zhang,Xin Su,Wei Wang,Jun Liu,Xinrui Zeng,Yongsen Chen,Chenjie Wang,Guibo Zhu,Jinqiao Wang,Bin Luo,Liangpei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 G-ray：一种基于相机局部射线角度的旋转相对位置编码，使不同投影模型下相同射线对产生一致的相对相位，实现投影不变的位置一致性；在 RoPE/GTA/RayRoPE 三种宿主编码上验证，覆盖 3D 重建与 NVS 任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多视角视觉 Transformer 在相机异构（视场角不同或投影模型不同）条件下，现有旋转相对位置编码依赖图像平面坐标，导致相对相位随投影变化、跨投影注意力缺乏一致几何线索。

Method: G-ray 将旋转相位参数化为相机局部射线角度（camera-local ray angles），使同一相机局部射线对在不同投影下产生相同相对相位；可直接使用或与现有编码（RoPE、GTA、RayRoPE）集成，保留互补几何线索且不引入额外可学习参数。

Result: 在三个异构 3D 重建 benchmark（50 视角）上，G-ray 在全部六项平均指标上领先，相比 MapAnything 将平均 pointmap 相对误差降低 45.8%（两者均提供标定）；仅在均质针孔图像上训练的重建模型可零重训处理混合针孔/非针孔输入，并在均质针孔重建协议上保持竞争力；NVS 中 GTA 与 RayRoPE 在联合视角与视场角变化下均获提升。

Conclusion: 射线级相对位置编码为异构相机多视角 Transformer 提供了投影不变的位置一致性，兼容多种现有编码，在 3D 重建与 NVS 上均有效，并具备跨投影泛化能力。

Abstract: We study relative position encoding for multi-view vision Transformers under camera heterogeneity, including varying fields of view (FoVs) or projection models. Existing rotary relative position encodings commonly use image-plane positional coordinates, producing projection-dependent relative phases and inconsistent geometric cues for cross-projection attention. We introduce G-ray, a ray-level relative position encoding whose rotary phases are parameterized by camera-local ray angles. The same camera-local ray pair induces the same relative phase across projections, providing projection-invariant positional consistency. G-ray can be used directly or integrated with existing encodings, retaining complementary geometric cues without additional learned parameters. We validate G-ray in three host encodings, RoPE, GTA, and RayRoPE, across 3D reconstruction and novel-view synthesis (NVS). Across three heterogeneous 3D reconstruction benchmarks at 50 views, G-ray leads all six averaged metrics and reduces mean pointmap relative error by 45.8% over MapAnything, with calibration supplied to both. Trained exclusively on homogeneous pinhole images, the 3D reconstruction model handles mixed pinhole and non-pinhole inputs without retraining and remains competitive on homogeneous pinhole 3D reconstruction protocols. For NVS, GTA and RayRoPE improve with G-ray under joint viewpoint and FoV variation. The project's webpage is available at https://g-ray-project.github.io/.

</details>


### [288] [TwinICL: Diagnosing Multimodal In-Context Learning through Paired Counterfactuals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15028)
*Zihan Xue,Po-Yi Lu,Serhii Honcharenko,Zih-Ching Chen,Hsuan-Tien Lin,Nanyun Peng,I-Hung Hsu,Kuan-Hao Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 TwinICL：一个程序化生成的成对文本-图像 ICL 基准，用于跨模态受控比较；发现多模态 ICL 普遍弱于纯文本 ICL，并通过三种干预组合在诊断子集上恢复性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 ICL 基准缺乏相互匹配的文本与图像版本，难以在受控条件下比较跨模态 ICL 表现。

Method: 构建程序化生成的配对基准 TwinICL，覆盖 6 个开放权重模型与 38 项任务；针对视觉访问、任务框架、推理三种干预进行测试；并用显式任务指令区分"执行任务"与"推断任务"的困难；进一步分析演示输入-输出对模态差距的重塑作用。

Result: 多模态 ICL 一致弱于纯文本 ICL，差距随任务类别而异；单项干预效果有限且不稳定，但三者组合在诊断子集上可恢复较强多模态性能；即便给出显式指令，仍存在模态差距。

Conclusion: 多模态 ICL 的模态差距既涉及任务推断也涉及任务执行；演示样本兼具"额外上下文"与"任务证据"的双重作用，可调节该差距；TwinICL 为跨模态 ICL 研究提供了受控比较工具。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables models to infer tasks from demonstrations, but existing benchmarks generally lack matched text and image versions needed to compare ICL performance across modalities. We introduce TwinICL, a procedurally generated benchmark providing such pairs for controlled comparison. Across six open-weight models and 38 tasks, multimodal ICL consistently underperforms text-only ICL, with gaps varying by task family. To test whether this gap can be recovered, we target visual access, task framing, and reasoning through three interventions. Their combination recovers strong multimodal ICL performance on a diagnostic subset, despite limited or inconsistent individual effects. To distinguish difficulties in executing tasks from those in inferring them, we evaluate models with explicit task instructions, revealing a modality gap even when the task is known. We then examine how adding demonstration inputs and outputs reshapes this gap, highlighting demonstrations' dual role as additional context to process and evidence about the task. The dataset is available at https://github.com/lab-flair/TwinICL.

</details>


### [289] [Tele360: Real-Time Feed-Forward Human Reconstruction from Sparse Unposed Cameras](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15032)
*Hanzhang Tu,Zhanfeng Liao,Wei Min,Jiajun Zhang,Yebin Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Tele360是首个面向稀疏、无位姿RGB流的实时前馈动态人体重建与自由视点可视化系统，单次前向即可联合估计相机位姿并重建动态3D高斯表示，实现单卡消费级GPU上2K输入的25+ FPS实时渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时高分辨率的真人自由视点可视化对沉浸式通信和交互式数字体验至关重要。现有方法要么依赖计算昂贵的优化，要么要求标定相机和低分辨率输入，难以实现实时高分辨率部署。因此需要一种能处理稀疏、无位姿输入并支持实时高分辨率渲染的前馈方案。

Method: 提出轻量级稀疏感知多视图Transformer主干，对前景人体区域进行token化并通过共享场景token保留全局上下文；采用全Transformer高斯解码器以避免卷积引起的过平滑并保持稀疏高效解码；引入混合特征金字塔注入多尺度外观线索辅助几何预测；加入轻量级可微Levenberg-Marquardt相机细化层增强多视图一致性与几何对齐；通过教师-学生蒸馏从大型视觉-几何基础模型迁移多视图几何先验以稳定稀疏无位姿输入下的学习；预测的高斯图经视频编解码器流式传输至远端设备进行交互式自由视点渲染。

Result: 在棚拍基准上取得最优视觉质量，并在单张消费级GPU上支持2K输入到渲染的实时处理，帧率超过25 FPS；额外采集的序列展示了在多相机设置下对多样化人物、服装和动作的适用性。

Conclusion: Tele360首次实现了从稀疏、无位姿RGB流出发的实时前馈动态人体重建与自由视点可视化，兼顾高分辨率、实时性与视觉质量，为沉浸式通信与交互式数字体验提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Live free-viewpoint visualization of real humans is critical for immersive communication and interactive digital experiences. Existing methods either rely on computationally expensive optimization or require calibrated cameras and low-resolution inputs, making real-time high-resolution deployment impractical. In this work, we present Tele360, the first real-time feed-forward system for dynamic human reconstruction and live free-viewpoint visualization from sparse, unposed RGB streams. Our system jointly estimates camera poses and reconstructs a dynamic 3D Gaussian representation for each time instance in a single forward pass. To achieve this, we start by designing a lightweight sparsity-aware multi-view transformer backbone that tokenizes foreground human regions while preserving global context through a shared scene token. We then employ a fully transformer-based Gaussian decoder to mitigate convolution-induced over-smoothing while keeping decoding sparse and efficient. In addition, we introduce a hybrid feature pyramid that injects multi-scale appearance cues into geometry prediction. We further introduce a lightweight differentiable Levenberg-Marquardt camera refinement layer to enhance multi-view consistency and geometric alignment. Moreover, to stabilize learning under sparse, unposed inputs, we transfer multi-view geometry priors from a large visual-geometry foundation model via teacher-student distillation. Finally, the predicted Gaussian maps are streamed with video codecs to remote devices for interactive free-viewpoint rendering. Extensive experiments show that Tele360 achieves state-of-the-art visual quality on studio benchmarks while supporting real-time 2K input-to-rendering at over 25 FPS on a single consumer GPU. Additional captured sequences illustrate its performance across varied subjects, clothing, and motions under our multi-camera setup.

</details>


### [290] [LG-VLN: A Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation Framework with LangGraph State Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15098)
*Jianhe Zhao,Yanhua Qiu,Zhiyu Zhang,Zibo Zhao,Jinhua Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LG-VLN：一种仅用单目RGB的零样本连续环境视觉语言导航框架，通过共享视觉特征和LangGraph状态编排，在R2R-CE val-unseen子集上取得21.3%成功率和12.1% SPL。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLN-CE方法依赖LiDAR、全景相机或额外传感器；且几何建图与语义导航使用分离的视觉表示，导致长轨迹上的空间-语义不一致。作者希望仅用单目RGB实现零样本导航，并统一几何与语义表示以缓解不一致问题。

Method: 提出LG-VLN框架：（1）在线前馈3D重建网络预测深度、相机位姿和稠密点云，用于智能体位姿估计与全局地图融合；（2）几何与导航共享稠密CleanDIFT特征，语义一致性用于剔除错误的帧间对应，目标实例约束定义视觉参考，其相似度与局部BLIP-2图文相关性结合形成语义价值图；（3）用LangGraph将指令解析、几何感知、语义价值更新、路径规划、动作执行与失败恢复建模为带条件转移和持久状态的有向状态图，含模块化恢复机制。

Result: 在R2R-CE val-unseen划分的固定550回合子集上，LG-VLN取得21.3%的成功率和12.1%的SPL。消融实验表明共享语义特征能提升导航性能，结合视觉相似度与图文相关性后进一步提升。

Conclusion: 结果表明，共享视觉表示与显式状态编排对仅用单目RGB的零样本VLN-CE是有效的。代码将公开以支持可复现性。

Abstract: Continuous-environment vision-and-language navigation (VLN-CE) requires interpreting natural-language instructions in unseen 3D environments and executing continuous low-level actions. Existing methods often depend on LiDAR, panoramic cameras, or extra sensors; separate geometric-mapping and semantic-navigation visual representations can cause long-trajectory spatial-semantic inconsistencies. We propose LG-VLN, a monocular zero-shot framework with shared visual features and LangGraph-based state orchestration. An online feed-forward 3D reconstruction network predicts depth, camera poses, and dense point clouds for agent-pose estimation and global map fusion. Geometry and navigation share dense CleanDIFT features: semantic consistency rejects incorrect inter-frame correspondences, while target-instance constraints define visual references whose similarity combines with local BLIP-2 image-text relevance to form a semantic value map. LangGraph represents instruction parsing, geometric perception, semantic value updates, path planning, action execution, and failure recovery as a directed state graph with conditional transitions, persistent state, and modular recovery mechanisms. On a fixed 550-episode subset of the R2R-CE val-unseen split, LG-VLN achieves 21.3% success and 12.1% success weighted by path length. Ablations show shared semantic features improve navigation, further boosted by combining visual similarity and image-text relevance. Results establish shared visual representations and explicit state orchestration as effective for zero-shot VLN-CE using monocular RGB alone. Code will be publicly released for reproducibility.

</details>


### [291] [ChatGPT Images 2.5 in the Wild: A Launch-Period Dataset and Detector Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15100)
*Dennis Ng,Xingyu Shen,Ankit Raj,Kidus Zewde,Tommy Duong,Yuchen Zhou,Yuxin Zhang,Neo Tiangratanakul,Simiao Ren*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究图像工具在保留公开名称的情况下更换底层生成器所导致的版本归因歧义问题。作者构建了包含3,478张图像（来自2,440条帖子、8个来源）的冻结数据集，记录了三个归因层级，并评估了六个冻结检测器。结果显示，检测器在数据集上的标记率（3.7%–56.4%）远低于GenImage召回率，且高标记率并不代表更好的检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像工具可能在保留公开名称的同时更换底层生成器，使得在线帖子的版本归因变得模糊。作者以ChatGPT Images 2.5发布为背景，研究这一产品过渡期内的模型使用与检测问题。

Method: 构建了冻结数据集：包含3,478张图像，来自2,440条帖子、8个来源，发帖时间覆盖公告后前51.1小时。数据集记录三个归因层级，经图像形式过滤与定向审核后保留独立图像。标题声明和宿主记录仅作为准入证据，而非独立核实的生成器身份。随后在参考照片上以5%标记率校准阈值，评估六个冻结检测器。并进行了仅针对X平台的探索性比较（与四月数据集对比），采用固定阈值后的聚类自助法区间。

Result: 观测到的内容特征取决于来源构成：NightCafe贡献39.0%的图像，却占CLIP判定为奇幻场景的77.0%。六个检测器的数据集标记率为3.7%–56.4%，比GenImage召回率低42–81个百分点。留出艺术品的假阳性率为1.5%–96.5%，说明更高的数据集标记率本身并不能证明检测性能更好。X平台对比显示，Effort在九月标记率更高，DoU存在提示性差异。

Conclusion: 该数据集支持对产品过渡期内报告模型使用情况的分析，并保留了来源与归因证据以供解读。由于归因、内容和处理差异的存在，X平台对比结果无法作因果解释。

Abstract: An image tool can change its underlying generator while retaining its public name, making version attribution from online posts ambiguous. We study this problem after the ChatGPT Images 2.5 launch. Our frozen collection contains 3,478 images from 2,440 posts across 8 sources. Recorded posting times fall within the first 51.1 hours after the announcement. It records three attribution tiers and retains standalone images after image-form filtering and targeted review. Caption claims and host records provide admission evidence, not independently verified generator identity. The observed content profile depends on the source mixture: NightCafe supplies 39.0% of images but 77.0% of CLIP-assigned fantasy scenes. We then evaluate six frozen detectors at thresholds calibrated to a 5% flag rate on reference photographs. Collection flag rates range from 3.7 to 56.4%, falling 42-81 percentage points below GenImage recall. Held-out artwork false-positive rates range from 1.5 to 96.5%, so a higher collection flag rate does not by itself establish better detection. An exploratory X-only comparison with our April collection finds a higher September flag rate for Effort, and a suggestive difference for DoU, under fixed-threshold post-clustered bootstrap intervals. Attribution, content and processing differences prevent a causal interpretation of these contrasts. The collection supports analysis of reported model use during a product transition, with source and attribution evidence retained for interpretation.

</details>


### [292] [DNF-SR: Dual-Input and Negative-Aware Feature Fine-Tuning for Real-World Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15120)
*Shuhao Han,Wenjie Liao,Hayden Vance,Hang Dong,Rui Zhang,Chun-Le Guo,Chongyi Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DNF-SR：双输入+负样本感知特征微调的一步扩散Real-ISR方法，兼顾保真度与感知质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一步扩散Real-ISR中，直接将低分辨率(LR)图像输入扩散模型会与模型原始输入分布产生分布差距(distributional gap)。常见做法是向LR隐变量加噪以缩小分布差距，但直接加噪会不可避免地破坏LR内容。因此需要在缩小分布差距的同时保持内容保真。

Method: 1) 双输入策略：将原始LR图像与加噪LR输入拼接后送入基于扩散的图像编辑模型，实现一步超分并提升感知与内容一致性；2) 利用加噪LR输入带来的随机性与多样性，提出后训练优化方法NF2T(Negative-aware Feature Fine-Tuning)：将多个输出划分为正/负子集，在图像空间与特征空间定义隐式策略改进方向，提升优化稳定性。

Result: 大量实验表明DNF-SR优于其他方法。代码将开源。

Conclusion: 双输入缓解分布差距与内容损坏的矛盾，NF2T利用噪声多样性进行正负感知的隐式策略优化，二者结合使一步扩散Real-ISR在保真度与感知质量上取得更优表现。

Abstract: Benefiting from the powerful generative priors of diffusion models, diffusion-based real-world image super-resolution (Real-ISR) methods have demonstrated impressive performance.To achieve efficient Real-ISR, several recent works have designed one-step diffusion-based models.Howerver, unmediatedly feeding LR into a diffusion model creates a distributional gap with the model's original input.A straightforward approach to reduce the distribution gap is to introduce noise to the LR latents. However, directly adding noise inevitably corrupts the content of the LR images.In this study, we propose DNF-SR, a Dual-input and Negative-aware Feature fine-tuning method for Real-ISR.Specifically, we use a dual-input strategy that concatenates the original LR image with the noisy LR input and feeds them into a diffusion-based image editing model, ensuring both high-fidelity one-step super-resolution and improved perceptual and content consistency.Additionally, the noise present in the noisy LR input introduces randomness and diversity into the outputs. We exploit this property and propose a post-training optimization method, Negative-aware Feature Fine-Tuning (NF2T), which guides the model toward producing higher-quality results.NF^2T classifies multiple outputs into positive and negative subsets and then defines implicit policy improvement directions in both the image and feature spaces, thereby further enhancing the stability of the optimization.Extensive experiments show that DNF-SR outperforms other methods.Code will be released.

</details>


### [293] [AdaVSkip: Adaptive Visual Token Skipping Across Layers For Efficient MLLMs Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15131)
*Yuyao Sun,Tao Deng,Shuang Li,Deqing Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AdaVSkip，为每层配备两个轻量路由器分别决定视觉token是否跳过自注意力与MLP模块，并用渐进式两阶段训练（监督+强化学习）学习输入自适应的计算路径，在保持性能的同时大幅降低计算量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM处理大量视觉token需耗费大量算力。已有方法多利用水平冗余（压缩token）或垂直冗余（早退、固定层跳过）。但作者发现垂直冗余的程度与分布随输入不同而变化，且在自注意力与MLP模块间也存在差异，固定策略难以适配这种动态特性。

Method: AdaVSkip为每层设置两个轻量路由器，独立判断视觉token是否经过或跳过自注意力与MLP模块，从而组成输入特定的视觉计算路径。针对路由决策离散、不可微的难题，采用两阶段渐进训练且冻结主干：Stage I用基于模块必要性分数生成的输入特定目标做监督训练，建立初始路由策略；Stage II用强化学习以生成答案的直接反馈优化路由，奖励包含答案正确性奖励与抑制过度保留视觉token计算的跳过一致性奖励。

Result: 在三种MLLM主干上，AdaVSkip在显著减少计算量的同时保持较强任务性能。在LLaVA-NeXT-7B上，FLOPs降低53.2%且保持原模型平均性能；与视觉token压缩结合后，FLOPs降低达91.2%，同时平均保留原性能的97.2%。

Conclusion: 利用输入与模块间差异化的垂直冗余，通过可学习的双层路由器实现自适应的视觉计算路径，可有效提升MLLM推理效率，并与token压缩方法互补。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) require substantial computation to process numerous visual tokens across all transformer layers. Most methods for efficient MLLM inference exploit horizontal redundancy by compressing visual tokens. Beyond token reduction, recent studies exploit vertical redundancy through early exit or fixed-layer skipping. However, we find that the extent and distribution of this redundancy vary across inputs and differ between self-attention and MLP modules. Motivated by these observations, we propose AdaVSkip, which equips each layer with two lightweight routers that independently determine whether visual tokens pass through by or skip the self-attention and MLP modules. These decisions collectively define an input-specific visual-computation path, but their discrete and non-differentiable nature makes learning effective paths challenging. To address this challenge, we develop a progressive two-stage training framework that updates only the routers while keeping the backbone frozen. Stage I establishes an initial routing policy through supervised training with input-specific targets derived from module-wise necessity scores. To further align the routing policy with task performance, Stage II uses reinforcement learning to optimize routing decisions with direct feedback from generated answers. It combines an answer correctness reward with a skip-consistency reward that discourages excessive retention of visual-token computation. Across three MLLM backbones, AdaVSkip maintains strong task performance with substantially less computation. On LLaVA-NeXT-7B, AdaVSkip reduces FLOPs by 53.2\% while preserving the original model's average performance. Combining it with visual token compression increases this reduction to 91.2\%, while retaining 97.2\% of the original performance on average.

</details>


### [294] [SparseTalk - Sparsifying 3D Gaussian Language Fields for Efficient 3D Visual Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15137)
*Davit Soselia,Joseph JaJa,Amitabh Varshney*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了3D高斯语言场中语义嵌入的冗余性，系统性稀疏化至8个视觉token，并提出基于物体的稀疏化方法，在ScanQA和MV-ScanQA上验证极少量token即可保持VQA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D高斯语言场虽为3D VQA提供显式、空间落地的表示，但密集语义特征每场景需数万个嵌入，导致存储、内存和推理开销大。作者希望探究下游推理实际需要多少表示。

Method: 从完整嵌入表示出发，系统性稀疏化语义嵌入，覆盖低至8个视觉token、低于单图等价块的未充分探索区间；比较随机、几何、语义及联合空间-语义选择策略；提出基于物体的稀疏化方法，将token预算分配到检测到的物体实例并保留背景上下文。

Result: 在ScanQA和MV-ScanQA上，密集高斯语言场存在大量冗余。仅需数百个语义嵌入（不足原表示1%）即可保持较强VQA性能。基于物体的选择表现较好，降至256 token时性能变化有限。该预算下SparseTalk仅保留SplatTalk 32,076-token推理输入的0.80%及平均77,207高斯密集场的0.332%，同时提升推理吞吐并将解码特征内存降低125倍。

Conclusion: 3D高斯语言场中密集语义表示高度冗余，基于物体的稀疏化可在极少token预算下维持VQA性能，显著降低内存与推理成本，为高效3D VQA提供可行路径。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian language fields provide an explicit, spatially grounded representation for 3D visual question answering (VQA), but their dense semantic features can require tens of thousands of embeddings per scene, resulting in substantial storage, memory, and inference costs. We investigate how much of this representation is actually necessary for downstream reasoning. Starting from a full embedding representation, we systematically sparsify its semantic embeddings, including the previously underexplored regime below a single image-equivalent block down to 8 visual tokens. We compare random, geometric, semantic, and joint spatial-semantic selection strategies and introduce an object-based sparsification method that distributes the token budget across detected object instances while retaining background context. Experiments on ScanQA and MV-ScanQA reveal substantial redundancy in dense Gaussian language fields. Strong VQA performance is retained with only a few hundred semantic embeddings, corresponding to less than 1% of the original representation. Object-based selection performs well relative to others, with only modest observed changes down to 256 tokens. At this budget, SparseTalk retains 0.80% of SplatTalk's 32,076-token inference input and 0.332% of the mean 77,207-Gaussian dense field, increasing inference throughput while reducing decoded-feature memory 125-fold.

</details>


### [295] [Automated Perceptually-Motivated Assessment of Photographic Consistency in Paired Clinical Photographs: Pipeline Development and Internal Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15144)
*Derrick Lin,Samantha Rabinovich,Joclin Rabinovich,Kassra Garoosi,Sumun Khetpal,Evan Delanoy,Neel Bhardwaj,Jason Roostaeian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究构建了一套感知驱动的术前/术后照片一致性评分流程，通过13个标定子指标聚为5类并加权合成单一分数S，用于客观量化同一患者两张照片的可比性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 整形外科疗效评价中，配对的前后照片是证据的基本单元，但尚无客观指标能验证同一患者的两张照片是否在可用于比较的一致条件下拍摄，因此需要量化的可比性度量。

Method: 提出感知驱动流程，分析前后配对照片的13个经标定子指标，经无监督相关结构分析划分为5个数据驱动聚类（光度、纹理/清晰度、姿态、光照方向、俯仰），各聚类内先平均再以加权和合成单一一致性分数。每个子指标经标定使其在已发表的同患者配对上的中位差值为0.5（仅为参考点，不表示通过/不通过）。在134对匹配的同患者已发表前后照片上标定，并在同图配对、合成扰动配对和134对错配的跨文献配对上评估。

Result: 总分S能区分匹配与错配配对（敏感度指数d'=2.15，95%CI[1.83,2.55]；ROC曲线下面积AUC=0.928，95%CI[0.896,0.959]），与高斯等方差预测高度一致。三个头部姿态角并未归入同一聚类：偏航与翻滚归为一类，而俯仰单独分离。同图配对达到天花板水平（S=0.99），总分在全部五个扰动轴上随扰动幅度单调下降。

Conclusion: 该分数衡量的是照片的可比性，而非美学或手术质量，并提供免费网络工具用于审计前后配对照片的可比性，但仍需针对专家判断进行验证。

Abstract: Purpose: Paired pre- and post-operative photographs are the standard unit of evidence for plastic surgical outcomes, yet no objective metric verifies whether two images of the same patient were captured under conditions consistent for comparison.
  Approach: We developed a perceptually motivated pipeline that analyzes pre/post pairs across thirteen calibrated sub-metrics, partitioned by unsupervised correlation-structure analysis into five data-driven clusters (photometric, texture / sharpness, pose, illumination direction, and pitch), averaged within each cluster and combined across clusters by a weighted sum into a single consistency score. Each sub-metric is calibrated so that its median difference across published within-patient pairs scores 0.5, which is a reference point and carries no pass/fail meaning. The pipeline was calibrated on 134 matched within-patient published pre/post pairs and evaluated against identical-image pairs, synthetic-perturbation pairs, and 134 mismatched cross-publication pairs.
  Results: The master consistency score S separated matched from mismatched pairs (sensitivity index d' = 2.15, 95% confidence interval (CI) [1.83, 2.55]; area under the receiver operating characteristic curve AUC = 0.928, 95% CI [0.896, 0.959]), closely matching Gaussian-equal-variance predictions. The three head-pose angles did not fall in one cluster: yaw and roll grouped together while pitch separated. Identical pairs scored at ceiling (S = 0.99) and the master score fell monotonically with perturbation magnitude on all five perturbation axes.
  Conclusions: The score quantifies photographic comparability, not aesthetic or surgical quality, and provides a freely available web tool for auditing the photographic comparability of pre/post pairs, pending validation against expert judgment.

</details>


### [296] [Weakly Supervised Spatial Grounding for Discriminative Attention-Based Ultrasound-Histopathology Alignment in Prostate Cancer Grading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15150)
*Obed Korshie Dzikunu,Emma Willis,Mohammad Mahdi Abootorabi,Mohamed Harmanani,Zhuoxin Guo,Ferdinand Luger,Adam Kinnaird,Brian Wodlinger,Parvin Mousavi,Purang Abolmaesumi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文将无配对跨模态蒸馏中的"特征判别"与"patch选择"两个功能解耦，利用活检常规记录的累及百分比作为弱空间监督约束恶性组织比例，使注意力集中而非趋于均匀，在7,166例穿刺活检芯上取得67.1 macro AUC与68.5 csPCa AUC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无配对跨模态蒸馏通过将池化的针区嵌入与冻结的组织病理学教师模型在分级组对应关系下对齐，把分级结构迁移到micro-US编码器中。但该设置下单一目标需同时承担两项不同职能：既要使patch特征具备组织状态判别力，又要决定哪些patch进入池化表示。这种耦合导致注意力趋于近均匀分布，特征判别性与patch选择相互掣肘，性能受限。

Method: 解耦上述两项功能。引入由活检常规记录的累及百分比（percentage involvement）导出的弱空间监督，约束每个活检芯内预测的恶性组织比例；该监督独立于对齐目标，直接作用于编码器特征。随后，对齐损失在芯内存在差异的特征上运算，注意力得以集中于部分patch而非保持近均匀。并在七个中心、811名患者、7,166个活检芯上采用患者级5折交叉验证进行评估，并与既有注意力正则化方法进行消融对比。

Result: 方法达到67.1 macro AUC与68.5 csPCa AUC；现有无配对对齐方法为61.2与52.8；最强单模态基线为63.1与62.6。针对既有防止注意力均匀化坍塌的注意力正则化器的消融表明：此类正则化器无法替代源自标签的监督——它们仅约束注意力分布，而所需信号作用于注意力所读取的特征。

Conclusion: 将特征判别与patch选择解耦、并以弱空间监督独立作用于编码器特征，可有效提升无配对跨模态蒸馏在micro-US前列腺癌分级中的性能。注意力正则化器不能替代标签导出的监督，因其作用对象是注意力分布而非注意力所读取的特征。

Abstract: Unpaired cross-modal distillation transfers grade structure from histopathology into a micro-ultrasound (micro-US) encoder by aligning a pooled needle-region embedding to a frozen histopathology teacher under grade-group correspondence alone. A single objective is thereby required to serve two distinct functions: rendering patch features discriminative of tissue state, and selecting which patches enter the pooled representation. We decouple them. Weak spatial supervision derived from percentage involvement, recorded routinely at biopsy, constrains the predicted proportion of malignant tissue within each core, acting on the encoder features independently of the alignment objective. The alignment loss then operates on features that differ across a core, and attention concentrates on a subset of patches rather than remaining near-uniform. On 7,166 biopsy cores from 811 patients across seven centers under patient-level 5-fold cross-validation, the method reaches 67.1 macro AUC and 68.5 csPCa AUC, against 61.2 and 52.8 for the existing unpaired alignment method and 63.1 and 62.6 for the strongest unimodal baselines. Ablation against existing attention regularizers designed to prevent attention-uniformity collapse shows that such regularizers do not substitute for label-derived supervision: they constrain the attention distribution, whereas the signal required acts on the features that attention reads.

</details>


### [297] [PACE: Progressive Angular-to-Norm Contrastive Embedding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15152)
*Yanping Li,Wei Zhou,Yawen Liu,Yibo Wang,Ke Zhu,Guangda Huzhang,Qing-Guo Chen,Zhao Xu,Jun Zhang,Wei Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PACE两阶段框架，通过渐进扩展表示空间与可训练参数空间，将多模态嵌入训练从余弦相似度平滑过渡到点积相似度，并引入Focal Embedding Loss，在多种骨干规模与多模态任务上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态嵌入模型多采用余弦对比目标，训练稳定但语义兼容性局限于角度几何，嵌入范数无法承载语义信号；而直接优化更具表达力的点积相似度（同时利用角度与范数）性能更差且训练不稳定。作者将其归因于过早的优化空间扩展，表现为角度-范数纠缠与表示空间的方向各向异性，并因全参数微调而加剧。

Method: PACE为两阶段框架，渐进扩展表示空间与可训练参数空间。第一阶段：余弦目标结合低秩适配（LoRA），在受限优化空间内建立可靠的角度几何。第二阶段：切换为点积相似度并进行全参数微调，使嵌入方向与范数共同编码语义信息。此外提出Focal Embedding Loss，一种置信度自适应目标，对正例检索置信度高的查询降权，聚焦具有竞争性负样本的模糊查询。

Result: 在多种骨干规模与多样化的多模态嵌入任务上进行的实验一致验证了PACE的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过渐进式优化空间扩展（先余弦+LoRA、后点积+全参数微调）配合置信度自适应的Focal Embedding Loss，可在保持训练稳定的同时释放点积相似度的表达力，提升多模态嵌入性能。

Abstract: Multimodal embedding models encode heterogeneous inputs into a shared embedding space, enabling efficient similarity computation across modalities and tasks. Most existing methods optimize cosine-based contrastive objectives, which promote stable training but restrict semantic compatibility to angular geometry, precluding embedding norms from serving as an additional semantic signal. However, directly optimizing the more expressive dot-product similarity, which leverages both angular and norm information, underperforms cosine-based training and exhibits unstable training dynamics. We attribute this discrepancy to premature optimization-space expansion, manifested as angular--norm entanglement and directional anisotropy in the representation space and further compounded by full-parameter fine-tuning. In this paper, we propose PACE, a two-stage framework that progressively expands both the representation and trainable parameter spaces. Stage I combines cosine-based objective with low-rank adaptation to establish a reliable angular geometry within constrained optimization spaces. Stage II switches to dot-product similarity and full-parameter fine-tuning, enabling embedding directions and norms to jointly encode semantic information. We further introduce Focal Embedding Loss, a confidence-adaptive objective that downweights queries with high positive retrieval confidence while emphasizing ambiguous queries with competitive negatives.
