Experiments across multiple backbone scales and diverse multimodal embedding tasks consistently validate the effectiveness of PACE.

</details>


### [298] [GRAVA: Grounded Reasoning-to-Action Representation and Learning for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15169)
*Xiao Liu,Haoyu Li,Jianghao Leng,Lin Wang,Chao Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GRAVA 提出 Grounded Reasoning-to-Action（GRA）框架，将场景 grounding、推理与动作生成统一到单个自回归流中，通过 GRA 数据构建与渐进式训练，在 NAVSIM 上取得纯自回归驾驶模型的 SOTA 表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有驾驶 VLA 模型虽逐步具备"先推理后行动"能力，但其中间推理与物理场景证据的关联较弱，且与可执行行为脱节，导致推理难以有效指导动作。

Method: 核心为 GRA：将动作相关语言指称链接到 2D 视觉区域与自车物理状态，用轨迹锚定的类型化图组织物体交互与决策，并序列化为 grounded reasoning；由单个 VLM 生成推理及紧凑的 Executable Planner 动作，再确定性解码为连续轨迹。同时提出 agentic 数据构建流程（前向场景 grounding + 反向轨迹锚定），构建含 220 万 grounded QA 对与 7 万条 GRA 推理轨迹的 GR-NavSim。采用渐进式训练：预训练建立 grounded cognition，模仿学习建立 reasoning-to-action 接口，强化学习与探索优化驾驶行为。

Result: 仅使用约 60% 的人类驾驶示范进行动作监督，GRAVA-8B 在完整 NAVSIM 基准上于纯自回归驾驶模型中达到 SOTA；在内部长尾基准上，完整 GRA 相比仅动作预测将关键物体合规性与闭环驾驶分数分别提升 19.3% 和 20.5%。

Conclusion: 在 grounded reasoning 到可执行动作生成的全过程中保留动作相关的物理证据，能显著提升驾驶模型性能，验证了 GRA 框架的有效性。

Abstract: Driving vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly reason before acting, but their intermediate reasoning is often weakly grounded in physical scene evidence and loosely connected to executable behavior. We present GRAVA, a framework built around Grounded Reasoning-to-Action (GRA), which unifies grounding, reasoning, and action generation in a single autoregressive stream. GRA links action-relevant language references to 2D visual regions and ego-centric physical states, organizes object interactions and decisions in a trajectory-anchored typed graph, and serializes this structure into grounded reasoning. A single VLM generates this reasoning followed by a compact Executable Planner action that is deterministically decoded into a continuous trajectory. We further introduce an agentic GRA data construction pipeline that combines forward scene grounding with backward trajectory anchoring, and use it to build GR-NavSim with 2.2M grounded question-answer pairs and 70K GRA reasoning traces. A progressive training strategy develops grounded cognition through pre-training, establishes the reasoning-to-action interface through imitation, and improves driving behavior through reinforcement learning and exploration. Using about 60% of the available human driving demonstrations for action supervision, GRAVA-8B achieves state-of-the-art performance among purely autoregressive driving models on the full NAVSIM benchmark. On an internal long-tail benchmark, full GRA improves key-object compliance and Closed-loop Driving Score by 19.3% and 20.5% over action-only prediction, respectively. These results show the benefit of preserving action-relevant physical evidence from grounded reasoning through executable action generation.

</details>


### [299] [EECTracker: Swarm Motion Prior-Guided Feature Compensation for Airborne Optical UAV Swarm Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15171)
*Zhaochen Chu,Tao Song,Ren Jin,Mingdong Jia,Defu Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EECTracker，用群体运动先验引导联合检测与跟踪，解决机载无人机群跟踪中目标尺度过小、检测响应间歇缺失导致的轨迹断裂与身份切换问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机载光学跟踪无人机群面临目标尺度极小、视角快速变化、背景杂乱等困难，导致目标特征响应弱、检测器输出间歇或暂时缺失。现有MOT方法依赖可靠的逐目标检测响应来维持状态与身份，响应不可靠时状态难以更新、跨帧关联线索模糊，造成轨迹碎片化和身份切换。

Method: EECTracker构建概率型群体运动先验，从可靠的历史轨迹片段中捕捉群体的短时图像平面运动趋势及其不确定性，为跨帧特征补偿提供空间引导；在此基础上提出能量—熵一致性激活（EEC Activation），用特征残差能量与局部残差熵评估运动先验条件下的特征一致性，由局部EEC分数引导像素级特征补偿，增强潜在目标区域中与运动先验一致的特征响应，抑制不一致的背景响应。

Result: 在AIRMOT和UAVSwarm数据集上，EECTracker整体跟踪性能优于现有最先进方法。相较最强对比方法SCT-MOT，在AIRMOT上MOTA/IDF1提升3.89/1.79个百分点，在UAVSwarm上提升2.81/1.74个百分点，同时保持在线推理速度。

Conclusion: 通过群体运动先验与能量—熵一致性激活机制，EECTracker在检测响应不可靠时仍能有效补偿特征、维持目标状态与身份，在机载无人机群跟踪任务上实现了性能与在线效率的兼顾。

Abstract: Airborne optical tracking of uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) swarms is challenging due to extremely small target scales, rapid viewpoint changes, and cluttered backgrounds, which can weaken target feature responses and lead to intermittent or temporarily missing detector responses. Existing multi-object tracking methods generally depend on reliable target-specific detector responses to maintain target states and identities across frames. When such responses become unreliable, target states cannot be reliably updated and cross-frame association cues become ambiguous, resulting in fragmented trajectories and identity switches. To address this problem, we propose EECTracker, a swarm-motion-prior-guided joint detection-and-tracking framework for airborne optical UAV swarm tracking. EECTracker constructs a probabilistic swarm motion prior from reliable historical tracklets to capture the shared short-term image-plane motion tendency of the swarm and its uncertainty, providing spatial guidance for cross-frame feature compensation. Building on this prior, we introduce Energy--Entropy Consistency Activation (EEC Activation) to evaluate motion-prior-conditioned feature consistency using feature residual energy and local residual entropy. The resulting Local EEC score guides pixel-level feature compensation by enhancing motion-prior-consistent feature responses in potential target regions while suppressing inconsistent background responses. Experiments on AIRMOT and UAVSwarm show that EECTracker achieves superior overall tracking performance compared with state-of-the-art methods. Compared with the strongest competing method SCT-MOT, EECTracker improves MOTA/IDF1 by 3.89/1.79 percentage points on AIRMOT and by 2.81/1.74 percentage points on UAVSwarm, while maintaining online inference speed.

</details>


### [300] [Does Attention-Guided Masking Really Help Object Discovery in Object-Centric Learning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15187)
*Youliang Tao,Yanhua Han,Bin Zhao,Juho Kannala,Joni Pajarinen,Rongzhen Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文探索用槽注意力语义引导图像掩码（AGM）以改进对象中心学习的自监督，但实验发现AGM并非总优于随机掩码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流对象中心学习方法用Slot Attention聚合图像特征为对象级表示，再通过重建随机掩码图像内容（Random Masking）提供自监督。近期DIAS仅用均匀随机掩码即取得有竞争力的对象发现精度。由于聚合时的注意力本身已具备对象发现能力，作者希望利用该注意力设计更好的掩码策略，从而提供更优的自监督信号。

Method: 提出注意力引导掩码（Attention Guided Masking, AGM）：利用Slot Attention聚合过程中的内部注意力语义来指导图像patch的掩码选择，替代DIAS中的均匀随机掩码（RM），并在六个公认数据集上进行对比实验，涵盖条件/无条件槽初始化两种设定。

Result: 在六个数据集上AGM并不总是优于RM。在无条件槽初始化下，AGM在具有真实纹理的数据集（COCO、VOC）上显著改善背景分割；但无论条件还是无条件初始化、跨数据集，前景对象发现能力保持相当或有所下降。

Conclusion: 作者建议对象中心学习社区的研究者：试图利用内部注意力语义来改进带掩码解码的OCL是高风险方向。源码、模型检查点和评估日志将在接收后公开。

Abstract: Object-Centric Learning (OCL) aims to decompose images into objects without human annotations. A major family of mainstream methods uses Slot Attention to aggregate image features into object-level representations and then from them reconstructs masked image content, i.e., Random Masking (RM), to provide self-supervision. The recent method DIAS simply masks image patches at uniform randomness yet achieves competitive object discovery accuracy. Since attention during aggregation already possesses object discovery ability, we explore using it to develop a better image patch masking strategy, i.e., Attention Guided Masking (AGM), thereby providing better self-supervision. Results on six recognized datasets show that AGM does not always outperform RM. Under unconditional slot initialization, AGM substantially improves background segmentation on datasets with realistic textures (COCO and VOC); Regardless of conditional or unconditional slot initialization and across datasets, foreground object discovery remains comparable or decreases. We suggest peer researchers in the OCL community that attempts to exploit internal attention semantics to improve OCL with masked decoding are risky. Our source code, model checkpoints and evaluation logs will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [301] [Reconstructing Is Not Acting: Action-Centric Latent Dynamics Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15189)
*Dingjie Fu,Dianxing Shi,Yangyang Xu,Jun Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现潜动作模型存在"重建-动作不匹配"问题，提出以动作为中心的ACT-LAM框架（AQ-IDM + AT-FDM），在多个机器人数据集和VP²基准上以更少参数和算力取得更强性能，VP²成功率提升7.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜动作模型（LAMs）通过从无标注视频中推断潜动作并重建未来状态来学习动作表示，但作者发现**重建误差越低并不必然带来更好的潜动力学或下游性能**，即"重建-动作不匹配"。该问题源于两个约束不足：一是逆动力学模型（IDM）未被显式鼓励区分动作相关转移与无关外观（nuisance appearance）；二是前向动力学模型（FDM）可通过当前状态的预测捷径，欠利用所推断的潜动作。

Method: 提出轻量级的以动作为中心的框架ACT-LAM，同时强化动作提取与动作利用：其Action Query IDM（AQ-IDM）使用可学习动作查询与门控聚合，在不施加强信息瓶颈的前提下选择性提取丰富的动作相关转移线索；其Action Token FDM（AT-FDM）将潜动作投影为动作token，与不断演变的状态表示逐步交互，实现持续的状态感知动作条件化。此外，ACT-LAM精简了特征处理流程，使模型容量集中于潜动力学建模。

Result: 在多个机器人数据集及VP²基准上的大量实验表明：ACT-LAM具有更强的潜动作一致性、前向动力学与下游视觉规划性能，且可训练参数更少、计算开销更低。特别是在VP²聚合成功率上超过此前SOTA达7.6%。

Conclusion: 重建质量与潜动作质量并不等价，重建导向的潜动力学建模需同时优化动作提取（区分动作与外观）与动作利用（避免预测捷径）；ACT-LAM以轻量设计在这两方面取得改进，验证了以动作为中心范式的有效性。

Abstract: Latent action models (LAMs) learn action representations from unlabeled videos by inferring latent actions from visual transitions and reconstructing future states. However, we identify a fundamental $\textbf{reconstruction-action mismatch}$: lower reconstruction error does not necessarily yield better latent dynamics or downstream performance. We attribute this mismatch to two underconstrained aspects of reconstruction-based latent dynamics modeling: (i) the inverse dynamics model (IDM) is not explicitly encouraged to distinguish action-related transitions from nuisance appearance, and (ii) the forward dynamics model (FDM) can underutilize the inferred latent action by exploiting predictive shortcuts from the current state. To address both limitations, we propose $\textbf{ACT-LAM}$, a lightweight action-centric framework that strengthens both action extraction and action utilization. Specifically, its Action Query IDM (AQ-IDM) employs learnable action queries and gated aggregation to selectively extract rich action-related transition cues without strong information bottlenecks. And its Action Token FDM (AT-FDM) projects latent actions into action tokens that progressively interact with evolving state representations, enabling continuous state-aware action conditioning. ACT-LAM further streamlines feature processing to concentrate model capacity on latent dynamics modeling. Extensive experiments on several robotic datasets and the VP$^2$ benchmark demonstrate stronger latent action consistency, forward dynamics, and downstream visual planning performance with fewer trainable parameters and lower computational overhead. In particular, ACT-LAM surpasses the previous state of the art by $\textbf{7.6%}$ on the aggregated VP$^2$ success rate. Codes at $\href{https://github.com/DingjieFu/ACT-LAM}{url}$.

</details>


### [302] [Long-to-Short Video Evidence Reasoning for Grounded Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15224)
*Kaiyan Chen,Junbin Xiao,Xun Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LOVER模型，通过长到短视频证据课程学习、GQA奖励（IoP优于IoU）与自适应时间戳渲染三项创新，提升视频接地问答性能，并在NExT-GQA和ReXTime上取得开源模型SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于强化学习的视频推理模型在长视频接地问答中存在证据跨度重叠度量不佳、时间可观测性弱、训练组织未按证据时长递进等问题，亟需针对性改进。

Method: LOVER包含三项模型无关且互补的设计：(1)长到短视频证据课程学习，按证据时长组织RL训练，从长程接地逐步过渡到短时推理；(2)GQA奖励，强调IoP奖励在证据定位上优于严格时间跨度重叠的IoU；(3)自适应时间戳渲染，基于背景感知的位置与颜色选择将时间戳渲染到视频帧上以增强时间可观测性。

Result: 三项设计在不同骨干网络上均有效提升QA、接地与接地QA性能；基于Time-R1构建的LOVER在NExT-GQA与ReXTime基准上取得开源模型新的SOTA结果，消融实验验证了各组件有效性。

Conclusion: LOVER通过课程学习、专门奖励与时间戳渲染三项创新，显著提升视频接地问答性能，验证了其通用性与有效性，达到开源模型领先水平。

Abstract: We present LOVER, a \underline{L}ong to sh\underline{O}rt \underline{V}ideo \underline{E}vidence \underline{R}einforced model for grounded question answering (GQA). LOVER highlights three innovations over existing reinforcement-learning (RL) based video reasoning models: (1) \textbf{Long-to-short Video Evidence Curriculum Learning}, which organizes RL training according to evidence duration and progressively adapts the model from long-range grounding to short-term reasoning; (2) \textbf{GQA Rewards}, which underscore the benefit of IoP reward over IoU for evidence spotting rather than strict temporal span overlap; (3) \textbf{Adaptive Timestamp Rendering}, which adaptively renders timestamps onto video frames using background-aware position and color selection to enhance temporal observability. The three designs are model-agnostic and reciprocal. They effectively improve QA, grounding, and grounded QA performance over different backbones. Notably, LOVER built on Time-R1 achieves new state-of-the-art (SOTA) results among open-source models on popular GQA benchmarks: NExT-GQA and ReXTime. Comprehensive ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of our three innovative components.

</details>


### [303] [Deep Learning-based Intelligent Diagnosis of Congenital Uterine Anomalies in 3D Ultrasound](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15225)
*Yueyue Xu,Yuhao Huang,Jiaxiao Deng,Yuanji Zhang,Haoming Zhang,Jiajia Qu,Shiying Zheng,Xiaomei Tang,Haining Chen,Chengcai Chen,Yiyi Wu,Xin Yang,Dong Ni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 CUA-Net 智能框架，无需冠状面重建即可自动分类先天性子宫异常，内外测试集准确率分别达 93.88% 和 91.52%，优于初级超声医师并接近高级医师水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先天性子宫异常（CUA）的临床诊断通常依赖冠状面重建，流程繁琐且对操作者经验依赖度高。为简化诊断流程、提升分类的自动化程度与标准化水平，作者希望构建一个无需冠状面重建即可完成 CUA 自动分类的智能框架，并验证其临床应用可行性（如缓解数据不平衡、难样本学习不足等问题）。

Method: CUA-Net 以 3D ResNet-18 为骨干网络，引入动态数据重采样策略缓解数据不平衡，并采用难样本挖掘技术通过损失调整充分学习困难病例；同时提出自监督重建以全面挖掘体数据信息，并运用在线数据增强纠正错误预测、提升泛化能力。在测试集上与多种深度学习方法以及初级/高级超声医师进行对比，评价指标包括准确率、精确率、召回率、F1 分数、micro-AUC 和 macro-AUC。

Result: CUA-Net 在内部与外部测试集均表现良好。内部队列：准确率 93.88%、精确率 87.01%、召回率 95.92%、F1 分数 88.09%、micro-AUC 0.9982、macro-AUC 0.9997。外部队列：准确率 91.52%、精确率 83.27%、召回率 88.63%、F1 分数 81.49%、micro-AUC 0.9945、macro-AUC 0.9990。模型在所有指标上均优于初级超声医师，在多数指标上与高级超声医师表现相当。

Conclusion: CUA-Net 在常见 CUA 类别分类中具有良好准确性与泛化性，并对较少见异常类型的识别展现出初步潜力。该能力有望优化临床工作流程，支持更标准化的诊断。

Abstract: Objective: To develop an intelligent framework, termed CUA-Net, for the automated classification of congenital uterine anomalies (CUA) without requiring coronal plane reconstruction, and to evaluate its clinical applicability.
  Methods: CUA-Net was built on 3D ResNet-18, equipped with a dynamic data resampling strategy to mitigate the data imbalance issue and a hard sample mining technique to fully learn from the difficult cases by loss adjustment. We further proposed the self-supervised reconstruction to comprehensively explore the volumes and the online data augmentation to refine the wrong predictions and enhance the model's generalization. We compared the CUA-Net with different deep-learning methods and junior/senior sonographers in the testing set. The evaluation metrics included accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, micro-AUC, and macro-AUC.
  Results: The proposed CUA-Net exhibited satisfactory performance in both internal and external test sets. In the internal cohort, the model achieved accuracy of 93.88%, precision of 87.01%, recall of 95.92%, F1-score of 88.09%, and micro-AUC of 0.9982 and macro-AUC of 0.9997. In the external set, it maintained good performance with accuracy of 91.52%, precision of 83.27%, recall of 88.63%, F1-score of 81.49%, micro-AUC of 0.9945 and macro-AUC of 0.9990. Our CUA-Net outperformed the junior sonographers across all performance indicators and achieved performance comparable to that of the senior sonographers across most metrics.
  Conclusion: The CUA-Net demonstrates favorable accuracy and generalizability in classifying common CUA categories, while showing preliminary potential for recognizing less prevalent anomalies. These capabilities may help optimize clinical workflows and support more standardized diagnosis.

</details>


### [304] [Closed-form Bayesian homography estimation from noisy point correspondences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15227)
*Hanne Beuter,Sebastian Dorn*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种从点对应估计单应矩阵的快速贝叶斯方法，显式引入观测噪声与先验知识，在齐次坐标下推导出单应矩阵后验均值的闭式解，并结合迭代贝叶斯处理非线性问题，输出单应参数的后验分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统单应矩阵估计方法（如DLT）仅给出点估计，无法直接量化由噪声观测引入的不确定性；该不确定性会传播至相机标定、三维重建等后续任务，在医疗影像、自动驾驶等安全关键领域尤为重要。

Method: 提出快速贝叶斯公式，用于从点对应估计单应矩阵；在齐次坐标下推导出单应矩阵后验均值的闭式解，并辅以迭代贝叶斯方法处理非线性问题；该方法显式融合测量不确定性与先验知识，并输出单应参数的后验分布。

Result: 合成实验验证了方法对投影变换的适用性，在不同噪声条件下估计精度优于DLT；图像拼接实验表明其适用于真实图像对应，并能额外提供不确定性信息。

Conclusion: 所提贝叶斯单应估计方法在保持快速性的同时，兼具精度优势与不确定性量化能力，可为后续视觉处理任务提供概率化的单应估计结果。

Abstract: While homographies are fundamental to many computer vision tasks, the majority of conventional estimation techniques provide only point estimates without directly quantifying uncertainty introduced by noisy observations. Uncertainty, though, propagates to subsequent processing steps such as camera calibration and 3D reconstruction and is particularly relevant in safety-critical and socially relevant fields including medical imaging, autonomous driving, and defense. We present a fast Bayesian formulation for homography estimation from point correspondences that explicitly incorporates measurement uncertainty and prior knowledge while providing a posterior distribution over the homography parameters. A closed-form solution of the posterior mean of the homography is derived in homogeneous coordinates and supplemented by an iterative Bayesian approach to handle non-linearities. Synthetic experiments demonstrate the applicability to projective transformations and show improved estimation accuracy over DLT under varying noise conditions. Image stitching experiments further demonstrate applicability to real image correspondences while additionally providing uncertainty information.

</details>


### [305] [Unsupervised Point Cloud Registration via Training-Time Semantic Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15228)
*Kezheng Xiong,Shiyun Xu,Sheng Ao,Siqi Shen,Cheng Wang,Chenglu Wen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CAESAR教师-学生框架，利用现成3D分割模型引导无监督LiDAR点云配准，通过双线索重匹配与语义-几何伪标签挖掘及语义预测蒸馏，在不增加推理开销、不需语义标注的情况下在KITTI和nuScenes上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模LiDAR点云的无监督配准受户外场景几何歧义影响，伪标签质量差、收敛次优，在nuScenes等稀疏低分辨率扫描上尤为严重。作者发现配准模型虽无显式语义监督，却隐含与配准精度强相关的语义感知能力，但这种感知脆弱，会被几何歧义引入的噪声监督迅速侵蚀导致性能崩溃。

Method: CAESAR为教师-学生框架，仅在训练阶段由现成3D分割模型引导。针对特征空间中潜在内点匹配常被少量错误近邻掩盖的问题，提出双线索引导重匹配（Dual-Cue Guided Re-Matching），通过重选而非直接剔除来恢复匹配。在此基础上，训练专用的语义-几何标签挖掘（Semantic-Geometric Label Mining）进行轻量批次级教师精炼，并在语义引导下挖掘可靠伪标签；同时引入语义预测蒸馏（Semantic Predictive Distillation），在特征空间巩固学生的语义感知。

Result: 在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上的大量实验表明达到当前最优性能，其中在更具挑战性的nuScenes基准上提升尤为显著。

Conclusion: CAESAR证明可通过训练阶段引入现成分割模型来稳定并强化配准模型的隐含语义感知，从而提升无监督LiDAR配准，且推理零额外开销、配准数据无需语义标注。

Abstract: Unsupervised registration of large-scale LiDAR point clouds remains challenging due to the geometric ambiguity inherent in outdoor scenes, which degrades pseudo-label quality and leads to suboptimal convergence, particularly for sparse, low-resolution scans such as those from nuScenes. We reveal that registration models intrinsically encode semantic awareness that strongly correlates with registration accuracy, albeit without explicit semantic supervision. However, this native awareness is fragile: noisy supervision arising from geometric ambiguity in unsupervised settings rapidly erodes the learned semantic structure, causing performance collapse. To this end, we propose CAESAR, a teacher-student framework guided by an off-the-shelf 3D segmentation model exclusively during training. We observe that potential inlier matches are often buried just beneath a few spurious neighbors in the noisy feature space, motivating Dual-Cue Guided Re-Matching to recover them through reselection rather than simply rejecting. Building on this, a train-only Semantic-Geometric Label Mining performs lightweight, batch-specific teacher refinement and mines reliable pseudo-labels under semantic guidance. We further introduce Semantic Predictive Distillation to consolidate the student's semantic awareness in the feature space. Extensive experiments on KITTI and nuScenes demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, with pronounced gains on the challenging nuScenes benchmark. Crucially, CAESAR incurs zero inference overhead and requires no semantic annotations on the registration data. Code will be released.

</details>


### [306] [Pre-PEFT Probing: Weight Statistics and Perturbation Robustness for Layer Selection in VLM Vision Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15229)
*Qingtao Xia,Jiahua Bao,Siyao Cheng,Jie Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种预微调探测方法，用于参数高效微调（PEFT）的层选择，通过权重统计特性与扰动鲁棒性评估视觉编码器各Transformer层的可适应性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有实践通常一次性对所有层应用LoRA等适配器，层选择多依赖启发式规则，导致可训练参数多、增益不稳定。作者希望以更少可训练参数获得更稳定、更高的性能增益，因此聚焦视觉编码器，直接评估各层的可适应性。

Method: 从两个角度刻画每一层：（i）其Q/K/V投影权重的统计特性（如范数与条件数）；（ii）在受控参数扰动下的鲁棒性。随后将这些指标与对单层施加PEFT所带来的下游性能增益进行系统性对比。

Result: 在涵盖七个基准和五种PEFT变体的实验中观察到一致的相关性：权重范数更大、条件数更高的层（或矩阵）通常对扰动更鲁棒，并更可能带来更大的微调增益。

Conclusion: 微调前的分布统计分析结合扰动测试可为适配层选择提供实用信号，从而在保持或提升性能的同时减少可训练参数。

Abstract: We propose a pre-fine-tuning probing method for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) layer selection, aiming to obtain more stable and higher gains with fewer trainable parameters when adapting large vision--language models (VLMs). Unlike the common practice of applying LoRA and other adapters to all layers at once---where layer selection often relies on heuristic rules---we focus on the vision encoder and directly evaluate the "adaptability'' of each Transformer layer. Specifically, we characterize each layer from two perspectives: (i) the statistical properties of its Q/K/V projection weights (e.g., norms and condition numbers); (ii) robustness under controlled parameter perturbations. We then systematically compare these indicators with the downstream performance gains brought by applying PEFT to a single layer. Across experiments covering seven benchmarks and five PEFT variants, we observe a consistent correlation: layers (or matrices) with larger weight norms and higher condition numbers are usually more robust to perturbations and are more likely to yield larger fine-tuning gains. These results show that distribution-statistics analysis and perturbation tests before fine-tuning can provide practical signals for adaptation-layer selection, thereby maintaining or improving performance while reducing trainable parameters.

</details>


### [307] [A 25-$μ$s/inf Event-driven Graph Neural Network Processor with Spatiotemporal Caching and Spline Convolution for Ultra-low-latency AI at the Edge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15241)
*Adrian Kneip,Martin Lefebvre,Daniel Gehrig,Victoria Catalán Pastor,Davide Scaramuzza,Marian Verhelst,Charlotte Frenkel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个可扩展至640×480分辨率的事件驱动图神经网络（EV-GNN）加速器ETHEREAL，通过邻居并行样条卷积引擎与2D/3D分层存储及ROI时空缓存，实现25.6μs端到端延迟、1.7μJ/事件能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DVS相机以像素为单位产生事件，时间分辨率达μs级，因而无法沿用传统基于帧的视觉算法-硬件协同设计。EV-GNN虽是很有前景的算法方案，但其混合了稠密规则的计算操作与稀疏不规则的访存，给硬件实现带来新挑战，目前缺乏能支撑高分辨率的高效加速器。

Method: 提出ETHEREAL加速器，包含两个关键设计：一是邻居并行（neighbor-parallel）样条卷积引擎，以应对稠密规则计算；二是2D/3D分离的存储层次结构，并引入新颖的兴趣区域（ROI）时空缓存机制，以缓解稀疏不规则访存。

Result: 在主流（state-of-the-art）工作负载上实现端到端推理，延迟为25.6μs，能耗为每事件1.7μJ，并首次将EV-GNN加速器扩展至640×480分辨率。

Conclusion: ETHEREAL验证了针对事件驱动图神经网络的算法-硬件协同设计路径的有效性，可在高分辨率下同时实现低延迟与低能耗的事件级推理。

Abstract: Dynamic-vision-sensor (DVS) cameras generate events on a per-pixel basis with a $μ$s-level temporal resolution, calling for new algorithm-hardware co-design approaches compared to standard frame-based vision. While event-driven graph neural networks (EV-GNNs) emerge as a promising algorithmic solution, they raise new HW challenges by mixing dense-regular compute operations and sparse-irregular memory accesses. We present ETHEREAL, the first EV-GNN accelerator that scales to 640$\times$480 resolutions, thanks to a neighbor-parallel spline convolution engine and a 2D/3D-split memory hierarchy with a novel region-of-interest spatiotemporal caching mechanism. Measurement results demonstrate end-to-end inference with 25.6$μ$s latency and 1.7$μ$J energy per event on state-of-the-art workloads

</details>


### [308] [AlignUS: MRI-Guided Ultrasound Representation Learning for ALS Classification from Tongue Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15285)
*Kadija Abdel Ghader,Emani Babe,Lorenzo Pettinari,Meya Haroune,Sidaty El Hadramy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出AlignUS跨模态知识蒸馏框架，用MRI解剖知识监督舌部高分辨率超声分类器，推理时仅需超声，患者级平衡准确率达0.958。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的早期评估困难，尤其在MRI不可用的低资源场景。舌部高分辨率超声（HRUS）便携低成本，可评估延髓受累，但超声数据量小且单独超声难以提取稳健表征，限制了可靠诊断模型的训练。

Method: AlignUS跨模态知识蒸馏框架：训练阶段将MRI的解剖知识迁移至基于HRUS的分类器，推理阶段仅需HRUS。模型联合使用分类损失、监督对比学习以及特征级蒸馏，使HRUS表征与MRI嵌入对齐。

Result: 在四个患者级交叉验证折上聚合，患者级平衡准确率0.958、macro-F1为0.963、ROC-AUC为0.990，并稳定优于HRUS基线与跨模态对比方法。

Conclusion: 来自MRI的监督信号可显著提升基于超声的ALS评估性能，同时保持低成本且推理阶段不依赖MRI，适用于低资源场景。

Abstract: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disease in which early assessment remains challenging, particularly in low-resource settings where MRI is often unavailable. High-resolution ultrasound (HRUS) of the tongue offers a portable and low-cost alternative for evaluating bulbar involvement, but learning reliable diagnostic models is limited by small datasets and the difficulty of extracting robust representations from ultrasound alone. We propose AlignUS, a cross-modal knowledge distillation framework that transfers anatomical knowledge from MRI to a HRUS-based classifier while requiring only HRUS at inference time. The model combines classification loss, supervised contrastive learning, and feature-level distillation to align HRUS representations with MRI embeddings. AlignUS achieves a patient-level balanced accuracy of 0.958, macro-F1 of 0.963, and ROC-AUC of 0.990, aggregated across four patient-level cross-validation folds, with consistent improvements over HRUS baselines and cross-modal alternatives. These results demonstrate that MRI-derived supervision can substantially improve ultrasound-based ALS assessment while preserving low-cost, inference-time independence from MRI.

</details>


### [309] [Learning from Reliable Negatives: Confidence-Anchored Test-Time Adaptation for GUI Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15307)
*Yizhou Liu,Fei Tang,Yuchen Yan,Zhengxi Lu,Songqin Nong,Tao Jiang,Wenhao Xu,Wenqi Zhang,Weiming Lu,Jun Xiao,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出无标签的测试时训练范式，基于坐标token置信度与负样本学习，显著提升GUI grounding性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GUI grounding的监督微调与强化学习依赖高成本标注，形成可扩展性瓶颈。

Method: 提出CAL，利用坐标token置信度过滤伪标签并分配基于距离的二值奖励；进一步提出CANL，仅用负样本优化模型，规避错误正样本风险。

Result: CANL-7B在ScreenSpot-V2达92.1%，在ScreenSpot-Pro达33.8%，较基座模型绝对提升8.9%。

Conclusion: 坐标token置信度可作为人工标注的有效替代，支撑可扩展的GUI智能体开发。

Abstract: Graphical User Interface (GUI) grounding is essential for autonomous agents to map natural language instructions to precise screen coordinates. However, existing supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning methods are constrained by the high cost of annotation, creating a scalability bottleneck. In this paper, we introduce a label-free test-time training paradigm driven by two key insights: (1) confidence patterns in coordinate tokens are a better indicator than full-sequence confidence, and (2) in sparse GUI coordinate spaces, negative samples offer more reliable learning signals than potentially noisy positive ones. We first propose Confidence-Anchored Learning (CAL), which utilizes coordinate-token confidence to filter pseudo-labels and assign distance-based binary rewards. Building on this, we develop Confidence-Anchored Negative Learning (CANL), which exclusively optimizes the model using negative samples to bypass the risks of incorrect positive samples. Experimental results demonstrate that CANL-7B achieves 92.1% on ScreenSpot-V2. On more challenging ScreenSpot-Pro, CANL-7B reaches 33.8%, an 8.9% absolute improvement over the base model. Our findings establish coordinate-token confidence as a powerful alternative to manual annotations for scalable GUI agent development.

</details>


### [310] [Hypergraph-Regularized Gramian Volumes for Multimodal Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15320)
*Anindya Nag,Ambuj Mehrish,Sebastiano Vascon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 HyVol，一种训练期超图正则化模块，在计算原始 Gram 体积损失前对多模态嵌入施加语义关系修正，推理时移除，不改变检索成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于体积（volume）的多模态检索虽能建模候选内部跨模态高阶对齐，但得分是候选局部的；语义相关的训练样本仅被当作对比负样本，其语义关系未被显式利用。

Method: 构建两类超边：文档超边连接同一候选的观测模态，语义超边连接互为首 k 近邻的候选（基于其分离后的字幕）。使用浅层门控超图网络对模态嵌入施加残差修正；用存在掩码将缺失流排除出消息传递；用恒等填充保持观测 Gram 子矩阵行列式且不做特征插补。修正作用于嵌入而非得分，故可同时适用于 Gram 与 HyperGram。训练后移除超图。

Result: 在 VAST-27M 的 150K 片段子集上训练两个骨干，在六个基准上做零样本评测。配对协议下，HyVol 在全部五个检索基准上提升 R@1，视频到文本增益在 MSR-VTT 达 +8.3、VATEX 达 +7.6。在缺失模态掩码下，所有实验设置的 V2T 边际均为正，但 T2V 边际在其中四种设置下略微为负。

Conclusion: HyVol 通过训练期超图正则化显式引入样本间语义关系，在推理时完全移除，保持骨干结构、原始打分函数与检索开销不变，同时提升零样本检索性能，但在缺失模态下的 T2V 方向存在轻微退化。

Abstract: Volume-based multimodal retrieval jointly scores a text query with a candidate's video, audio, and subtitle embeddings. While this approach captures higher-order within-candidate alignment, the score remains candidate-local, and semantically related training samples primarily serve as contrastive negatives. This work introduces Hypergraph-Regularized Gramian Volumes (HyVol), a training-time module that incorporates these semantic relations prior to evaluating the original volume loss. Document hyperedges connect the observed modalities of each candidate, whereas semantic hyperedges link candidates whose detached captions are mutual top-k neighbors. A shallow gated hyper-graph network applies residual corrections to the modality embeddings. Presence masks exclude unavailable streams from message passing, and identity padding preserves the determinant of the observed Gram submatrix without feature imputation. As refinement operates on embeddings rather than scores, the same construction applies to both Gram and HyperGram. We remove the hypergraph after training, leaving the backbone-only architecture, original scoring function, and retrieval cost unchanged. We train both backbones on a 150K-clip subset of VAST-27M and evaluate zero-shot performance on six benchmarks. Under the paired protocol, HyVol improves R@1 across all five retrieval benchmarks, with video-to-text gains reaching +8.3 on MSR-VTT and +7.6 on VATEX. Under missing-modality masking, the V2T margin remains positive in all experimental settings, although the T2V margin becomes slightly negative in four.

</details>


### [311] [Concept-Grounded Reasoning with Prompt-Driven Localization for Interpretable Structured Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15334)
*Xinyue Xu,Hongbin Lin,Juangui Xu,Hualiang Wang,Lehan Wang,Lijie Hu,Weiyang Liu,Adrian Weller,Xiaomeng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CORAL框架，将病灶定位与概念级监督整合到统一推理过程，通过概念瓶颈与掩码调制视觉特征驱动MLLM生成结构化医学报告，在BUS-CoT和IU X-ray上取得诊断准确率、概念一致性与报告质量的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学多模态大模型多采用端到端多模态融合，未对临床定义的中间属性建模，导致视觉定位能力弱、可解释性不足，与结构化、证据驱动的临床诊断流程不一致。

Method: CORAL由三部分组成：提示驱动的医学分割模型定位病灶；概念瓶颈模块预测多类临床属性；将生成的文本概念token与掩码调制的视觉特征在MLLM中融合，实现结构化报告生成与诊断预测。

Result: 在BUS-CoT与IU X-ray数据集上，CORAL相较通用及医学专用强基线MLLM，在诊断准确率、概念一致性和报告质量上均取得一致提升。

Conclusion: 概念驱动的推理能更好地将生成过程与临床决策流程对齐，验证了空间定位与概念级监督结合的有效性。

Abstract: Medical imaging modalities such as ultrasound and X-ray are widely used in clinical practice, where diagnosis follows a structured, evidence-driven workflow aligned with standardized criteria. While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show promise for automated medical report generation, most existing systems rely on end-to-end multimodal fusion without modeling clinically defined intermediate attributes, leading to limited grounding and interpretability. To address this issue, we propose CORAL (COncept-grounded ReAsoning with Localization), a multimodal framework that integrates spatial grounding and concept-level supervision into a unified reasoning process. CORAL employs a prompt-driven medical segmentation model to localize lesions and predicts multi-class clinical attributes through a Concept Bottleneck module. The resulting textual concept tokens are combined with mask-modulated visual features within an MLLM to enable structured report generation and diagnostic prediction. Experiments on BUS-CoT and IU X-ray datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in diagnostic accuracy, concept consistency, and report quality over strong general-purpose and medical MLLMs, indicating that concept-grounded reasoning better aligns generation with clinical decision processes.

</details>


### [312] [Query-Conditioned Spherical Centroid Aggregation for Multimodal Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15335)
*Ambuj Mehrish,Anindya Nag,Sebastiano Vascon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 SCALAR，一种查询条件的多模态聚合器，通过在球面质心计算前为各模态分配基于相关性的权重，解决对称聚合导致的性能退化问题。仅用 4.8M 可训练参数，在五个基准中的四个上实现正向聚合增益（最高 +4.0 R@1），并在模态缺失场景下显著优于 GRAM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态检索中的几何聚合器（Gramian volumes、双曲 volumes、谱目标）将所有模态对称处理，导致联合得分常低于最强单模态路径 1.9–27.6 R@1。受控分析表明根因在于"均匀模态影响力"（uniform modality influence），即缺乏查询条件化的模态重要性区分。

Method: 提出 SCALAR（Spherical Centroid Aggregation with Learned Adaptive Relevance）：(1) 查询条件化聚合器，在计算球面质心前为每个可用模态分配基于相关性的权重；(2) 支持任意模态子集；(3) 使用 rank-8 LoRA 适配器在掩码、降元（reduced-arity）视图上训练。

Result: 五个基准中四个取得正向聚合增益（最高 +4.0 R@1），而此前聚合器最多仅一个为正；均匀权重消融复现了对称聚合的退化现象；仅 4.8M 可训练参数下，在 3 个基准取得最高 text-to-video R@1，第 4 个与最优结果在种子波动范围内持平；测试时模态 dropout 下，其表示阶段得分在所有掩码率与基准上比 GRAM 检查点高 3.2–10.9 R@1；但随模态移除，仅在全模态集上训练的 reranker 逐渐收敛至纯视频路径，削弱表示层增益。

Conclusion: 查询条件化的自适应模态相关性加权能有效克服对称聚合的均匀影响力缺陷，以极小参数代价带来稳健的聚合增益与模态缺失鲁棒性；同时揭示了标准两阶段检索管线的局限——reranker 训练分布与推理时模态可用性不匹配会侵蚀表示层收益。

Abstract: Multimodal retrieval integrates video, audio, subtitles, and text; however, recent geometric aggregators, such as Gramian volumes, hyperbolic volumes, and spectral objectives, treat all modalities symmetrically. Under a unified evaluation protocol, their joint scores frequently lag behind the strongest single-modality pathway by 1.9 to 27.6 R@1. Controlled analyses attribute this outcome to uniform modality influence. This work introduces Spherical Centroid Aggregation with Learned Adaptive Relevance (SCALAR), a query-conditioned aggregator that assigns relevance-based weights to each available modality before computing a spherical centroid. SCALAR accommodates arbitrary modality subsets and is trained on masked, reduced-arity views using rank-8 LoRA adapters. Across five benchmarks, SCALAR achieves positive aggregation gain on four, reaching +4.0 R@1, while none of the evaluated prior aggregators is positive on more than one. A uniform-weight ablation reproduces the degradation observed with symmetric aggregation. With only 4.8 million trainable parameters, SCALAR attains the highest text-to-video R@1 on three and performs within seed variation of the best result on a fourth. Under test-time modality dropout, SCALAR's representation-stage score surpasses the released GRAM checkpoint at every evaluated masking rate and benchmark by 3.2 to 10.9 R@1. Finally, as modalities are removed, rerankers trained exclusively on complete modality sets increasingly converge toward their video-only pathways, diminishing these representation-level gains and underscoring a limitation of standard two-stage retrieval pipelines.

</details>


### [313] [Robust Multi-Model Fitting through Learning Neighbor Regions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15348)
*Chang Nie,Guangming Wang,Zhe Liu,Hesheng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LNR（Learning Neighbor Regions）粗到细框架，通过神经网络预筛选最小集并进行邻域区域特征编码，解决多模型拟合中特征利用不足、优化低效、模型重叠及不可微问题，在四类任务上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模型拟合在噪声环境下同时拟合多个模型，是场景重建与混合现实等计算机视觉任务的基础；但现有方法受限于特征利用不充分、优化效率低、模型重叠以及流程不可微等问题。

Method: LNR为粗到细框架：粗层模块用神经网络提取最小集的局部点对关系与全局上下文几何特征，输出置信度以预筛选少量优质最小集；细层模块为每个假设编码邻域区域特征（由邻近数据点的几何特征构成，可被多个区域共享），从而对每个假设单独细化与打分。网络直接从数据点特征而非假设参数学习，避免对采样过程与模型求解器求导。

Result: 在四个经典多模型拟合任务上的大量实验表明，LNR取得state-of-the-art性能。

Conclusion: 分析表明LNR易于适配各类鲁棒多模型拟合任务。

Abstract: Multi-model fitting involves fitting multiple models accurately in a noisy environment. It is the basis for computer vision tasks such as scene reconstruction and mixed reality. However, its performance is often limited by insufficient feature utilization, inefficient optimization, model overlap, and the non-differentiable pipelines. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a robust coarse-to-fine framework called Learning Neighbor Regions (LNR). Recognizing that substantial computational resources are wasted on numerous bad minimum sets, we propose the coarse-level module. This module utilizes a neural network to extract and analyze geometric feature of both local point-wise relationships and global contextual information in minimum sets, outputting confidence to pre-select a small number of good minimum sets, thereby enhancing overall efficiency before solving hypotheses. To address model overlap, LNR encodes neighbor region features for each hypothesis in its fine-level module. These region features consist of geometric features of neighboring data points, which can be used by multiple regions simultaneously. This design allows the neural network to individually refine and score each hypothesis. Importantly, LNR is trained to learn directly from data point features rather than from the hypothesis parameters, thus avoiding differentiating the sampling process and the model solvers. Extensive experiments on four classic multi-model fitting tasks demonstrate that LNR achieves state-of-the-art performance. The analysis suggests that LNR can be easily adapted to various robust multi-model fitting tasks.

</details>


### [314] [End-to-End Cell Detection via Instance-aware Graph Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15354)
*Ruochen Liu,Yalin Zheng,Jingxin Liu,Jianfeng Zhang,Shoujun Huang,Dexing Kong,Haofeng Li,Wei Lou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种端到端细胞检测与分类框架，联合建模图像块级视觉表示与实例级交互，包含动态图构建模块和实例感知图网络，在多种染色协议数据集上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病理分析中准确的细胞检测与分类直接影响诊断准确性与治疗方案制定。现有基于图神经网络的方法虽能建模肿瘤微环境中细胞核的空间与关系模式，但普遍采用"先视觉提取、后关系建模"的两阶段范式，需分阶段调参，增加流程复杂度且阻碍端到端联合优化。

Method: 提出端到端框架，同时建模patch级视觉表示与instance级交互。包含：(1) 动态图构建模块：利用由patch级特征衍生的可学习查询作为细胞实例表示，动态构建图结构，邻接关系由特征相似度与空间距离融合定义；(2) 实例感知图网络：进行自适应实例筛选与特征重组，在细胞图上聚合为拓扑潜在状态，用于由视觉线索驱动的选择性状态空间转换，融合外观与关系证据。

Result: 在多个采用不同染色协议的细胞与细胞核检测数据集上评估，该方法在检测与分类性能上均显著优于现有方法。代码将开源于 https://github.com/RuochenLiu23/IGM。

Conclusion: 通过统一的端到端设计，将视觉表示与关系建模联合优化，避免了传统两阶段范式的分阶段调参问题，验证了外观与关系证据融合在细胞检测与分类任务中的有效性。

Abstract: Accurate cell detection and classification are crucial for pathological analysis, directly affecting diagnostic accuracy and treatment planning. To capture complex cellular interactions beyond visual appearance within the tumor microenvironment, several approaches have employed graph neural networks to model spatial and relational patterns among cell nuclei, yielding promising results. However, these methods typically adopt a two-stage paradigm of visual extraction followed by relational modeling, which necessitates separate tuning for each stage, thereby increasing pipeline complexity and hindering end-to-end joint optimization. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end framework for cell detection and classification that jointly models patch-level visual representations and instance-level interactions, which incorporates a dynamic graph construction module and an instance-aware graph network. Specifically, the graph construction module dynamically builds the graph structure using learnable queries derived from patch-level features as cell instance representations, with adjacency defined by integrating feature similarity and spatial distances. The instance-aware graph network performs adaptive instance filtering and feature reorganization, aggregating them over the cell graph into a topological latent state for a selective state-space transition driven by visual cues, fusing appearance and relational evidence. When evaluated on multiple datasets with different staining protocols for cell and nucleus detection, our method significantly outperforms existing approaches in both detection and classification performance. The code will be released at https://github.com/RuochenLiu23/IGM.

</details>


### [315] [Diffusion Trajectory Modeling for Semantic Correspondence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15357)
*Yusung Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Diffusion Trajectory Modeling (DTM)，将扩散过程中间特征视为沿时间轴的轨迹，用于语义对应并取得优异性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有方法仅使用单个时间步的特征图或多时间步特征聚合，忽略了扩散过程中每个空间 patch 的表征沿时间轴逐步演化形成的语义轨迹，这类语义难以从静态快照中捕获。

Method: 将每个空间 patch 在多个时间步上的特征演化建模为轨迹，进行 patch 级轨迹建模，从而提取以往方法未设计的对应线索，用于语义对应任务。

Result: 实证显示空间对应的 patch 在扩散过程中形成相似的轨迹模式，表明扩散的时间轴携带语义信息；在 SPair-71k、SPair-U 和 AP-10K 上取得强劲性能。

Conclusion: DTM 从轨迹中心的视角重新利用扩散表征，为扩散特征在语义对应等下游任务中的应用提供了新思路。

Abstract: Diffusion models generate images through an iterative diffusion process, and recent studies have demonstrated that the intermediate feature maps produced during this process contain rich visual representations, leading to their adoption across a variety of downstream tasks. However, most existing approaches are limited to either using a single feature map at a specific timestep or aggregating feature maps across multiple timesteps. We observe that intermediate representations in the diffusion process form meaningful trajectories along the time axis. In particular, the representation of each spatial patch evolves progressively throughout the generative process, encoding semantics that are difficult to capture from static snapshots alone. This observation motivates the need to treat diffusion representations as temporally structured trajectories rather than static snapshots. To this end, we propose Diffusion Trajectory Modeling (DTM), a framework that interprets the temporal evolution of each spatial patch as a trajectory and leverages it for semantic correspondence. By effectively modeling patch-wise trajectories generated across multiple timesteps, DTM captures correspondence cues that prior methods are not designed to capture. We further demonstrate empirically that spatially corresponding patches form similar trajectory patterns throughout the diffusion process, suggesting that the temporal axis of diffusion carries semantic information. Experiments on SPair-71k, SPair-U and AP-10K show that DTM achieves strong performance, presenting a new perspective for exploiting diffusion representations from a trajectory-centric viewpoint.

</details>


### [316] [CapsuleMotion: A Lightweight Real-Time Visual Motion Predictor for Capsule Endoscopy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15367)
*Oliver Bause,Julia Werner,Oliver Bringmann*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CapsuleMotion，通过预测帧间运动动态调整视频胶囊内镜帧率，并结合LocalizationNet低功耗定位器官，在RISC-V演示平台上实现最高20.66%能耗降低，并提升小肠入口检测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频胶囊内镜受限于可吞咽体积，电池容量有限，而图像采集与传输功耗高，二者矛盾导致难以完成全消化道筛查，需要以目标导向方式高效利用有限能量。

Method: CapsuleMotion利用设备端图像压缩指标预测相邻帧间运动，按预测运动幅度调整相机帧率；进入小肠前采用低功耗模式大幅降低帧率，并在预测到运动时用LocalizationNet判断当前器官位置。在Rhode Island VCE数据集评估，并部署于集成硬件加速器的超低功耗单核RISC-V演示平台。

Result: 相比无动态帧率的传统胶囊，CapsuleMotion可降低电能消耗最高20.66%，同时提升小肠入口检测准确率。

Conclusion: 患者特异性的动态胶囊行为能在不增加硬件负担的前提下提升筛查完整性与能量效率，验证了运动预测与低功耗器官定位结合方案的可行性。

Abstract: Video Capsule Endoscopy (VCE) is a non-invasive medical examination that allows for the observation of the small intestine, which is otherwise difficult to access. A fundamental challenge persists in the form of their limited size in order to still be swallowable. The resulting restricted battery capacity, however, contradicts with the power-intensive nature of image capture and transmission. Therefore, we propose CapsuleMotion, a patient-specific dynamic capsule behavior that utilizes the available energy in a goal-oriented manner to increase the likelihood of a complete screening of the gastrointestinal tract. By investigating and combining metrics from the on-device image compression, CapsuleMotion predicts the motion between two successive frames. The camera's frame rate will be modified in accordance with the predicted magnitude of motion. Furthermore, prior to entering the small intestine, the capsule operates in a low power mode with a significantly reduced frame rate. In this mode, the LocalizationNet is employed to determine the current organ, provided that motion was predicted. The proposed framework is evaluated on the Rhode Island VCE dataset and deployed on an ultra-low power single-core RISC-V demonstrator with an integrated hardware accelerator. CapsuleMotion demonstrated the capability to reduce electric energy consumption by up to 20.66% in comparison with conventional capsules that lack a dynamic frame rate. Additionally, the accuracy of detecting the entry point of the small intestine has been improved.

</details>


### [317] [BSC-Net: A Small-Branch-Sensitive Structural Continuity Network for Coronary Vessel Segmentation and Quantitative Angiographic Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15400)
*Wanxian Li,Jiaqian Qin,Qingyi Xian,Yazhi Li,Song Chen,Liman Li,Hao He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出BSC-Net（基于ResNet-U-Net），通过定向采样增强小血管表征，并结合长程上下文建模与边缘引导损失（EIL）修复血管结构连续性，在XCA数据集上取得SOTA分割性能并支持定量冠脉分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: XCA中血管分割是定量冠脉分析的基础，但受成像噪声、复杂分叉、血管与背景结构重叠影响，易出现血管连通性断裂和小分支漏检，分割精度不足。

Method: BSC-Net框架：以ResNet-U-Net为骨干；通过定向采样（targeted sampling）提升小血管表征；集成长程上下文建模与Edge-Informed Loss（EIL）以改善血管结构连续性。在两个公开XCA数据集上验证分割性能，并基于分割结果进行自动定量冠脉分析。

Result: 在两个公开XCA数据集上达到SOTA，Dice/IoU分别为77.8%/90.6%与64.5%/83.0%；并导出狭窄率、达峰时间、相对传播速度等形态学与血流动力学参数。

Conclusion: BSC-Net在保持血管连续性的同时实现准确血管分割，支持可靠的定量冠脉评估与冠心病下游分析与临床评价。

Abstract: Vessel segmentation in X-ray coronary angiography (XCA) is a fundamental step for quantitative coronary analysis and subsequent assessment of coronary artery disease. However, accurate vessel segmentation remains challenging because of imaging noise, complex bifurcations, and the overlap of vessels and background structures, which can lead to disrupted vascular connectivity and missed small branches. In this work, we propose BSC-Net, a ResNet-U-Net-based framework tailored to improve small-vessel representation and repair vascular structural continuity. BSC-Net enhances small-vessel representation through targeted sampling and improves vascular structural continuity by integrating long-range contextual modeling and Edge-Informed Loss (EIL). BSC-Net was validated on two public XCA datasets, demonstrating state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in coronary vessel segmentation with Dice and IoU scores of 77.8%/90.6% and 64.5%/83.0%, respectively. Furthermore, based on the obtained vessel segmentation, we performed automated quantitative coronary analysis and derived clinically relevant morphological and hemodynamic parameters, including stenosis ratio, time-to-peak, and relative propagation velocity. These results demonstrate that BSC-Net produces accurate vessel segmentation results with preserved vascular continuity for quantitative coronary assessment, enabling reliable downstream analysis and clinical evaluation of coronary artery disease.

</details>


### [318] [MarKey: Marginal Utility Guided Greedy Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15408)
*Hongchang Shi,Jinpeng Hu,Ao Wang,Wenzheng Zhou,Hui Ma,Feng Li,Zenglin Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练关键帧选择框架MarKey，将关键帧选择建模为集合感知的贪心优化，通过查询相关性、边际覆盖增益与上下文相关冗余的联合打分，提升长视频理解效率与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频理解中，密集编码帧序列计算开销大，而有限视觉预算下的均匀采样会遗漏稀疏但关键的证据。现有免训练关键帧选择方法多对帧进行孤立打分，未显式考虑候选帧与已选子集的互补性，易导致冗余选择和证据覆盖不完整。

Method: MarKey为免训练框架，将关键帧选择形式化为集合感知的贪心优化。每次迭代用可处理的代理目标对候选帧打分，联合考虑查询相关性、边际覆盖增益和上下文相关冗余，选效用最高帧；并用紧凑的代表性锚点近似全视频覆盖，用已选帧的有界窗口限制上下文比较以提升效率。

Result: 在涵盖整体视频理解、人物中心视频理解和开放式视频理解的三类共六个基准上，MarKey持续优于现有方法；进一步分析显示在不同MLLM骨干、模型规模和帧预算下均有稳健增益。

Conclusion: 集合感知的贪心优化结合锚点近似与有界窗口，可在免训练条件下有效缓解关键帧选择中的冗余与覆盖不足问题，作为通用即插即用策略提升长视频多模态理解。

Abstract: Long-video understanding remains challenging for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) because densely encoding long frame sequences is computationally expensive, while uniform sampling under a limited visual budget can miss sparse yet decisive evidence. Recent training-free keyframe selection methods have enabled more efficient inference and yielded promising performance gains. However, many existing methods score frames largely in isolation without explicitly considering how each candidate complements the currently selected subset, potentially resulting in redundant selections and incomplete evidence coverage. To address this limitation, we propose MarKey, a training-free framework that formulates keyframe selection as subset-aware greedy optimization. At each iteration, MarKey scores each candidate using a tractable surrogate that jointly accounts for query relevance, marginal coverage gain, and context-dependent redundancy, and selects the frame with the highest utility. To make this iterative subset-aware evaluation efficient, MarKey uses a compact set of representative anchors to approximate full-video coverage and a bounded window of previously selected frames to limit context-dependent comparisons. Experiments on six benchmarks spanning holistic video understanding, human-centric video understanding, and open-ended video understanding demonstrate that MarKey consistently outperforms existing methods. Further analyses show robust gains across different MLLM backbones, model scales, and frame budgets.

</details>


### [319] [ViCo-SAM3: Vision-Conditioned Alignment for Open-Vocabulary Camouflaged Object Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15418)
*Qiangqiang Zhou,Wenjun Tang,Yong Chen,Dandan Zhu,Jiawei Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ViCo-SAM3：用视觉条件化对齐弥合文本语义与像素线索的鸿沟，在OVCOS任务上达到SOTA且泛化性强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放词汇伪装目标分割（OVCOS）需在文本引导下分割未见过的伪装目标。作者观察到SAM3仍存在全局文本语义与细粒度像素级视觉线索之间的显著语义鸿沟；同时，全量微调文本编码器会带来沉重参数开销，并易过拟合训练类别，损害开放词汇表示的灵活性。

Method: 提出ViCo-SAM3，一个视觉条件化对齐框架。核心为ViCo模块：用全局视觉上下文动态调制文本嵌入，使文本表示适配当前图像内容，从而桥接视觉—文本语义鸿沟；并设计ViCoBind（视觉条件化跨模态绑定）模块，增强视觉与文本表示间的跨模态交互与语义对齐。方法无需额外技巧（without bells and whistles）。

Result: 在OVCamo基准上取得state-of-the-art性能，并展现出强泛化能力。

Conclusion: 通过视觉条件化调制文本嵌入与跨模态绑定对齐，ViCo-SAM3在避免文本编码器全量微调代价与过拟合风险的同时，有效缓解OVCOS中的语义鸿沟，兼具高性能与开放词汇泛化性。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary camouflaged object segmentation (OVCOS) aims to segment unseen camouflaged objects under text guidance. We observe that SAM3 still suffers from a pronounced semantic gap between global textual semantics and fine-grained pixel-level visual cues in OVCOS. Meanwhile, fully fine-tuning the text encoder introduces heavy parameter overhead and risks overfitting to training categories, which compromises open-vocabulary representation flexibility. To address these issues, we propose ViCo-SAM3, a Vision-Conditioned alignment framework designed for OVCOS. Specifically, we introduce vision-conditioned (ViCo) module, which dynamically modulates text embeddings with global visual context, enabling textual representations to adapt to the current image content and thereby effectively bridging the semantic gap between vision and text. Building on this, we further design a vision-conditioned cross-modal binding (ViCoBind) module to enhance cross-modal interaction and semantic alignment between visual and textual representations. Without bells and whistles, ViCo-SAM3 achieves state-of-the-art performance on the OVCamo benchmark and demonstrates strong generalization.

</details>


### [320] [A Conservative OCR-Enabled Workflow for R214 Sodium Screening of South African Packaged Foods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15427)
*Mayimunah Nagayi,Alice Scaria Khan,Tamryn Frank,Rina Swart,Clement Nyirenda*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究提出一个保守的基于包装图像的钠含量筛查流程，结合区域检测、OCR、产品身份与钠证据提取、R214类别判定及确定性阈值比较，并与独立视觉语言模型流程对照，用于筛查南非包装食品是否符合R214钠限值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 利用食品包装图像监测钠/盐含量以对照南非R214钠限值存在困难，因为筛查决策需要产品身份、营养标签证据、报告基准以及类别特定阈值等多重要求。

Method: 使用442个包装食品、3929张完整包装图像的真实南非食品包装数据集；YOLO26s小目标检测器生成4195个区域裁剪；采用严格后处理为每个产品生成一行钠证据；整合流程包括区域检测、OCR、产品身份与钠证据提取、R214类别分配、确定性阈值比较；并设置独立的Qwen2.5-VL 7B视觉语言模型流程进行对照。

Result: 整合流程产出：290例OUTSIDE R214 SCOPE、139例REVIEW、7例SCREEN-PASS、6例SCREEN-FAIL。Qwen2.5-VL 7B流程产出：387例OUTSIDE R214 SCOPE、31例REVIEW、20例SCREEN-PASS、4例SCREEN-FAIL。两流程在R214类别精确分配上442个产品中一致415个（93.9%），在类别是否属于R214范围内一致416个（94.1%），最终筛查结果一致307个（69.5%）。对60个产品的人工核验显示，严格结果一致率低于监管状态一致率，且所有人工"数据不足"案例均未被两个自动化流程判为SCREEN-PASS或SCREEN-FAIL。

Conclusion: 保守的图像筛查可有效组织包装证据、识别明确案例，并将不确定案例归入REVIEW，而非强行给出SCREEN-PASS或SCREEN-FAIL判定。

Abstract: Using food package images to monitor sodium and salt content against South Africa's R214 sodium limits is challenging when screening decisions require product identity, nutrition facts panel evidence, reporting basis, and category-specific thresholds. This study presents a conservative image-based workflow that combines region detection, optical character recognition (OCR), product identity and sodium evidence extraction, R214 category assignment, deterministic threshold comparison, and independent vision language model comparison. The evaluation used 442 packaged food products and 3 929 full package images from a real-world South African food packaging dataset. A YOLO26s small detector generated 4 195 region crops, and strict post-processing produced one sodium evidence row per product. The integrated workflow produced 290 OUTSIDE R214 SCOPE, 139 REVIEW, seven SCREEN-PASS, and six SCREEN-FAIL outcomes. The independent Qwen2.5-VL 7B vision language model workflow produced 387 OUTSIDE R214 SCOPE, 31 REVIEW, twenty SCREEN-PASS, and four SCREEN-FAIL outcomes. The workflows agreed on exact R214 category assignment for 415 of 442 products (93.9%) and on whether the assigned category was within R214 scope for 416 of 442 products (94.1%). Final screening outcome agreement was 307 out of 442 products, or 69.5%. Manual verification on 60 products showed lower strict outcome agreement than regulated status agreement, while all manual INSUFFICIENT DATA cases were kept out of SCREEN-PASS and SCREEN-FAIL by both automated workflows. The findings show that conservative image-based screening can organise package evidence, identify clear cases, and assign uncertain cases to REVIEW rather than forcing SCREEN-PASS or SCREEN-FAIL decisions.

</details>


### [321] [AnchorGUI: Asymmetric Memory for Dual-Scale Learning in GUI Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15457)
*Shengjie Jin,Zelong Sun,Hengbo Xu,Yanbiao Ma,Zhiwu Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出AnchorGUI框架，通过认知状态锚（CSA）将GUI导航中的多模态轨迹转化为显式的预测误差信号，实现单回合内纠错与跨回合经验蒸馏的双尺度学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM驱动的GUI导航代理难以处理和利用密集、连续的视觉历史。该瓶颈同时制约了单回合内的即时纠错（intra-trial）与多次尝试间的经验蒸馏（cross-trial）。作者将其归因于GUI导航中的信息不对称：预期内的状态转移可压缩为轻量文本摘要，而预期外的结果则需保留截图作为因果证据以支持准确诊断。

Method: 提出AnchorGUI统一框架，核心为认知状态锚（CSA）。CSA作为逐步基元，主动比较预期转移与实际观测转移，将被动多模态轨迹转化为显式预测误差信号，并借此驱动基于非对称记忆的双尺度学习机制：单回合纠错中，滑动窗口选择性地保留检测到不匹配处的视觉证据，提供即时、视觉落地的反馈；跨回合蒸馏中，非对称记忆将计算昂贵的信用分配搜索空间聚焦于可能的失败步骤。

Result: 在四个基准上验证了有效性。在AndroidWorld上，AnchorGUI以每步2.4倍token缩减实现57.3%成功率；跨回合蒸馏成功率达69.2%（提升11.9%），显著优于标准反思方法，同时保持亚线性的上下文扩展。

Conclusion: AnchorGUI利用预测误差驱动的非对称记忆机制，有效缓解GUI导航代理在视觉历史处理上的信息不对称瓶颈，在提升成功率的同时降低token开销并保持亚线性上下文增长。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable autonomous GUI navigation, but agents still struggle to process and learn from dense, continuous visual histories. This bottleneck hinders both immediate error correction within a single episode (intra-trial) and experience distillation across multiple attempts (cross-trial). We trace these challenges to an empirical informational asymmetry in GUI navigation: while expected transitions can often be compressed into lightweight textual summaries, unexpected outcomes benefit from preserved screenshots as causal evidence for accurate diagnosis. Building on this insight, we propose AnchorGUI, a unified framework driven by the Cognitive State Anchor (CSA). The CSA acts as a per-step primitive that actively compares expected and observed transitions, converting passive multimodal trajectories into explicit prediction-error signals. These signals orchestrate a dual-scale learning mechanism via an asymmetric memory. For intra-trial correction, a sliding window selectively retains visual evidence for detected mismatches, providing immediate, visually-grounded feedback. For cross-trial distillation, this asymmetric memory focuses the computationally expensive credit assignment search space on likely failure steps. Experiments across four benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our approach. On AndroidWorld, AnchorGUI achieves a 57.3% success rate with a $2.4\times$ token reduction per step. Furthermore, cross-trial distillation reaches 69.2% success (+11.9% gain), significantly outperforming standard reflection methods while maintaining sub-linear context scaling.

</details>


### [322] [BVB: Benchmarking Agentic Video Understanding via Programmatic Reconstruction in Blender](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15478)
*Yolo Y. Tang,Daiki Shimada,Jiayue Meng,Jing Bi,Pinxin Liu,Yicheng Wang,Yunzhong Xiao,Zhangyun Tan,Zeliang Zhang,Chao Huang,Susan Liang,Qianxiang Shen,Luchuan Song,Ali Vosoughi,Mingqian Feng,Melika Filvantorkaman,Chenliang Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 BVB（Blender-VideoBench）基准，要求智能体通过编写 Blender 脚本重建真实视频，并采用双轴评估（Dual VQA 语义保真 + Latent Similarity 感知相似），在统一沙箱与成本限制下评测 10 个模型家族的 51 种配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态智能体已能通过编程（而非扩散模型）在 Blender 等软件中创作复杂视频，但现有视频理解基准仍主要以问答形式评测模型。作者认为，若智能体真正理解一段视频，就应能以程序方式重建它，因此需要一个以"程序化重建"为核心判据的评测基准。

Method: 提出 BVB 基准：智能体将真实视频重建为 Blender 动画场景。为保证公平比较，所有智能体通过轻量级框架 Mini-BVB 在完全相同的沙箱中编程，并受统一成本限制。评估时从重建场景的动画相机渲染结果出发，采用两个维度：(1) Dual VQA，衡量重建保留了多少时空事实；(2) Latent Similarity，衡量重建与源视频的感知相似度。总分为两者的平方根均值（square-root mean），以鼓励均衡表现。

Result: 共评测来自 10 个模型家族的 51 种配置，并分析语义保留、感知相似度、推理开销与成本。最佳模型的 Latent Similarity 达 88.6，但在源视频正确的时空问答中仅保留 53.7% 的正确回答。增加推理投入可提升视觉相似度，却无法弥合事实准确性上的差距。在 15 名评分者、5 种配置的盲测中，Latent Similarity 与人类偏好高度相关。

Conclusion: 程序化重建是一种可行的智能体视频理解评测方式，其中语义保留（semantic retention）仍是核心挑战。

Abstract: Multimodal agents can create complex videos in software such as Blender by coding without relying on diffusion models. Yet video understanding benchmarks still evaluate models mainly through question answering. If an agent truly understands a video, it can reconstruct it programmatically. We introduce BVB, Blender-VideoBench, a benchmark that tests this ability by asking agents to reconstruct real-world videos as animated Blender scenes. To ensure fair comparison, each agent programs the reconstruction through a lightweight harness, Mini-BVB, in an identical sandbox under a shared cost limit. The benchmark renders each reconstruction from its animated camera and evaluates it on two axes: (1) Dual VQA measures how many spatiotemporal facts the reconstruction preserves. (2) Latent Similarity measures how closely the reconstruction matches the source video perceptually. Our overall score, a square-root mean, favors balanced performance. We evaluate 51 configurations from 10 model families and analyze semantic retention, perceptual similarity, reasoning effort, and cost. The best model reaches 88.6 Latent Similarity but retains only 53.7% of the source-correct spatiotemporal answers. Additional reasoning improves visual similarity but does not close this gap in factual accuracy. In a blind study with 15 raters and five configurations, Latent Similarity correlates strongly with human preference. These results show that programmatic reconstruction is a viable test of agentic video understanding, and that semantic retention remains the main challenge.

</details>


### [323] [CatchMonitor: a machine learning system for automated fish discard quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15484)
*Geoff French,Michal Mackiewicz,Mark Fisher,Helen Holah,Rebecca Lamb*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文报告了CatchMonitor系统的持续开发，构建了一个计算机视觉原型系统，可从渔船REM监控视频中自动量化废弃渔获，并通过半监督学习提升物种识别精度、结合目标跟踪实现丢弃量化，同时以多位专家人工计数的变异性作为性能对比基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 渔船甲板真实环境（光照、遮挡、运动、鱼体堆叠等）使监控视频分析极具挑战，而人工计数废弃渔获费时且存在主观差异，因此需要自动化的丢弃量化手段。

Method: 在既有工作基础上引入半监督学习提升物种识别准确率；采用简单且鲁棒的目标跟踪方法；在其之上构建废弃渔获量化原型系统；并统计分析多位专家人工计数的变异性，作为系统性能的对比基准。

Result: 物种识别精度较前期工作有所提升；系统实现了对废弃渔获的原型化自动量化；专家间人工计数存在可测量的变异性，并被用作评估基准。

Conclusion: 半监督学习与鲁棒跟踪相结合可支撑REM视频中丢弃渔获的自动量化；以人工计数变异性为基准表明自动化方法具备与人工可比乃至更一致的评估潜力。

Abstract: We report on the continued development of CatchMonitor, resulting in a prototype computer vision system designed to automatically quantify discarded fish from video footage collected from Remote Electronic Monitoring (REM) systems on fishing trawlers. The analysis of trawler surveillance footage is a challenging problem due to the real-world conditions on board fishing vessels. Building on our prior work we improve the accuracy of species identification through the application of semi-supervised learning. We utilise a simple and robust object tracking approach, upon which we build our prototype discard quantification system. Finally we analyse the variability of manual discard quantification performed by multiple expert human analysts, using it as a benchmark against which we compare the performance of our system.

</details>


### [324] [SyntheticDoc: A Large Synthetic Dataset for Document Unwarping and Illumination Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15503)
*Daniel Woortmann,Tanguy Magne,Olga Sorkine-Hornung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 SyntheticDoc——一个百万级、高分辨率、程序化生成并具像素级精确标注的文档去畸变数据集，用物理模拟器与路径追踪渲染生成几何与光照，训练简单基线模型后在去畸变与光照校正任务上与SOTA方法对比验证其价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习文档矫正与光照校正模型的性能根本上受限于训练数据。近十年来社区高度依赖 Doc3D，但该数据集在规模与质量上已日益受限，成为研究瓶颈。因此需要一个大规模、高质量的数据集来推动文档去畸变研究。

Method: 构建 SyntheticDoc：包含1,000,000个高分辨率程序化生成的训练样本，并有大规模验证集与测试集。每个样本配有丰富且像素级精确的标注，包括UV映射、法线图、反照率（albedo）和阴影（shading）。为兼顾物理准确性与照片级真实感，页面几何由基于物理的模拟器生成，并使用路径追踪（path tracer）进行渲染。随后在 SyntheticDoc 上训练一个简单基线模型，并在文档去畸变与光照校正两项任务上与SOTA方法比较。

Result: 论文报告了在 SyntheticDoc 上训练的简单基线模型在文档去畸变和光照校正任务上的性能，并与当前最先进方法进行了对比（摘要未给出具体数值）。数据集与生成代码已公开。

Conclusion: SyntheticDoc 以百万级规模、物理准确的几何与逼真渲染、以及像素级多模态标注，突破现有文档去畸变数据集的规模与质量瓶颈；即使简单基线模型也能在此基础上展现与SOTA可比的表现，数据集与生成代码开源以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Deep learning models have become the standard tool for document rectification and illumination correction, yet their performance is fundamentally bound by their training data. For nearly a decade, the community has heavily relied on Doc3D, a pioneering but increasingly limited document unwarping dataset in terms of scale and quality. To address this bottleneck, we introduce SyntheticDoc, a massive, high-quality dataset designed to push the boundaries of document unwarping. SyntheticDoc is composed of 1,000,000 high-resolution procedurally generated training samples, alongside extensive validation and test sets. Each sample is paired with rich, pixel-perfect annotations, including UV maps, normal maps, albedo and shading. To ensure physical accuracy and photorealism, the paper geometries are generated via a physics-based simulator and rendered using a path tracer. To demonstrate the benefit of our dataset, we train a simple baseline model on SyntheticDoc and report on its performance in comparison to state-of-the-art methods on both document unwarping and illumination correction tasks. Our dataset is available at https://igl.ethz.ch/projects/SyntheticDoc/ and the code used to generate it at https://github.com/tanguymagne/SyntheticDoc .

</details>


### [325] [Assessing nnU-Net Generalization across Brain Tumor Populations in BraTS-GoAT 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15524)
*Tristan Kirscher,Vivian Metzger,Philippe Meyer,Xavier Coubez*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该摘要报告了 BraTS-GoAT 异质人群肿瘤分割的基线结果：3D nnU-Net 在官方验证集上 ET/TC/WT 的全局 DSC 分别为 0.7805、0.8288、0.8854；跨域泛化存在明显性能下降；失败病例与 ET 体积小、成分分散相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估肿瘤分割模型在异质人群（跨域）条件下的泛化表现，并识别导致分割失败的关键因素，为 BraTS-GoAT 基准提供可复现的基线。

Method: 训练常规 3D nnU-Net：1,351 例标注数据，五折交叉验证，每折 1,000 轮；最终预测器对五折取平均并施加测试时镜像（TTA）。同时对比残差编码器替代方案，并在匹配的 fold-0 推理设置下比较源域 OOF 与合并验证集性能。对 OOF 失败病例进行参考 ET/WT 体积校正后的多因素分析。

Result: 合并官方验证集全局 DSC：ET 0.7805、TC 0.8288、WT 0.8854。fold-0 匹配推理下，平均区域 Dice 由源域 OOF 的 0.9058 降至合并验证集的 0.8310（Δ=−0.0747）。镜像 TTA 仅带来小幅单折增益，集成收益不明确；残差编码器方案平均 Dice 为 0.8282。OOF 失败病例的参考 ET 体积显著更小；校正 ET 与 WT 体积后，较低 Dice 仍与 ET 成分更分散、最大连通成分中 ET 占比更小相关。

Conclusion: 常规 3D nnU-Net 在异质人群上出现显著跨域性能下降，其中 ET 分割最弱。失败主要由小体积、多连通/碎片化的 ET 病灶驱动，提示需针对小且分散的 ET 结构改进分割策略。

Abstract: BraTS-GoAT evaluates tumor segmentation across heterogeneous populations. We trained a conventional 3D nnU-Net on 1,351 labeled cases using five-fold cross-validation and 1,000 epochs per fold. The final predictor averaged all folds and applied test-time mirroring. On pooled official validation, global DSC values were 0.7805, 0.8288, and 0.8854 for enhancing tumor (ET), tumor core (TC), and whole tumor (WT). Under matched fold-0 inference, mean regional Dice decreased from 0.9058 on source out-of-fold (OOF) cases to 0.8310 on pooled validation (difference--0.0747). Mirroring gave small single-fold gains but no clear ensemble benefit; a residual-encoder alternative reached 0.8282 mean Dice. In labeled OOF predictions, failure cases had substantially smaller reference ET volumes; after adjustment for ET and WT volume, lower Dice remained associated with more disconnected ET components and a smaller fraction of ET contained in the largest component.

</details>


### [326] [PIVOT: Physics-Grounded Verification for AI-Generated Audio-Video Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15562)
*Bo Zheng,Kangran Zhao,Xiaoyu Zhang,Weinan Guan,Zhiheng Li,Yize Chen,Haizhou Li,Qingshan Liu,Siwei Lyu,Baoyuan Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出物理一致性驱动的AIGC检测框架PIVOT，通过估计音视频物理量并验证相关物理定律约束来判别真伪，同时构建PhysForensics-Bench基准，性能优于直接使用大模型检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着生成模型进步，AIGC内容愈发逼真，传统依赖伪影线索的检测器效果被削弱；但当前生成器仍难以忠实复现真实事件的物理行为，因此可利用物理定律约束作为新的检测依据。

Method: PIVOT从视频与音频中估计物理量，为每个片段选择相关物理定律，并验证其可测量约束；除真/伪判断外，还输出支持性证据，包括验证结果、相关时间窗口及各适用定律的支持物理量。框架以音视频实例化，原则上可扩展至其他AIGC模态。

Result: 在PhysForensics-Bench（九个事件中心场景族、两种近期音视频生成器的配对真假片段）上，PIVOT在Real+Seedance取得70.30%准确率、64.29% F1，在Real+VEO取得72.16%准确率、65.82% F1；Gemini 3.1 Pro直接检测分别为53.96%/60.09%和57.22%/63.44%。

Conclusion: 物理一致性验证可作为结构化、可审查的证据来源，有效补充基于伪影的AIGC检测方法，具有实际应用前景。

Abstract: As generative models continue to advance, AI-generated content (AIGC) is becoming increasingly realistic, weakening the artifact cues commonly exploited by existing detectors. Nevertheless, faithfully reproducing the physical behavior of real-world events remains challenging for current generators. We therefore explore detecting AIGC by assessing whether the depicted event satisfies measurable constraints derived from physical laws. We introduce PIVOT, a physics-grounded AIGC detector, instantiated here for audio-video clips, that estimates physical quantities from video and audio, selects physical laws relevant to each clip, and verifies their measurable constraints. Beyond a real/fake decision, PIVOT returns supporting evidence that records the verification outcome, relevant time window, and supporting quantities for each applicable law. Although instantiated and evaluated here on audio-video data, the framework can, in principle, extend to other AIGC modalities whenever the physical quantities required for verification can be estimated reliably. We also introduce PhysForensics-Bench, comprising paired real and generated audio-video clips from nine event-centric scene families and two recent audio-video generators. On PhysForensics-Bench, PIVOT achieves 70.30% accuracy and 64.29% F1 score on Real+Seedance, and 72.16% accuracy and 65.82% F1 on Real+VEO. In comparison, direct inspection with Gemini 3.1 Pro obtains 53.96% accuracy and 60.09% F1 on Real+Seedance, and 57.22% accuracy and 63.44% F1 on Real+Veo. These results demonstrate the practical promise of physical-consistency verification as a structured and inspectable source of evidence that complements artifact-based AIGC detection.

</details>


### [327] [What a gated sensing pipeline never looks at: bandwidth reduction and the misses behind it](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15579)
*Raghu Venkat,Tricha Anjali*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 评估一条门控感知流水线：用"发送发现而非视频"替代原始传输，在受限链路上实现最高41,977x（含对照155,830x）的数据压缩；但修正跟踪器测速缺陷后性能由1/4降至1/7，作者以单飞行的tick级轨迹定位3次漏检环节，并将其定位为案例研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受限（contested）链路上机载传感器无法传输视频，因此"发送发现（findings）而非视频、并报告二者比特比"看似是合理替代方案。论文旨在实测该方案的压缩效果与检测能力，同时检验这种单一压缩比指标能否真实反映系统性能。

Method: 构建门控感知流水线：学习式目标检测 + 图像-文本比较，配合确定性调度、门控、证据累积与传输规则；在筹备拍摄的影像上运行，语义阶段在线。修正跟踪器对速度的测量方式（去除正态性模型据以学习的测量伪影）后重新运行；并设置未布置任何事件的控制飞行作为对照，输出单飞行的tick级轨迹（3,187行）以定位漏检阶段。

Result: 修正前：211 s内发送38,736比特，压缩41,977x，4个事件中命名1个、无误报。修正后：四次飞行共7个布置事件中命名1个。控制飞行无报告，压缩155,830x，为全研究最大压缩比也最无信息量。tick级轨迹将3次漏检分别定位为：1次未产生航迹、1次在结构位置检验处以0.129未通过、1次通过539个结构tick但仅达3.192（阈值边界3.807）。另报告一例已知失效模式：在线正态性模型吸收了它随后要判别的目标，并用该目标随后未通过的阈值进行了标定。

Conclusion: 证据总体为1次检测、6次漏检（四次布置飞行）加1次干净对照，应作为案例研究而非性能证明。核心论点：产生压缩比的机制同时决定哪些观测能进入决策，因此压缩比与检测性能不可分开报告；压缩比度量的是场景而非系统。论文给出复现协议与生成结果，标明未分发的支撑性工件，并说明哪些实验未运行。

Abstract: An airborne sensor on a contested link cannot send video, so the appealing move is to send findings instead and report the ratio between the two. We evaluate a gated sensing pipeline that does this, combining learned object detection and image-text comparison with deterministic scheduling, gating, evidence accumulation and transmission rules. On staged footage with the semantic stage live it sends 38,736 bits over 211 s, a reduction of 41,977x, and names 1 of 4 staged events with no false report. That detection has since been superseded: a correction to how the tracker measures speed removed the measurement artefact the normality model had been learning from, and the flight no longer warms. Under the corrected code the pipeline names 1 of 7 staged events across four flights, and we report both. On a control flight where nothing was staged it reports nothing, a reduction of 155,830x: the largest number in the study and the least informative, because a reduction ratio measures the scene. The mechanisms that produce the reduction also decide which observations ever reach a decision, so the two cannot be reported apart. We give a tick-level trace of one flight (3,187 rows) that places each of three missed events at the stage where it stopped progressing: one produced no track, one failed the structural place test at 0.129, and one passed 539 structural ticks but reached only 3.192 against a boundary of 3.807. We also report one instance of a known failure mode, an online normality model absorbing the object it will later judge, measured against the threshold that object then failed. The evidence is one detection and six misses across four staged flights, beside one clean control, and we treat it as a case study. We give the reproduction protocol and generated results, identify which supporting artifacts are not distributed, and state which experiments did not run.

</details>


### [328] [A Unified Vision-Language Model for PSMA PET/CT Report Generation, Visual Question Answering, and Lesion Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15603)
*Yang Xing,Jiong Wu,Savas Ozdemir,Yang Zhou,Boxiao Yu,Ying Zhang,Zheren Zhu,Chenyu You,Wei Shao,Yang Lu,Kang Wang,Tinsu Pan,Yang Yang,Kuang Gong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出统一的PSMA PET/CT视觉-语言模型，集成报告生成、视觉问答与病灶分割，采用LLaVA式架构与四阶段训练策略，在多任务基准上均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准确的PSMA PET/CT解读对前列腺癌管理至关重要，但现有PET/CT AI模型通常仅处理孤立任务，缺乏统一的多任务框架。

Method: 采用LLaVA式架构，包含PET/CT视觉编码器、MLP-Mixer投影模块、LoRA微调的大语言模型及3D分割分支；训练分四阶段：视觉编码器预训练、投影层对齐、VLM微调、多任务最终微调。语言任务使用5,747例带配对报告的PSMA PET/CT数据集，分割任务使用AutoPET的PSMA子集。

Result: 在标准报告生成指标上优于PET2REP及基于CT的基线；在各类VQA问题类型上均有提升；Dice与病灶级重叠F1高于SegAnyPET和nnUNet。

Conclusion: 结果支持在单一多任务模型架构内实现结构化、可交互、可解释且具备体素级定位能力的PSMA PET/CT统一分析框架的可行性。

Abstract: Accurate PSMA PET/CT interpretation is central to prostate cancer management, yet existing PET/CT AI models typically address isolated tasks. We propose a unified PSMA PET/CT vision-language model for report generation, visual question answering, and lesion segmentation. The framework adopts an LLaVA-style architecture, comprising a PET/CT vision encoder, an MLP-Mixer projection module, a LoRA-tuned large language model, and a 3D segmentation branch. Training followed a four-stage strategy: vision encoder pretraining, projection-layer alignment, VLM fine-tuning, and final multitask tuning. Language tasks used 5,747 PSMA PET/CT datasets with paired reports, while segmentation used the PSMA subset of AutoPET. The model outperformed PET2REP and a CT-based baseline across standard report-generation metrics, improved performance across VQA question types, and achieved higher Dice and lesion-level overlap F1 than SegAnyPET and nnUNet. These results support the feasibility of a unified framework for structured, interactive, interpretable PSMA PET/CT analysis with voxel-level grounding within a single multitask model architecture.

</details>


### [329] [VideoScout: Learning Agentic Active Exploration with Adaptive Reasoning Pacing for Long Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15606)
*Weixin Xu,Zhenyu Yang,Bing Wang,Shengsheng Qian,Changsheng Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将长视频理解建模为"顺序证据获取（SEA）"问题，提出多轮推理智能体 VideoScout，通过自适应观看节奏在有限视觉上下文窗口内遍历长视频，并利用 66K 探索轨迹的两阶段训练（冷启动 SFT + DAPO 强化学习）显著提升 7B 模型的长视频理解与推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型在短视频理解上进展显著，但受限于视觉上下文窗口，长视频理解仍不足。现有方法依赖均匀帧采样或粗到细的智能体缩放，难以在足够长的视频中定位稀疏且关键的证据。

Method: 将长视频理解形式化为顺序证据获取（SEA）问题：智能体沿时间轴逐轮读取视频，每轮决定观看速度、保留哪些证据、何时回访不确定片段以及何时停止作答。据此提出 VideoScout 多轮推理智能体，通过动态控制观看节奏，在有限视觉上下文窗口内高效遍历长视频，兼顾内容分析深度与阅读效率。训练上构建 VideoScout-66K（来自 10K 条答案验证轨迹的 66K+ 高质量探索轮次），采用两阶段流程：冷启动监督微调学习逐轮输出格式；再用 DAPO（解耦裁剪与动态采样策略优化）进行轨迹级强化学习，复合奖励由答案准确率、输出格式合规性以及智能体观看进度与教师答案时机的 IoU 时间对齐共同构成。

Result: 在长视频理解与推理基准上的大量实验表明，该 7B 模型相较现有已训练的 7B 智能体模型取得了强劲性能。

Conclusion: 将长视频理解重构为顺序证据获取问题并配合自适应节奏的多轮智能体与轨迹级强化学习，是在有限上下文窗口下提升长视频理解与推理的有效途径。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress on short video understanding yet remain limited on long videos due to the limited visual context window. Prevailing approaches rely on uniform frame sampling or recent coarse-to-fine agentic zooming, both of which struggle to localize sparse, decisive evidence in sufficiently long videos. We formulate long video understanding as a \textbf{Sequential Evidence Acquisition (SEA)} problem, in which an agent reads the video turn by turn along the temporal axis, deciding at each turn how fast to watch, what evidence to retain, when to revisit uncertain segments, and when to stop and answer. Inspired by this view, we propose \textbf{VideoScout}, a multi-turn reasoning agent that instantiates the SEA paradigm through adaptive reasoning pacing. Specifically, by dynamically controlling the viewing pace, VideoScout enables efficient traversal of long videos within a bounded visual context window, allowing the agent to access more video content while balancing content analysis depth with reading efficiency. To train VideoScout, we construct VideoScout-66K, a set of over 66K high-quality exploration turns from 10K answer-verified trajectories, and adopt a two-stage pipeline: cold-start supervised fine-tuning teaches the agent per-turn output format, while the Decoupled Clip and Dynamic sAmpling Policy Optimization (DAPO) algorithm performs trajectory-level reinforcement learning with a composite reward that jointly considers answer accuracy, output format compliance, and the temporal alignment between the agent's viewing progress and the teacher's answer timing measured by intersection-over-union (IoU). Extensive experiments on long video understanding and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our 7B model achieves strong performance compared with existing trained 7B agentic models.

</details>


### [330] [ModaLens: Measuring Image Sensitivity in Report-Conditioned Medical VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15635)
*Sebastián Andrés Cajas Ordóñez,Maximin Lange,Quang Bui,Anqi Peter Li,Felipe Ocampo Osorio,Rafi Al Attrach,Kushul Reddy Palakala,Sahil Kapadia,Zakaria Laouabdia Sellami,Xinyue Zhang,Ashley Zhang,Leo Anthony Celi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ModaLens 成对图像替换审计方法，通过固定问题与报告、替换同一患者另一检查的图像，量化报告可用性对视觉语言模型图像敏感性的影响。在 MIMIC-CXR 3,199 例配对病例、14 个问题上，报告可用时答案翻转率由无报告时的 20.94% 降至 4.26%，成对提升 16.7 个百分点（95% CI 15.6–17.7）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 放射报告本身即可回答临床问题，因此难以判断视觉语言模型是否真正利用了图像信息。需要一种可测量、可复现的审计方法，分离"报告可用性"对模型图像依赖程度的因果影响，以检验模型是否仅在复述报告文本而非进行视觉推理。

Method: 提出 ModaLens：成对图像替换审计。在 MIMIC-CXR 的 3,199 个配对病例（293 名患者）上，对每例 14 个问题（13 个针对具体征象、1 个综合问题）执行替换——将原图像换为另一检查的图像（通常为同一患者），保持问题与报告不变。以生成答案是否变化作为图像敏感性指标，设定显式作答指令与原始提示（小写首 token 读出）两种协议，并比较有无报告两种条件下的配对差异，同时考察连续答案分数。

Result: 显式作答指令下，有报告时生成答案变化率 4.26%，无报告时 20.94%，成对增加 16.7 个百分点（患者聚类 95% CI 15.6–17.7）。原始提示下为 4.70% 对 17.07%。图像替换还会在二值预测不变的情况下改变连续答案分数。方向在另外两个模型谱系中可复现。

Conclusion: 在该协议下，报告可用性显著降低模型对图像替换的敏感性，提示模型可能更多依赖报告文本而非图像证据。由于标签由报告派生，结论对"视觉正确性"的推断有限。方法、提示词与全部数值运行记录已开源。

Abstract: A radiology report can already answer a clinical question, so it is hard to tell whether a vision-language model also uses the image. ModaLens, a paired image-swap audit, measures how report availability changes image sensitivity: MedGemma-27B on 3,199 paired MIMIC-CXR cases from 293 patients, all 14 questions per case (13 finding-specific and one composite), each image replaced by one from another study, usually of the same patient, with question and report fixed. Under an explicit answer instruction, the model's generated answer changes on 4.26 percent of trials with the report and 20.94 percent without it, a paired increase of 16.7 points (patient-clustered 95 percent CI 15.6 to 17.7), so report availability reduces image-swap sensitivity under this protocol; the original prompt with a lowercase first-token readout gives 4.70 percent against 17.07 percent, and substitutions also move continuous answer scores where the binary prediction does not change. The labels are derived from reports, which limits conclusions about visual correctness; the direction replicates in two further model lineages. Code, the exact prompts and a run record for every number are at https://github.com/criticaldata/MODALENS.

</details>


### [331] [SAM3D-Part: Interactive Part Selection and Generation from 3D Objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15639)
*Jiahao Chang,Dong Du,Wanhu Sun,Yujian Zheng,Chuanyu Pan,Bowen Zhao,Chongjie Ye,Yuanming Hu,Xiaoguang Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SAM3D-Part，一种基于提示的框架，可从源 3D 网格中选择性生成指定部件并输出完整可复用网格。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代 3D 资产制作常以部件为单位进行编辑、复用、动画与制造，用户往往只需要若干特定部件而非完整对象分解。现有 3D 生成方法无视用户意图生成全部部件，可提示 3D 分割方法通常只输出局部表面而非可复用的完整网格；图像条件下的部件生成器在不直接以源网格为条件时，难以保持隐藏几何与准确放置。

Method: 给定源网格与部件提示，先将源几何编码为紧凑网格特征，并与渲染图像、选择掩码和点图观测通过逐像素通道融合对齐；融合表示驱动前馈生成模型，仅生成被查询部件为完整网格。为放回源坐标系，预测稠密逐体素对应关系，并从分布式空间证据估计部件变换，而非单一全局位姿编码。多部件顺序查询时，已生成部件存入 part cache 并作为上下文约束复用。

Result: 大量实验与消融表明，SAM3D-Part 显著提升源对齐、降低条件化成本，并实现一致的选择性部件生成，达到 state-of-the-art。代码与权重将发布于 https://github.com/Jiahao620/sam3d-part。

Conclusion: SAM3D-Part 通过提示驱动的选择性部件生成，兼顾完整网格输出、源几何保持与准确放置，并支持多部件一致性生成。

Abstract: Part-level control is essential for modern 3D asset creation, where objects are frequently edited, reused, animated, or fabricated through their individual components. In many such workflows, users need only several specific components rather than a complete object decomposition. However, existing 3D generation methods produce all parts regardless of user intent, while promptable 3D segmentation methods typically output partial surfaces instead of reusable complete meshes. In addition, image-conditioned part generators further struggle to preserve hidden geometry and accurate placement without directly conditioning on the source mesh. To address these problems, we present SAM3D-Part, a prompt-driven framework for selective part generation from input 3D object meshes. Given a source mesh and a part prompt, SAM3D-Part first encodes the source geometry into compact mesh features and aligns them with the rendered image, selective mask, and point-map observations via pixel-wise channel fusion.
