The fused representation conditions a feed-forward generative model to produce only the queried component as a completed mesh. To place the generated part back into the source coordinate frame, SAM3D-Part predicts dense per-voxel correspondences and estimates the part transformation from distributed spatial evidence rather than a single global pose code. For sequential multi-part queries, previously generated parts are stored in a part cache and reused as contextual constraints, reducing conflicts among independently requested components. Extensive experiments and ablations demonstrate that SAM3D-Part can significantly improve source alignment, reduce conditioning cost, and enable consistent selective part generation, achieving state-of-the-art. Code and weights will be available at https://github.com/Jiahao620/sam3d-part.

</details>


### [332] [Human-Grounded Calibration for Long-Text Image-Text Congruence in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15640)
*Alessandro Gambetti,Qiwei Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Congruency Score（CS）——一种轻量级校准层，将图文相似度证据映射为有界的一致性分数，用于长文本图文一致性评分，并揭示检索性能、人类判断关联与阈值校准是三个需分别评估的目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长文本图文一致性评分对视觉-语言系统日益重要，但双编码器模型的原始相似度分数难以解释为经过校准的一致性度量，尤其是在图像与文本嵌入之间存在模态鸿沟（modality gap）的情况下。

Method: 提出 Congruency Score（CS）：一种轻量级校准层，将图文相似度证据映射为有界分数。在 DOCCI 与 Urban1k 数据集上，对四个冻结的视觉-语言骨干模型进行评估，并结合人类标注进行验证。

Result: 投影后质心距离的下降并不一致地提升图文检索性能；人类评估显示存在权衡：直接事后校准保持了与人类判断的高关联，而某些基于投影的配置虽能降低阈值相关的斜率与截距畸变，却以检索性能和关联强度为代价。

Conclusion: 长文本图文一致性评分应被确立为一个校准化的分数估计问题，检索性能、人类判断关联与阈值校准必须作为三个独立目标分别评估；CS 提供了一种轻量级方式来暴露并操作化这一区分。

Abstract: Long-text image--text congruence scoring is increasingly important for vision-language systems that must evaluate whether detailed textual descriptions match visual content. However, raw similarity scores from dual-encoder models are difficult to interpret as calibrated congruence measures, especially under the modality gap between image and text embeddings. This paper proposes Congruency Score (CS), a lightweight calibration layer that maps image--text similarity evidence into a bounded score. Using DOCCI and Urban1k, we evaluate four frozen vision-language backbones and show that observed reductions in post-projection centroid distance do not uniformly improve image--text retrieval performance. Human-grounded evaluations on DOCCI further reveal a trade-off: direct post-hoc calibration preserves high association with human judgments, whereas selected projection-based configurations can reduce threshold-relevant slope and intercept distortions at the cost of retrieval performance and association strength. These results establish long-text image--text congruence scoring as a calibrated score-estimation problem, where retrieval performance, human association, and threshold calibration must be evaluated as distinct objectives. CS provides a lightweight way to expose and operationalize this separation.

</details>


### [333] [MedDiME: Efficient Latent Diffusion with Adaptive Masking for Medical Counterfactual Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15647)
*Yan Zeng,Changlu Guo,Anders Nymark Christensen,Morten Rieger Hannemose,Anders Bjorholm Dahl*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MedDiME提出潜空间分类器引导扩散框架，结合梯度驱动的自适应掩码，实现高效、空间精确的医学反事实生成，推理提速达40倍、峰值显存降至1/13。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学反事实生成通过修改图像改变模型预测以提升可解释性，但现有基于扩散的方法速度慢、内存消耗大，难以应用于高分辨率场景；且现有掩码策略与像素空间表示紧密耦合，无法兼容潜空间扩散编辑。

Method: 提出MedDiME，一个潜空间分类器引导的扩散框架，降低计算与内存开销，并引入兼容潜空间、由梯度驱动的自适应掩码机制，实现空间精确的医学反事实生成。

Result: 大量实验表明，MedDiME在实现高质量反事实生成的同时，相比此前的分类器引导扩散基线取得显著效率提升：推理速度最高快40倍，峰值GPU显存占用降低13倍。

Conclusion: MedDiME有效缓解了医学反事实生成中的效率与内存瓶颈，并解决了掩码策略与潜空间不兼容的问题，为高分辨率医学图像的可解释性分析提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Medical counterfactual generation modifies images to change model predictions for interpretability. However, existing diffusion-based approaches are often prohibitively slow and memory-intensive, making them difficult to apply in high-resolution settings. Moreover, existing masking strategies are tightly coupled with pixel-space representations, making them incompatible with latent-space diffusion editing. To address these challenges, we propose MedDiME, a latent-space classifier-guided diffusion framework that reduces computational and memory overhead while introducing a latent-compatible, gradient-driven adaptive masking mechanism for spatially precise medical counterfactual generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MedDiME achieves high-quality counterfactual generation with significant efficiency gains compared to prior classifier-guided diffusion baselines, achieving up to 40 times faster inference and 13 times lower peak GPU memory usage.

</details>


### [334] [From Model Patterns to Abstract Semantics in Compositional Zero-Shot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15649)
*Weize Li,Zhicheng Zhao,Fei Su*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CLEAR是一个基于完形填空式推理的重排序框架，通过将原语变化视为上下文驱动的具体视觉线索激活，提升组合零样本学习的识别性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有组合零样本学习方法依赖视觉语言模型，并通过多表征显式建模原语的上下文变化，但受限于固定的变体容量以及抽象语义与具体语义之间的竞争。

Method: 提出新视角，将原语变化视为上下文驱动的具体视觉线索激活而非独立实体；据此设计CLEAR框架，从原语候选集中以由粗到细的方式提取条件变体，执行完形填空式推理以推断高层语义，并通过重排序纠正对显著具体原语的预测偏差。

Result: 大量实验表明，CLEAR在具有挑战性的C-GQA和MIT-States数据集上持续提升基模型性能，并优于现有最先进方法。代码已开源。

Conclusion: CLEAR通过完形填空式推理与重排序机制有效缓解了原语变体建模的局限，为组合零样本学习提供了新的解决思路。

Abstract: Compositional Zero Shot Learning aims to recognize unseen compositions by recombining learned primitives. Recent methods rely on vision language models and attempt to explicitly model contextual variations of primitives through multiple representations. However, such approaches are limited by fixed variant capacity and competition between abstract and concrete semantics. In this work, we present a new perspective that views primitive variations as the context-driven activation of concrete visual cues rather than independent entities. Based on it, we propose CLEAR, a CLoze-style rEAsoning-based Re-ranking framework inspired by human perceptual processes. CLEAR extracts conditional variants from the primitive candidate set in a coarse-to-fine manner, performs cloze-style reasoning to infer high-level semantics, and re-ranks predictions to correct biases toward salient concrete primitives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CLEAR consistently improves the Base Model and outperforms state-of-the-art methods on the challenging C-GQA and MIT-States datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/buptLwz/CLEAR.

</details>


### [335] [Circuit-MLLM: Topological Logic-Guided Latent-Space Visual Reasoning for Circuit Schematic Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15668)
*Jinyuan Deng,Yuqi Jiang,Wenjing Huang,Xin Li,Qi Sun,Cheng Zhuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Circuit-MLLM 多模态推理框架，将电路原理图拓扑分析重构为器件定位、路径追踪与隐空间序贯推理过程，通过电路知识挖掘与拓扑引导排序策略提升电路理解能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型虽在通用任务表现优异，但电路原理图因元件布局密集、拓扑逻辑独特，需要细粒度结构解析才能提取电气语义，通用 MLLM 难以胜任。

Method: 1）将电路拓扑分析重构为器件定位、路径追踪与隐空间内的序贯推理；2）引入电路知识挖掘机制，使模型隐表示与多粒度电路视觉专家提取的结构丰富特征深度对齐，内化拓扑语义；3）设计拓扑引导排序策略，将推理从刚性光栅扫描顺序中解耦，强制沿电路拓扑逻辑在隐空间逐步推理。

Result: 在多种电路分析任务上持续优于强基线，平均得分较 GPT-5.1 高出 25%。

Conclusion: 该框架有效提升了电路原理图拓扑分析性能，验证了拓扑引导隐空间推理与知识对齐机制的有效性，代码已开源。

Abstract: Through pre-training on extensive text and image datasets, current multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on general tasks. However, circuit schematics present a unique challenge for MLLMs due to their dense component layouts and distinct topological logic, demanding fine-grained structural parsing to extract the electrical semantics. To address this, we propose Circuit-MLLM, a multimodal reasoning framework that reformulates circuit topology analysis as a process of device localization, path tracing, and sequential reasoning within the latent space. We introduce a circuit knowledge mining mechanism that deeply aligns the model's latent representations with structurally rich features derived from multi-granularity circuit vision experts, enabling the model to effectively internalize topological semantics. Building upon these internalized semantics, we devise a topology-guided sequencing strategy that decouples reasoning from the rigid raster-scan order, enforcing stepwise inference along the circuit's topological logic in latent space. Across diverse circuit analysis tasks, Circuit-MLLM consistently outperforms strong baselines, notably achieving a 25% higher average score than GPT-5.1, which demonstrates the effectiveness of our framework in circuit schematic topology analysis. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/IC-Yuan/Circuit-MLLM.

</details>


### [336] [Benchmarking Intra-Patient 3D Deformable Multimodal Image Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15669)
*Matteo Barbieri,Giammarco La Barbera,Juan Pablo De La Plata,Sabine Sarnacki,Isabelle Bloch,Pietro Gori*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文对患者内3D多模态可变形配准方法进行了系统性基准评测，覆盖三个不同解剖区域与难度数据集，比较经典优化方法与现代学习方法（含深度学习与基础模型）。核心发现：几何指标（DSC、HD95）与图像相似度指标（MIND-SSC）持续不一致；解剖引导方法在分割区域内重叠度高但区域外退化；尚无方法能在各解剖与模态下稳健，患者内3D多模态配准仍是开放问题，需多准则评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态图像配准是众多临床流程的关键环节，但不同模态下对应解剖结构常呈现显著不同的图像强度，导致配准困难。现有研究缺乏覆盖多解剖区域、多难度层级并同时纳入经典与前沿学习方法的统一评测，且评价标准单一，难以判断方法是否真正实现全局多模态对应。

Method: 构建患者内3D多模态可变形配准的综合基准，横跨三个数据集，涵盖不同解剖区域与难度水平，并同时包含合成形变恢复与真实临床场景。评测对象包括经典优化类方法与现代学习类方法（近期深度学习模型及基础模型）。采用互补指标：平均Dice相似系数（DSC）、平均95百分位Hausdorff距离（HD95），以及基于MIND自相似性上下文的模态无关结构相似度度量（MIND-SSC）。

Result: 各数据集结果差异显著：学习类方法在大规模合成基准上表现更优，而在真实盆腔配准中仅观察到有限提升。几何指标（DSC、HD95）与图像相似度指标（MIND-SSC）之间持续存在不一致，表明重叠度提升不必然意味着更好的全局多模态对应。解剖引导方法取得最高重叠分数，但在分割区域之外性能下降，揭示标签驱动对齐与全局结构一致性之间的权衡。总体而言，现有方法均无法在各类解剖与模态下实现稳健性能。

Conclusion: 患者内3D多模态配准需要多准则评估，应纳入基于形变的度量指标；该问题仍是开放难题，尚无方法能在不同解剖结构与模态间稳健泛化。

Abstract: Multimodal image registration is a key component of many clinical workflows, yet it remains challenging because corresponding anatomical structures often exhibit substantially different image intensities across modalities. In this work, we present a comprehensive benchmark of intra-patient 3D multimodal deformable registration methods across three datasets covering different anatomical regions and difficulty levels, including both synthetic deformation recovery and real clinical scenarios. We evaluate classical optimization-based approaches and modern learning-based methods, including recent deep learning and foundation models, using complementary metrics: Average Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), average 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95), and a modality-independent structural similarity measure based on the MIND self-similarity context (MIND-SSC). Results show high variability across datasets, with learning-based methods demonstrating superior performance on large synthetic benchmarks, while only limited improvements are observed in real pelvic registration. A key finding of this study is the consistent disagreement between geometric metrics (DSC, HD95) and image-based similarity metrics (MIND-SSC), highlighting that improved overlap does not necessarily imply better global multimodal correspondence. Furthermore, anatomy-guided approaches achieve the highest overlap scores but exhibit degraded performance outside of segmented regions, revealing a trade-off between label-driven alignment and global structural coherence. Overall, our results indicate that no current method achieves robust performance across anatomies and modalities. We demonstrate that intra-patient 3D multimodal registration requires multi-criteria evaluation, including deformation-based metrics, and remains an open problem.

</details>


### [337] [MambaMPD: A Mamba-Driven Segmentation Framework for Marine Pollution Detection from Remote Sensing Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15676)
*Shuaiyu Chen,Wei Han,Peng Ren,Chunbo Luo,Zeyu Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 MambaMPD，一种融合频率感知增强（FAA）与多尺度边缘引导注意力（EGA）的增强型 Mamba 框架，用于海洋污染检测（MPD），在保持低计算量的同时提升分割精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海洋污染检测（MPD）对保护海岸生态系统与海洋生物多样性至关重要。Vision Mamba 在遥感语义分割中因高效捕获长程依赖与全局上下文而展现潜力，但其在 MPD 中的应用尚待探索。MPD 的难点在于低信噪比、污染模式破碎、以及污染物与周围海水视觉相似导致的边界模糊。

Method: 提出 MambaMPD，引入两种互补结构先验：1）频率感知增强（FAA），将小波变换集成到编码器中，把特征分解为多尺度频率子带，以捕获低频上下文语义与高频结构细节；2）多尺度边缘引导注意力（EGA），自适应融合分层拉普拉斯边界线索与深层语义表示，在解码前细化编码器特征以锐化边界。解码器采用带挤压激励注意力和深监督的 U-Net 风格结构，跨尺度逐步恢复并细化语义与空间信息。

Result: 在两个基准 MPD 数据集上，MambaMPD 的 mIoU 高于对比方法，且计算量显著低于基于基础模型的方法。在 MADOS 上，F1 较 OSDMamba 提升 3.6%；在 M4D 上，Oil Spill IoU 较 TransOilSeg 提升 6.82%。

Conclusion: MambaMPD 通过频率与边缘双重结构先验，提升了模型对微弱污染信号的敏感性与边界保持能力，在 MPD 任务中实现了精度与计算效率的较优平衡。

Abstract: Accurate marine pollution detection (MPD) is essential for protecting coastal ecosystems and marine biodiversity. Vision Mamba models have shown promise in remote-sensing semantic segmentation by efficiently capturing long-range dependencies and global context, yet their potential for MPD remains underexplored. MPD is particularly challenging because of low signal-to-noise ratios, fragmented pollution patterns, and indistinct boundaries caused by the visual similarity between pollutants and the surrounding sea. To address these issues, we propose MambaMPD, an enhanced Mamba-based framework incorporating two complementary structural priors: Frequency-Aware Augmentation (FAA) and multi-scale Edge-Guided Attention (EGA). FAA integrates wavelet transforms into the encoder to decompose features into multi-scale frequency subbands, enabling the model to capture low-frequency contextual semantics and high-frequency structural details needed to identify small, low-contrast, and irregular pollution patterns. EGA adaptively fuses hierarchical, Laplacian-derived boundary cues with deep semantic representations, refining encoder features before decoding to sharpen boundaries and reduce ambiguity in visually confusing, spatially fragmented scenes. Together, these modules improve sensitivity to subtle pollution signals while preserving fine boundary structures. A U-Net-style decoder with squeeze-and-excitation attention and deep supervision progressively restores and refines semantic and spatial information across scales. Extensive experiments on two benchmark MPD datasets show that MambaMPD achieves higher mIoU than competing methods while requiring substantially less computation than foundation-model-based approaches. On MADOS, it improves F1 by 3.6% over OSDMamba; on M4D, it raises Oil Spill IoU by 6.82% over TransOilSeg.

</details>


### [338] [V-ICAL Bench: Evaluating Video In-Context Learning for Multimodal Agents in Interactive Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15683)
*Ziqian Fan,Shibo Xu,Junjie Li,Xiangyu Zhao,Shengyuan Ding,Yifan Yang,Zhenjie Yang,Haodong Duan,Yue Zhou,Zhihang Zhong,Xue Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 V-ICAL 基准，用于评估多模态智能体在交互环境中基于视频演示的上下文学习能力，覆盖 37 个环境、342 个交互任务，结果显示现有最强模型得分仅 54.4/100，远低于人类 83.6 分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 上下文学习（ICL）虽已使模型无需参数更新即可从示例中适应，但多模态 ICL 仍研究不足，尤其是交互环境中的视频演示。多模态智能体从视频学习面临独特挑战：需将上下文演示转化为可执行策略、在新颖视觉状态下落地该策略，并依据环境反馈迭代修正动作。现有基准缺乏对这类能力的系统评测。

Method: 提出 V-ICAL 基准，包含 37 个环境中的 342 个交互任务，采用人工筛选的演示视频作为任务特定的行为示例；智能体从目标初始状态出发进行持续交互评估，将上下文知识归纳与状态落地、时序记忆、规划、动态环境适应等核心智能体能力相衔接。对 19 个先进多模态智能体开展广泛评测，并进行受控对比实验。

Result: 评测显示明显不足：最佳模型 Seed-2.1-Pro 仅得 54.4/100，Gemini-3.1-Pro、GPT-5.6 等领先模型均未超过 50 分，远低于人类基线 83.6 分。受控对比进一步表明，当前智能体难以可靠地将视频示例转化为有效策略，未能带来一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: V-ICAL 揭示了多模态智能体在 ICL 能力上的关键缺口，凸显了未来研究的迫切需求。

Abstract: While In-Context Learning (ICL) enables models to adapt from exemplars without parameter updates, multimodal ICL remains largely underexplored, particularly regarding video demonstrations in interactive environments. For multimodal agents, learning from videos presents unique challenges: they must translate in-context demonstrations into executable policies, ground these policies in novel visual states, and iteratively refine actions based on environmental feedback. We introduce V-ICAL, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate video-based ICL for multimodal agents. Comprising 342 interactive tasks across 37 environments, V-ICAL utilizes human-curated demonstration videos as task-specific behavioral exemplars, evaluating agents through sustained interaction from a target initialization. The benchmark seamlessly connects in-context knowledge induction with core agentic capabilities, including state grounding, temporal memory, planning, and adaptation in dynamic environments. Extensive evaluations across 19 state-of-the-art multimodal agents reveal significant limitations: the best-performing model, Seed-2.1-Pro, achieves a score of only 54.4/100, while other leading models (e.g., Gemini-3.1-Pro, GPT-5.6) fail to surpass 50, far below the human baseline of 83.6. Controlled comparisons further demonstrate that current agents struggle to reliably translate video exemplars into effective policies, failing to yield consistent performance gains. Ultimately, V-ICAL exposes a critical gap in the ICL capabilities of multimodal agents, underscoring an urgent need for future research.

</details>


### [339] [SURE-Map: Self-Correcting Streaming Geometric Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15795)
*Mingkai Liu,Hao Zhao,Xingxing Zuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SURE-Map：面向流式几何基础模型的自校正框架，通过跨视角几何不确定性与多时间尺度自校正，缓解动态物体、弱纹理导致的局部误差累积与长时尺度漂移，在 KITTI、Oxford Spires、VBR 上刷新在线前馈重建 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式几何基础模型因逐帧推断仅依赖有限上下文，对动态物体与弱纹理脆弱；局部小误差会累积为严重几何畸变与长时尺度漂移。作者主张可靠的流式重建不仅需要"预测能力"，更需要"自校正能力"。

Method: 提出 SURE-Map 自校正框架，含两大互补原则：(1) 显式建模跨视角几何不确定性——区别于仅反映单视角预测可靠性的深度/点置信度，该不确定性直接衡量联合预测的位姿与深度是否产生几何一致的跨视角像素对应关系；(2) 多时间尺度自校正——快速连续帧推断保持流式效率，稀疏关键帧窗口推断提供更长程几何证据，周期性重标定近期轨迹的尺度，以消除局部校正无法解决的缓慢累积尺度误差。

Result: 在长时基准上取得在线前馈重建新 SOTA：KITTI 的 ATE-RMSE 从 24.00 m 降至 17.24 m，Oxford Spires 从 5.11 m 降至 4.74 m，VBR 从 31.37 m 降至 28.58 m；引入回环闭合精化后进一步改善至 15.17 m、4.63 m 与 22.12 m。

Conclusion: 跨视角几何不确定性与多时间尺度自校正相结合，可有效抑制流式重建中的误差累积与尺度漂移；SURE-Map 亦可与回环闭合精化叠加获得进一步提升，为流式几何基础模型提供了可扩展的自校正范式。

Abstract: Streaming geometric foundation models are emerging as a compelling alternative to SLAM systems. Yet this streaming nature introduces a fundamental issue: each prediction is made from limited context, which is vulnerable to dynamic objects and weak textures. Small local errors accumulate into severe geometric distortion and long-horizon scale drift. We argue that reliable streaming reconstruction requires geometric foundation models to be not only predictive, but also self-correcting. We introduce SURE-Map, a self-correcting framework built upon two complementary principles. First, we explicitly model cross-view geometric uncertainty. Unlike conventional depth or point confidence, which primarily reflects the reliability of individual-view prediction, our uncertainty directly measures whether the jointly predicted pose and depth induce geometrically consistent cross-view pixel correspondences. Second, because local correction alone cannot eliminate slowly accumulating scale errors, we introduce multi-timescale self-correction: fast consecutive-frame inference preserves streaming efficiency, while sparse keyframe-window inference provides longer-range geometric evidence to periodically recalibrate the scale of recent trajectories. SURE-Map establishes new state-of-the-art performance for online feed-forward reconstruction across long-horizon benchmarks, reducing ATE-RMSE from 24.00 to 17.24 m on KITTI, 5.11 to 4.74 m on Oxford Spires, and 31.37 to 28.58 m on VBR, with further improvements to 15.17, 4.63, and 22.12 m when incorporating loop-closure refinement. Project page: https://mingkai-liu.github.io/projects/sure-map/.

</details>


### [340] [VC-Attention: Value Smoothing and Softmax Casting for Low-bit Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15810)
*Xingyang Li,Dongyun Zou,Shining Zhang,Jiacheng Chen,Haocheng Xi,Lvmin Zhang,Jun-Yan Zhu,Song Han,Zhekai Zhang,Yujun Lin,Muyang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VC-Attention：无需训练的低比特注意力框架，通过 Value 平滑（V-Smooth）与概率域量化（ExpCast-FP8）解决 value 离群点导致的精度损失和 softmax 指数成为流水线瓶颈的问题，在多款 GPU 与视频生成模型上实现更优保真度与 1.46-3.6x 的注意力加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散 Transformer 在视频生成中达到 SOTA，但其长时空序列使注意力成为主要部署开销，需要既准确又快速的低比特核。精度受离群点限制：块量化尺度由最大元素决定，使典型元素可表示范围被压缩。已有工作平滑了 query 和 key，但 value 离群点既无固定通道结构也无固定时空结构，仍是输出误差的主要来源。速度受 softmax 限制：低比特 Tensor Core 只加速两个矩阵乘法，中间的高精度指数运算因此成为数据中心 GPU 上最长的流水线阶段。

Method: 提出 VC-Attention，一种训练无关的低比特注意力框架，将 Value 平滑与融合的概率 Cast 相结合。(1) V-Smooth：通过轻量在线聚类重排 value token，使同一硬件块内的 token 能一起良好量化；仅量化减去块均值后的残差，并利用在线 softmax 已维护的行和恢复该均值。(2) ExpCast-FP8：将 log 域分数通过一次融合乘加直接映射为 E4M3 概率码，消除 FP32 指数与格式转换。并在 B200、B300、H200、RTX PRO 6000、RTX 5090 上实现。

Result: 在 Wan2.2、LongCat-Video、HunyuanVideo-1.5、MiniMax-H3 上，VC-Attention 相比低比特基线提升保真度；注意力核相比 BF16 FlashAttention-4 在数据中心 Blackwell 与 Hopper 上加速 1.46-1.59x，在工作站显卡上加速 2.3-3.6x；端到端生成一段视频分别快 1.13-1.19x 与 1.36-1.70x。

Conclusion: 通过针对 value 离群点的在线聚类重排与残差量化，以及消除高精度指数瓶颈的融合 FP8 概率映射，VC-Attention 在保持/提升生成保真度的同时显著加速了低比特注意力核与端到端视频生成，并在多代数据中心与工作站 GPU 上完成实现与验证。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers deliver state-of-the-art video generation, but their long spatiotemporal sequences make attention the dominant deployment cost, and a deployable low-bit kernel must be accurate and fast. Accuracy is limited by outliers: a block's quantization scale is set by its largest entries, leaving typical entries confined to a narrow range of representable values. Prior work smooths queries and keys, but value outliers follow no fixed channel or spatiotemporal structure and remain the dominant source of output error. Speed is limited by softmax: low-bit Tensor Cores accelerate only the two matrix multiplications, so the high-precision exponential between them becomes the longest pipeline stage on datacenter GPUs. We propose VC-Attention, a training-free low-bit attention framework that addresses both by pairing Value smoothing with a fused probability Cast. V-Smooth reorders value tokens by lightweight online clustering, so the tokens in a hardware block quantize well together. It quantizes only the residual after subtracting the block mean, and restores that mean from the row sum the online softmax already maintains. ExpCast-FP8 maps log-domain scores directly to E4M3 probability codes with one fused multiply-add, eliminating the FP32 exponential and the format conversion. We implement VC-Attention for B200, B300, H200, RTX PRO 6000, and RTX 5090. Across Wan2.2, LongCat-Video, HunyuanVideo-1.5, and MiniMax-H3, VC-Attention improves fidelity over low-bit baselines, speeds up the attention kernel over BF16 FlashAttention-4 by 1.46-1.59x on datacenter Blackwell and Hopper and by 2.3-3.6x on workstation cards, and generates a clip 1.13-1.19x and 1.36-1.70x faster end to end.

</details>


### [341] [Integrating Multi-view Multi-light Surface Reconstruction into Cultural Heritage Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15833)
*Baptiste Brument,Robin Bruneau,Benjamin Coupry,Vincent Demoulin,Jean Mélou,Antoine Laurent,Fabien Castan,Jean-Denis Durou,Lilian Calvet*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究将光度立体、自动掩膜与多视图法向-反射率整合等计算机视觉方法集成进开源摄影测量框架Meshroom，构建面向文化遗产的多视图多光照表面重建工作流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文化遗产三维记录依赖图像表面重建，摄影测量软件虽已普及，但仅擅长常规多视图采集，未充分利用多视图-多光照数据；而遗产领域中RTI穹顶等控光设备已普遍用于采集光照变化图像，因此需将既有采集实践与前沿视觉方法衔接，形成可落地的操作流程。

Method: 不提出新的重建算法，而是组装并暴露现有先进方法：完整光度立体生态（标定、自标定与通用型）、自动物体掩膜，以及多视图法向与反射率整合，并将其集成到开源摄影测量框架Meshroom中，形成面向遗产领域的可用工作流。

Result: 系统在计算机视觉研究代码与文化遗产实际应用之间构建了中间软件层，使近期技术更易使用与评估，并能在既有遗产作业流程中衔接多视图-多光照采集数据。

Conclusion: 将先进多视图多光照重建方法整合进成熟摄影测量工具，可弥合研究与实践之间的鸿沟，提升遗产细尺度表面重建的可及性与可评估性。

Abstract: Cultural heritage documentation increasingly relies on image-based 3D surface reconstruction, with photogrammetry software making such workflows accessible to archaeologists, conservators, and heritage technicians. These tools have been successful for conventional multi-view acquisition, but they do not routinely exploit richer multi-view, multi-light data, despite its potential for improving fine-scale surface reconstruction. This limitation is particularly relevant in heritage contexts, where controlled-light acquisition devices such as RTI domes are already used to capture illumination-varying image sets. The challenge is therefore to connect these existing acquisition practices with recent computer vision methods in a form that can be used within operational heritage workflows. In this work, we address this need by integrating state-of-the-art components from computer vision for multi-view, multi-light surface reconstruction into Meshroom, an open-source photogrammetry framework. Rather than proposing a new reconstruction algorithm, our contribution is to assemble and expose existing advanced methods, namely a complete photometric stereo ecosystem (calibrated, self-calibrated and universal), automatic object masking, and multi-view normal-and-reflectance integration, within a usable heritage-oriented workflow. The proposed system thus provides an intermediate software layer between computer vision research code and practical cultural heritage applications, making recent techniques easier to use and evaluate.

</details>


### [342] [TRACE: Two-Stage Detector-Response Estimation With Angular Cosine Expansion for Ring Artifact Correction in Photon-Counting CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15834)
*Jigang Duan,Heran Wang,Ligen Shi,Zheng Sun,Ping Yang,Xing Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TRACE：一种两阶段无监督正弦图分解方法，用固定偏置加低阶DCT分量建模条纹，在实测PCD-CT数据上抑制环形伪影并保持细节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光子计数探测器CT中探测器响应非均匀性会引入系统性投影误差与环形伪影；实测数据中残余条纹幅度随投影角度缓慢变化，固定偏置模型无法充分刻画。

Method: 将条纹表示为固定偏置与低阶离散余弦变换（DCT）分量之和，用少量系数描述各探测器单元的角向变化；采用可学习的分析—合成架构表示理想投影，通过两阶段优化依次分离理想投影与固定条纹、动态条纹；引入角梯度软正交约束，在共享DCT梯度子空间内抑制相关变化，降低物体结构泄漏进伪影估计。全部参数直接在实测正弦图上优化，无需配对训练数据。

Result: 在实测QRM小鼠体模与猪蹄数据上，TRACE抑制了环形伪影、提升图像均匀性，同时保留边缘锐度、软组织纹理与骨小梁细节。

Conclusion: TRACE通过两阶段无监督分解与软正交约束，有效估计并校正响应相关的固定与动态条纹误差，在保持结构细节的同时改善PCD-CT图像质量，且不依赖配对训练数据。

Abstract: Detector response nonuniformity introduces systematic projection errors and ring artifacts in photon-counting detector computed tomography (PCD-CT). In measured PCD-CT data, residual stripe amplitudes vary slowly with projection angle, which fixed-bias models cannot adequately capture. We propose TRACE, a two-stage unsupervised sinogram decomposition method for estimating and correcting these response-related errors. TRACE represents stripes as a fixed bias plus low-order discrete cosine transform (DCT) components, using a small number of coefficients to describe angular variations at each detector element. A learnable analysis--synthesis architecture represents the ideal projections, while two-stage optimization separates them from fixed and then dynamic stripes. An angular-gradient soft orthogonality constraint suppresses correlated variations within the shared DCT gradient subspace, reducing the leakage of object structures into the artifact estimate. All parameters are optimized directly on the measured sinogram without paired training data. Experiments on measured QRM mouse phantom and porcine trotter data show that TRACE suppresses ring artifacts and improves image uniformity while preserving edge sharpness, soft-tissue texture, and trabecular detail.

</details>


### [343] [LynnReal-Omni: Native multi-modal Video Generation for Agentic Visual Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15863)
*Xiaofeng Mao,Peijia Lin,Shaohao Rui,Yibo Zhang,Haibin Wan,Weijie Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LynnReal-Omni统一多模态视频生成框架，结合智能体视觉创作实现可控、高质量、实时的视频生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散模型具有随机性且难以控制：精确内容需重复采样且不保证成功，长时序场景在外观、交互和时间一致性上易漂移。智能体视觉创作虽提供显式参考、可编辑3D场景或可执行游戏状态实现稳定控制，但本身无法保证高保真的物体与角色。二者结合可实现稳定、高质量生成。

Method: 基于32B共享多模态扩散Transformer构建LynnReal-Omni，统一文本生成视频、图像条件生成、参考引导生成、结构控制、编辑、退化视频修复和长视频生成；接受外观参考、可编辑3D渲染、游戏录制等异质视觉输入。另训练27B的Flash共享多模态扩散Transformer用于实时渲染。构建视频清洗、主体关联、多模态标注与对齐控制的数据流水线，形成多镜头音视频语料，并提出MSAVP（100提示、20指标）评测设计。Flash版本通过模型与解码加速（含轻量VAE解码器）降低推理成本。

Result: 单张H100上，22帧540p视频的预热生成与解码：LynnReal-Omni耗时843ms，Flash版本耗时377ms。

Conclusion: 该框架为实时流式视频生成奠定基础，使LynnReal-Omni成为智能体视觉创作统一、可控且高效的基础。

Abstract: Video diffusion models are stochastic and hard to control: precise content often requires repeated sampling without guaranteed success, and long-horizon scenes drift in appearance, interactions, and temporal coherence. Agentic visual creation provides explicit references, editable 3D scenes, or executable game states for stable control, but does not by itself guarantee high object or character fidelity. Combining the two can enable stable, high-quality generation. To realize this combination, we present LynnReal-Omni, a native multimodal video generation framework built on a 32B shared multimodal diffusion transformer that unifies text-to-video, image-conditioned generation, reference-guided generation, structural control, editing, degraded video restoration, and long-video generation. It accepts heterogeneous visual inputs, including appearance references, editable 3D renders, and game recordings, allowing agents to compose visual conditions within a unified model. We also train a dedicated 27B Flash shared multimodal diffusion transformer for real-time rendering. We build a systematic data pipeline for video cleaning, subject association, multimodal annotation, and aligned control construction, yielding a curated corpus of multi-shot audiovisual segments, and introduce MSAVP, a 100-prompt, 20-metric evaluation design that separates instruction following, generating plausibility, visual quality, temporal behavior, and audio coordination. LynnReal-Omni-Flash further reduces inference cost through model and decoding acceleration, including a lightweight VAE decoder; on one H100, warm generation and decoding of a 22-frame 540p video take 843 ms with LynnReal-Omni and 377 ms with Flash. These results provide a foundation for real-time streaming video generation, making LynnReal-Omni a unified, controllable, and efficient basis for agentic visual creation.

</details>


### [344] [Anatomical Grounding and Leakage-Aware Multimodal Contrastive Learning for Alzheimer's Disease Classification from Structural MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15888)
*Paul-Gabriel Nicolae,Irina Georgiana Mocanu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文用轻量切片级编码器在ADNI-1上考察AD分期中的两个问题：图像模型关注解剖无关区域，以及多模态模型依赖标签泄漏变量。FastSurfer分割作解剖参照，YOLOv8定位AD相关结构mAP_50>0.96，Grad-CAM显示纯图像分类器常关注颅骨、眼眶与背景；CLIP式图像-表格对比融合中，认知评分融合达87.3%三向准确率（视为泄漏驱动的上界），区域体积融合为73.0%；对比目标影响编码器所学表征；限制于内侧颞叶裁剪可将纯图像三向准确率由58.7%提升至65.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构MRI深度网络在AD分期中虽准确率尚可，却常关注解剖无关区域；加入临床表格的多模态模型又常依赖用于定义诊断标签的变量，造成标签泄漏与性能虚高，因此需系统研究这两类问题。

Method: 采用轻量切片级编码器（ResNet18＋单层Transformer跨切片）处理ADNI-1共1,075例基线T1加权扫描。以FastSurfer分割为解剖参照，用分割衍生标签训练YOLOv8定位AD相关结构，并用Grad-CAM比较图像分类器的关注区域；采用CLIP式图像-表格对比框架，按标签泄漏谱组织ADNIMERGE变量，分别与认知评分和区域体积融合，并比较不同对比目标对图像编码器表征的影响；另将输入限制为每受试者内侧颞叶裁剪。

Result: YOLOv8在分割衍生标签上定位AD相关结构mAP_50>0.96；Grad-CAM显示纯图像分类器常关注颅骨、眼眶和背景。与认知评分融合获87.3%三向准确率，被视为泄漏驱动上界而非影像结果；与区域体积融合为73.0%。在MCI vs. CN上，编码器对齐认知评分时纯图像头为52.4%，对齐体积时达73.8%（推理不使用表格输入）。限制为内侧颞叶裁剪使纯图像三向准确率从58.7%升至65.1%。所有结果为小规模平衡测试集上的单次运行，报告了置信区间及妨碍与已发表数字直接比较的协议差异。

Conclusion: 轻量切片级模型可定位AD相关解剖结构，但纯图像分类仍存在关注解剖无关区域的问题；多模态融合的高准确率部分源于标签泄漏，认知评分融合应视为上界；对比目标决定图像编码器学到的表征质量；聚焦内侧颞叶可提升纯图像性能。结果受单次运行与小测试集限制，需谨慎解读并注意协议可比性。

Abstract: Deep networks trained on structural MRI for Alzheimer's disease (AD) staging often reach reasonable accuracy while attending to anatomically irrelevant regions, and multimodal models that add clinical tables frequently rely on variables that were used to assign the diagnostic label in the first place. We study both issues with a deliberately lightweight slice-based encoder (ResNet18 with a one-layer Transformer over slices) on 1,075 baseline T1-weighted scans from ADNI-1. First, we use FastSurfer segmentations as an anatomical reference: YOLOv8 models trained on segmentation-derived labels localize Alzheimer-relevant structures with mAP_50 above 0.96, and a Grad-CAM comparison shows that the image-only classifier frequently attends to the skull, orbits and background. Second, we adapt a CLIP-style image - tabular contrastive framework and organize ADNIMERGE variables along a label-leakage spectrum. Fusion with cognitive scores yields 87.3% three-way accuracy, which we treat as a leakage-driven upper bound rather than an imaging result; fusion with regional volumes yields 73.0%. We observe that the choice of contrastive target changes what the image encoder learns: on MCI vs. CN, the image-only head reaches 52.4% when the encoder is aligned to cognitive scores and 73.8\% when aligned to volumes, although no tabular input is used at inference. Third, restricting the input to a per-subject crop of the medial temporal lobe raises image-only three-way accuracy from 58.7% to 65.1%. All results come from single runs on a small balanced test set, and we report confidence intervals and the protocol differences that prevent direct comparison with published numbers.

</details>

### [345] [SkillAtlas: An Attack Trace Library for Agent Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13353)
*Yuxin Tian,Zenghao Duan,Liang Pang,Zhiyi Yin,Xueqi Cheng*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出SkillAtlas——一个托管式攻击轨迹库，将私有的agent技能安全报告转化为经审核、脱敏、可检索的公开案例，包含3,014个案例、6,589条轨迹、151,131个步骤，覆盖8类风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent技能的风险并非源于稳定签名或单次沙箱运行，而是通过模型决策、用户上下文、工具调用与执行反馈动态涌现；现有静态、动态及基准式评估难以保留可供检查、检索和复用的公开证据。

Method: 构建托管式攻击轨迹库SkillAtlas，将私有agent技能安全报告包转换为经审核、脱敏、可搜索的公开案例，并采用基于轨迹的标签（trajectory-grounded labels）进行标注。

Result: 库内含3,014个案例、6,589条轨迹、151,131个步骤、233个受影响技能、8个风险类别；42.5%的成功案例在首次非成功轮次后才取得成功；轨迹标签将执行前防护准确率提升至0.770。

Conclusion: 公开可检索的攻击轨迹库能有效保留agent技能安全证据，轨迹级标注可显著提升执行前防护性能，为agent技能风险研究提供可复用基础设施。

Abstract: Agent skills are reusable units for language-model agents, but their risks emerge through model decisions, user context, tool calls, and execution feedback rather than through stable signatures or a single sandbox run. Existing static, dynamic, and benchmark-style evaluations rarely preserve public evidence that can be inspected, searched, and reused. We present SkillAtlas, a hosted attack trace library that converts private agent-skill security report bundles into reviewed, redacted, and searchable public cases. The library contains 3,014 cases, 6,589 traces, 151,131 steps, 233 affected skills, and 8 risk categories; 42.5% of successful cases first become successful after a non-success initial round, and trajectory-grounded labels improve pre-execution guard accuracy to 0.770.

</details>


### [346] [Principled Detection of Coordinated Manipulation from Aggregate Distortion and Account Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13407)
*Qian Guo,Yidan Hu,Rui Zhang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"聚合优先"的证据层，将上下文级结果分布（直方图、计数、分辨率、参考分布）的扭曲作为主要证据对象，先固定区间证据再引入身份信息，通过减去匹配零假设期望获得带符号证据，并在历史亚马逊评论流上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协同操纵是集体性行为，多个账户可共同扭曲评分、排名和参与度。现有防御主要从身份、图、内容或共活动构建证据，缺乏以结果分布层面为出发点、先于身份信息构建证据的方法。作者希望建立一种以聚合层面分布扭曲为核心的证据层，避免早期依赖身份带来的偏置。

Method: 提出聚合优先证据层：仅观测直方图、计数、分辨率和参考分布，身份在区间证据固定后才被揭示。由于原始差异具有正的有限样本期望，减去匹配零假设期望以获得带符号证据，并处理参考分布不确定性。参与日志随后跨账户累加这些固定增量。理论方面：刻画匹配暴露散度、界定自影响上界、建立有限时域分离，并推导配对上下文下的精确线性复用定律。评估采用受控轮换实验和配对反事实干预（历史亚马逊评论流提供行为背景，合成身份提供已知联盟成员，精确干净孪生样本作反事实对照）。

Result: 在固定攻击扫描中，将同一操纵事件跨身份重新分配并增加复用，使账户分数ROC-AUC从0.500升至0.797。在使用活动与暴露匹配的干净孪生样本时，频率处于随机水平，而反事实归因达到ROC-AUC 0.744。在均值保持的形状干预下，Wasserstein-1和Jensen-Shannon证据分别达到ROC-AUC 0.909和0.967，而频率与基于均值的归因仍为随机水平。聚合证据可补充重复共活动，简单未训练组合将混合机制ROC-AUC从0.750提升至0.874。

Conclusion: 聚合优先的证据层能够有效检测协同操纵，在多种干预与匹配条件下显著优于频率和均值等基线方法，并能与重复共活动机制互补，提升混合机制检测性能。

Abstract: Coordinated manipulation is collective: plausible accounts can jointly distort ratings, rankings, and engagement. Existing defenses primarily construct evidence from identities, graphs, content, or co-activity. We introduce an aggregate-first evidence layer that treats distortion of a context-level outcome distribution as the primary evidence object. The engine observes only a histogram, count, resolution, and reference distribution; identities are withheld until interval evidence is fixed. Because raw discrepancies have positive finite-sample expectation, we subtract a matched null expectation to obtain signed evidence and account for reference uncertainty. Participation logs then accumulate these fixed increments across accounts. We characterize matched-exposure divergence, bound self-influence, establish finite-horizon separation, and derive an exact linear reuse law for paired contexts.
  We evaluate the mechanism with controlled rotation experiments and paired counterfactual interventions on historical Amazon review streams. Historical reviews provide the behavioral background; synthetic identities provide known coalition membership, and exact clean twins provide counterfactual controls. In a fixed-attack sweep against historical non-donor comparison accounts, reassigning the same manipulated events across identities with increasing reuse raises account-score ROC-AUC from 0.500 to 0.797. With activity- and exposure-matched clean twins, frequency is at chance while counterfactual attribution achieves ROC-AUC 0.744. Under a mean-preserving shape intervention, Wasserstein-1 and Jensen-Shannon evidence achieve ROC-AUC 0.909 and 0.967, while frequency and mean-based attribution remain at chance. Aggregate evidence complements repeated co-activity, improving mixed-mechanism ROC-AUC from 0.750 to 0.874 with a simple untrained combination.

</details>


### [347] [BadEngram: Backdoor Attack on Gated Memory Components in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13478)
*Ariel Fogel,Omer Hofman,Eilon Cohen,Roman Vainshtein*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文提出 BadEngram，一种针对门控参数化记忆（gated parametric memory）的后训练后门攻击，可在不改动骨干权重与计算图的前提下植入持久触发器行为；受控实验达 96.6% ASR，且在 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 的 Per-Layer Embedding 子系统上验证了生产级可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期语言模型为在不按比例增加计算量的前提下扩展开放权重模型容量，引入门控参数化记忆模块，检索已学习值并注入中间表示。这类模块带来效率收益，但形成了独特的攻击面：其参数可在独立于骨干网络的情况下被修改，却直接塑造骨干计算。作者由此提出核心问题——这类参数是否构成一个安全性关键、但无法从"骨干权重未变"中推断出其完整性的组件。

Method: 提出 BadEngram 后训练攻击：仅修改门控记忆参数（检索到的记忆值），保持骨干权重与执行图不变，植入与触发器相关的后门行为。实验分两阶段：先在受控 Engram 模型上建立攻击可行性并因果刻画机制，通过将检索记忆值替换为干净版本或关闭记忆门进行消融；再将该漏洞测试扩展到 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 的原生 Per-Layer Embedding 子系统，两个基准使用独立训练的检查点。

Result: 受控 Engram 模型上：触发输入 ASR 达 96.6%，匹配的无触发输入误激活仅 0.1%，干净准确率保持 99.6%；将检索记忆值替换为干净值或关闭记忆门后，ASR 降至至多 0.32%，证实后门经门控记忆通路表达。生产规模上（Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 原生 Per-Layer Embedding）：HarmBench 上 ASR 50.4%，AdvBench 上 60.0%，而休眠条件 ASR 分别为 0.9% 与 0.0%。

Conclusion: 原生门控记忆参数是模型安全性关键组成部分，其完整性无法从骨干网络保持不变来推断。BadEngram 表明门控参数化记忆构成独立且现实的后门攻击面，在受控与生产规模下均可持续植入触发器行为，提示模型安全审计与完整性验证须显式覆盖记忆参数，而非仅检查骨干权重。

Abstract: To expand open-weight models' capacity without proportionally increasing computation, recent language models incorporate gated parametric memories that retrieve learned values and inject them into intermediate representations. Despite these efficiency benefits, such modules create a distinct attack surface: their parameters can be modified independently of the backbone while directly shaping its computation. We introduce BadEngram, a post-training attack that exploits this surface to implant persistent, trigger-dependent behavior while leaving conventional backbone weights and the execution graph unchanged. We first establish the attack's feasibility and causally characterize its mechanism in a controlled Engram model, where BadEngram achieves 96.6% ASR on triggered inputs while limiting false activation on matched trigger-free inputs to 0.1% and preserving 99.6% clean accuracy. Replacing the retrieved memory values with their clean counterparts or closing the memory gates reduces ASR to at most 0.32%, confirming that the backdoor is expressed through the gated-memory pathway. We then test whether this vulnerability extends to production scale in Qwen3.8-Flash-Next's native Per-Layer Embedding subsystem. Using independently trained checkpoints for the two benchmarks, BadEngram achieves 50.4% ASR on HarmBench and 60.0% on AdvBench, while dormant-condition ASR remains 0.9% and 0.0%, respectively. These results identify native gated-memory parameters as a security-critical part of the model whose integrity cannot be inferred from an unchanged backbone.

</details>


### [348] [Canaries in the Bank: Auditing User-Level Privacy in Private Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13499)
*Sai Aparna Aketi,Enayat Ullah,Shripad Gade*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种协议感知的实证审计方法，通过服务器端共享候选库中植入约1%的探针，评估Private Evolution（PE）在联邦场景下合成数据的实际隐私泄露，发现自然文本攻击远低于理论DP界，而高熵nonce攻击最接近隐私上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PE通过聚合裁剪后的用户投票构建差分隐私直方图，其噪声校准基于最坏情况用户贡献，但尚不清楚对手能否在遵守PE协议的前提下实现这一最坏情况隐私损失，因此需要量化形式化最坏情况隐私与实际可达泄露之间的差距。

Method: 提出协议感知的实证审计：服务器承诺使用单一共享候选库，并用源自已知非私有canary的探针替换约1%的候选条目；评估八种攻击，包括候选库不变基线、精确副本、合理改写和高熵合成nonce，并在Yelp和Sentiment140数据集上实验。

Result: 在Yelp和Sentiment140上，自然文本攻击得到的隐私泄露远低于理论DP界；基于nonce的攻击给出明显更强的界，且最接近该机制的隐私上限。

Conclusion: 结果量化了形式化最坏情况隐私与通过协议有效候选库操纵可实现的泄露之间的差距，表明PE的理论DP界在当前攻击下较为保守。

Abstract: Private Evolution (PE) generates high-fidelity synthetic data in federated settings without exposing users' raw data. It aggregates clipped user votes over a shared candidate bank into a differentially private histogram, with noise calibrated to the worst-case user contribution. However, it is unclear whether an adversary can realize this worst-case privacy loss while following the PE protocol. We introduce a protocol-aware empirical audit in which the server commits to a single shared candidate bank and replaces roughly 1% of its entries with probes derived from a known, non-private canary. We evaluate eight attacks, including an unchanged-bank baseline, exact copies, plausible paraphrases, and high-entropy synthetic nonces. Experiments on Yelp and Sentiment140 show that natural-text attacks remain substantially below the theoretical DP bound, while nonce-based attacks yield considerably stronger bounds and come closest to the mechanism's privacy ceiling. These results quantify the gap between formal worst-case privacy and leakage achievable through protocol-valid candidate-bank manipulation.

</details>


### [349] [Mind the Gap: Detecting Description-Execution Mismatch Attacks in DAO Governance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13601)
*Bowen Cai,Nanzi Yang,Weiheng Bai,Youshui Lu,Yajin Zhou,Kangjie Lu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出首个面向真实 DAO 治理的描述-执行不匹配（DEMI）攻击系统性检测框架：通过 DAO 无关的仿真框架重建治理画像并推演提案执行行为，结合证据映射范式让 LLM 定位逐操作文本依据，实现了高覆盖、高精度、可跨模型泛化的检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DAO 采用"提案-投票-执行"流程，成员依据自然语言描述投票，但描述意图与实际代码执行可能不一致。恶意提案者可提交看似无害的描述以通过投票，而实际代码转移资金或夺取协议控制权，即描述-执行不匹配（DEMI）攻击。该过程天然存在此漏洞，亟需在真实治理场景中系统识别。

Method: 两方面挑战与对应方法：（1）DAO 部署多样、难以统一可扩展分析——提出 DAO 无关仿真框架，基于历史链上交易构建每个 DAO 的治理画像，并驱动新提案走完整个治理生命周期以获取其执行行为；（2）自由文本描述与结构化执行轨迹难以直接比对——提出证据映射范式，要求 LLM 定位每条操作的显式文本佐证，而非给出整体判断，从而大幅提升精度与召回。

Result: 在真实以太坊 DAO 治理大规模数据集上：仿真覆盖 92.7% 活跃 DAO 与 89.3% 已执行提案，远超现有平台；检测器在分层交叉验证下达 81.7% 平均精度与 98.3% 平均召回；证据映射可跨 LLM 厂商泛化而非依赖单一模型；在系统化红队/蓝队评估中，Robustness Guard 即使面对了解检测器的自适应攻击者也能防御大多数攻击，且该鲁棒性可泛化至留出提案。

Conclusion: 该工作首次实现对真实 DAO 治理中 DEMI 攻击的系统检测，仿真覆盖面与检测性能均显著优于现有方案；证据映射范式提升了可比性与跨模型通用性，Robustness Guard 提供了对自适应对抗的稳健防护，为 DAO 治理安全提供了可扩展、可泛化的分析基础。

Abstract: Decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) change protocols through a proposal-based process: initiators submit a proposal, members vote on it based on its natural-language description, and if it passes, the project executes the code behind it. This process is inherently vulnerable to deceptive proposals, where the described intent and the actual code execution mismatch. A malicious proposer can submit a benign-looking description to pass voting while the executed code transfers funds or seizes control of the protocol, which we call a Description-Execution Mismatch (DEMI) attack.
  We present the first systematic framework for DEMI detection in real DAO governance. First, the diversity of DAO deployments makes a unified, scalable analysis difficult; we address this with a DAO-agnostic simulation framework that builds a per-DAO governance profile from historical on-chain transactions and then drives each new proposal through the full governance lifecycle to obtain its execution behavior. Second, free-form descriptions and structured execution traces are hard to compare; we address this with an evidence-mapping paradigm that requires an LLM to locate explicit per-action textual justifications rather than issue a holistic judgment, substantially improving precision and recall over direct querying.
  On a large-scale dataset of real-world Ethereum DAO governance, our simulation derives execution results for 92.7% of active DAOs and 89.3% of executed proposals, far exceeding existing platforms. Our detector reaches 81.7% mean precision and 98.3% mean recall under stratified cross-validation, and evidence mapping generalizes across LLM vendors rather than depending on one model. Under a systematic red-team/blue-team evaluation, the Robustness Guard defends most adaptive attacks even against an adversary that knows the detector, and this robustness generalizes to held-out proposals.

</details>


### [350] [EI-DDLGN: Efficient Encrypted Inference with Deep Differentiable Logic Gate Networks under TFHE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13636)
*Mahmoud Y. M. Yassin,Mahmoud AbdelHafeez Sayed,Mostafa Taha*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 EI-DDLGN，首次系统研究基于 TFHE 的深度可微逻辑门网络加密推理，并引入 MFW-PBS Bypass 语义保持执行策略，在 MNIST、FashionMNIST 与 UCI Phishing 上显著改善精度-延迟权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TFHE 为外包深度学习的隐私推理提供强保护，但现有 TFHE 兼容网络多为算术神经架构，受可编程引导（PBS）、累加器增长与电路位宽敏感影响，推理延迟高。作者因此探索布尔原生的 DDLGN 作为替代。

Method: 研究 DDLGNs 在 TFHE 下的加密推理（EI-DDLGN），刻画加密执行成本与模型规模、学习的布尔函数分布及传播线状态的关系；提出 Model-Fixed-Wire PBS Bypass（MFW-PBS Bypass），在不改变已学习网络拓扑的前提下消除不必要的 PBS 操作。在 72 种深度-宽度配置及三个数据集上进行评估。

Result: DDLGN 是算术 TFHE 推理的高效替代方案，取得明显更优的精度-延迟权衡。在 MNIST 上，EI-DDLGN-Small 达到与 QAT-FCNN-4 相当的精度，同时将加密推理延迟降低 13.4 倍。

Conclusion: 布尔原生的 DDLGN 推理与 TFHE 的布尔执行模型天然契合，可避免隐藏层算术累加；MFW-PBS Bypass 进一步降低开销。代码已开源。

Abstract: Privacy-preserving inference via Torus Fully Homomorphic Encryption (TFHE) provides strong protection for sensitive data in outsourced deep learning applications. However, most TFHE-compatible neural network frameworks remain based on arithmetic neural architectures, resulting in high inference latency due to programmable bootstrapping (PBS), accumulator growth, and circuit bit-width sensitivity. In this work, we investigate Deep Differentiable Logic Gate Networks (DDLGNs) as a Boolean-native alternative for encrypted inference under TFHE. Because DDLGNs learn Boolean computations directly and discretize into fixed logic gate networks, their inference procedure is naturally aligned with TFHE's Boolean execution model and avoids arithmetic accumulation in hidden layers. We present EI-DDLGN, the first in-depth study of TFHE-based DDLGN inference, and characterize how encrypted execution cost depends on model size, learned Boolean-function distribution, and propagated wire status. We also introduce Model-Fixed-Wire PBS Bypass (MFW-PBS Bypass), a semantics-preserving execution strategy that eliminates unnecessary PBS operations without modifying the learned network topology. Evaluations across 72 depth-width configurations on MNIST, FashionMNIST, and UCI Phishing show that DDLGNs constitute an efficient alternative to arithmetic TFHE inference, achieving substantially improved accuracy-latency trade-offs. Notably, on MNIST, EI-DDLGN-Small matches the accuracy of QAT-FCNN-4 while reducing encrypted inference latency by 13.4x. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Carleton-SCI/EI-DDLGN

</details>


### [351] [Basis Rigidity of the AES S-box and Generic Rigidity of Inversion under Affine Transformations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13644)
*Zheng Zhang,Na Zhang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 研究AES S盒中有限域求逆经外层仿射变换后其基对称性（Frobenius对称）如何被破坏，给出刚性判据、稳定子与中心化子代数刻画及概率界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AES S盒由有限域求逆加固定仿射变换构成，求逆本身在不同基实现下具有内在Frobenius对称性，需弄清外层仿射/线性变换如何改变这些基对称性，以评估变换后的刚性与结构稳定性。

Method: 先建立变换后求逆的确定性刚性判据并应用于AES S盒；再研究外层可逆线性变换变化时的一般问题，将非平凡线性稳定子的存在性归约为由求逆的双侧线性等价产生的半线性候选的共轭问题，并用相对范数与Frobenius轨道刻画，同时精确计算相关中心化子代数的维数。

Result: AES S盒仿射变换的线性部分单独就使变换后求逆映射基刚性；给出半线性候选共轭的精确条件与中心化子代数维数；对均匀随机外层线性变换，非平凡线性稳定子存在的概率上界为2^{-Ω(n^2)}，并给出基于精确共轭条件的更精细有限维界；小维数值实验验证了AES刚性、共轭与中心化子公式及有限维估计。

Conclusion: AES S盒在外层线性部分作用下即呈基刚性，一般外层线性变换下非平凡线性稳定子极罕见；半线性共轭与中心化子代数结构给出精确刻画，为S盒及求逆型密码结构的对称性与随机化分析提供框架。

Abstract: The AES S-box is constructed from finite field inversion followed by a fixed affine transformation. Since inversion possesses intrinsic Frobenius symmetries among its coordinate realizations, we study how these basis symmetries are altered by outer affine transformations.
  We first develop a deterministic rigidity criterion for transformed inversion and apply it to the AES S-box. This shows that the linear part of the AES S-box affine transformation alone makes the transformed inversion map basis rigid. We then investigate the corresponding generic problem when the outer invertible linear transformation varies. The existence of a nontrivial linear stabilizer is reduced to a conjugacy problem for semilinear candidates arising from two sided linear equivalences of inversion, which we characterize in terms of relative norms and Frobenius orbits. We also determine the dimensions of the associated centralizer algebras exactly. These structural results imply that, for a uniformly chosen outer linear transformation, the probability that the linear stabilizer is nontrivial is bounded by $2^{-Ω(n^2)}$, with sharper finite dimensional bounds obtained from the exact conjugacy condition. Computational experiments independently verify the AES rigidity result, the conjugacy and centralizer formulas, and the finite dimensional estimates in small dimensions.

</details>


### [352] [PatchRisk: Forecasting Future Vulnerability Exposure in Open-Source Dependency Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13719)
*Ashfaq Ali Shafin,Khandaker Mamun Ahmed*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文研究开源软件生态中"未来传递性漏洞暴露"预测问题，构建了防泄漏基准PatchRisk，并提出HistoryGraph方法显著提升预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源软件生态是网页级依赖网络，下游包的风险可能源于其传递依赖日后被披露漏洞。现有漏洞检测工作多关注代码当前是否脆弱或已知脆弱依赖是否已存在，忽略了"未来传递性漏洞暴露"这一前瞻性问题。该问题对Web智能与软件供应链安全至关重要，可支持在未来暴露可见前进行主动依赖分诊。

Method: 论文构建PatchRisk基准，基于开源漏洞咨询数据与deps.dev的npm、PyPI依赖图。采用过滤感知标签、包级不相交评估、时间测试及嵌套的1K/3K/5K/10K采样尺度，最大清洗设置含9,007个根包-版本图，覆盖4,157个根包。评估三类特征族：TimeOnly、GraphStruct、HistoryGraph。

Result: 在10K时间测试基准上，HistoryGraph相较最强TimeOnly基线，90天预测AUPRC从0.351提升至0.640，365天预测从0.473提升至0.813。该提升在更小尺度及包组洗牌鲁棒性测试中保持稳定。

Conclusion: 研究表明未来传递性漏洞暴露可被有效预测，HistoryGraph特征族显著优于仅时间特征，且构建的防泄漏基准PatchRisk为供应链安全的前瞻性依赖分诊提供了可靠评估框架。

Abstract: Open-source software ecosystems are web-scale dependency networks. A downstream package can become exposed to security risk not because its own source code changes, but because one of its transitive dependencies later receives a vulnerability advisory. Existing vulnerability-detection work often focuses on whether code is currently vulnerable or whether a known vulnerable dependency is already present. We study a different problem: future transitive vulnerability exposure. Given a package-version dependency graph observed at release time, the task is to predict whether any non-root dependency will receive a vulnerability advisory within a future horizon. This problem is important for Web intelligence and software supply-chain security because it supports proactive dependency triage before future exposure is visible. It is also easy to evaluate incorrectly: current vulnerable dependencies can leak the label, and different versions of the same root package can create package-level memorization across train and test splits. We therefore construct PatchRisk, a leakage-aware benchmark from Open Source Vulnerability advisories and deps.dev dependency graphs for npm and PyPI. The benchmark uses filtration-aware labels, package-disjoint evaluation, temporal testing, and nested 1K, 3K, 5K, and 10K sampling scales. The largest cleaned setting contains 9,007 root package-version graphs spanning 4,157 root packages. We evaluate three feature families: TimeOnly, GraphStruct, and HistoryGraph. On the 10K temporal-test benchmark, HistoryGraph improves AUPRC over the strongest TimeOnly baseline from 0.351 to 0.640 for 90-day forecasting and from 0.473 to 0.813 for 365-day forecasting. The improvement remains stable across smaller scales and package-group shuffle robustness tests.

</details>


### [353] [PQLN: Post-Quantum Security for the Bitcoin Lightning Network's Off-Chain Surfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13781)
*Ahmet Kurt,Abdul-Salem Beibitkhan,Yacoub Hanna,Abdullah Aydeger*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出PQLN，这是比特币闪电网络（Lightning Network）的首个后量子扩展方案，用格密码标准 ML-DSA 与 ML-KEM 保护闪电网络的链下通信面（gossip、传输握手、发票、支付洋葱、offers），兼容现有节点并在 rust-lightning 中实现与评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子计算机将攻破比特币及闪电网络所依赖的椭圆曲线密码。即便比特币完成共识层的后量子升级，也无法覆盖闪电网络链下的通信面（gossip、点对点传输、发票、支付洋葱、offers），这些面需要独立保护。攻击者今天即可记录加密流量，待量子计算机出现后再解密（harvest-now-decrypt-later），还可进行节点冒充、发票伪造和支付去匿名化。闪电网络可先行迁移到后量子密码，无需等待比特币。

Method: 提出 PQLN——闪电网络的混合后量子扩展，使用基于格的 ML-DSA 与 ML-KEM 标准保护上述通信面：通过 gossip 分发后量子节点身份；对传输握手进行混合化；为发票添加后量子签名；在 offers 中提交后量子密钥；使支付洋葱混合化。针对后量子材料远大于椭圆曲线材料的问题，设计了将其适配进闪电网络现有消息格式与尺寸限制的技术。在量子 adversary 模型下分析安全性，并在 rust-lightning 中实现。

Result: 使用真实闪电网络节点的评估表明，PQLN 节点可与未修改节点互操作。新增密码学运算耗时至多 0.33 毫秒，主要开销在通信：gossip 数据在 ML-DSA 下约增长十倍，在更小的 Falcon 下约增长四倍。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，PQLN 是闪电网络首个后量子方案的设计、实现与评估，可在不等待比特币升级的情况下抵御 harvest-now-decrypt-later 等量子威胁。

Abstract: A cryptographically relevant quantum computer will break the elliptic-curve cryptography behind Bitcoin and its Lightning Network, the most widely used payment channel network. Even a post-quantum consensus upgrade of Bitcoin would not cover Lightning's off-chain surfaces, so its gossip, peer transport, invoices, payment onions, and offers need separate protection. An adversary can already record Lightning's encrypted traffic today and decrypt it once such a computer exists. Lightning can therefore move to post-quantum cryptography now, without waiting for Bitcoin, and stop such harvest-now-decrypt-later attacks along with node impersonation, invoice forgery, and payment deanonymization. In this paper, we propose PQLN, a hybrid post-quantum extension of Lightning that protects all of these surfaces with the lattice-based standards ML-DSA and ML-KEM. PQLN distributes post-quantum node identities through Lightning's gossip, hybridizes the transport handshake, adds post-quantum signatures to invoices, commits post-quantum keys in offers, and makes payment onions hybrid. Since post-quantum material is much larger than its elliptic-curve counterpart, we introduce techniques that fit it into Lightning's existing message formats and size limits. We analyze the security of PQLN against a quantum adversary and implement it in rust-lightning, a major Lightning implementation. Our evaluation with real Lightning nodes shows that PQLN nodes interoperate with unmodified nodes. The added cryptographic operations take at most 0.33 milliseconds, and the main cost is communication, since gossip data grows about tenfold with ML-DSA and about fourfold with the smaller Falcon. To our knowledge, PQLN is the first post-quantum design, implementation, and evaluation for Lightning.

</details>


### [354] [Exploring Automated Vulnerability Identification in JavaScript Code Using Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13816)
*Manit Kaushik,Ishir Bhardwaj,Pranav Gupta,Pankaj Jalote,Arun Balaji Buduru*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文通过实证研究评估了基于大语言模型（LLM）识别JavaScript漏洞的能力，结果显示微调后的LLM在代码片段级漏洞检测上显著优于传统SAST工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: JavaScript广泛用于约98.8%的网站，其代码漏洞构成重大安全风险，但现有静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具在孤立代码片段上难以识别许多真实漏洞，因此需要探索LLM作为替代或补充方案的可行性。

Method: 构建包含1,125个JavaScript代码片段、覆盖5类CWE（CWE-74注入、CWE-78 OS命令注入、CWE-79 XSS、CWE-89 SQL注入、CWE-400资源消耗失控）的数据集；评估三个LLM系列（Gemini 1.5 Flash、GPT-4o Mini、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B），并对比多种提示策略（零样本、思维链、少样本）与微调方法。

Result: LLM在片段级漏洞识别上大幅超越传统SAST工具：微调后的Gemini 1.5 Flash达到60%检测准确率，而基于规则的分析器接近零性能；微调将准确率从29%提升至60%；思维链提示对具推理能力的模型（如GPT-4o Mini）有效；少样本提示对XSS等多态漏洞有效；结构化漏洞（如SQL注入）可达84%准确率，各类别性能存在差异。

Conclusion: LLM为JavaScript代码的自动化漏洞识别提供了实用途径，尤其在结合任务对齐的监督微调时效果显著；但由于召回率有限且跨漏洞类型性能不均衡，LLM应作为现有安全分析流程的补充而非替代。

Abstract: JavaScript powers approximately 98.8% of all websites, making vulnerabilities in its code a significant security risk, yet existing detection approaches such as Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools often fail to identify many real-world vulnerabilities when applied to isolated code snippets. This paper presents an empirical study of Large Language Model (LLM)-based vulnerability identification for JavaScript programs, evaluating three LLM families (Gemini 1.5 Flash, GPT-4o Mini, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B) across multiple prompting strategies (zero-shot, chain-of-thought, few-shot) and fine-tuning approaches on a dataset of 1,125 JavaScript code snippets spanning five Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) categories: Injection (CWE-74), OS Command Injection (CWE-78), Cross-Site Scripting (CWE-79), SQL Injection (CWE-89), and Uncontrolled Resource Consumption (CWE-400). Our experiments show that LLMs substantially outperform traditional SAST tools on snippet-level vulnerability identification, with a fine-tuned Gemini 1.5 Flash model achieving 60% detection accuracy compared to near-zero performance from rule-based analyzers. We find that fine-tuning improves accuracy from 29% to 60%, Chain-of-Thought prompting benefits reasoning-capable models such as GPT-4o Mini, few-shot prompting is effective for polymorphic vulnerabilities such as Cross-Site Scripting, and performance varies across vulnerability categories, reaching up to 84% accuracy for structured vulnerabilities such as SQL Injection. These results indicate that LLMs provide a practical approach for automated vulnerability identification in JavaScript code, particularly when combined with task-aligned supervision, though they should complement rather than replace existing security analysis workflows due to limited recall and uneven performance across vulnerability types.

</details>


### [355] [PriMobiBench: Characterizing Visual Privacy Leakage in VLM-Driven Mobile GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13873)
*Qihang Cen,Tianshuo Cong,Da Song,Xinlei He,Jiaxing Song,Ke Xu,Qi Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出首个移动GUI智能体视觉隐私基准PriMobiBench与数据集MobiLeak，量化了截屏驱动的隐私泄露与用户画像风险，并提出UI掩码缓解方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动GUI智能体依赖VLM解释截屏流自动化手机任务，带来敏感信息直接泄露与用户画像隐忧，但缺乏标准化基准，难以在真实工作流中量化这些风险。

Method: 构建PriMobiBench基准，提供数据生成、智能体轨迹构建与多模型评估的统一流水线；发布MobiLeak数据集，涵盖16个应用的执行轨迹、25个隐私属性与2960个隐私实例；并提出在云端处理前掩码隐私敏感但任务无关UI元素的缓解方案。

Result: VLM可直接提取敏感信息，成功率最高82.5%；可从聚合视觉证据推断用户画像，成功率约70%；掩码缓解方案使画像成功率最多降低58%，性能损失仅约8%。

Conclusion: 本研究提供首个面向移动GUI智能体视觉隐私风险的系统基准，证明泄露与画像均以高度令人担忧的水平可行，并为缓解提供实用方向。

Abstract: Mobile GUI agents increasingly rely on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to automate smartphone tasks by interpreting screenshot streams. However, this design introduces serious and underexplored privacy risks, including direct leakage of sensitive on-screen information and unintended user profiling. The absence of standardized benchmarks makes it difficult to quantify these risks in realistic mobile agent workflows. To address this gap, we propose PriMobiBench, the first benchmark for systematically evaluating privacy leakage and visual profiling in screenshot-driven mobile agents. It provides a unified pipeline for data generation, agent trajectory construction, and multi-model evaluation. We also introduce MobiLeak, a dataset of execution traces from 16 apps, covering 25 privacy attributes with 2,960 embedded privacy instances. Our results reveal substantial risks: (1) VLMs can directly extract sensitive information with up to 82.5% success rate; (2) beyond explicit leakage, they can infer user profiles from aggregated visual evidence with approximately 70% success. We further propose a mitigation that masks privacy-sensitive but task-irrelevant UI elements before cloud processing, reducing profiling success by up to 58% with only approximately 8% performance loss. Overall, our work provides the first systematic benchmark for visual privacy risks in mobile GUI agents, demonstrates that both leakage and profiling are feasible at a highly concerning level, and offers a practical direction for mitigation.

</details>


### [356] [When Malicious Instructions Persist: Persistent Memory Poisoning Attack on Harness-Based Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13889)
*Shuhuai Huang,Jingfeng Zhang,Hong Jia*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出PMPA——一种针对基于harness的LLM智能体的持久记忆投毒攻击：将恶意指令嵌入良性外部源，诱导智能体在无框架直接访问权限下写入持久记忆，并在后续会话中触发恶意行为与隐私泄露。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: harness设计通过整合记忆、工具调用与运行时控制提升了LLM智能体能力，但也引入安全与隐私风险：来自外部源的恶意指令可能被写入持久记忆并跨会话存留。作者希望系统性地研究这一风险。

Method: 提出PMPA攻击框架：将恶意指令嵌入良性外部来源（如外部文档/内容），间接诱导受害智能体将其写入持久记忆，无需直接访问智能体框架本身。被投毒的记忆在后续会话中被检索，从而触发额外恶意动作并造成隐私泄露。在OpenClaw和Claude Code上，跨不同骨干LLM、输入模态与触发场景进行评估；并测试一种针对性的提示级防御。

Result: 在所有设置下，PMPA在OpenClaw上取得平均注入成功率（ISR）73.7%、跨会话攻击成功率（C-ASR）55.5%；在Claude Code上分别为66.9%与81.7%，同时两系统上的良性任务性能均得以保持。针对性的提示级防御在多种设置下可降低记忆注入，但一旦持久记忆已被投毒，其保护效果有限。

Conclusion: 基于harness的智能体存在持久记忆投毒这一现实且严重的跨会话安全与隐私风险，现有提示级防御不足以应对记忆已被污染后的情形，凸显了在记忆读写链路层面构建更强防护机制的必要性。

Abstract: Harness design has transformed the development of LLM-based agents by integrating memory, tool use, and runtime control. However, this design also introduces security and privacy risks because malicious instructions from external sources may be written into persistent memory and persist across sessions. To study this risk, we propose PMPA, a Persistent Memory Poisoning Attack against harness-based agents. PMPA embeds malicious instructions into benign external sources and induces the victim agent to write them into persistent memory without directly accessing to the agent framework. Once stored, the poisoned memory can be retrieved in later sessions, triggering additional malicious actions and causing privacy leakage. We evaluate PMPA on OpenClaw and Claude Code across different backbone LLMs, input modalities, and trigger scenarios. Across all settings, PMPA achieves average Injection Success Rate (ISR) and Cross-session Attack Success Rate (C-ASR) of 73.7%/ 55.5% on OpenClaw and 66.9%/ 81.7% on Claude Code, while preserving benign task performance on both systems. We further evaluate a targeted prompt-level defense and find that it can reduce memory injection in many settings, but provides limited protection once the persistent memory has been poisoned.

</details>


### [357] [Enforcement of In-Kernel Stateful Security Policies via eBPF](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13930)
*Letterio Galletta*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 BPFence，一个内核内运行时验证框架，通过具备形式化语义的策略语言表达事件间时序关系，并借助类型系统与有限状态监视器编译为 eBPF 程序在内核执行，以防御多步、依赖历史的攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多租户系统上的许多攻击是多步且依赖历史的：单个操作无害，但恶意性仅在完整执行轨迹上显现。防御此类攻击需要同时满足三个条件的策略：有状态、内核内执行、语义精确。现有方案各有缺陷——内核原生系统调用过滤与传统 MAC 框架是无状态的；当前 eBPF 工具用临时性 YAML 规则表达策略，无法刻画事件间时序关系，且语义仅由实现定义。

Method: BPFence 提供一种具有形式化语义的策略语言，可表达事件间时序关系；并提供类型系统，静态区分内核可控制的与仅可观测的事件。每个良类型策略先被编译为相对于其语义被证明正确的有限状态监视器，再编译为在内核中运行的 eBPF 程序。

Result: 在七个取自真实攻击模式的案例研究以及一组微基准与宏基准上对 BPFence 进行评估，结果表明其执行开销与生产部署兼容。

Conclusion: BPFence 统一满足了有状态、内核内执行与精确语义三项要求，将形式化策略语义、类型系统与可证明正确的有限状态监视器落地为内核 eBPF 程序，在真实攻击模式下有效且开销可接受。

Abstract: Many attacks against workloads running on multi-tenant systems are multi-step and history-dependent: sequences of innocuous operations whose malicious nature emerges only over an execution trace. Defending against them requires security policies that are stateful, are enforced within the kernel, and have a precise semantics. Currently deployed proposals fail on at least one count: kernel's built-in syscall filtering and classical MAC frameworks are stateless, while current eBPF-based tools express their policies through ad hoc YAML rules that cannot capture temporal relations among events, and whose semantics is defined only by the implementation.
  We present BPFence, an in-kernel runtime-verification framework that satisfies the properties above. BPFence provides a policy language with a formal semantics that can express temporal relations among events. It also provides a type system that statically distinguishes events the kernel can control from those it can only observe. Every well-typed policy is compiled into a finite-state monitor proved correct with respect to its semantics, and then into eBPF programs that run inside the kernel. We evaluate BPFence on seven case studies drawn from real-world attack patterns, and on a set of micro- and macro-benchmarks to show that the enforcement overhead remains compatible with production deployment.

</details>


### [358] [Confuse the Model, Control the Flow: Understanding and Mitigating Privacy Leakage from LLM Agents with Information Flow Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14003)
*Minsun Shim,Ramisha Raida Karim,Ruthwik Jakkula,Kaiwen Zhou,Xin Liu,Xin Eric Wang,Zhou Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 现有基于LLM自身判断的隐私防御存在"执行机制即为攻击面"的结构性问题；本文提出FLOWSEAL——一个位于LLM上下文之外的工具级拦截器，基于数据溯源和信息流控制格实现受控解密，将泄露率降至近零并保持任务效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个人AI代理需访问用户私密数据与通信以提供个性化服务，由此产生持续隐私风险：代理须判断某敏感信息是否应披露给特定对象。现有防御（更强系统提示、训练、显式同意检查）均由后端LLM在同一对话上下文中做出判断，而该上下文恰是攻击者可控制的，导致执行机制与攻击面重合，存在结构性缺陷。

Method: 首先通过三种新攻击验证现有防御的脆弱性：协作工作区诱饵（Collaborative Workspace Lure，将提取伪装为协作）、语义混淆攻击（Semantic Obfuscation Attack，通过省略而非明示诱导披露）、信道解耦攻击（Channel Decoupling Attack，将提取请求与披露拆分至独立信道），三者均无需提示注入，仅靠普通交互。据此提出FLOWSEAL：将机密性执行移至LLM上下文之外的工具级拦截器，以数据溯源和信息流控制格（information-flow-control lattice）为基础，实现受控解密（controlled declassification）。

Result: 在三个基准、五个基于提示的基线和八种攻击（含通过MCP执行实时工具调用的真实代理）上进行评估：FLOWSEAL将泄露率降至近零（如针对协作工作区诱饵从52.2%降至0.5%），同时保持任务效用，且效果不依赖于底层LLM后端。

Conclusion: 将隐私执行机制置于LLM上下文之内存在根本性缺陷，因为执行与攻击面重合；将机密性执行外移至工具级、基于数据溯源与信息流控制的拦截器（FLOWSEAL），可有效且与模型无关地防御多种泄露攻击，同时不损害任务效用。

Abstract: Personal AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) are increasingly given access to a user's private data and communications in order to provide personalized assistance. This access creates a persistent privacy risk: the agent must decide whether a given sensitive information should be disclosed to a particular party. Existing defenses address this by making the agent's backend LLM more privacy-preserving through stronger system prompts, training, or explicit consent-checking procedures, but this approach has a structural challenge: whenever enforcement is a judgment the LLM makes over the same conversational context an adversary controls, the enforcement mechanism and the attack surface coincide. We demonstrate this against existing defenses with three new attacks that require only ordinary agent interaction and no prompt injection: Collaborative Workspace Lure reframes an extraction attempt as collaborative work; Semantic Obfuscation Attack induces disclosure through omission rather than through anything the agent writes; and Channel Decoupling Attack splits the extraction request and the disclosure across independent channels. All three achieve substantially higher leak rates than the attacks these defenses were originally designed to withstand. Guided by this observation, we present FLOWSEAL, a defense that enforces confidentiality through a tool-level interceptor outside the LLM's context, grounded in data provenance and an information-flow-control lattice with controlled declassification. Evaluated across three benchmarks, five prompt-based baselines, and eight attacks, including a real agent executing live tool calls through MCP, FLOWSEAL reduces leak rates to near zero (e.g., 52.2% to 0.5% against Collaborative Workspace Lure) while preserving task utility, regardless of the underlying LLM backend.

</details>


### [359] [A High-Throughput FPGA Architecture for Real-Time TCP-SYN Scan Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14043)
*Faisal Saeed,Mohammad Fahad,Ayesha Javaid,Christian Doerr,Muhammad Ali Siddiqi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出一种轻量级FPGA架构，实现线速可重构TCP-SYN端口扫描指纹检测，延迟恒为两周期（10 ns），资源随指纹数线性增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TCP-SYN端口扫描常为网络攻击的前兆，检测数据包头中的扫描器指纹可提供及时入侵告警。现有方法要么计算开销过大无法线速运行，要么仅支持离线分析。

Method: 将每个指纹编译为浅层布尔LUT树，实现并行求值，恒定两周期延迟；检测核心与MAC层前端解耦，前端做流式字段提取，无需帧缓存或高层状态，仅改前端即可适配不同线速；用Python框架自动将布尔表达式编译为可综合HDL，免去手工RTL修改。

Result: 在Versal VCK190上10 Gbps、18个指纹部署时约占0.5% LUT，容量可支持2000+并发指纹；Virtex-6上1 Gbps占用低于2.5%；两种速率下检测延迟均为10 ns，比软件IDS典型逐包处理延迟低三至四个数量级；在8小时生产流量上与软件复现交叉验证，零误报/漏报。

Conclusion: 该架构以极低资源开销和恒定低延迟实现线速可重构指纹检测，具备良好可扩展性与跨线速可移植性，验证了检测正确性。

Abstract: TCP-SYN port scanning often precedes cyber-attacks, and early detection of scanner fingerprints embedded in packet headers can provide timely intrusion alerts. Existing approaches are either too computationally expensive for line-rate operation or limited to offline analysis. This brief presents a lightweight FPGA architecture for reconfigurable line-rate fingerprint detection, where each fingerprint is compiled into a shallow Boolean LUT tree, enabling parallel evaluation with constant two-cycle latency regardless of fingerprint count, while resource cost grows linearly with fingerprint count. This detection core is decoupled from a MAC-layer frontend that performs streaming field extraction with no frame buffering or higher-layer state, allowing deployment across different line rates by modifying only the frontend. A Python framework automatically compiles Boolean expressions into synthesizable HDL, eliminating manual RTL changes. For TCP-SYN port-scan fingerprint detection, the architecture uses approximately 0.5% LUTs at 10 Gbps on a Versal VCK190 for 18 deployed fingerprints, with capacity for over 2,000 concurrent fingerprints, and under 2.5% on a Virtex-6 at 1 Gbps, with a detection latency of 10 ns at both rates, three to four orders of magnitude below typical per-packet processing latency in software intrusion-detection systems. The system was cross-validated against a software re-implementation on an 8-hour production packet trace, confirming detection correctness with zero false positives/negatives.

</details>


### [360] [Symmetric Models for Syndrome Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14052)
*Elisa Gorla,Simone Trebiani*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文针对二元情形下精确变体Syndrome Decoding Problem (SDP)，提出基于初等对称多项式的新多项式模型，通过估计正则度和求解度界评估求解复杂度，所得估计低于既有多项式模型，并给出复杂度直接依赖具体实例的改进变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精确变体SDP的已有多项式模型求解复杂度较高，需要更高效的代数建模方式以降低求解复杂度。

Method: 基于初等对称多项式构建SDP精确变体的多项式模型；通过建立关联理想的正则度界与求解度界来估计求解相应多项式系统的计算复杂度；并构造复杂度直接依赖具体SDP实例的模型变体；最后讨论方法向其他SDP变体的推广。

Result: 新模型的复杂度估计低于此前多项式模型；改进变体的复杂度直接依赖具体SDP实例，且低于第一个模型。

Conclusion: 基于初等对称多项式的建模可有效降低精确变体SDP的求解复杂度，且方法具备推广至其他SDP变体的潜力。

Abstract: This paper introduces a new polynomial model for the exact variant of the Syndrome Decoding Problem (SDP) in the binary case. The model is based on elementary symmetric polynomials. We estimate the computational complexity of solving the corresponding polynomial system by establishing bounds on the degree of regularity and on the solving degree of the ideal associated to the model. The complexity estimate is lower than for previous polynomial models. We also provide a variant of the model whose complexity depends directly on the specific instance of the SDP and is lower than for the first model. Finally, we discuss how to apply our approach to solve other variants of the SDP.

</details>


### [361] [AGENTQ: Quantization-Conditioned Backdoor Attacks on LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14060)
*Xiaoqun Liu,Qiben Yan*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究面向LLM智能体的"量化条件攻击"(QCA)，提出AGENTQ框架，在保持良性功能的同时将恶意行为集中到量化模型中，最高可达100%的量化后攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化是开放权重LLM智能体的默认部署路径，但它并非行为保持型：攻击者可发布能通过审计的全精度检查点，却在量化后表现出恶意行为（量化条件攻击QCA）。此前的QCA工作针对自由文本生成，危害需经人类读者中介；而在智能体场景中，触发的载荷是可无人工监督直接执行的结构化函数，风险更为严重。该新型威胁此前尚无研究。

Method: 作者首先尝试直接迁移已有的后门注入方法，发现虽能在量化后产生恶意行为，但会显著损害良性效用，使攻击不具实用性。为探究威胁的真实上界，提出AGENTQ攻击框架，其核心是将分层带状LoRA注入(layer-banded LoRA injection)与部分PGD修复(partial-PGD repair)结合，作用于多码本量化等价类之上。

Result: 在三种触发-动作对和三种码本(NF4、FP4、INT8)设置下，AGENTQ的量化后攻击成功率最高达到100%，且良性效用损失极小。

Conclusion: AGENTQ证明了针对LLM智能体的QCA威胁上界极高，凸显出在部署开放权重智能体之前，将量化感知的安全评估作为标准要求的必要性。

Abstract: Quantization is one of the default deployment paths for open-weight LLM agents, but it is not behavior-preserving: an adversary can release a full-precision checkpoint that passes audits yet misbehaves once quantized, termed as quantization-conditioned attack (QCA). Prior QCA work targets free-text generation, where harm is mediated by a human reader. In contrast, the agentic setting poses a more severe risk: the triggered payload is a structured function that can be executed without human oversight. We present the first study of QCA against LLM agents. We find that directly adapting prior backdoor-injection methods can produce malicious behavior after quantization, but substantially degrades benign utility, rendering the resulting attacks impractical. To understand the true upper bound of the threat, we propose AGENTQ, an attack framework that combines layer-banded LoRA injection with partial-PGD repair over a multi-codebook quantization-equivalence class. AGENTQ preserves normal agentic capability while concentrating malicious behavior in the quantized model. Across three trigger-action pairs and three codebooks (NF4, FP4, INT8), AGENTQ reaches up to 100% post-quantization attack success rate with minimal loss of benign utility, underscoring the need to make quantization-aware safety evaluation a standard requirement before open-weight agents are deployed.

</details>


### [362] [SkillSecurer: Detecting and Patching Prompt-Injection Vulnerabilities in AI Agent Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14079)
*Donato Mecca,Alberto Verna,Youness Bouchari,Nikhil Jha,Marco Mellia*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出全智能体框架SkillSecurer，用于智能体技能的安全风险生成、检测、定位与修复，在受控场景实现100%注入检测率，并在真实技能库中发现超17%技能存在潜在漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体技能（Agent skills）以可复用的指令、脚本和配置扩展AI智能体的能力，但同时也引入了新的攻击面，攻击者可借此影响智能体的决策与行为。现有方法多停留在技能级标记，缺乏对注入的细粒度定位与可操作修复。

Method: SkillSecurer采用全智能体架构：红方智能体生成覆盖九类威胁的上下文兼容注入，并记录精确修改位置；蓝方智能体分析完整技能包，给出有依据的证据并提出补丁；在受控实例中，验证器将检测结果与补丁同记录的注入进行比对，实现注入级评估。评估时先筛选最佳后端LLM，再与竞品对比，并对各阶段人工交叉验证。

Result: 采用最佳后端模型时，SkillSecurer是唯一实现100%注入检测率的扫描器；对skills.sh流行技能的分析显示，超过17%的技能存在潜在漏洞；实际运行部分技能可触发真实安全事件，验证了未经验证技能的风险。

Conclusion: 上下文感知的LLM分析能够提供可靠的注入定位与可操作的修复方案，效果超越单纯的技能级标记，说明该框架在智能体技能安全防护上具有实用价值。

Abstract: Agent skills extend AI agents with reusable instructions, scripts, and configuration, but are also open to new attacks to influence an agent's decisions and actions. To address these risks, we present SkillSecurer, a fully agentic framework for generating, detecting, localising, and remediating security risks in agent skills. Its red agent generates context-compatible injections across nine threat types while recording the exact modification; its blue agent analyses complete skill packages, produces grounded evidence, and proposes patches. For controlled instances, a verifier compares findings and patches with the recorded injection, enabling injection-level evaluation.
  We thoroughly evaluate SkillSecurer by selecting the best backend LLM, comparing it with competitors, and manually cross-validating each evaluation stage. With its best performing backend, SkillSecurer is the only scanner to achieve a 100% injection detection rate. Next, we analyse popular skills from skills.sh, finding latent vulnerabilities in more than 17% of the skills examined. Testing some of those skills, we trigger actual incidents, showing the risks of running unverified skills. Our results show that context-aware LLM analysis can provide reliable injection localisation and actionable remediation beyond skill-level flagging alone.

</details>


### [363] [The Deception Delta: Adversarial Evaluation of LLM-Based Smart Contract Bytecode Forensics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14098)
*Timo Schefold*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文系统评估了22个前沿大模型在对抗性设计的智能合约字节码上的鲁棒性，发现结构性欺骗使资金抽取检测率下降20个百分点，且简单提示防御无效，当前LLM不适合作为独立的取证工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型日益被用于区块链取证以解读未经验证的智能合约字节码，但其面对刻意误导分析的对抗性合约时的鲁棒性尚未被系统测试。论文旨在填补这一空白，检验LLM在对抗性欺骗下的可靠性。

Method: 在13个专门构建的合约（9个欺骗向量、4个对照）上，用6种提示策略评估22个前沿模型，得到8,528个可分析的非拒答运行，且合约具有EVM验证的ground truth。采用校准的LLM-as-judge流水线，辅以两项独立于judge的指标与50条人工金标准标签进行验证。

Result: 对抗性欺骗使资金抽取检测率相比功能匹配的对照下降20.0个百分点（95% CI: [17.2, 22.8]）。多跳调用链、XOR掩码选择器、存储加载抽取参数等结构性伪装几乎对所有模型都抵抗检测。此外发现"合理化"现象：模型正确描述隐藏的抽取机制，却接受合约的欺骗性框架并判定为良性。简单的防护指令总体上无益，且会在两个方向上使个别模型不稳定。结构性欺骗对六种提示策略基本不敏感，仅两家供应商的5个模型检测率超过50%。

Conclusion: 在单次、仅原始字节码的协议下，当前LLM并非可靠的独立取证工具。该结论不适用于多轮、工具增强、源码感知或反编译器参与的流程；源码边界检查作为显式子集分析给出，而非主评估的一部分。研究提示结构性欺骗更可能是能力局限，而非简单的提示工程问题。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in blockchain forensic investigations to interpret unverified smart contract bytecode. Their robustness has not been systematically tested against contracts adversarially designed to mislead analysis.
  We evaluate 22 frontier models on 13 purpose-built contracts (9 deception vectors, 4 controls) across six prompt strategies, yielding 8,528 analyzable non-refusal runs against contracts with EVM-verified ground truth. A calibrated LLM-as-judge pipeline, supported by two judge-independent metrics and 50 human gold-standard labels, shows that adversarial deception reduces drain detection by 20.0 percentage points (95% CI: [17.2, 22.8]) relative to functionally matched controls.
  Structural camouflage via multi-hop call chains, XOR-masked selectors, and storage-loaded drain parameters resists detection across nearly all models. Beyond non-detection, we identify rationalization: models correctly describe the hidden drain mechanism but accept the contract's deceptive framing and dismiss it as benign, yielding positive but incorrect evidence of safety. Simple guard instructions provide no aggregate benefit and destabilize individual models in both directions.
  Structural deception is largely insensitive across the six tested prompt strategies, more consistent with a capability limitation than with a simple prompting problem. Only five models from two providers exceed 50% detection.
  Under our single-shot, raw-bytecode-only protocol, current LLMs are not reliable standalone forensic tools. Our central claim does not extend to multi-turn, tool-augmented, source-aware, or decompiler-in-the-loop workflows; a source-code boundary check is reported as an explicit subset analysis rather than as part of the main evaluation.

</details>


### [364] [Same Name, Different Server: A Security Census of Silent Drift in the Model Context Protocol Ecosystem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14119)
*Obada Kraishan*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文对公共 MCP（Model Context Protocol）注册表进行全量普查（21,643 个服务器、72,606 条版本记录，2026 年 8 月快照），扫描其中 14,353 个服务器的源码，发现核心问题并非某一类漏洞，而是版本间"静默漂移"：51.1% 的多版本服务器改变其对外声明，40.6% 为静默变更，4.2% 在保留注册表身份的同时将远程端点重定向至其他主机。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MCP 已成为大语言模型应用接入外部工具的事实标准接口，其公共注册表分发数千个社区构建的服务器，却缺乏成熟软件包生态所积累的审核基础设施。作者希望量化该生态的真实安全状况，并检验"流行度（star 数）可代表安全性"这一常见假设是否成立。

Method: 1) 采集完整公共 MCP 注册表快照（21,643 个服务器、72,606 条版本记录）；2) 抓取 14,353 个服务器的源代码；3) 使用基于模式的扫描器，覆盖八类威胁目录；4) 以 414 条人工标注发现衡量扫描器准确率，并按各类别实测精确率对观测流行率进行校正；5) 通过逻辑回归分析静默漂移与高危发现之间的关联（优势比 OR 及 95% 置信区间）。

Result: 观测流行率以未认证网络暴露为主（占被扫描服务器的 9.57%）；经精确率校正后，高危流行率由 11.14% 降至约 7.6%。稳定性方面：51.1% 的多版本服务器在版本间改变了对外声明，40.6% 为静默变更，4.2% 将远程端点重定向到不同主机并保留注册表身份，且协议从不向已安装客户端提示该变化。静默漂移与高危发现几近三倍相关（OR = 2.96，95% CI [2.56, 3.42]）。流行度保护作用微弱（log stars 每单位 OR = 0.78），星标数并非安全性的良好代理指标。

Conclusion: MCP 生态的核心风险是供应链层面的版本不稳定性与静默漂移，而非单一漏洞类型。作者据此提出针对注册表设计、客户端固定（pinning）与扫描器分诊的具体建议，并发布匿名化数据集。

Abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the common interface through which large language model applications reach external tools, and its public registry now distributes thousands of community-built servers with little of the vetting infrastructure that mature package ecosystems have accumulated. This paper reports a census of that ecosystem.
