We harvested the full public MCP registry (21,643 servers, 72,606 version records, August 2026 snapshot), fetched source code for 14,353 servers, and applied a pattern-based scanner covering an eight-class threat catalogue whose accuracy we measured against 414 hand-labeled findings. Observed prevalence is dominated by unauthenticated network exposure (9.57% of scanned servers); after correcting each class by its measured precision, 11.14% observed high-severity prevalence reduces to roughly 7.6%. The central finding concerns instability rather than any single weakness: 51.1% of multi-version servers changed what they advertise between versions, 40.6% did so silently, and 4.2% redirected their remote endpoint to a different host while keeping their registry identity, a change the protocol never surfaces to installed clients. Silent drift is associated with nearly threefold higher odds of a high-severity finding (OR = 2.96, 95% CI [2.56, 3.42]). Popularity offers only weak protection (OR = 0.78 per unit of log stars), so star counts are a poor proxy for safety. We derive concrete recommendations for registry design, client-side pinning, and scanner triage, and release an anonymized artifact.

</details>


### [365] [A Graph-Based Framework for Extending Metric Differential Privacy Mechanisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14125)
*Ruiyao Liu,Chenxi Qiu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 首次将"扩展"系统化为度量差分隐私(mDP)的通用设计范式，提出基于图的扩展框架并给出正确性条件，实例化为多分辨率网格的树形扩展算法，在路网数据集上实现效用-可扩展性的良好权衡且保持精确ε-mDP保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: mDP适合结构化秘密域，但在大规模或细粒度域上直接构造效用感知机制往往计算上不可行。为此需要一种在小子集上设计、再扩展到目标域的方法。

Method: 提出基于图的扩展框架：先在有限种子记录集上指定机制，再扩展到更大目标域。识别正确性所需三条件——局部mDP约束、重叠一致性、后继层mDP保持；证明满足条件时诱导的全局机制良定义并满足目标域上的ε-mDP。以多分辨率网格为实例，给出树形扩展算法，通过一维插值与逐维复合实现多维扩展。

Result: 在路网数据集上的实验表明，该方法在保持精确mDP保证的同时，取得了较强的效用-可扩展性权衡。

Conclusion: 扩展可作为mDP的通用设计范式而非特定方法的构造；图框架与三条件为扩展机制提供了一般性正确性保证，树形算法验证了其在实际结构化域上的可行性。

Abstract: Metric differential privacy (mDP) is well suited to structured secret domains, but directly constructing utility-aware mechanisms over large or fine-grained domains is often computationally prohibitive. We study extension-based mDP design, where a mechanism is first specified on a finite set of seed records and then extended to a larger target domain. To our knowledge, this is the first work to systematically formulate extension as a general design paradigm for mDP rather than a method-specific construction. We present a graph-based extension framework, identify three requirements for correctness, local mDP constraints, overlap consistency, and successor-level mDP preservation, and show that, under these conditions, the induced global mechanism is well defined and satisfies $ε$-mDP on the target domain. We further instantiate the framework with a tree-based extension algorithm for multi-resolution grids, where multi-dimensional extension is realized through one-dimensional interpolation and dimension-wise composition. Experiments on road-map datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves a strong utility-scalability trade-off while preserving exact mDP guarantees.

</details>


### [366] [PixCrypt: Fast Fine-Grained FHE with Range-Aware Caching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14137)
*Chao Wang,Shubing Yang,Xiaoyan Sun,Yan Bai,Jun Dai,Dongfang Zhao*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: PixCrypt：一种基于缓存的细粒度全同态加密加速机制，将昂贵的新鲜密文生成替换为缓存检索与系数级操作，支持CKKS/BFV/BGV，线性噪声增长减少自举需求，细粒度加密速度提升最高35倍并保持IND-CPA安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细粒度数据（如像素级图像）的隐私保护分析需要高精度密文计算，但现有技术各有局限：MPC交互开销大，DP仅保护聚合值，PHE不支持乘法；FHE虽支持任意密文运算，但计算代价高昂，软硬件加速均面临挑战。

Method: 提出PixCrypt缓存加速机制：以缓存检索替代昂贵的新鲜密文生成，在CKKS、BFV、BGV上进行系数级操作；通过随机化重构确保密文不重复；利用线性噪声增长减少自举次数并降低NTT负载。

Result: 细粒度加密速度最高提升35倍，同时保持IND-CPA安全性；在五个真实像素级图像处理任务上的实验表明显著提升了FHE在隐私保护分析中的实用性。

Conclusion: PixCrypt通过缓存与系数级操作有效缓解FHE在细粒度数据分析中的计算瓶颈，为隐私保护分析提供了更实用的FHE加速方案。

Abstract: Many analytics tasks require secure computation over encrypted data. In particular, fine-grained data such as pixel-level images require higher precision, as every pixel can directly affect outcomes in tasks like tumor segmentation and anomaly detection. While Multi-Party Computation (MPC) is interactive, Differential Privacy (DP) protects only aggregate values, and Partially Homomorphic Encryption (PHE) lacks multiplicative support, none of them can efficiently handle fine-grained data analytics. Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) uniquely enables arbitrary operations on encrypted pixels but remains computationally expensive, posing significant challenges for both software and hardware accelerators. We present PixCrypt, a caching-based acceleration mechanism for fine-grained fully homomorphic encryption. PixCrypt replaces expensive fresh ciphertext generation with cache retrieval and coefficient-level operations across CKKS, BFV, and BGV, while randomized reconstruction ensures that ciphertexts do not repeat. Its linear noise growth reduces the need for bootstrapping and lowers NTT load, improving hardware accelerator efficiency. This design yields up to 35x faster fine-grained encryption and maintains IND-CPA (Indistinguishability under Chosen Plaintext Attack) security. Experiments on five real-world pixel-level image processing tasks show that PixCrypt significantly improves the practicality of FHE for privacy-preserving analytics.

</details>


### [367] [Transparent Identity Verification Approach Using MPC and Efficient Credential Status Handling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14195)
*Istiaque Ahmed,Shoji Kasahara,Kentaroh Toyoda,Tadashi Nakano,Thi Hong Tran*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出一种基于多方安全计算（MPC）的透明、低成本身份验证框架，通过链下私有代码执行与区块链锚定，结合多维位矩阵压缩、可复用可验证凭证及后量子签名，实现国家规模的可扩展eKYC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于零知识证明的eKYC框架存在计算开销大、电路设计僵化、集成复杂、链上验证昂贵等问题；W3C 2021 BitString凭证状态机制更新效率低、大规模部署可扩展性差，亟需更透明、低成本且抗量子的身份验证方案。

Method: 采用多方安全计算（MPC）实现链下私有代码执行并生成运行时证明锚定区块链；引入多维位矩阵模型配合ZSTD压缩凭证数据；支持细粒度状态更新与Layer-2区块链锚定；使用带唯一访问令牌的可复用可验证呈现（VP）实现免费验证与访问控制；结合选择性披露保护隐私，并集成SHA3哈希与Falcon后量子签名。

Result: ZSTD将凭证数据压缩至76字节（GZIP为140字节），显著降低存储与带宽成本；支持免费验证与细粒度状态更新，Layer-2锚定实现低成本、防篡改验证；实验与安全性研究表明系统对量子攻击具有鲁棒性，具备透明性与可扩展性。

Conclusion: 该框架为国家级身份验证提供了面向未来、透明、可扩展且抗量子的实用解决方案。

Abstract: A secure and privacy-preserving identity verification process is essential for digital ecosys- tems. Current eKYC frameworks that rely on Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs) face high computational cost, rigid circuit design, complex integration, and expensive on-chain verification. The W3C 2021 BitString- based credential status mechanism also suffers from inefficient updates and poor scalability in large- scale deployments. We propose a transparent and cost-effective identity verification framework based on Multi-Party Computation (MPC). It enables private off-chain code execution and produces runtime proofs anchored to a blockchain. The framework introduces a multidimensional bit-matrix model with efficient compression. Using ZSTD, the credential data is reduced to 76 bytes compared to 140 bytes with GZIP, cutting storage and bandwidth costs. The system also supports fine-grained status updates and Layer-2 blockchain anchoring for tamper-evident, low-cost verification. The system employs reusable verifiable presentations (VPs) with unique access tokens, enabling cost-free verification and stronger access control. Selective disclosure preserves user control and strengthens privacy. Finally, the system integrates SHA3 hashing and Falcon post-quantum signatures. This guarantees robustness against quantum attacks, transparency, and scalability. It is a future-proof solution for national-scale identity verification, as demonstrated by experimental findings and security studies that validate its robustness and applicability.

</details>


### [368] [Enc53: DNSSEC-Anchored Stateless Tickets for Post-Quantum Authoritative DNS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14210)
*Minh Hoang Tran,Munshi Rejwan Ala Muid,Taejoong Chung*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: Enc53是一种服务器无状态的会话票据协议，将权威DNS加密拆分为基于DNSSEC锚定的TLS认证供给阶段与1-RTT AEAD加密UDP稳态阶段，在Knot DNS中实现后仅需约570B、接近明文UDP延迟，并在计算与内存效率上显著优于ADoT/ADoQ，且与PQ-DNSSEC联合部署时仍低于1232B限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DNSSEC仅认证RRset，不提供端点认证与信道安全；DoT/DoQ面向存根到解析器跳设计，依赖长连接摊薄初始开销。但递归到权威路径具有高扇入且各解析器查询频率不均，加之ML-DSA等后量子证书链超过TCP初始窗口、冷启动PQ DoQ字节开销可达UDP的约140倍，且近半TLD/2LD权威服务器对非空闲连接也设寿命限制，导致现有加密方案在此场景严重失配。

Method: 提出Enc53无状态会话票据协议：第一阶段在初始查询上完成短时、DNSSEC锚定、TLS认证的供给；第二阶段稳态下传输1-RTT AEAD加密的UDP DNS查询。服务器端无状态：递归解析器持有流量密钥与会话票据，权威服务器仅持对称STEK。基于Knot DNS实现。

Result: 供给后稳态Enc53交换约570B，约为明文UDP的3倍，延迟与未加密UDP基线相差1ms内。恢复的PQ-ADoT为7.7倍字节、3倍延迟；恢复的PQ-ADoQ为10倍字节、相同延迟。针对根服务器查询轨迹评估，Enc53较ADoT/ADoQ计算效率提升2倍，较ADoT内存效率提升3倍，较ADoQ提升12倍。与FN-DSA-512 PQ-DNSSEC联合部署时，Enc53-DNSSEC联合UDP数据报仍低于1232B缓冲区限制。

Conclusion: Enc53通过无状态票据与两阶段设计，在递归到权威路径实现高效认证加密，规避长连接与后量子证书的固有开销，在字节、延迟、计算和内存效率上优于ADoT/ADoQ，并与后量子DNSSEC兼容适配1232B限制。

Abstract: DNSSEC authenticates RRsets, but does not provide endpoint authentication or channel security. DNS-over-TLS (DoT) and DNS-over-QUIC (DoQ) can facilitate such needs, but were designed for the stub-to-resolver hop, where stable long-lived connections amortize the expensive initial setup. The recursive-to-authoritative path's high fan-in and nonuniform per-resolver query frequency invert said dynamics. Post- quantum primitives further sharpen this mismatch: an ML-DSA WebPKI certificate chain crosses TCP's initial window, a cold PQ DoQ may incur up to about 140 times the total bytes of the same query over UDP. A survey of TLD and 2LD nameservers further bounds connection lifetimes, with almost half surveyed imposing limits on even non-idle connections. We present Enc53 -- a stateless session ticket protocol enabling efficient authenticated authoritative DNS encryption. Enc53 splits DNS encryption into 2 phases: a short-lived, DNSSEC-anchored, TLS- authenticated provisioning on the initial query in the 1st, and a steady state of 1-RTT AEAD-encrypted UDP DNS queries in the 2nd. Enc53 is server-side stateless: recursive resolvers hold the traffic secret and session ticket, authoritative nameservers hold only a symmetric STEK. We implemented Enc53 in Knot DNS. After provisioning, a steady state Enc53 exchange costs about 570 B -- roughly 3 times a plain UDP query -- and lands within 1 ms of the unencrypted UDP baseline. Resumed PQ-ADoT pays 7.7 times the bytes and 3 times the latency; resumed PQ-ADoQ pays 10 times the bytes for the same latency. When evaluated against a root server query trace, Enc53 achieves 2-fold compute efficiency over ADoT/ADoQ, 3-fold memory efficiency over ADoT, and 12-fold memory efficiency over ADoQ. Finally, when deployed in conjunction with FN-DSA-512 PQ-DNSSEC, the joint Enc53-DNSSEC UDP datagram remains below the 1232B buffer limit.

</details>


### [369] [Policy-Governed Post-Quantum Migration for Legacy Microservices Using Ephemeral Sidecar Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14286)
*Nirmal Kumar Jingar*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出PG-PQMES框架，通过策略治理的临时边车架构，实现云原生与微服务系统中无需修改遗留代码的动态、可逆后量子密码迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子计算快速发展对云原生及微服务企业系统中常用的经典密码学构成重大威胁。但传统密码原语与遗留微服务深度耦合，直接迁移至后量子密码学（PQC）复杂、风险高且具有破坏性。

Method: 提出PG-PQMES框架，包含三层架构：注入运行时密码学的临时密码边车层、集中管理迁移的策略治理层、度量性能并自动回滚的迁移安全与可观测性层；并提出策略治理的临时PQ迁移（PG-EPM）算法，以优化性能、合规性与信任驱动的迁移过程。

Result: 在微服务仿真环境中的实验评估表明，相较于现有迁移策略，该方法在迁移时间、服务停机时间、延迟开销和回滚恢复时间方面均有显著降低。

Conclusion: 基于边车且由策略驱动的迁移策略，为安全的后量子转型提供了一种可行、可扩展且适用于企业规模的迁移方案。

Abstract: The fast development of quantum computing represents a big risk to classical cryptography that is commonly used in cloud native and microservice based enterprise systems. Traditional cryptographic primitives are closely linked to legacy microservices and it is both intricate, hazardous, and disruptive to straight up migrate to post-quantum cryptography (PQC). In a bid to overcome these issues, this research presents a PolicyGoverned Post-Quantum Migration through Ephemeral Sidecar Architectures (PG-PQMES), a framework of dynamic and reversible migration that allows transparent adoption of PQC without any modifications in the legacy code of applications. The architecture is a combination of three coherent layers, including Ephemeral Crypto Sidecar Layer which injects the runtime cryptography, Policy Governance Layer which manages the migration centrally, and Migration Safety and Observability Layer which measures the performance and rolls back automatically. An innovative Policy-Governed Ephemeral PQ Migration (PG-EPM) algorithm is proposed to maximize the performance, compliance, and trust-based migration. In simulated environment of microservices, experimental assessment shows that the time of migration, service downtime, overheads of latency, and rollback recovery time are substantially reduced using the current migration strategies. The findings show that a sidecar-based migration strategy that is policy-based offers a viable, scalable, and enterprise-scale migration to a secure post-quantum transformation.

</details>


### [370] [Fusing Spectral Signatures and Activation Clustering for Backdoor Detection in Healthcare Imaging Models: Method, Implementation, and Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14290)
*Suresh Tamang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文将频谱签名分析与激活聚类两类后门检测方法在分数层面融合，构建八阶段开源检测流水线，并在医学影像基准与CIFAR-10上按4种投毒率、5个随机种子评测，发现医学影像上融合检测AUROC≥0.99，而CIFAR-10高投毒率下两类信号同时失效导致融合失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习模型在医疗影像诊断流程中的部署日益广泛，医疗行业指南将模型投毒与对抗攻击列为需专门防御的威胁，联邦政策也要求向农村医院等关键基础设施运营方提供AI漏洞检测工具。然而频谱签名分析与激活聚类通常只作为独立基线评估，二者输出未被组合，且在医学影像基准上的检测性能报告远少于自然图像领域，因此需要一种融合式检测方法并补充医学场景下的实证。

Method: 提出一种分数级融合规则，将逐类频谱排名与激活聚类标记合并为单一的逐样本投毒分数以及一个模型级一致性统计量；给出该八阶段流水线的开源实现；在公开医学影像基准的合成投毒变体与CIFAR-10上，以0%、1%、5%、10%四种投毒率、每种五个随机种子开展评测，对比各单独检测器与融合检测器；检测输出以NIST AI RMF Measure函数与MITRE ATLAS的术语表述。

Result: 在医学影像基准上，融合检测器在所有非零投毒率下AUROC均达到0.99以上。在CIFAR-10上融合并非一致有效：10%投毒率时激活聚类的真阳性率降至0.000，频谱方法AUROC单独退化至接近随机水平（0.545），而攻击成功率高达97.2%，表明后门已完整植入；融合分数作为两种信号的加权组合继承了这一共同失效。

Conclusion: 分数级融合在医学影像基准上表现稳健，但在CIFAR-10高投毒率下会因两个组成信号的共同失效而失效，说明融合并非普适增益。研究同时以安全与合规团队惯用的NIST AI RMF与MITRE ATLAS术语呈现检测结果，便于行业落地对接。

Abstract: Machine learning models are increasingly deployed in healthcare imaging pipelines for diagnostic support, and training-time attacks against them are a named sector-level concern: healthcare-sector guidance identifies model poisoning and adversarial attacks as threats requiring dedicated defenses, while federal policy directs expanded AI vulnerability-detection tooling to critical infrastructure operators such as rural hospitals. Spectral signature analysis and activation clustering are two established backdoor detection methods routinely evaluated as independent baselines, but their outputs are not ordinarily combined, and reported detection performance on medical imaging benchmarks remains sparse relative to the natural-image setting. This paper contributes three things: a score-level fusion rule combining per-class spectral ranking with activation-clustering flags into a single per-sample poisoning score and a model-level agreement statistic; an open-source implementation of the resulting eight-stage pipeline; and an evaluation of that pipeline against synthetically poisoned variants of a public medical imaging benchmark and CIFAR-10 at four poisoning rates (0%, 1%, 5%, 10%) over five seeds each, measuring each detector alone against the fusion. On the medical benchmark, the fused detector reaches AUROC >= 0.99 at every nonzero poisoning rate tested. On CIFAR-10, fusion does not uniformly help: at 10% poisoning, activation clustering's true-positive rate collapses to 0.000 and spectral AUROC independently degrades to near-chance (0.545), despite a 97.2% attack success rate confirming the backdoor was fully installed. The fused score, a weighted combination of both signals, inherits this joint failure. Detection output is expressed in NIST AI RMF Measure-function and MITRE ATLAS terms, so findings are reported in the vocabulary security and compliance teams already use.

</details>


### [371] [Cryptanalytic Extraction of Neural Networks Without Known Architecture Assumption](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14379)
*Yantian Shen,Yi Chen,Anyu Wang,Hongbo Yu,Xiaoyun Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文首次去除密码分析式提取攻击中"已知网络架构"的假设，针对ReLU全连接网络提出"猜测-确定"框架，联合恢复架构与参数，实现端到端攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有密码分析式提取攻击均默认攻击者已知网络架构（如深度与各隐藏层维度），这一假设过强，限制了攻击的现实适用性。本文旨在研究能否去除该假设，仅凭黑盒原始输出同时恢复网络架构与参数。

Method: 提出猜测-确定（guess-and-determine）框架，核心观察是维度猜测会在参数恢复过程中留下对架构敏感的可识别痕迹。具体发现两类痕迹：(i) 签名恢复所得合并权重向量中的"零后缀"，其长度揭示多余猜测数；(ii) 基于原像的符号恢复中的"相等模式"，仅在维度猜测正确时出现。二者构成两条互补的恢复路径，并进一步提出两个识别倒数第二层的判据以终止猜测过程。

Result: 在多种ReLU网络上实现了端到端攻击，涵盖扩张型（expansive）与非扩张型（non-expansive）架构，验证了框架在未知架构条件下的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文提出首个无需已知网络架构的密码分析式提取攻击，通过维度猜测留下的两类痕迹实现架构与参数的联合恢复，并可借助倒数第二层判据终止猜测，显著放宽了攻击假设。

Abstract: Cryptanalytic extraction attacks recover the parameters of a neural network given only black-box access to its raw output. However, all existing attacks rely on a fundamental assumption: the attacker knows the network architecture. For example, regarding ReLU activation-based fully connected networks, the network depth and the dimension of each hidden layer are known.
  In this paper, we study whether this assumption can be removed. We focus on ReLU fully connected networks and propose a guess-and-determine framework that recovers the architecture and the parameters jointly. The core of our approach is a simple but powerful observation: dimension guessing leaves architecture-sensitive traces in the parameter recovery process. We identify two such traces: (i) a \emph{zero suffix} in the merged weight vectors produced by signature recovery, whose length reveals the number of excess guesses; and (ii) an \emph{equality pattern} in the preimage-based sign recovery, which occurs only when the dimension guess is correct. These two signals give rise to two complementary recovery routes. We further propose two criteria for identifying the second-to-last layer, which is necessary for terminating the guessing process. We implement end-to-end attacks on a wide range of ReLU networks, including both expansive and non-expansive architectures. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first cryptanalytic extraction attack that removes the assumption of known network architecture.

</details>


### [372] [Quantifying Observable High-Frequency Swapping on Arbitrum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14481)
*Shijian Chen,Ya Chen,Jing Cai,Catherine Liu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文首次提出"高频兑换"(HFS)概念，基于Arbitrum 18个月全链数据构建可复现管线，识别出477个HFS兑换者，完成约3000万笔兑换、名义成交额超10^11美元的系统性实证刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Layer-2 rollup以确定性排序、亚秒级出块和极低gas费改变了以太坊交易经济，抑制了经典MEV，却催生了一种此前未被识别的行为模式；该现象虽规模渐增，但缺乏系统性识别与量化研究。

Method: 在Arbitrum上开展大规模测量，使用2023年1月至2024年6月共18个月全链数据；构建可复现管线：筛选自愿性单跳兑换交易、归因至兑换者地址层面，并基于到达间隔动态对HFS行为进行分类；随后从多维度做实证分析。

Result: 识别出477个独立的HFS兑换者，累计近3000万笔兑换，名义成交额超过10^11美元；在其活动模式、时间动态、兑换者身份、代币覆盖、场所集中度、兑换规模、时间间隔与订单方向等维度上均发现区别于常规零售或套利活动的结构性规律。

Conclusion: 本文提供了Arbitrum上高频兑换的大规模地址级实证刻画，并揭示稳定币套利、CEX-DEX执行缺口与短周期往返交易等案例行为，为去中心化市场微观结构的后续研究奠定了广泛的实证基础。

Abstract: Layer-2 rollups have reshaped Ethereum's transaction economy by replacing mempool competition with deterministic sequencing, sub-second block times, and negligible gas fees. While these properties suppress classical Miner/Maximal Extractable Value (MEV), they give rise to a new and previously unrecognized behavioral regime. In this paper, we introduce the concept of High-Frequency Swapping (HFS), referring to continuous single-hop swaps at machine cadence within decentralized exchanges. Despite its growing footprint, this phenomenon has not been systematically identified or quantified in prior work. We conduct a large-scale measurement of HFS on Arbitrum, using 18 months of full-chain data (Jan. 2023--Jun. 2024). Specifically, we construct a reproducible pipeline that isolates voluntary single-swap transactions, attributes them to the swapper level, and classifies HFS behavior through inter-arrival dynamics. The analysis uncovers 477 distinct HFS swappers responsible for nearly 30 million swaps and over $10^{11}$ USD in notional volume. Our study conducts a comprehensive empirical investigation of HFS from multiple perspectives. We begin with a global overview of activity patterns, and then examine temporal dynamics, swapper identity, token coverage, and venue concentration, and explore swap size, time gap, and order direction. Finally, we explore case-level behavior, including stablecoin arbitrage, CEX-DEX execution gaps, and short-horizon round-trip trading. Across these dimensions, we identify consistent structural regularities that distinguish HFS from conventional retail or arbitrage activity. This work provides a large-scale address-level empirical characterization of High-Frequency Swapping on Arbitrum and a broad empirical foundation for future research on decentralized market microstructure.

</details>


### [373] [SENTINEL: A Multi-Pathway Architecture for Detecting Living-Off-the-Land APT Attacks on Windows Command Lines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14593)
*Ahad Bin Islam Shoeb,Kamrul Hasan,Jamal Uddin Tanvin,Liang Hong,Imtiaz Ahmed,Md Arif Billah,Al Amin*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出SENTINEL，一种多路径架构，通过结合BERT语义编码、字符级CNN、命令间注意力机制与自编码器异常评分，检测利用合法Windows工具的高级持续性威胁（LOTL）攻击，在Volt Typhoon基准上显著优于单独BERT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LOTL是APT攻击者主导的规避技术，利用合法Windows工具执行恶意操作而无需部署定制恶意软件，使国家级攻击活动能在军事与关键防御基础设施中长期潜伏。现有检测方法无法应对混淆命令和多阶段攻击序列，如Volt Typhoon利用纯签名Windows工具在美国关键基础设施中潜伏超过18个月未被发现。

Method: SENTINEL采用多路径架构，整合四种组件：基于BERT的语义编码、用于混淆不变性的字符级CNN、用于多阶段模式识别的命令间注意力机制，以及基于自编码器的异常评分。

Result: 在基于Microsoft和CISA威胁情报构建的平衡Volt Typhoon基准上，SENTINEL对已记录的国家级攻击命令达到92.0%准确率，对混淆变体达91.2%，而单独BERT分别为74.0%和72.0%。逐类分析显示，在非平衡数据上总体验证准确率超98%的模型，在平衡对抗集上恶意召回率仅44-58%。字符级处理贡献5.6个百分点的混淆不变性，相比仅数据增强基线高出8.0个百分点。

Conclusion: 多路径架构设计在数据驱动鲁棒性之外具有结构性价值，字符级处理与命令间注意力等组件对检测混淆和多阶段LOTL攻击至关重要；同时揭示高总体准确率在非平衡数据上会掩盖低恶意召回率的问题。

Abstract: Living-Off-the-Land (LOTL) is the dominant evasion technique of Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) actors, exploiting legitimate Windows utilities to conduct malicious operations without deploying custom malware and enabling state-sponsored campaigns to maintain persistent access within military and critical defense infrastructure for extended periods. Existing detection methods fail against obfuscated commands and multi-stage attack sequences, as demonstrated by the Volt Typhoon APT campaign, which maintained undetected access to U.S. critical infrastructure for over 18 months using exclusively signed Windows utilities. We present SENTINEL, a multi-pathway architecture integrating BERT-based semantic encoding, character-level CNN for obfuscation invariance, inter-command attention for multi-stage pattern recognition, and autoencoder-based anomaly scoring. Evaluated on a balanced Volt Typhoon benchmark derived from Microsoft and CISA threat intelligence advisories, SENTINEL achieves 92.0% accuracy on documented state-sponsored attack commands and 91.2% on obfuscated variants, compared to 74.0% and 72.0% for standalone BERT. Per-class analysis reveals that models achieving over 98% overall validation accuracy on imbalanced data exhibit only 44-58% malicious recall on balanced adversarial sets. Character-level processing contributes 5.6 percentage points of obfuscation invariance, and the 8.0 percentage point gap over augmentation-only baselines confirms structural architectural value beyond data-driven robustness alone.

</details>


### [374] [LLM Agent Capabilities Should Follow Task Intent and Context Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14631)
*Yusheng Zheng,Wenhui Zhang,Yu Mao*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 IntentCap，将 LLM Agent 的能力作用域绑定到当前任务意图，通过多源权限组合与单调收窄实现最小权限控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM Agent 会执行代码、修改文件、调用服务与委派任务，其所需最小权限随任务意图动态变化，无法像传统系统那样预定义。现有问题在于：所有上下文来源（用户请求、工具结果、文档、Shell 输出、Skill/MCP 指令、记忆）进入同一规划通道且影响等同，但信任级别不同；对抗性注入或意外作用域扩大可能导致权限被滥用。既有防御只约束操作与信息流，缺少对"任务级、多源权限组合"的研究。

Method: 提出"任务意图作用域"能力模型（而非沙箱或会话生命周期的固定授权），并实现 IntentCap：从用户意图、工作流指令、工具 Schema、运行时环境四类来源组合能力，采用字段级所有权与单调收窄原则——每个来源只贡献特定字段，任一来源不能填充他人的字段，租约只能收窄用户已授权限、绝不扩大。系统用 LLM 生成短期租约，由确定性检查器在任何副作用提交前校验，并通过工具级与 OS 级信息流策略强制执行。

Result: 评估显示：IntentCap 能阻断测试中的违规行为且不误拒良性操作；各来源边界均独立必要；检查器可泛化到工具、执行、放置与委派等不同边界。

Conclusion: Agent 能力应按任务意图而非沙箱/会话边界进行作用域限定，且任何单一上下文来源都不足以定义完整能力；多源组合加字段级所有权、单调收窄与确定性校验，可有效防御注入与作用域扩大攻击，同时保持正常功能可用。

Abstract: LLM agents take real actions, including executing code, modifying files, calling services, and delegating tasks, driven by context sources: user requests, tool results, documents, shell outputs, Skill and MCP instructions, memory. Unlike traditional systems, where capability is predefined, the least-privilege capability an agent needs is dynamic, depending on its task intent: what it wants to do and how. This creates a security and safety challenge: all inputs enter one shared planning channel with equal influence, by adversarial injection or accidental scope widening, yet a user's explicit request and a document's extracted text carry different trust and should not share authority to choose a destination or widen access. Existing defenses constrain operations and information flow; we study task-scoped, multi-source authority composition.
  We argue that agent capabilities should be scoped to the current task intent, not a sandbox or session lifetime, and that no single context source defines a complete capability. IntentCap composes capabilities from four such sources: user intent, workflow instructions, tool schemas, and runtime environment, with field-level ownership and monotonic narrowing. Each source contributes specific fields, none can fill another's, and the lease only narrows the user's authorized authority, never widens it. IntentCap uses an LLM to generate short-lived leases from these sources, validated by a deterministic checker before any side effect commits and enforced by tool- and OS-level information flow policies. Evaluation shows IntentCap blocks tested violations without rejecting benign actions, each source boundary is independently necessary, and the checker generalizes across tool, execution, placement, and delegation boundaries.

</details>


### [375] [CIG-MIA: Context-Induced Information Gain Membership Inference Attacks against Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14649)
*Tan Xue,Huo Chang,Wang Changhui,Yang Sanrui,Li Heng,Chen Ping,Luo Xiapu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出CIG-MIA，一种基于上下文诱导信息增益的RAG知识库成员推断攻击方法，在灰盒与纯文本黑盒设定下均取得优秀效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG系统通过检索接口暴露“候选文档是否存在于知识库”这一信息，构成成员隐私风险；现有成员推断攻击依赖直接成员提示、响应相似度、掩码恢复或查询扰动等信号，易受提示防御、语义相关检索文档及生成器参数化知识影响，鲁棒性不足。

Method: 提出CIG-MIA：核心洞察是显式注入候选文档对成员与非成员影响不同——若文档已可被检索到，注入对文档衍生答案提供额外支持很小；若不存在，注入引入新证据带来更大似然增益。灰盒设定下直接从token级似然计算该增益；黑盒设定下用基于轻量代理估计器、结合语义相似度与精确匹配特征的生成文本评分来估计同一增益。

Result: 在Natural Questions、MS-MARCO和HealthCareMagic上对比近期RAG成员推断基线；在Natural Questions上灰盒设定AUC达0.99，黑盒设定AUC达0.93；并分析信息增益信号、RAG配置影响、消融实验及对改写与生成随机性的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: CIG-MIA以信息增益为核心信号，有效实现灰盒与黑盒RAG成员推断，性能优于现有基线且对多种干扰因素具备鲁棒性。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems ground large language models on external knowledge bases, enabling access to private, domain-specific, and up-to-date knowledge without retraining. However, the same retrieval interface can expose whether a candidate document is contained in the knowledge base. This paper studies knowledge base membership inference against RAG systems under both gray-box and text-only black-box access. Existing RAG membership inference attacks rely on signals such as direct membership prompts, response similarity, mask recovery, or query perturbation, which can be sensitive to prompt defenses, semantically related retrieved documents, and the generator's parametric knowledge. We introduce CIG-MIA, a membership inference attack based on context-induced information gain. The key insight is that explicit candidate-document injection affects members and non-members differently: if a document is already available through retrieval, injection provides little additional support for document-derived answers; if it is absent, injection introduces new evidence and yields a larger likelihood gain. In the gray-box setting, CIG-MIA computes this gain directly from token-level likelihoods. In the black-box setting, it estimates the same gain from generated text by scoring selected answer tokens with a lightweight surrogate-based estimator using semantic similarity and exact-match features. We evaluate CIG-MIA on Natural Questions, MS-MARCO, and HealthCareMagic against recent RAG membership inference baselines. On Natural Questions, CIG-MIA achieves an AUC of 0.99 in the gray-box setting and 0.93 in the black-box setting. We further analyze the information-gain signal, RAG configuration effects, ablations, and robustness to paraphrasing and generation randomness.

</details>


### [376] [Mitigating 51% Attacks in Blockchain Systems Through Early Detection and Checkpoint-Based Defense](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14670)
*Victor Kebande*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种“哈希算力监控预警 + 检查点限制重组深度”的两层防御机制，并通过蒙特卡洛仿真验证其可降低51%攻击的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PoW区块链中51%攻击是重要安全隐患：算力集中可能形成恶意多数控制，进而实现对抗性链重组。因此需要一种能在临界阈值前预警、并在攻击发生后限制重组破坏的防御方案。

Method: 提出两层防御框架。第一层持续监控挖矿算力集中度，在达到多数控制临界阈值前提供早期预警；第二层采用检查点机制限制可接受的链重组深度。使用蒙特卡洛仿真在不同攻击场景下评估两种机制，共进行1,000次仿真运行。

Result: 在1,000次仿真中，45%预警阈值相对50%临界阈值可提供平均10.531分钟的预警提前量。在检查点深度N=6时，约63.68%的模拟重组尝试被拒绝，平均重组深度由7.948个区块降至1.634个区块，降幅约79.4%。

Conclusion: 在评估条件下，早期检测与基于检查点的缓解措施构成互补机制，可有效降低51%攻击的潜在影响。

Abstract: The 51% attack remains one of the significant security concern in Proof-of-Work (PoW) blockchains, where increasing hash-power concentration can create a malicious majority-control risk and enable adversarial chain reorganization. This paper proposes a two-layer defense that combines early hash-power monitoring with checkpoint-based mitigation. The first layer monitors mining-power concentration and provides an early warning before the critical majority-control threshold is reached. The second layer uses checkpointing to restrict the depth of accepted chain reorganizations. Monte Carlo simulations are used to evaluate both mechanisms under different attack scenarios. Across 1,000 simulation runs, a 45% warning threshold provided a mean warning-to-critical lead time of 10.531 minutes before the modeled 50% critical threshold was reached. At the selected checkpoint depth of N = 6, approximately 63.68% of simulated reorganization attempts were rejected, while the mean reorganization-depth outcome decreased from 7.948 to 1.634 blocks, representing an approximately 79.4% reduction. The results demonstrate that early detection and checkpoint-based mitigation provide complementary mechanisms for reducing the potential impact of 51% attacks under the evaluated conditions.

</details>


### [377] [ViTeGate: Visual-Textual Triggered Knowledge Poisoning for Vision-Language Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14685)
*Xue Tan,Xuandi Zeng,Yu Shao,Zhongli Fang,Mingyu Luo,Xiaoyan Sun,Ping Chen,Jun Dai*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出ViTeGate——针对视觉语言检索增强生成系统的"视觉+文本"双触发器知识投毒攻击，通过视觉触发器将毒化证据推入检索结果、文本触发器诱发攻击者指定回复，实现选择性激活，在InfoSeek上攻击成功率最高达0.98，同时干净答案准确率最高达0.93。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代视觉语言检索增强生成（VLRAG）系统通过检索外部图文证据增强大型视觉语言模型（LVLM），但检索流程引入攻击面：攻击者可向知识库注入毒化的图文对影响模型输出。现有知识投毒攻击多为"常开式"（always-on），只要毒化证据被检索即会干扰生成，缺乏精确的激活控制，难以将恶意行为局限于目标输入，从而降低攻击的隐蔽性与有效性。因此需要一种可按条件选择性激活的投毒攻击机制。

Method: 提出ViTeGate双触发器知识投毒攻击框架：1）视觉触发器（visual trigger）用于条件性地将毒化证据提升至检索结果中；2）文本触发器（textual trigger）用于诱导检索到的毒化证据产生攻击者指定的回复。通过协同检索与生成两个阶段，当视觉触发器缺失时降低毒化证据暴露，当文本触发器缺失时保持正常回复，从而支持攻击的选择性激活并减少单一触发器导致的意外触发。

Result: 在多个查询数据集、检索器与LVLM上进行实验验证了ViTeGate的有效性。在InfoSeek数据集上，ViTeGate取得最高0.98的攻击成功率（ASR），同时保持最高0.93的干净答案准确率（clean answer accuracy）。

Conclusion: ViTeGate通过视觉与文本双触发器协同，实现了对VLRAG系统知识投毒攻击的选择性、精确激活，兼顾了高攻击成功率与正常任务性能，揭示了VLRAG检索—生成链路中条件化投毒的现实威胁。

Abstract: Modern Vision-Language Retrieval-Augmented Generation (VLRAG) systems augment Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) with retrieved visual and textual evidence, enabling responses grounded in external knowledge. However, the retrieval pipeline also creates an attack surface: adversaries can inject poisoned image-text pairs into the knowledge corpus to influence model outputs. Existing knowledge poisoning attacks are typically always-on, allowing poisoned evidence to affect generation whenever it is retrieved. This lack of precise activation control makes it difficult to confine malicious behavior to intended inputs, reducing both attack stealth and effectiveness. In this paper, we propose ViTeGate, a visual-textual triggered knowledge poisoning attack for VLRAG systems. ViTeGate uses a visual trigger to conditionally promote poisoned evidence into retrieval results and a textual trigger to induce an attacker-specified response from the retrieved evidence. By coordinating retrieval and generation, ViTeGate reduces poison exposure when the visual trigger is absent and preserves normal responses when the textual trigger is absent. The two-trigger design enables selective attack activation and reduces unintended single-trigger activation. Experiments across multiple query datasets, retrievers, and LVLMs validate the effectiveness of ViTeGate. On InfoSeek, ViTeGate achieves an attack success rate of up to 0.98 while maintaining a clean answer accuracy of up to 0.93.

</details>


### [378] [Detecting and Localizing Segment-Level Poisoning in Multi-Source LLM-Agent Inputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14723)
*Xue Tan,Changhui Wang,Sanrui Yang,Hao Luan,Zhuyang Yu,Jin Wei,Ping Chen,Xiaoyan Sun,Jun Dai*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出ActProbe框架，通过LLM内部激活的"poison direction"检测并定位多源输入中的投毒片段，无需修改后端模型，性能优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代LLM代理通过聚合多源检索段落、评论和文档构建提示，面临片段级投毒攻击。现有防御依赖文本模式、外部嵌入或辅助检测器，难以应对流畅且语义合理的投毒片段，且定位责任片段能力有限。

Method: 观察到成功攻击会在LLM内部激活中引发结构化偏移，形成一致的"poison direction"。ActProbe将MLP激活投影到学习的毒化方向，用少量校准集训练轻量线性SVM检测污染提示；再用BinRoL（递归替换消融、马氏距离分支剪枝、MAD鲁棒叶检测）定位投毒片段。无需修改后端LLM，将定位开销从O(n)降至O(k log n)。

Result: 在三个数据集、两种攻击、四个开源LLM上，ActProbe实现0.01假阳性率、0.05假阴性率、0.94定位召回率、0.90定位F1。对防御感知的自适应攻击仍有效，并可通过替代模型实现黑盒API的投毒片段移除。

Conclusion: ActProbe利用内部激活空间结构有效检测和定位多源LLM输入中的投毒片段，鲁棒性强且计算高效，可扩展至黑盒场景。

Abstract: Modern large language model (LLM) agents often construct prompts by aggregating retrieved passages, user reviews, and documents from multiple external sources. This paradigm exposes them to segment-level poisoning attacks, in which an adversary controlling only a small subset of sources injects malicious content to manipulate model outputs. Existing defenses mainly rely on textual patterns, external embeddings, or auxiliary detectors and may therefore fail against fluent, semantically plausible poisoned segments. They also provide limited support for locating the responsible segments. We observe that successful corrupted-evidence and adversarial-instruction attacks induce structured shifts in the LLM's internal activations, forming a consistent activation-space pattern that we call the poison direction. Based on this observation, we propose ActProbe, an internal-state-based framework for detecting and localizing poisoned segments in multi-source LLM inputs. ActProbe projects MLP activations onto a learned poison direction and uses a lightweight linear SVM trained on a small calibration set to detect contaminated prompts. It then applies BinRoL, which combines recursive replacement ablation, Mahalanobis-distance-based branch pruning, and MAD-based robust leaf detection to locate poisoned segments. ActProbe requires no modification to the backend LLM and reduces localization overhead from O(n) exhaustive probing to O(k log n) forward passes. Across three datasets, two attacks, and four open-weight LLMs, ActProbe achieves a 0.01 false-positive rate, a 0.05 false-negative rate, 0.94 localization recall, and a 0.90 localization F1-score. It remains effective against defense-aware adaptive attacks and can protect black-box APIs through surrogate-based poisoned-segment removal.

</details>


### [379] [Trinqet: Private Triangle and Quadrangle Counting over Distributed Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14737)
*Mushtari Sadia,Amrita Roy Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 Trinqet，一个面向安全多方计算（MPC）场景的私有三角形与四边形检测系统，通过新颖的 MPC 友好算法在保持恶意威胁模型下强安全性的同时安全地利用图的稀疏性，消除大量冗余操作，运行时间最高比五个基线快 10^5 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三角形和四边形计数是图分析中的核心统计量，但许多真实图分布在不同参与方之间且关系高度敏感，无法直接共享数据。MPC 提供了一种原则性替代方案，但存在根本性矛盾：协议必须隐藏图拓扑，因而需对所有潜在边执行完全数据无关（data-oblivious）的操作，而真实图极度稀疏，导致绝大多数计算被浪费。

Method: 提出 Trinqet 系统，针对私有三角形和四边形检测设计新的 MPC 友好算法。其核心是一套新颖技术，能够在恶意威胁模型下保持强安全性的前提下，安全地利用图稀疏性，消除大量不必要的操作。系统同时支持计数与枚举两种任务。

Result: 在评估中，Trinqet 的运行时间优于全部五个基线，最高提速达 10^5 倍。

Conclusion: Trinqet 有效缓解了 MPC 隐私保护与图稀疏性之间的根本矛盾，在保证恶意模型下强安全性的同时实现了高效的私有三角形和四边形计数与枚举，显著超越现有基线，为分布式敏感图分析提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Triangle and quadrangle counts are core statistics in graph analysis. Yet many real-world graphs are distributed across multiple parties and encode highly sensitive relationships, precluding direct data sharing. Secure multi-party computation (MPC) provides a principled alternative, but introduces a fundamental tension: the protocol must hide the graph's topology, forcing fully data-oblivious operations over all potential edges--while real-world graphs are extremely sparse, making most of this work wasted. We propose Trinqet, a system that resolves this tension through new MPC-friendly algorithms for private triangle and quadrangle detection. Trinqet safely exploits sparsity using a suite of novel techniques that eliminate vast numbers of unnecessary operations while preserving strong security in the malicious threat model. Trinqet supports both counting and enumeration and, in our evaluation, outperforms all five baselines by up to 10^5 in runtime.

</details>


### [380] [PIMENTO: A Privacy Framework for Querying Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14745)
*Mushtari Sadia,Ang Chen,Amrita Roy Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: Pimento框架将文本语料、查询与隐私策略统一映射为关系数据库，从而在自然语言分析中同时形式化地实现情境完整性(CI)与差分隐私(DP)保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CI约束“信息可流向何处”，DP约束“可推断出什么”，二者互补，但都难以直接对应自然语言，导致面向非结构化文本的分析无法获得这些隐私保证。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: Pimento接收三种自然语言输入（文本语料、查询、隐私策略），将其落地为关系数据库这一共同基础，并在其上形式化强制CI与DP。三项关键技术贡献：DP感知的Text-to-SQL（寻找所需DP噪声最小的正确查询）；CI感知的Text-to-SQL（把自然语言策略编译为数据库上可执行的CI规则）；以及新定义的“情境差分隐私”，在CI下重定义传统DP邻域并给出更紧的平滑敏感度界。

Result: 在新基准上，Pimento在75.3%的情况下选出最佳查询（较基线最高提升45个百分点），并在策略正确落地时实现零泄漏。

Conclusion: Pimento是首个在CI、DP及其组合下为自然语言分析提供形式化隐私保证的框架，同时兼顾端到端隐私保障与效用提升。

Abstract: Currently, there are two state-of-the-art, complementary privacy guarantees: contextual integrity (CI) for what may flow, and differential privacy (DP) for what may be inferred. Yet neither maps cleanly onto natural language, leaving existing approaches unable to provide these guarantees for analytics over unstructured text. We address this gap with Pimento, a framework that takes three forms of natural language: text corpus, queries, and privacy policies; and grounds them into a relational database, creating a common substrate on which both guarantees can be enforced formally. With this design, we not only provide end to end privacy guarantees, but also improvement to utility through three key contributions: DP aware Text-to-SQL, which searches for correct queries requiring the least DP noise; CI aware Text-to-SQL, which compiles natural language policies into executable CI rules over the database; and a new privacy definition we call contextual differential privacy, which redefines the traditional DP neighborhood under CI, and yields a tighter smooth sensitivity bound. Across new benchmarks, Pimento selects the best query in 75.3% of cases (upto +45 points over baselines) and achieves zero leakage under correct policy grounding. To our knowledge, Pimento is the first framework to provide formal privacy guarantees for natural language analytics under CI, DP, and their composition.

</details>


### [381] [The Stochastic Deputy: Structural Tenant Isolation for Tool-Using LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14780)
*Mirza Samad Ahmed Baig,Syeda Anshrah Gillani,Asher Ali,Muhammad Hamzah Siddiqui*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文将"多租户工具把租户标识交给可能被注入指令的LLM代理"形式化为随机代理问题，提出结构性防御：从MCP工具模式中移除租户身份、把作用域绑定到已验证凭证并在代理下层强制执行；实验表明移除参数可阻断越权读取，但仍需密码学保护的上下文以防伪造可写作用域，同时评估了集合型作用域的性能代价与部署限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多租户工具通常接受租户标识并对照调用方权限进行校验，但当调用方是LLM代理时，资源选择被委托给一个上下文可能含攻击者可控指令的进程，导致越权访问风险；现有依赖模型合规性的做法不可靠，需要可强制执行的接口与凭证层面的隔离机制。

Method: 将问题形式化为随机代理问题；提出结构性防御：从MCP工具模式中删除租户身份、将作用域绑定到已验证凭证、在代理下层执行强制；通过373次试验、8种模型配置、2种传输方式的消融实验验证；在生产级多GB数据集上比较集合型作用域下函数包装成员谓词与JSON_TABLE横向连接的延迟表现。

Result: 带正确校验的租户参数在26/26次越界尝试（41次可信借口试验中的26次）中被成功利用；移除参数后无工具签名可表达该读取，但56次试验中有12次通过伪造可写作用域逃逸接口；集合型作用域在函数包装成员谓词下产生57倍延迟比，JSON_TABLE横向连接在租户键有索引时恢复索引访问；同时暴露权限规模导致的查询规划器悬崖与索引覆盖不完整等部署限制。

Conclusion: 租户隔离应依赖可强制执行的接口和凭证，而非模型合规性；接口不变性需要密码学保护的上下文，且需关注作用域表示带来的性能与部署约束。

Abstract: Multi-tenant tools commonly accept a tenant identifier and validate it against the caller's entitlement. For a large language model (LLM) agent, that pattern delegates resource selection to a process whose context may contain attacker controlled instructions. We formalize this stochastic deputy problem and present a structural defense: remove tenant identity from the Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool schema, bind scope to a verified credential, and enforce it below the agent. In a 373-trial ablation across eight model configurations and two transports, a correctly validated tenant parameter served every out-of-scope attempt: 26 of 26, or 26 of 41 plausible-pretext trials overall. With the parameter removed, no tool signature could express the read. Twelve of 56 trials instead escaped the interface by forging writable scope, showing that interface invariance requires cryptographically protected context. On a production dataset containing multiple GBs of data, set-valued scope caused a measured $57\times$ latency ratio under function-wrapped membership predicates; a JSON_TABLE lateral join recovered index access where the tenant key was indexed. The evaluation also exposes deployment limits, including an entitlement-size query-planner cliff and incomplete index coverage. The result is a tenant-isolation argument that depends on enforceable interfaces and credentials rather than model compliance.

</details>


### [382] [Python Import as an Execution Boundary: An Empirical Study of Bugs, Vulnerabilities, and Analysis Gaps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14791)
*Baihong Chen,Wen Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 ImportMine，系统研究 Python 中由 import 引发的缺陷与安全漏洞，结合安全公告、PyPI 项目历史与源码/补丁证据，确认 31 个公告漏洞、38 个应用-数据边界案例及 1,302 个仓库中的 1,429 个项目历史缺陷，并构建 ImportVulBench 基准（228 对修复前后程序，覆盖 11 类缺陷）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Python 的 import 不仅解析依赖，还会在模块/包初始化时执行代码，可能触发失败、加载动态/原生代码、访问资源或改变安全敏感状态。既有工作多关注包选择、恶意包或包漏洞，缺乏对 import 相关缺陷与安全漏洞的系统性认识。

Method: 结合安全公告与 PyPI 项目历史，利用源码与补丁证据确认 import 激活条件、成因、修复方式及解释该行为所需的程序信息；统计并归类 import 相关缺陷类型。

Result: 保留 31 个 import 相关公告漏洞和 38 个应用-数据边界案例，在 1,302 个仓库中确认 1,429 个项目历史缺陷；初始化期激活的项目历史缺陷中 97.6% 中断或干扰正常执行，而 20 个初始化激活的公告漏洞中 90.0% 为高危或严重；模块级代码与包初始化激活了 98.3% 的分析案例；动态加载虽较少见，但多数执行安全敏感操作；许多修复通过改变 import 激活时机而非移除依赖；最终导出 ImportVulBench（228 对修复前后程序，覆盖全部 11 种缺陷类型）。

Conclusion: import 的初始化副作用是 Python 软件中一类普遍且严重的缺陷与安全漏洞来源，且常被现有工作忽视；通过系统化证据与 ImportVulBench 基准，为后续检测、评估与修复研究提供支持。

Abstract: Python import does more than resolve dependencies: it executes code during module and package initialization. This behavior can trigger failures, load dynamic or native code, access resources, or change security-sensitive state before an application calls a package API. Prior work studies package selection, malicious packages, or package vulnerabilities. We present ImportMine, a study of import-related bugs and security vulnerabilities in Python software. We combine security advisories with PyPI project histories and use source and patch evidence to confirm how import activates cases, why the problem occurs, how developers fix it, and what program information is needed to explain the behavior. We retain 31 import-related advisory vulnerabilities and 38 application-data boundary cases and confirm 1,429 project-history bugs across 1,302 repositories. Among the project-history bugs activated during initialization, 97.6% stop or disrupt normal execution. In contrast, 90.0% of the 20 initialization- activated advisory vulnerabilities are High or Critical. Module-level code and package initialization activate 98.3% of the analyzed history cases. Dynamic loading is much less common, but most of its cases perform security-sensitive actions. We also find that many fixes change when an import becomes active instead of removing the dependency. Finally, we derive ImportVulBench, 228 paired pre-fix and fixed programs covering all 11 bug types.

</details>


### [383] [When Apps Outlive Vendors: Security Implications of IoT Abandonware](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14798)
*Dayeon Kang,Elvis Yeboah-Duako,Sachin Thomas,Pubali Datta*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文首次对"IoT abandonware"（被厂商放弃支持的IoT伴侣应用）进行大规模安全测量，分析61,500款Android应用，发现73.6%存在安全风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IoT市场扩张带来大量伴侣应用，厂商停止支持后这些应用仍留在用户设备上运行并采集数据，却不再获得安全更新，导致已知及新发现的漏洞无法修补，增加远程利用、未授权设备访问和长期数据滥用风险。

Method: 以截至2025年3月至少两年未更新或已停止服务的61,500款IoT伴侣Android应用为样本，从反编译二进制中提取潜在与嵌入资源（如捆绑库、域名、权限）；识别含放弃后CVE报告的过时依赖及易被接管或数据外泄的域名；并进行静态数据流分析，追踪由权限推断的敏感数据如何传播至失效或可劫持的外部端点。

Result: 数据集中73.6%的应用存在安全风险；持久化的分析SDK与第三方追踪器在厂商失去控制后仍持续汇聚用户数据与设备遥测，形成可被攻击者重定向或滥用的数据流；安装量前1000的应用中有30款将数据发送至失效的外部端点。

Conclusion: 被放弃支持的IoT伴侣应用构成普遍且被忽视的安全隐患，其遗留的数据流与依赖漏洞在厂商失去支持后长期存续，需要针对abandonware的系统性检测与治理。

Abstract: As the Internet of Things (IoT) market continues to expand, many companion apps are being published in app stores, raising security concerns for those whose vendors have abandoned support. Even after vendors discontinue support, such applications frequently remain operational on users' mobile devices, continue to interface with users' IoT devices and collect user data without receiving security updates. This leaves known and newly discovered vulnerabilities unmitigated, increasing risks of remote exploitation, unauthorized device access, and prolonged data misuse. We define these abandoned applications as "IoT abandonware" and present the first large-scale measurement study of the security risks associated with discontinued applications.
  We analyze 61,500 IoT companion Android applications that had not been updated for at least two years or were no longer in service as of March 2025. From decompiled binaries, we extracted latent and embedded resources (e.g., bundled libraries, domain names, and permissions), and assessed their security implications. First, we identify outdated dependencies with post-abandonment CVE reports and discover domains vulnerable to takeover or data exfiltration. Second, we perform static data-flow analysis to trace how sensitive data, inferred from the extracted permissions, propagates to broken or hijackable external endpoints. We found that persistent analytics and third-party trackers continue aggregating user data and device telemetry long after vendor control lapses, creating data flows that adversaries can redirect or abuse. Overall, we identified security risks in 73.6% of our dataset, with 30 of the top 1,000 most-installed apps sending data to broken external endpoints.

</details>


### [384] [Reversibility-Verified De-identification for Cloud-Local LLM Inference: A Locally Certified Dehydrate-Rehydrate Loop with Layered Assurance (DR-SL)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14883)
*Wen Hu,Ya Yu,Xutong Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出DR-SL（脱水-复水+自学习环）框架，将去标识化完备性形式化为两个可测条件（Pufferfish语义下的充分性与QA探针任务信息保持），用本地双分支验证器在字典序门控下迭代脱水，并配套硬性红线、外部强攻击者复测与人工兜底。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云端级推理能力与敏感数据须留本地之间存在根本矛盾：现有脱敏手段（占位符替换、差分隐私扰动、技能蒸馏）都缺少一个同时兼顾安全与效用的"发布决策"机制，难以判定某条样本是否可以安全出域。

Method: DR-SL：1）用Pufferfish语义刻画去标识充分性，用QA探针度量任务信息保持；2）完全本地的双分支验证器在字典序门控下迭代脱水，保证终止；3）辅以确定性硬红线、外部强攻击者重测与人工兜底；4）理论上给出Fano型下界、Pufferfish见证与速率-隐私可行性判据。

Result: 最坏情况全任务耦合基准上，泄漏率由0.457降至0.304（p≈0）；发布链在出口处实现0.000字面泄漏（160实例、两种强攻击者），且系统按可行性判据预测退化为认证-路由。混合耦合基准上，同一安全点自动发布67.5%实例且零实测泄漏，在相同发布规则下帕累托优于占位符与选择性LDP方案。两项人类研究锚定语义效用指标（Spearman ρ=0.839）与标注金标准（类型级召回≥0.987）。自学习假设未被支持，如实报告。全部理论边界通过数值验证，代码、合成数据、协议与人类研究包均公开。

Conclusion: 理论边界只证明泄漏上限而非安全性保证，且在当前工作点近乎空泛，因此发布安全性实际依赖经验校准、硬红线与人工复核。DR-SL在安全-效用权衡上优于现有脱敏范式，但自学习机制的假设未获支持，未来需在更广泛耦合场景下进一步验证其可扩展性。

Abstract: Cloud-local LLM inference must keep sensitive user data on-device while exploiting cloud-grade reasoning, yet existing sanitization approaches (placeholder substitution, differential-privacy perturbation, and skill distillation) lack a release decision that is simultaneously safe and utility-preserving. We propose DR-SL (Dehydrate-Rehydrate with Self-Learning loop), which formalizes de-identification completeness as two measurable conditions: de-identification sufficiency under Pufferfish semantics, and task-information preservation via QA probes. A fully local two-branch verifier iterates dehydration under a lexicographic gate with guaranteed termination, backed by a deterministic hard line, an external strong-attacker re-test, and human fallback. We prove Fano-type lower bounds, a Pufferfish witness, and a rate-privacy feasibility criterion, and state their scope plainly: the bounds certify leakage, never safety, and are near-vacuous at our operating point, so release safety rests on empirical calibration, the hard line, and human review. On a worst-case fully task-coupled benchmark the loop reduces leakage from 0.457 to 0.304 (p approx. 0) and the release chain delivers 0.000 literal leakage at egress (160 instances, two strong attackers), the system degrading to certification-and-routing exactly as the feasibility criterion predicts. On a mixed-coupling benchmark the same safe point releases 67.5% of instances automatically at zero measured leakage, Pareto-dominating placeholder and selective-LDP corners under an identical release rule. Two human studies anchor the semantic utility metric (Spearman rho = 0.839) and the annotation gold (type-level recall at least 0.987). The exploratory self-learning hypothesis was not supported and is reported as such. All theoretical bounds pass numerical verification; code, synthetic datasets, protocol, and human-study packages are public.

</details>


### [385] [Toward an Empirical Probabilistic Risk Manifestation Model of Organizational Cybersecurity in SMEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14888)
*FNU Nurjahan,Aidan Eiler,Mst Eshita Khatun,Lamine Noureddine,Aisha Ali-Gombe*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 基于22家中小企业两年281项安全发现，构建跨层经验性风险显现模型，识别主导风险路径并评估评估流程的精简方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中小企业网络安全风险研究多缺乏来自真实评估的跨层经验证据，且实务评估负担重，需明确哪些组织安全职能最关键、风险如何传导，以及能否精简评估而不损失覆盖度。

Method: 采用迭代主题编码识别反复出现的组织安全职能；基于281项验证发现估计经验性风险显现模型，将职能与暴露条件、攻击机制、安全结果相链接；用概率传播识别主导风险路径；以留一组织法检验路径稳定性；比较保留6项与5项职能的精简方案。

Result: 识别出8项组织安全职能、2类暴露条件、5种攻击机制和6类结果。多数职能的主导路径为资产暴露→凭据泄露→未授权访问；基础设施与网络安全主要通过网络暴露传导，该路径在留一组织分析下稳定。保留6项职能可减少24%评估负担，保留97%关键发现和92%风险路径覆盖；保留5项减少45%负担，保留89%关键发现和85%路径覆盖。

Conclusion: 该模型刻画的是样本内的经验关联而非因果或预测关系；中小企业安全评估可在保证覆盖度的前提下精简，6项职能方案偏安全导向，5项职能方案偏效率导向。

Abstract: In this paper, we present a cross-layer empirical study of organizational cybersecurity risk in Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), analyzing 281 validated security findings from 22 real-world SME cybersecurity assessments conducted over two years through a pro bono university cybersecurity clinic. We first identify recurring organizational security functions through iterative thematic coding, then estimate an empirical Risk Manifestation Model linking these functions to exposure conditions, attack mechanisms, and cybersecurity outcomes, and use probability propagation to identify dominant risk pathways. The model characterizes empirical associations observed in this sample rather than causal or predictive relationships. Our analysis identifies eight organizational security functions associated with two exposure conditions, five attack mechanisms, and six outcome categories. Across most functions, the dominant pathway follows asset exposure to credential compromise to unauthorized access, whereas infrastructure and network security primarily propagates through network exposure; these pathways remain stable under leave-one-organization-out analysis. Finally, we evaluate whether SME cybersecurity assessments can be simplified while preserving meaningful security coverage. Retaining six functions reduces assessment burden by 24% while preserving 97% of critical findings and 92% of risk-pathway coverage, a security-oriented reduction, while retaining five functions reduces burden by 45% while preserving 89% of critical findings and 85% of risk-pathway coverage, a more efficiency-oriented alternative.

</details>


### [386] [ActGuard: Pre-execution Action Auditing against Indirect Prompt Injection in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14987)
*Bingzheng Wang,Xiaoyan Gu,Wentao Wang,Xingyou Yang,Hongcheng Li,Rong Yin*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出前置动作审计框架 ActGuard，通过工具先验与参数级证据定位识别并移除诱导不安全动作的恶意内容，在保持任务效用的同时降低间接提示注入攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体通过工具调用与外部环境交互，工具输出可能带来间接提示注入（IPI）攻击。现有防御（提示加固、内容过滤、预生成计划、权限约束）难以兼顾复杂任务表现，或过度净化外部内容，导致安全性与效用难以平衡。核心挑战是在保持执行灵活性的同时，精准识别并去除真正诱导不安全动作的恶意内容。

Method: ActGuard 为执行前动作审计框架：不判断外部内容本身是否可疑，而评估其是否使当前动作偏离局部合理预期。每步预测即将动作可能使用的工具，构建局部工具先验且不约束执行轨迹；执行前将候选动作与该先验比对，进行工具级对比分析与参数级证据定位，以识别工具选择与动作参数的偏离；随后由验证器检查定位到的证据，仅掩盖被确认为恶意的片段，并从净化后的上下文重新生成动作。

Result: 在工具调用智能体的挑战性基准上评估，ActGuard 将攻击成功率降至与最先进防御相当的水平，同时任务效用接近无攻击设置，取得良好的安全—效用权衡。代码已公开。

Conclusion: 通过前置动作审计、局部工具先验与证据定位式净化，ActGuard 在保留合法规划灵活性的同时减少盲目过滤带来的信息损失，实现了优于传统防御的安全与效用平衡。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents interact with external environments through tool invocation, but tool outputs can also expose them to indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks. Existing defenses mainly rely on prompt hardening, content filtering, pre-generated plans, or permission constraints. These approaches often struggle with complex tasks or over-sanitize external content, making it difficult to balance security and utility. The key challenge is therefore to preserve execution flexibility while precisely identifying and removing the malicious content that actually induces unsafe actions. To address this challenge, we propose ActGuard, a pre-execution action auditing framework. Rather than judging whether external content is inherently suspicious, ActGuard assesses whether it causes the current action to deviate from a locally reasonable expectation. At each step, ActGuard predicts the tools likely to be used by the upcoming action and constructs a local tool prior without constraining the execution trajectory. Before execution, it compares the candidate action against this prior and performs tool-level contrastive analysis and parameter-level evidence localization to identify deviations in tool selection and action parameters. A verifier then examines the localized evidence, masks only spans confirmed as malicious, and regenerates the action from the sanitized context. This design preserves legitimate planning flexibility while minimizing information loss from indiscriminate filtering. We evaluate ActGuard on challenging benchmarks for tool-using agents. Results show that ActGuard reduces attack success rates to a level comparable to state-of-the-art defenses while maintaining task utility close to the no-attack setting, achieving a favorable security-utility trade-off. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/binzhwang/ActGuard.

</details>


### [387] [PIDS-Bench: Evaluating Prompt-Injection Detectors Under Over-Defense, Obfuscation, and Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15017)
*Yusuf Khalid Shire,Sang-Chul Kim*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出PIDS-Bench多轴冻结基准，联合评估攻击检测与良性误报，揭示聚合F1掩盖的"来源敏感过度防御"失效模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有提示注入检测器多以分布内测试集上的聚合F1为评价指标，无法反映分布偏移下的行为，尤其忽略决策边界良性侧的直接误报成本。需在固定阈值下同时衡量攻击检测与良性误报，考察硬良性、混淆攻击及域/结构漂移等场景。

Method: 构建PIDS-Bench：一个冻结的多轴基准，内含分布内输入、模拟注入结构但无恶意的硬良性提示、混淆攻击、域与结构分布偏移；在固定阈值下评估七种检测器（学习型基线、外部提示注入分类器、广义安全比较器）并设规则型下界参照；进行全阈值扫描与五个训练种子、按来源分解，并测试硬负样本增强的影响。

Result: 在留出集上F1>0.98的检测器，对来自公共语料、限于安全相关内容的良性子集误分类约三分之一；全阈值扫描与五个种子下，无内部检测器能同时满足F1>=0.95且硬良性FPR<=0.10。硬负样本增强几乎消除精选压力输入上的过度防御，但对来源外部提示的过度防御基本不变，即"来源敏感过度防御"；该不对称在两种微调架构中均成立，且不随增强池扩大而减弱，外部来源FPR仍远高于0.10。

Conclusion: 阈值校准与精选风格增强均无法弥补外部来源良性样本的高误报；与外部来源分布匹配的增强能否消除该差距尚待验证，提示需按来源报告良性误报并改进增强策略。

Abstract: Prompt-injection detectors are typically evaluated using aggregate F1 on in-distribution test data, which offers limited insight into behavior under distribution shift, particularly on the benign side of the decision boundary, where false positives impose direct operational cost yet are seldom measured. We present PIDS-Bench, a frozen multi-axis benchmark that jointly evaluates attack detection and benign false-positive behavior at fixed thresholds, spanning in-distribution inputs, hard-benign prompts that mimic injection structure without malicious intent, obfuscated attacks, and domain and structural distribution shifts. We evaluate seven detectors (learned baselines, external prompt-injection classifiers, and broad-safety comparators) alongside a rule-based lower-bound reference.
  Multi-axis evaluation exposes a failure mode that aggregate F1 conceals. A detector exceeding F1 = 0.98 on the held-out split still misclassifies roughly one-third of an externally-sourced benign subset drawn from public corpora and restricted to security-adjacent content. Across a full threshold sweep and five training seeds, no internal detector reaches an operating point satisfying F1 >= 0.95 and hard-benign FPR <= 0.10 together on this stress distribution. Decomposing by provenance, we find that hard-negative augmentation nearly eliminates over-defense on curated stress inputs but leaves it substantially intact on externally-sourced prompts, a pattern we term provenance-sensitive over-defense. The asymmetry holds across both fine-tuned architectures and does not diminish as the augmentation pool grows, with the externally-sourced FPR remaining far above the 0.10 target. Whether augmentation matched to the externally-sourced distribution would close this gap is untested; threshold calibration and curated-style augmentation alone do not.

</details>


### [388] [Efficient Branch-and-Bound Testing and Verification of zkVMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15020)
*Hideaki Takahashi,Suman Jana,Junfeng Yang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: ZEBRA 是一个全自动的 zkVM 约束验证与缺陷检测框架，将验证归约为规范轨迹空间上的解集基数问题，利用约束稀疏性在整数区间格上进行分支限界求解，可在生产规模下发现零日漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: zkVM 将虚拟机语义翻译为执行轨迹上的代数约束，约束正确性至关重要：单条错误约束可导致欠约束（伪造证明）或过约束（拒绝合法执行）。现有方法在生产规模下缺乏有效保证——模糊测试与单元测试漏检、SMT 求解器难以处理约束规模与非线性、定理证明器需大量人工工作。

Method: ZEBRA 对给定程序与输入，要求约束恰好对应唯一有效执行轨迹（不多不少），从而把验证归约为规范轨迹空间上的解集基数问题，并在计数前消除空行填充、非确定性置换等冗余。为可计算地求基数，将分析从有限域见证提升到整数区间格，利用 zkVM 约束的结构稀疏性（5 个真实 zkVM 中约束平均仅使用理论连通容量的 14.0%）实现紧致区间传播；并采用并行分支限界搜索，输出具体反例或证明有界区域内无违规。

Result: 在 5 个真实 zkVM 上评估，ZEBRA 发现 11 个零日缺陷，其中 6 个已被独立确认、3 个已被开发者修复。相比基于 SMT 的验证，ZEBRA 快 51.5 倍，多验证 16.5 个百分点实例，其范围验证相比重复单输入验证效率提升最高达 63 倍。

Conclusion: ZEBRA 通过稀疏性驱动的区间格基数计算与分支限界搜索，实现了生产规模下全自动的 zkVM 约束正确性验证与缺陷检测，在效率与覆盖率上显著优于 SMT 方案，并具备实际发现与修复漏洞的能力。

Abstract: Zero-knowledge virtual machines (zkVMs) enable verifiable execution of general-purpose programs by translating virtual machine semantics into algebraic constraints over execution traces. The correctness of these constraints is critical: a single incorrect constraint can admit forged proofs (under-constrained) or reject valid executions (over-constrained). Existing approaches do not provide meaningful guarantees at production scale: fuzzers and unit tests often miss bugs, SMT solvers struggle with the size and nonlinearity of constraints, and theorem provers require substantial manual effort.
  We present ZEBRA, a fully automated verification and bug-detection framework: for a given program and input, the constraint must admit exactly one valid execution trace - no more and no fewer. This reduces zkVM verification to a solution-set cardinality problem over a canonical trace space, where redundancies such as null-row padding and non-deterministic permutations are eliminated prior to counting.
  To compute cardinality tractably, ZEBRA lifts analysis from finite-field witnesses to an integer interval lattice, exploiting a structural sparsity property of zkVM constraints: across 5 real-world zkVMs, constraints utilize only 14.0% of their theoretical connectivity capacity on average. This sparsity enables tight interval propagation with limited approximation error. ZEBRA performs a parallel branch-and-bound search that either produces a concrete counter-example or certifies the absence of violations within a bounded region.
  We evaluate ZEBRA on five real-world zkVMs. ZEBRA discovers 11 zero-day bugs; 6 have already been independently confirmed and 3 have been fixed by developers. Compared to SMT-based verification, ZEBRA is 51.5x faster, verifies 16.5 percentage point more instances, and its range verification provides up to 63x efficiency gain over repeated single-input verification.

</details>


### [389] [SpliTEE: Improving LLM Inference on Trusted Hardware with Differentially Private GPU Outsourcing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15039)
*Shashie Dilhara Batan Arachchige,Robin Carpentier,Hassan Jameel Asghar,Dali Kaafar*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出基于差分隐私的LLM拆分推理架构：将LLM推理在可信执行环境（TEE）与不可信GPU间拆分，用DP噪声替代加密保护中间表示，并给出关键函数的全局敏感度分析与浮点误差上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户提示可能包含敏感/隐私信息，远程部署的LLM可能在重训练中被记忆而滥用。在TEE中执行LLM可保护提示，但现有TEE以CPU为主，远慢于GPU。已有Slalom方案用加密保护送往GPU的中间输入，但本文希望扩展到LLM推理并避免加密带来的量化限制。

Method: 扩展Slalom的拆分推理架构至LLM：TEE与不可信GPU分工，对送往GPU的中间表示施加差分隐私噪声（而非加密），使LLM保持在浮点域、避免量化。方法核心是对关键LLM函数进行全局敏感度分析，以界定所需DP噪声尺度；并推导由掩蔽与噪声消除（在TEE内）引起的浮点误差上界，表示为隐私参数epsilon的函数。实现采用Intel TDX，评估Llama-3.2-3B与Qwen3-4B。

Result: 提示重建攻击可从中间表示近乎80%准确率恢复提示，说明掩蔽中间表示是必要的。拆分执行比TDX内全CPU推理快近2倍，比基于加密的Slalom快5-15秒，同时精度更高。在已知DP机制条件下进行提示重建，也无法恢复超过一个无关提示所包含的信息量。

Conclusion: 用差分隐私保护LLM拆分推理中的中间表示是可行且高效的：无需加密/量化，保持浮点精度，性能优于全CPU TEE推理与加密方案，并在信息论层面限制了提示重建泄露。

Abstract: User prompts provided to large language models (LLMs) may contain sensitive or private information that can be misused by remotely deployed models, such as through inadvertent memorization during retraining. One way to protect user prompts is to execute the LLM inside a trusted execution environment (TEE), with the guarantee that the service provider has no access to computations performed within or information exchanged with the TEE. However, current TEEs are primarily CPU-based and significantly slower than GPUs optimized for LLM inference. To circumvent this, Tramer and Boneh (2019) proposed Slalom, which splits neural network inference between a TEE and an untrusted GPU and encrypts intermediate inputs sent to the GPU. We extend this split-inference architecture to LLM inference and instead protect intermediate inputs using differential privacy. We show that masking intermediate representations is necessary by showing that a prompt-reconstruction attack can recover prompts from these representations with nearly 80% accuracy. Our main contribution is a global sensitivity analysis of key LLM functions, which bounds the required scale of differentially private noise. Unlike encryption, differential privacy avoids quantization, allowing the LLM to remain in the floating-point domain. We also derive an upper bound on floating-point error from masking and noise cancellation in the TEE as a function of the privacy parameter epsilon. We implement our architecture using Intel TDX and evaluate it with two LLMs: Llama-3.2-3B and Qwen3-4B. Our split execution is nearly twice as fast as fully CPU-based inference inside TDX and 5-15 seconds faster than encryption-based Slalom while achieving higher accuracy. Finally, we demonstrate that prompt reconstruction, even with knowledge of the differential privacy mechanism, cannot recover more information than is contained in an unrelated prompt.

</details>


### [390] [CounterPersona: Append-Only Defense Against Unauthorized Persona Skill Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15097)
*Pengwei Wang,Zihan Wang,Hangcheng Cao,Qingchuan Zhao,Hongwei Li,Guowen Xu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出CounterPersona，通过构造反人格证据应对仅追加场景下的人格技能蒸馏，保护个人隐私与劳动自主权。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人格技能蒸馏可从个人信息中提取模式并编码为可复用技能，使AI系统复现个人行为，但这引发个人隐私与劳动自主权问题。现有基于扰动的防御需在数据采集前修改数据，而历史记录一旦被攻击者收集便无法更改、净化或撤销，难以适应仅追加场景。

Method: CounterPersona构造定向的反人格证据，将兼容的行为状态打包为紧凑的实现单元，并通过理由引导的一致性重写进行强化。

Result: 大量实验表明，CounterPersona在词法、语义及基于LLM的度量上均取得强且一致的效果，并对不同蒸馏器保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了技能反蒸馏范式，用于在未经授权的技能蒸馏场景下保护个人隐私与劳动自主权。

Abstract: Persona skill distillation can extract recurring patterns from personal information and encode them into reusable skills, enabling AI systems to closely replicate an individual's behavior. However, such replication also raises serious concerns regarding personal privacy and labor autonomy. Unlike existing perturbation-based defenses that require individuals to modify their data before collection, once historical records are collected by an attacker, they can no longer be altered, sanitized, or revoked. Therefore, such defenses are difficult to adapt to this append-only setting. To solve this challenge, we introduce CounterPersona, which constructs targeted counter-persona evidence, packs compatible behavioral states into compact realization units, and strengthens them through rationale-guided consistency rewriting. We conduct extensive experiments showing that CounterPersona achieves strong and consistent effectiveness across lexical, semantic, and LLM-based measures, while remaining robust across distillers. Our work establishes a skill anti-distillation paradigm for protecting personal privacy and labor autonomy against unauthorized skill distillation.

</details>


### [391] [Sociotechnical Aspects of Tor Relay Rejection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15192)
*Jules Dejaeghere,Lionel Goffaux,Pierre Luycx,Hosam Elkoulak,Florentin Rochet*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文研究 Tor 网络中继版本 EoL（生命终止）策略的社会技术影响：通过用户调研、历史数据驱动的网络仿真与安全指标分析，发现操作者总体支持该策略但实践不一；EoL 仅带来轻微的敌手优势，网络扰动对匿名性影响更大；少数被拒绝中继贡献了超过 50% 的安全价值，并提出策略实施建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2019 年 Tor 项目对旧版本中继执行 EoL 策略，拒绝过时中继，涉及相当比例共识权重。该策略虽有助于网络维护、减少向后移植、缩短漏洞暴露窗口，但其社会技术影响（操作者认知、匿名性与安全性后果）尚无研究。

Method: 1) 用户研究（N=26）调查中继操作者对 EoL 策略的认知与运维实践；2) 基于历史数据的网络仿真，评估策略对 Tor 客户端在常见敌手模型下的即时影响；3) 提出安全指标，在两种敌手模型下量化中继贡献并按其个体效用与安全性排序；4) 分析四轮排除（exclusion rounds）。

Result: 操作者虽非普遍知晓 EoL 策略，但总体持支持态度，运维实践存在差异，偶尔会排除新安装的中继；仿真显示敌手仅获得边际优势，而网络扰动（中继加入与退出）对用户匿名性的影响更为显著；四轮排除分析表明，少数被拒绝中继通常贡献了所有被排除中继所提供安全性的 50% 以上。

Conclusion: EoL 策略在安全上带来的直接风险有限，网络扰动与中继安全贡献的不均衡分布更值得关注；据此提出 EoL 策略实施建议，以缓解潜在弊端。

Abstract: In 2019, the Tor Project enforced an end-of-life (EoL) policy for Tor versions, leading to the rejection of outdated relays, amounting to a notable fraction of consensus weight. While this policy aids network maintenance, reduces backporting efforts, and shortens vulnerability exposure, its sociotechnical implications remain unstudied.
  A user study ($N=26$) reveals that relay operators, though not universally aware of the EoL policy, generally view it favorably. Operational practices vary, occasionally excluding newly installed relays from the network.
  Network simulations, grounded in historical data, assess the policy's immediate impact on Tor clients against common adversaries. Results indicate a marginal adversarial advantage, with network churn (i.e., relays entering and exiting) exerting a more pronounced effect on user anonymity. Security metrics are introduced to evaluate relay contributions against two adversary models, enabling ranking by individual utility and security. Analysis of four exclusion rounds shows that a minority of rejected relays typically account for over 50% of the security provided by all excluded relays.
  Recommendations for EoL policy implementation are proposed to mitigate potential drawbacks.

</details>


### [392] [Large Universe Subset Predicate Encryption with IND-CCA Security (with Constant-size Ciphertext and Keys)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15312)
*Sayantan Mukherjee*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个大宇宙下CCA安全、密文和密钥均为常数长度的子集谓词加密(SPE)方案，并基于标准子群判定问题证明了其标准选择性安全，进而通过黑盒变换得到首个常数长度CCA安全的WIBE、WKD-IBE等原语。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SPE研究存在明显不足：Katz等(CANS'17)仅给出小宇宙下选择性IND-CPA安全的两种构造；Chatterjee和Mukherjee(RSA'19)的大宇宙构造中，第一种虽密文和密钥为常数长度但仅满足受限的选择性安全，第二种虽达自适应安全但密文长度依赖数据属性集大小，且两者均不满足CCA安全。因此需要构造同时具备大宇宙、CCA安全、常数长度密文与密钥的SPE方案。

Method: 提出一种大宇宙下的子集谓词加密构造，实现常数长度的密文与密钥；在标准子群判定问题假设下证明其满足标准选择性安全；并借助黑盒变换将高效SPE转换为WIBE、WKD-IBE等原语。

Result: 构造出首个大宇宙CCA安全SPE，密文和密钥均为常数长度，并在标准子群判定问题下证明了标准选择性安全；同时得到首个具有常数长度密文和密钥的CCA安全WIBE、WKD-IBE等方案。

Conclusion: 该工作弥补了现有SPE在大宇宙、CCA安全与常数长度效率三者难以兼得的空白，并通过黑盒变换扩展了高效SPE的应用范围，为WIBE、WKD-IBE等原语提供了高效的CCA安全实例。

Abstract: Katz et al. (CANS'17) introduced Subset Predicate Encryption (SPE).
  This scheme is a generalization of broadcast encryption as it emulates the \emph{subset containment} predicate in the encrypted domain.
  They proposed two selectively IND-CPA secure SPE constructions in the small universe setting.
  They also showed some black-box transformations of SPE to well-known primitives like WIBE and ABE to establish the richness of the SPE structure.
  Chatterjee and Mukherjee (RSA'19) proposed two SPE constructions in the large-universe setting.
  Their first construction achieved constant-size ciphertexts and secret keys, but it is proven secure in a restricted version of selective security.
  Although the second construction achieves adaptive security, the ciphertext size depends on the size of the data-attribute set.
  Furthermore, neither of these two constructions achieves CCA security.
  In this work, we propose the first large-universe CCA-secure subset predicate encryption with constant-size ciphertext and secret keys.
  We prove this construction achieves standard selective security under the standard subgroup decision problems.
  Finally, we transform our extremely efficient SPE into the first CCA-secure WIBE, WKD-IBE, etc., with constant-size ciphertexts and secret keys via black-box transformations.

</details>


### [393] [Divide, Consult, Conquer: Capability Laundering Through Aligned LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15383)
*Mark Russinovich,Blake Bullwinkel,Giorgio Severi,Cristian Ovadiuc,Ahmed Salem*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 论文提出"能力洗白"（capability laundering）攻击：较弱未对齐模型将有害任务拆分为看似无害的子问题，分别向更强的对齐模型咨询，再在本地整合答案，从而绕过单轮拒绝防御。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前语言模型安全评估通常以单次交互为单位，但真实威胁可能来自多次被单独允许的交互组合。作者希望揭示现有防御的这一盲区：对有害任务的一次拒绝，并不能阻止前沿能力被跨交互转移与组合。

Method: 采用"编排者—顾问"框架：用较弱未对齐的本地编排模型把有害任务分解成良性子问题，独立咨询更强的对齐前沿模型，再本地合成答案。通过筛选原始前沿模型能解、对齐模型会拒绝、且无辅助编排者失败的任务，测量"咨询增益"。评估对象为 GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.8、Grok-4.3 作为顾问，四个本地编排者，数据集为 CyBench、BountyBench 与有害 CBRN 请求。

Result: CyBench 上 Gemma-4-31B 借助 GPT-5.5 恢复 8/14、借助 Opus 恢复 7/9，而 Gemma-4-12B 仅 2/21 与 4/15；BountyBench 上 Gemma-4-31B 恢复 3/9 与 2/3，Muse-Glimmer-30B 则 22 与 13 中均无一恢复。CBRN 方面，在假设生物武器攻击链的八个步骤上，咨询使 Gemma-4-31B 的平均评分从 62.3 升至 83.1（百分制）。

Conclusion: 拒绝有害任务并不能阻止前沿能力通过多次单独允许的交互被转移和组合，暴露出现有单轮安全防御的系统性缺口。

Abstract: Language model safety is typically evaluated one interaction at a time. We show that a weaker, unaligned model can split a harmful task into benign-looking subproblems, consult a stronger aligned model independently on each, and combine the answers locally. We call this attack capability laundering. Unlike a jailbreak, no single response is a harmful task. We measure consultation-aided uplift using tasks that a raw frontier model solves, the aligned frontier refuses, and the unassisted orchestrator fails. We evaluate GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, and Grok-4.3 as consultants to four local orchestrators on CyBench, BountyBench, and harmful CBRN requests. On CyBench, Gemma-4-31B recovers 8/14 candidates with GPT-5.5 and 7/9 with Opus, compared with 2/21 and 4/15 for Gemma-4-12B. On BountyBench, Gemma-4-31B recovers 3/9 and 2/3 candidates, while Muse-Glimmer-30B recovers none of 22 and 13. For CBRN, we measure uplift across eight steps of a hypothetical bioweapon attack chain and find that consultation raises Gemma-4-31B's mean rubric score from 62.3 to 83.1 on a 100-point rubric scale. These results expose a gap in current defenses: refusing a harmful task does not prevent frontier capabilities from being transferred and composed across many individually permitted interactions.

</details>


### [394] [An Empirical Security Analysis of Open-Source Software Used in Onboard Satellite Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15425)
*Roee Idan,Tomer Cohen Galor,Asaf Shabtai,Yuval Elovici*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 对126个公开卫星星载软件仓库，采用SBOM生成、软件成分分析、SAST、IaC分析与密钥扫描的组合流水线，最终得到2827条安全发现，刻画了开源星载软件生态中重复出现的安全弱点分布，为优先级排序提供实证依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 星载飞行系统越来越多地采用开源软件（可复用框架、共享库、社区维护组件）以加速开发，但由此把软件安全风险引入到补丁代价高昂、失效可能影响任务运行的系统中；因此需要实证地了解该生态中安全弱点的普遍性与分布。

Method: 面向126个公开仓库构建分析流水线：软件物料清单（SBOM）生成、软件成分分析（SCA）、静态应用安全测试（SAST）、基础设施即代码（IaC）分析、密钥扫描；随后进行基于规则的清洗、星载范围过滤与基于指纹的去重，得到2827条发现的最终数据集，并按CWE分类法归入8个弱点族。

Result: 安全发现广泛存在但分布不均：中危占49%，中危及以上占72%。八个弱点族中，内存安全与代码质量占比最高，其次为输入验证与注入类。81.4%的发现位于项目自研代码，外部依赖代码仍是重要来源。这些发现不构成任务特定的可利用性结论，但提供了该生态中重复安全模式的实证刻画。

Conclusion: 该研究量化了开源星载卫星软件生态中安全弱点的普遍程度与分布特征，揭示自研代码为主要发现来源、依赖代码亦不可忽视，可用于确定需优先投入安全关注的领域。

Abstract: The use of open-source software (OSS) in satellite flight systems is increasing as missions adopt reusable frameworks, shared libraries, and community-maintained components. While this accelerates development, it also introduces software-security risks into systems where patching is costly and failures may affect mission operations. This paper presents an empirical security study of OSS used in onboard satellite systems. We analyze 126 public repositories using a pipeline that combines software bill of materials generation, software composition analysis, static application security testing, infrastructure-as-code analysis, and secret scanning. After rule-based cleaning, onboard-scope filtering, and fingerprint-based deduplication, the pipeline produced a final dataset of 2,827 findings.
  The results show that security findings are widespread but unevenly distributed. Medium-severity findings account for 49% of the dataset, and 72% are classified as medium severity or higher. A Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE)-based taxonomy assigns all findings to eight weakness families. Memory Safety and Code Quality dominate the dataset, followed by Input Validation and Injection. Most findings occur in project-developed code, accounting for 81.4% of the dataset, while external dependency code remains a relevant source of findings. While these findings do not establish mission-specific exploitability, they provide an empirical characterization of recurring security patterns across the open-source onboard satellite software ecosystem, helping quantify their prevalence and prioritize areas that warrant the greatest security attention.

</details>


### [395] [Misleading the Planner through Deceptive Resumes: Registration-Time Injection in Centralized Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15516)
*Zhaofeng Yu,Haokai Ma,Dongyang Zhan,Hongli Zhang,Han Fang,Ee-Chien Chang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 集中式LLM多智能体系统通过注册worker agent扩展能力，其描述由planner读取；由于第三方描述在系统外编写却被planner信任，形成"注册时注入"通道。作者定义worker描述四字段，构建八种描述操纵攻击并在GAIA上评估，最严重情况下任务成功率从84.31%降至37.25%，或token消耗/执行时间增加超111%，且跨实现、模型与真实市场描述稳健。作者提出注册时防御DescGuard，仅保留worker作用域的接口信息，可将规划指标与下游性能恢复至基线水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集中式LLM多智能体系统依赖注册新worker扩展功能，planner会读取worker描述以决定任务分解、子任务分配与需求。第三方描述在系统外部编写却被planner默认信任，因此构成注册时注入通道：恶意载荷可在用户指令到来前植入，针对planner并经由生成的计划传播至良性worker，即使被操纵的worker从未被分配子任务或调用也可能生效。作者还观察到真实市场中worker描述普遍不规范，为操纵提供空间，因此需要系统刻画该风险并给出防御。

Method: 1）定义worker描述的四个字段：功能（functionality）、输入规范（input specification）、输出规范（output specification）与使用约束（usage constraints）；2）分析三个公开agent市场的32,000条描述，统计字段缺失与字段外内容比例；3）构建八种描述操纵攻击策略，分别针对任务分解、能力落地（capability grounding）与子任务规格（subtask specification）；4）在GAIA基准上评估攻击效果，并跨两种MAS实现、六个planner LLM、四个LLM评估器以及三个市场的真实描述进行稳健性验证；5）提出注册时防御DescGuard，在描述到达planner前仅保留worker作用域的接口信息，并验证其与现有隔离、权限控制与运行时机制的兼容性。

Result: 在32,000条公开描述中，多数省略输入规范与使用约束，至少23.35%包含四字段之外的内容。八种攻击策略在GAIA上均有效：最严重情况下，单条被操纵描述使任务成功率从84.31%降至37.25%，或将token消耗或执行时间提高超过111%，而用户目标保持不变、worker仍忠实执行生成的计划。攻击效果在两种MAS实现、六个planner LLM、四个LLM评估器及三个市场的真实描述上持续存在。DescGuard在不修改worker实现、planner或编排逻辑的前提下，将受攻击的规划指标与下游性能恢复至接近基线水平，并可与隔离、权限控制与运行时机制叠加使用。

Conclusion: 第三方worker描述构成集中式LLM多智能体系统中被忽视的注册时注入面：操纵可预先植入、无需被调用即可经planner传播，显著损害任务成功率或资源效率，且具有跨实现、跨模型与真实市场描述的稳健性。注册时仅保留worker作用域接口信息的DescGuard可有效缓解该威胁，并与既有安全机制互补，表明描述供给侧的接口化约束是提升MAS安全性的关键方向。

Abstract: A centralized LLM-based multi-agent system (MAS) extends its functionality by registering new worker agents, whose descriptions are read by the planner to decide how a task is decomposed, which worker executes each subtask, and what each subtask requires. Third-party descriptions are authored outside the system but trusted by the planner, creating a registration-time injection channel. The payload is planted before any user instruction arrives, targets the planner and propagates through the generated plan to benign workers, taking effect even when the crafted worker is never assigned a subtask or invoked. We define four worker-description fields: functionality, input specification, output specification, and usage constraints. Among 32,000 descriptions from three public agent marketplaces, most omit input specifications and usage constraints, while at least 23.35% contain content outside these fields. We construct eight description-manipulation attack strategies targeting task decomposition, capability grounding, and subtask specification, and evaluate them on GAIA. In the most severe cases, a single manipulated description reduces task success from 84.31% to 37.25%, or increases token consumption or execution time by over 111%, while the user objective remains unchanged and workers faithfully execute the resulting plan. These effects persist across two MAS implementations, six planner LLMs, four LLM evaluators, and the real-world descriptions from three marketplaces. We further propose DescGuard, a registration-time defense that retains only worker-scoped interface information before descriptions reach the planner. DescGuard restores the targeted planning metrics and downstream performance toward their baseline levels without modifying worker implementations, the planner, or the orchestration logic, and composes with existing isolation, permission-control, and runtime mechanisms.

</details>


### [396] [Automating Attack Graph Construction for Agentic Pentesting. Towards Neuro-Symbolic Vulnerability Hunting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15523)
*Oliver Stevanovic,Jasmin Wachter*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该文提出半自动化流水线，将Trivy、Semgrep、Nmap扫描结果转为MulVAL谓词，并用LLM辅助构建Datalog规则，经MulVAL/XSB符号推理生成攻击图，在54个CyBench Web CTF任务上验证其可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于扫描器输出的逻辑攻击图具备可审计的攻击路径推理能力，而LLM智能体缺乏这一点。但将MulVAL等符号框架集成到现代安全工作流中，需要把扫描证据翻译为初始事实并构建领域专用规则，存在互操作性障碍。

Method: 半自动化流水线：解析Trivy、Semgrep、Nmap的发现结果，转换为MulVAL谓词；使用LLM辅助流程，构建将扫描器可检测证据与攻击技术关联的领域专用Datalog规则；再由MulVAL/XSB执行符号推理，生成结构化攻击路径。在智能体流水线（Hybrid Reasoner）中对54个CyBench Web CTF任务评估攻击图构建基础设施，但不评估下游智能体性能。

Result: 每个任务至少生成一个可达目标的攻击图；平均真实漏洞覆盖率为53.7%，其中51.9%实现完全覆盖；平均噪声路径率为83.9%；端到端时间中位数24.9秒，其中MulVAL推理2.7秒。

Conclusion: 该流水线对智能体工作流具有可行性和运行时实用性，但谓词覆盖、规则覆盖与路径精度仍是限制因素。下一步包括语义规则验证，以及面向图引导渗透测试的智能体级对比。

Abstract: Logic attack graphs grounded in scanner output provide explicit and auditable attack path reasoning LLM-based agents lack.
