Integrating symbolic frameworks such as MulVAL to contemporary security workflows or agentic pipelines, however, requires translating scanner evidence to initial facts, and creating domain-specific rules. We present a semi-automated pipeline that addresses this interoperability problem and depict its feasibility in a web-security case study. Our pipeline parses findings from Trivy, Semgrep, and Nmap into MulVAL predicates and uses an LLM-assisted process to construct domain-specific Datalog rules linking scanner-detectable evidence to attack techniques. MulVAL/XSB then performs symbolic inference to generate structured attack paths. We evaluate the attack-graph construction infrastructure on 54 web Capture-the-Flag tasks from CyBench within an agentic pipeline (Hybrid Reasoner); we do not evaluate the performance of the downstream agent. Every task produced at least one goal-reaching graph, and we achieve mean ground-truth vulnerability coverage of 53.7%, with 51.9% achieving full coverage; mean noise-path rate was 83.9%. With median end-to-end time of 24.9 s (MulVAL reasoning: 2.7 s) the pipeline is feasible and runtime-practical for agentic workflows, but predicate coverage, rule coverage, and path precision remain limiting factors. Next steps include semantic rule validation and agent-level comparison for graph-guided pentesting.

</details>


### [397] [Approval Integrity and Recovery in LLM Answer Publication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15576)
*Faruk Alpay,Taylan Alpay*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文研究LLM发布系统中的发布完整性，考察精确内容绑定、授权新鲜度与检查点恢复机制，通过RAGTruth人工标注数据、错误轨迹追踪、提示注入与跨域校准实验，量化了语义误批准、授权过期与恢复引入错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM系统的发布完整性要求将已批准内容绑定到其当前授权上下文，但现有发布执行机制中精确内容绑定、授权新鲜度与检查点恢复这三类问题缺乏可执行的边界测量，语义误批准、过期授权与恢复过程本身引入的错误难以区分与量化。

Method: 基于150个源任务的900条RAGTruth人工标注响应，用三个带日期的Ministral模型与同模型直接接地基线共产生3,600次评估；比较生产响应行为检查器（14B）与直接基线对不支持标签答案的接受情况并统计支持答案保留率；用精确提升-纠正恒等式追踪100条3B-14B-8B-14B时序答案轨迹；在65条初始批准答案上对比最终状态化重检-恢复策略与初始检查点的精确匹配错误；通过受控证据指纹改动检验发布与恢复间的不对称新鲜度执行；另做BIPIA提示注入实验与Hugging Face跨域校准迁移实验（ArguAna→SciFact/NFCorpus，Thunderbird→BGL）。

Result: 14B生产检查器接受302条不支持标签答案中的291条，直接基线仅接受41条；支持答案保留率分别为95.2%与66.9%。在65条初始批准答案中，状态化重检-恢复策略使精确匹配错误相对初始检查点增加9.23个百分点（95%文章聚类区间[-1.72, 19.61]）。受控证据指纹改动暴露出发布与恢复之间不对称的新鲜度执行。BIPIA实验中266条有效编辑器输出零目标插入。跨域校准实验将检索模型从ArguAna迁移至SciFact与NFCorpus，并将诊断决策规则从Thunderbird迁移至BGL，区分了概率校准变化与排序变化。

Conclusion: 这些测量在可执行的发布边界上将语义误批准、过期授权与恢复引入错误三者区分开来，为LLM发布完整性机制提供了可量化的诊断框架，并揭示恢复策略可能反而放大精确匹配错误、发布与恢复的新鲜度执行存在不对称性。

Abstract: Publication integrity in LLM systems requires binding approved content to its current authorization context. We examine exact-content binding, authorization freshness and checkpoint recovery in Lightcap's publication enforcement mechanism. On 900 independently human-annotated RAGTruth responses from 150 source tasks, three dated Ministral models and a same-model direct-grounding baseline yield 3,600 assessments. The production response-act checker instantiated with 14B accepts 291 of 302 unsupported-labelled answers; the direct baseline accepts 41. Supported-answer retention is 95.2% and 66.9%, respectively. An exact promotion-correction identity tracks error through 100 chronological 3B-14B-8B-14B answer trajectories. Among 65 initially approved answers, the final stateful recheck-recovery policy increases exact-match error by 9.23 percentage points relative to the initial checkpoint (95% article-clustered interval [-1.72, 19.61]). Controlled evidence-fingerprint changes expose asymmetric freshness enforcement between publication and recovery. A separate BIPIA prompt-injection experiment records zero target insertions among 266 valid editor outputs. External Hugging Face calibration experiments transfer retrieval models from ArguAna to SciFact and NFCorpus, and diagnostic decision rules from Thunderbird to BGL, distinguishing probability calibration from ranking changes. The measurements separate semantic false approval, stale authorization and recovery-induced error at executable publication boundaries.

</details>


### [398] [Tractable Defense against Advanced Persistent Threats in Networked Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15614)
*Brandon Collins,Keith Paarporn,Shouhuai Xu,Philip N. Brown*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文针对布尔动态系统（BDS）建模的APT网络防御问题，提出一种基于平均场分析的启发式值函数，以解决精确最优控制计算不可解的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: APT具有隐蔽性、检测信息有限且含噪、横向移动以及防御者需权衡系统可用性资源等特点，布尔动态系统可自然刻画这四类基本要素。但在该框架下，最优或启发式控制因值函数随网络规模增长而计算不可解，难以在计算可行的时间内求解。

Method: 作者提出一种受平均场分析启发的启发式值函数，并证明在底层状态估计分布熵最大的假设下，该启发式等价于值函数的精确计算。

Result: 数值实验评估了该启发式方法的解质量，并以熵假设被违背的程度作为参数进行了检验。

Conclusion: 所提启发式在熵最大化假设下具有精确性依据，为解决APT防御中计算不可解的控制问题提供了可行途径，其性能与熵假设的偏差程度相关。

Abstract: Recently, the theory of Boolean Dynamical Systems was proposed to study the decision theory surrounding the defense of computer networks against Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs). Boolean Dynamical Systems naturally capture four first principle primitives of APTs: the stealthy nature of attacks, limited and noisy information from automated systems like intrusion detection systems, lateral movement after the attacker penetrates into the network, and the defender's ability to secure a subset of computers at any time at the loss of resources such as system uptime. Currently, doing optimal/heuristic control in a computationally tractable manner is not possible because the emergent value function is computationally intractable (with respect to the network size). To resolve this, we propose a mean-field analysis inspired heuristic value function. We prove that our proposed heuristic is based on an exact computation of the value function under the assumption that the underlying state estimate distribution maximizes entropy. We numerically evaluate the quality of our heuristic as parameterized by the degree to which the entropy assumptions are violated.

</details>


### [399] [Scaling Verification of Cryptographic Software with Aeneas, Rust, and Lean](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15648)
*Son Ho,Cédric Fournet,Jonathan Protzenko,Michael Naehrig,Joshua Clune,Patrick Longa,Guillaume Boisseau,Fernando Leal Sánchez,Aymeric Fromherz,Antoine Delignat-Lavaud*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出一套面向生产级Rust密码软件的形式化验证方法：用Aeneas将Rust提炼为Lean纯模型，结合AI智能体自动写证明并经Lean内核独立校验，在SymCrypt上验证SHA-3、ML-KEM等算法（237 KLOC Lean对应16.7 KLOC Rust），证明其满足性能、可移植性、部署与可维护性要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有密码软件验证多针对为便于验证而重写的代码，难以应用于追求性能与系统集成的生产代码；同时底层指针存活性与别名推理负担重，且验证工作量大、难以规模化。作者希望直接在Rust生产代码上做验证，并借助AI降低形式化证明的成本。

Method: 1) 以Rust生产代码为验证对象，利用Rust所有权机制，通过Aeneas将Rust抽取为Lean中的纯函数模型，规避指针存活性与别名等底层推理；2) 利用Lean的可扩展性开发tactic与库，简化抽取代码的推理；3) 设计并调优工具链以支持AI使用：由智能体自主编写形式化证明并由Lean内核独立校验，智能体还协助密码标准与平台相关intrinsic的形式化（仍需专家设计与审阅）；4) 在SymCrypt上落地，验证由C移植至Rust的SHA-3、ML-KEM等实现，并扩展FrodoKEM、ML-DSA、HPKE等实验性优化与实现以考察可扩展性，覆盖x86-64与ARM平台。

Result: 构建237 KLOC的Lean开发，验证了16.7 KLOC支撑后量子密码套件的Rust代码，确立其安全性、无panic性与功能正确性，覆盖x86-64与ARM平台；评估表明经过验证的Rust能够满足SymCrypt在性能、可移植性、部署与可维护性方面的要求。

Conclusion: 该工作表明对生产级Rust密码代码进行大规模形式化验证是可行的：所有权-Aeneas-Lean路径配合AI辅助证明可显著降低验证负担，且验证后的代码不牺牲性能与工程实用性，为后量子密码等实际部署提供了可扩展的验证范式。

Abstract: We develop a new methodology for verifying cryptographic software. We target production code written in Rust for performance and system integration, rather than verification convenience. Rust's ownership discipline enables Aeneas to extract a pure model of this code in Lean, relieving us from low-level reasoning about pointer liveness and aliasing. Lean's extensibility lets us develop tactics and libraries that greatly simplify reasoning about extracted Rust code.
  We design and tune our toolchain to facilitate the use of AI. Agents autonomously write formal proofs, which are independently verified by the Lean kernel. Agents also assist in the formalization of cryptographic standards and platform-specific intrinsics, which still requires expert design and review.
  We apply our methodology to SymCrypt, Microsoft's cryptographic provider. We verify its implementations of algorithms such as SHA-3 and ML-KEM, which were ported from C to Rust. We also extend SymCrypt with experimental optimizations and implementations of algorithms such as FrodoKEM, ML-DSA, and HPKE to explore the scalability of writing, adapting, and verifying cryptographic code. Our 237~KLOC Lean development establishes safety, panic-freedom, and functional correctness of 16.7~KLOC of Rust code supporting post-quantum cipher suites for x86-64 and ARM platforms. Our evaluation shows that verified Rust can meet SymCrypt's performance, portability, deployment, and maintainability requirements.

</details>


### [400] [CiteShade: Citation Laundering in Multi-Source Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Its Counterfactual Defense](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15660)
*Guo Fuzheng*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出首个针对RAG引用通道的"引用洗白"攻击CiteShade，通过单一恶意源使模型输出错误答案并归因于不支持该答案的可信源，并在多跳问答上验证其有效性与防御难点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG的引用是用户的审计线索，使用户无需完全信任模型即可核实答案。此前RAG安全研究只关注攻击者能否污染答案，而引用通道这一审计机制尚未被探索，因此作者将其视为新的、可实际利用的攻击面。

Method: 提出CiteShade攻击：攻击者仅控制一个来源，诱导模型生成攻击者选定的错误答案，并将其归因于一个并不支持该答案的可信来源，同时正确答案的证据仍保留在上下文中。作者将该攻击形式化为优化问题，推导出检索、生成与引用三个必要条件，并在不依赖任何指令的情况下构造满足条件的恶意来源。

Result: 在多源多跳问答任务上，攻击将错误答案率从0.01提升至0.68；来源删除实验证实恶意来源在所有测量案例中都是因果驱动因素。脆弱性与模型"引用倾向"相关而非模型规模，在最易引用的模型上，显式指令下CLR达0.84，无指令时仍达0.64。困惑度过滤与引用支持检查均被证明不足。

Conclusion: RAG的引用通道构成实际且严重的攻击面，现有基于困惑度过滤和引用支持校验的防御不足以应对。作者提出一种反事实防御，通过验证究竟哪个来源真正驱动了答案来识别引用洗白。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds a language model's answers on retrieved external knowledge and returns each answer with citations that identify its sources. Those citations are the user's audit trail: they let a reader verify a claim without trusting the model. Prior security work on RAG asks whether an attacker can corrupt the answer, leaving the citation channel unexplored. We show that this channel is a new and practical attack surface. We propose CiteShade, the first citation laundering attack to RAG, in which an attacker controlling a single source induces a model to produce an attacker-chosen wrong answer and to attribute it to a trusted source that does not support it, while the evidence for the correct answer remains in context. We formulate the attack as an optimization problem, derive three necessary conditions (retrieval, generation, and citation) and construct sources satisfying them without any instruction. On multi-source multi-hop question answering the attack raises the wrong-answer rate from 0.01 to 0.68, and source deletion confirms the malicious source is the causal driver in every measured case. Vulnerability tracks a model's propensity to cite rather than its scale, reaching CLR 0.84 under explicit instruction and 0.64 with no instruction at all on the most citation-prone model tested. We then show that perplexity filtering and citation-support checking are each insufficient, and propose a counterfactual defense that verifies which source actually drove the answer.

</details>


### [401] [HYDRA: Quantifying Botnet Resource Thresholds for Efficient Link-Flooding Attacks on LEO Satellite Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15693)
*Roee Idan,Rami Puzis,Asaf Shabtai,Yuval Elovici*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: HYDRA是一个建模与优化框架，将链路泛洪攻击（LFA）变体形式化为僵尸网络最小化问题，用于量化LEO星座网络对定向中断的韧性，并在更少资源下达到与ICARUS相当的破坏效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LEO卫星星座（如Starlink、Kuiper）正成为全球低延迟连接的关键骨干，但其可预测运动、时变拓扑及星间/星地链路依赖等特性易被攻击者利用。已有研究表明LFA可攻击网络瓶颈，但先前工作未量化LEO网络对定向中断的韧性。

Method: 提出HYDRA框架，将LFA变体形式化为僵尸网络最小化问题，通过求解最小活跃僵尸子集及其流量分配来量化网络韧性；并评估五种缓解策略：路由多样化、入口管控、基于距离的流量约束、源端限流、僵尸网络消耗。

Result: 在相同隐蔽性约束下，HYDRA使用比ICARUS少34%的僵尸节点和少23%的总攻击流量即可实现相同的定向中断；在拓扑持续演化下维持连续攻击的成功率超97%。

Conclusion: HYDRA可有效量化LEO网络对LFA的韧性，并为路由多样化、入口管控、距离约束、源端限流和僵尸网络消耗等缓解措施提供评估依据，从而提升网络韧性。

Abstract: Low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite constellations, such as Starlink and Kuiper, are rapidly emerging as a critical backbone for low-latency global connectivity. As these systems expand, they become more attractive attack targets, necessitating increased resilience and security. Threat actors seek to exploit constellation-specific properties such as predictable motion, time-varying topologies, and reliance on inter-satellite and ground-satellite links. Recent work has shown that link-flooding attacks (LFAs) can exploit these properties to congest strategic network bottlenecks. Yet, prior work does not quantify the resilience of LEO networks to targeted disruption. We present HYDRA, a modeling and optimization framework that formulates LFA variants as botnet minimization problems. HYDRA quantifies network resilience to LFAs by measuring the smallest active subset of bots and the corresponding traffic allocation required to disrupt communication between targeted geographic areas. Under matched stealth constraints, HYDRA achieves the same targeted disruption as ICARUS while using 34% fewer bots and 23% less aggregate attack traffic. HYDRA achieves over 97% success in sustaining continuous attacks as the network topology evolves. Finally, HYDRA evaluates five mitigation strategies, showing how routing diversification, ingress policing, distance-based traffic constraints, source throttling, and botnet attrition reduce attack success and improve network resilience to targeted disruption.

</details>


### [402] [When the World Lies: Backdoor Attacks on Latent World Models for Downstream Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15781)
*Roberto Riaño,Gorka Abad,Stjepan Picek,Aitor Urbieta*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文揭示预训练世界模型作为可复用动力学骨干时存在供应链后门：仅控制发布检查点的攻击者即可劫持下游控制器，且受害者全程使用干净数据训练与评估、从未见过触发器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练世界模型正像预训练编码器和语言模型一样被作为现成的动力学骨干复用于控制任务，但这种复用引入的供应链攻击面尚未被充分研究。作者旨在证明仅控制已发布检查点的攻击者能劫持下游控制器，而受害者在干净数据上训练评估、从未接触触发器。

Method: 攻击不编码显式的“触发器→动作”规则。被投毒模型将带触发器的观测路由到选定的潜在区域，并重塑该区域的局部动力学，使受害者自身的优化过程（Dreamer 式想象中 actor 训练，或基于预测未来的 MPC/CEM 规划）自行重新发现攻击者的目标动作。

Result: 在多个控制任务和触发器族上，触发器将控制器动作导向攻击者目标，可控制所有动作维度，在最强设置下劫持 100% 的触发步。检查点仍能通过受害者部署前的干净数据诊断，干净任务成功率至少保持约 75%。效应具有时间门控性：仅在触发器存在时出现，移除触发器后消失。触发器盲修复具有预算依赖性：适度干净微调可保留干净效用但触发失败依旧存在，而足够激进的适配只有在显著降低干净控制性能后才能消除该效应。

Conclusion: 世界模型骨干本身正成为控制领域一个新兴且未被充分审视的攻击面。完整代码与工件已在仓库中提供。

Abstract: Pretrained world models, learned simulators that encode an observation into a latent state and predict how it evolves under actions, are beginning to be reused as off-the-shelf dynamics backbones for control, like pretrained encoders and language models are reused today. We show that this reuse opens a supply-chain backdoor: an adversary who controls only a released checkpoint can hijack the downstream controller, even though the victim trains and evaluates entirely on clean data and never sees the trigger. The attack encodes no explicit trigger-to-action rule. Instead, the poisoned model routes trigger-bearing observations into a chosen latent region and reshapes the local dynamics there, so that the victim's own optimization (Dreamer-style actor training in imagination, or MPC/CEM planning over predicted futures) re-discovers the attacker's target action on its own. Across several control tasks and trigger families, the trigger steers the controller's action toward the attacker's target, controlling every action dimension and hijacking 100\% of triggered steps on the strongest settings. The checkpoint still passes the clean-data diagnostics a victim would run before deployment, with clean-task success retaining at least $\sim$75\%. The effect is temporally gated: it appears only while the trigger is present and disappears when the trigger is removed. Trigger-blind repair is budget-dependent: moderate clean fine-tuning can preserve clean utility while leaving the triggered failure intact, whereas sufficiently aggressive adaptation can remove it only after substantially degrading clean control. The world-model backbone itself is therefore an emerging and underexamined attack surface for control. The full code and artifacts are available in our repository.

</details>


### [403] [RAPID: A Real-Time Defense Against Unauthorized Model Distillation for Text-to-Image Services](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15799)
*Zihan Wang,Boheng Li,Rui Zhang,Wenshu Fan,Qingchuan Zhao,Tianwei Zhang,Hongwei Li,Guowen Xu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出RAPID框架，将防御扰动集成进VAE解码器，通过自参考潜在最大化与重建引导颜色正则，实现对T2I模型输出蒸馏的实时、低开销防护。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散式T2I模型的生成能力是重要知识产权，但易受黑盒输出蒸馏攻击（攻击者采集prompt-图像对训练未授权替代模型）。现有基于扰动的方法采用逐样本优化，计算与延迟开销大，损害在线服务可用性；而直接迁移到共享解码器设置时，逐样本目标难以奏效，经验发现共享解码器引起的潜在偏移远小于逐样本优化，说明该场景下"目标可达性"比"破坏性"更关键。

Method: RAPID：自参考潜在最大化框架，去除外部依赖，促使同一模型更新在训练样本间产生一致的破坏效果以提升可达性；并引入重建引导的颜色正则化，阻断潜在捷径并强化视觉破坏。

Result: 在4个T2I模型与4个数据集上、对比5个代表性基线，RAPID持续降低替代模型生成质量，同时保持服务端视觉保真度。

Conclusion: 该工作为已部署T2I系统中针对未授权蒸馏的实时防护建立了新范式。

Abstract: Diffusion-based text-to-image (T2I) models are increasingly used for visual content creation, making their generation capability a valuable intellectual property asset. However, this capability is vulnerable to black-box output-based distillation, where an adversary queries the service, collects prompt-image pairs, and trains an unauthorized substitute model that mimics its generation behavior. Existing perturbation-based defenses apply sample-wise optimization to make generated images disruptive to unauthorized training, but introduce substantial computation and latency that reduce the usability of online T2I services. A natural solution is to integrate defensive perturbations into the VAE decoder, allowing the protected model to generate defended images directly without online sample-wise optimization. However, existing sample-wise objectives struggle to transfer to the shared decoder setting. We empirically find that a defensive shared decoder induces a substantially smaller latent shift than sample-wise optimization, suggesting that objective reachability matters more than destructiveness in this setting. To overcome this limitation, we propose RAPID, a self-referenced latent maximization framework that removes external dependencies and encourages the same model update to induce consistently disruptive effects across training samples, thereby improving reachability. We further introduce reconstruction-guided color regularization that blocks the latent shortcut and reinforces visual disruption. Extensive experiments on four T2I models and four datasets, with comparisons against five representative baselines, show that RAPID consistently degrades substitute-model generation quality while preserving service visual fidelity. Our work establishes a paradigm for real-time protection against unauthorized distillation in deployed T2I systems.

</details>


### [404] [First Galileo SAS Authenticated Time Solution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15824)
*Aleix Galan-Figueras,Ignacio Fernandez-Hernandez,Wim De Wilde,Rafael Terris-Gallego,Gonzalo Seco-Granados,Cillian O'Driscoll,Sibren De Bast,Sofie Pollin*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文首次实现了基于经过认证的民用GNSS信号（Galileo E6-C SAS）的时间解算，利用快照软件接收机从认证伪距中计算接收机钟差，验证了在SAS全面部署之前实现认证授时的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对民用GNSS接收机的欺骗攻击日益普遍，尤其在冲突区域严重影响航空、海事和关键基础设施。现有加密认证方案（如Galileo OSNMA）仅验证导航数据的真实性，而测距码本身仍未受保护，因此Galileo推出E6-C信号认证服务（SAS）直接认证测距测量。但SAS目前仅由两颗椭圆轨道卫星播发、同时最多可见一颗，无法完成完整定位解算，本文旨在探索在此约束下能否实现认证授时。

Method: 开发了一个快照软件接收机，实现简化版Galileo SAS协议，从单条经过认证的伪距中计算接收机钟差；使用Septentrio工程原型软件定义无线电接收机采集的射频数据，对两颗支持SAS的卫星在不同地点采集的记录进行评估。

Result: 成功从经过认证的民用GNSS信号中计算出时间解，并在不同采集地点、使用两颗SAS能力卫星的录制数据完成评估，验证了在SAS全面运行部署之前实现认证授时的可行性。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首次从经过认证的民用GNSS信号中计算时间解，表明在SAS完全部署前即可利用单条认证伪距实现认证授时，为抗欺骗授时提供了新途径。

Abstract: Spoofing attacks against civilian GNSS receivers have grown more common, especially near conflict zones where they now disrupt civil aviation, maritime operations, and critical infrastructure on a daily basis. Spoofing is possible because legacy civil GNSS signals are largely predictable in both their navigation data and ranging codes, allowing an attacker to forge a signal that imposes a false position and time on an unsuspecting receiver. Cryptographic authentication schemes such as Galileo's Open Service Navigation Message Authentication (OSNMA) mitigate this threat by verifying the authenticity of the navigation data. The ranging code itself, however, remains unprotected. To close this gap, Galileo is introducing a Signal Authentication Service (SAS) in the E6-C signal, which directly authenticates ranging measurements. SAS is currently transmitted by only two satellites in an elliptical orbital plane, of which at most one is visible at a time, meaning a full position solution is not yet possible; however, a georeferenced receiver can still obtain an authenticated time solution. This paper presents, to the authors' knowledge, for the first time, a timing solution computed from an authenticated civil GNSS signal. We develop a snapshot software receiver implementing a simplified version of the Galileo SAS protocol to compute the receiver clock bias from an authenticated pseudorange, using radio-frequency data recorded with an engineering prototype software-defined radio receiver from Septentrio. We evaluate the resulting timing solution using recordings from both SAS-capable satellites collected at different locations, demonstrating the feasibility of authenticated timing ahead of full SAS operational deployment.

</details>


### [405] [The Model Proposes, the Code Disposes: A Pre-Registered Ablation of a Verifier-and-Acceptance Stage in an LLM-Orchestrated Offensive-Security Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15887)
*Theodoros Moutesidis*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 在受控靶场中，将"模型验证器+确定性代码强制执行"的验证-接受阶段加入LLM攻防安全智能体，可显著减少上报前被压制的发现（中位数2 vs 0，单侧精确p=0.00003），并提升模型盲评下的发布精度（0.471 vs 0.353，p=0.0087），但未证明召回率等效或优于其他智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估验证-接受阶段（模型验证器给出裁决、由确定性代码强制执行）是否会改变LLM驱动的攻防安全智能体所报告的内容，即该阶段对智能体产出（压制行为、发布精度、召回、审计可追踪性）的影响。

Method: 三部分研究：(1) 15次运行的探索性预实验；(2) 预注册的20次运行确证性消融实验；(3) 预注册的2×2析因研究，40次运行，覆盖两个刻意设置的易受攻击实验室靶标。比较加入与移除验证-接受阶段的效果，并对模型验证器与确定性接受规则的作用进行归因分解；同时使用插桩金丝雀检测外部接触。

Result: 确证性研究：移除该阶段后，上报前压制消失（中位数2 vs 0，单侧精确p=0.00003），模型盲评发布精度下降（0.471 vs 0.353，p=0.0087）；对冻结但不完整的真值列表，召回无显著差异（双侧p=0.158，未建立等效）。析因研究将压制归因于模型验证器（Holm校正p=0.004）；确定性接受规则单独未压制任何假阳性，未检出交互作用（p=0.72）。完整设计保留93.8%的模型裁定真候选，但未达到预注册非劣效标准（单侧95%下界0.875<0.90）。60/60次运行金丝雀零接触。存在6项审计轨迹故障（含1项评估工具故障）。

Conclusion: 结论较为保守：验证器改变了系统最终发布的内容，确定性代码提供强制执行与可审计性；但未证明其优于其他智能体，也未证明可推广到实验室靶标之外。精度与敏感度指标目前仅为支持性证据（独立人工裁决尚未完成）。

Abstract: We evaluate whether a verifier-and-acceptance stage - a model verifier whose verdicts are enforced by deterministic code - changes what an LLM-driven offensive-security agent reports. We report a 15-run exploratory pilot, a pre-registered 20-run confirmatory ablation, and a pre-registered 2 x 2 factorial study with 40 runs across two deliberately vulnerable lab targets. In the confirmatory study, removing the stage eliminated pre-report suppression (median 2 versus 0 findings per run; exact one-sided p = 0.00003) and reduced model-blinded shipped precision (median 0.471 versus 0.353; p = 0.0087). Recall against a frozen but incomplete ground-truth list did not differ significantly (two-sided p = 0.158; equivalence was not established). The factorial study attributed suppression to the model verifier (Holm-adjusted p = 0.004); deterministic acceptance rules alone suppressed no false positives, and no interaction was detected (p = 0.72). The full design retained 93.8% of model-adjudicated true candidates but did not meet its pre-registered non-inferiority criterion because the lower one-sided 95% bound was 0.875, below the 0.90 floor. Across the confirmatory and factorial studies, an instrumented canary recorded zero contacts in 60 of 60 runs, with incidental external contacts disclosed separately. Independent human adjudication of the retained blind packets is pending, so precision and sensitivity endpoints are supporting rather than final evidence. Six audit-trail failures, including one in the evaluation tooling, are also disclosed. The results support a narrow conclusion: the verifier changes what the system ships, while deterministic code supplies enforcement and auditability; they do not establish superiority to other agents or generalization beyond lab targets.

</details>


### [406] [Authorization Architectures for Tool-Using AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15906)
*Rakesh Kumar Surapani,Pradeep Kumar Dolabehera Kakitapelli,Arun Morampudi,Praveena Padi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该综述提出以“人类用户—运营者—编排智能体—子智能体—工具端点”构成的委托主体层级为组织框架，系统考察智能体身份与凭证、委托与作用域传播、运行时授权执行、提示注入作为授权绕过、以及可审计性与不可否认性五个层面，并给出七项结构性要求、四层参考架构与三种可部署配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具调用型AI智能体（可自主调用API、数据库、浏览器及MCP等协议）正成为生产基础设施，但“智能体何时被授权代表人类行动”的安全模型仍不成熟。可信的人机系统要求每个重要动作可追溯到人类委托主体、受实际委托范围约束、且事后可争议，而现有部署难以端到端可靠满足这三项性质；既有文献多在孤立地处理某一侧面（非人类身份凭证、经典访问控制、提示注入、审计日志），却忽视了授权决策点本身——即工具调用发生的那一刻。

Method: 采用结构化叙述性综述：从约180篇候选文献中筛选出2023至2026年间发表的89篇一手来源，围绕主体层级与五个相互依赖的层面进行分析，提炼七项结构性要求，推导四层参考架构，并将要求应用于三种可部署参考配置。

Result: 提出七项结构性要求与四层参考架构，并在三种可部署参考配置上验证要求；识别出运行时执行（runtime enforcement）与聚合边界（aggregation bounds）为主要未解决缺口。

Conclusion: 面向工具使用型AI智能体的授权安全模型需以委托主体层级为核心，将身份凭证、委托作用域传播、策略执行点处的即时授权、针对提示注入的防护与审计溯源统一为端到端框架；当前最紧迫的研究空白在于运行时可执行性与多跳/多动作聚合的边界界定。

Abstract: Tool-using artificial intelligence (AI) agents, systems that autonomously invoke application programming interfaces (APIs), databases, browsers, and inter-agent protocols such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), are becoming production infrastructure. Yet the security model governing when an agent is authorized to act on a human's behalf remains underdeveloped. Trustworthy human-AI systems require that every consequential agent action be traceable to a human principal, bounded by what that human actually delegated, and contestable after the fact; few documented deployments satisfy all three properties reliably and end to end. Existing literature addresses fragments of this problem in isolation, credential management for non-human identities, classical access control models, prompt injection, and audit trails, while giving little attention to the authorization decision point itself, the moment a tool invocation occurs, and mechanisms that make that decision correct, enforceable, and accountable. This review introduces a principal hierarchy spanning human user, operator/deployer, orchestrator agent, sub-agent, and tool endpoint as an organizing framework, and examines five interdependent layers: agent identity and credential lifecycle; delegation and scope propagation across multi-hop chains; runtime enforcement and just-in-time authorization at policy enforcement points (PEPs); prompt injection as an authorization bypass that breaks the principal hierarchy; and auditability, provenance, and non-repudiation. Drawing on a structured narrative review of 89 primary sources screened from approximately 180 candidates published between 2023 and 2026, we propose seven structural requirements, derive a four-layer reference architecture, apply the requirements to three deployable reference configurations, and identify runtime enforcement and aggregation bounds as the principal unresolved gaps.

</details>


### [407] [Vulnerability Localization Benchmark: Measuring Agentic Security Analysis at Repository Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15939)
*Aman Priyanshu,Supriti Vijay,Kimia Majd,Xuhong He,Fraser Burch,Takahiro Matsumoto,Jianliang He,Baturay Saglam,Arthur Goldblatt,Zhuoran Yang,Amin Karbasi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出VLoc Bench基准，研究代码库级别的漏洞定位能力，评估27个语言模型与4个静态分析工具，发现定位仍具挑战且定位能力不等于修复后可靠判断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有网络安全评估主要关注模型能否检测、复现或修复漏洞，而忽略了"能否定位相关代码"这一前置能力；仓库规模下的漏洞定位是独立且尚未被系统评估的能力。

Method: 构建VLoc Bench，包含来自290个仓库、6个包生态、147个CWE类别的500个真实漏洞；每个任务提供修复前后两个快照。漏洞快照下仅给CWE描述与只读终端访问，要求返回受影响文件；已修复快照下需判断漏洞是否已不存在。在统一智能体接口下评估27个语言模型和4个静态分析工具。

Result: 仓库级漏洞定位依然困难：最强系统File F1仅0.229，38.4%的任务无任何被评模型正确定位。此外，定位能力强并不意味着修复后行为可靠，能有效识别漏洞文件的系统仍可能在已修复仓库上报告无依据的位置。

Conclusion: 漏洞定位应被视为一种独特的仓库级能力；该工作提供了研究安全智能体如何搜索漏洞代码以及何时应避免误报的评估框架。

Abstract: Language-model agents increasingly operate over complete software repositories, yet cybersecurity evaluations primarily measure whether they can detect, reproduce, or repair vulnerabilities rather than whether they can locate the relevant code. We study vulnerability localization: given a weakness class and an unfamiliar repository, identify the implementation files associated with that weakness. We introduce the Vulnerability Localization Benchmark (VLoc Bench), comprising 500 real world vulnerabilities from 290 repositories across six package ecosystems and 147 CWE categories. Each task pairs repository snapshots immediately before and after a security fix. On the vulnerable snapshot, an agent receives only the CWE description and read-only terminal access and must return the affected files; on the patched snapshot, it must determine that the recorded vulnerability is no longer present. We evaluate 27 language models and four static-analysis tools under a common agent interface. Repository-scale vulnerability localization remains difficult: the strongest system achieves 0.229 File F1, and 38.4% of tasks receive no correct localization from any evaluated model.
  We further find that stronger localization does not imply reliable behavior after remediation: systems that identify vulnerable files effectively can still report unsupported locations on patched repositories. These results establish vulnerability localization as a distinct repository-scale capability and provide a setting for studying both how security agents search for vulnerable code and when they should refrain from reporting it.

</details>


### [408] [Adversarial Testing of Automated Program Repair Agents for Security Vulnerabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15963)
*Fares Trad,Simin Chen,Hung Viet Pham,Gias Uddin,Baishakhi Ray*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文首次实证研究了LLM自动程序修复（APR）智能体在对抗性issue描述下的安全性，构建了SWEADV基准（750条对抗性issue，覆盖5类攻击），发现对抗描述可使智能体在修复成功的同时以51.7%的比例引入恶意行为，且现有检测机制（LLM-as-judge、静态分析）检测准确率仅为39.4%~62.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM智能体被用于自动程序修复，未来APR智能体可能在极少人工干预下自动修bug，由此引发信任问题：智能体能否同时产出功能正确且安全的代码？若攻击者针对生产环境部署的APR智能体，构造看似良性、实则诱导其生成"功能正确但不安全"代码的对抗性issue，后果如何？现有工作缺乏对此类对抗攻击的系统性实证评估。

Method: 1）构建SWEADV基准：基于SWE-bench Verified的150个修复任务，为每个任务生成5种攻击类型的对抗性issue描述（命令执行、反序列化、路径遍历、拒绝服务、弱哈希），共750条。2）评估3种LLM后端（GPT-5-Mini、MiniMax-M2.5、DeepSeek-R）的mini_swe APR智能体在SWEADV上的表现。3）检验常规检测机制的有效性：修复前用LLM-as-judge检测对抗issue描述；修复后用静态分析工具与LLM-as-judge检测对抗性补丁。

Result: 对抗性issue描述平均可诱导智能体在51.7%的情况下产生含恶意行为的"修复成功"补丁；修复前LLM-as-judge检测对抗issue的平均准确率仅62.3%；修复后静态分析工具与LLM-as-judge检测对抗补丁的平均准确率分别仅39.4%和55.4%。

Conclusion: 自主APR智能体对对抗攻击具有明显脆弱性，现有检测机制不足以拦截恶意补丁，因此目前尚不能信任其在生产环境中部署。研究呼吁在APR智能体的安全对齐、对抗鲁棒性及补丁安全验证方面开展进一步工作。

Abstract: Software agents with Large Language Models (LLMs) are designed for Automated Program Repair (APR) tasks, raising the possibility that, in the near future, APR agents will fix bugs automatically without much human intervention. Can we trust an APR agent to produce both functionally correct and secure code in such situations? What if attackers target production APR agents with adversarial issues that seem benign but may influence the agents to produce correct but insecure code? In this paper, we took a first step towards answering these questions by conducting an empirical study. First, we created SWEADV, a benchmark of 750 adversarial issue descriptions constructed from 150 repair tasks in SWE-bench Verified. For each repair task, we created five adversarial issue descriptions, one for each attack type: command execution, deserialization, path traversal, denial of service, and weak hashing. Second, we evaluated mini_swe APR agents from three LLM backends on SWEADV: GPT-5-Mini, MiniMax-M2.5, and DeepSeek-R. We found that on average, adversarial issue descriptions can induce malicious behaviors with successful repair in 51.7% of cases. Third, we investigated whether typical detection mechanisms are sufficient to prevent such malicious patches from being accepted. Pre-repair detection with LLM-as-judge on the adversarial issue descriptions resulted in an average detection accuracy of only 62.3%. Post-repair detection on adversarial APR patches using static analysis tools and LLM-as-judge achieved average detection accuracies of only 39.4% and 55.4%, respectively. We conclude that autonomous APR agents cannot be trusted yet in production deployment, given their susceptibility to adversarial attacks.

</details>

### [409] [Stochastic Gradient Descent over P2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13343)
*Maria Oprea,Qin Li,Yunan Yang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究在概率测度空间（Wasserstein空间P2）上的随机梯度下降（SGD）是否具有类似欧氏空间的扩散近似。借助Lions可微性将问题提升到线性Hilbert空间，构造速度场匹配原随机梯度均值与协方差的高斯随机场近似，并通过高阶Taylor展开证明该高斯近似以二阶弱精度捕捉SGD动力学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典SGD的扩散近似用高斯噪声替代随机梯度的复杂随机性，是理解其动力学与长期行为的强有力工具。但该原理能否推广到目标为P2上泛函的概率测度优化尚不清楚：P2的非线性几何与无穷维特性使欧氏理论无法直接推广，因此需要建立相应的近似原理。

Method: 利用Lions可微性将P2上的优化问题提升到线性Hilbert空间，从而可用高阶微分运算；构造一个高斯随机场近似，使其速度场匹配原随机梯度的均值与协方差（矩匹配）；借助高阶Taylor展开分析该矩匹配，证明高斯近似对SGD动力学的逼近精度。

Result: 通过高阶Taylor展开的矩匹配分析，证明所构造的高斯近似能够以二阶弱精度（second-order weak accuracy）捕捉概率测度上SGD的动力学。

Conclusion: 该结果为在概率测度上的随机优化中用解析上易处理的高斯涨落替代样本驱动的随机性提供了严格的理论基础。

Abstract: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) admits diffusion approximations that replace the complicated randomness of stochastic gradients by Gaussian noise, providing a powerful tool for understanding its dynamics and long-time behavior. We investigate whether an analogous approximation principle holds for optimization over probability measures, where the objective is a functional defined on the Wasserstein space P2. The nonlinear geometry and infinite-dimensional nature of P2 prevent a direct extension of the classical Euclidean theory. Using Lions differentiability, we lift the problem to a linear Hilbert space, where higher-order differential calculus becomes available. We then construct a Gaussian random-field approximation whose velocity field matches the mean and covariance of the original stochastic gradient. By exploiting this moment matching through higher-order Taylor expansions, we show that the Gaussian approximation captures the SGD dynamics with second-order weak accuracy. Our result provides a rigorous foundation for replacing sample-driven randomness by analytically tractable Gaussian fluctuations in stochastic optimization over probability measures.

</details>


### [410] [Beyond Point Forecasts: A Survey on Probabilistic Forecasting for Time Series and Spatiotemporal Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13345)
*Donia Besher,Rajdeep Pathak,Madhurima Panja,Tanujit Chakraborty*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该综述按"不确定性在预测流程中何处、以何种方式引入"建立统一分类法，整合模型无关与模型内在的概率预测方法，并通过跨范式实证研究给出方法选择指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率预测对不确定性下的决策至关重要，但其方法论在时间序列与时空预测、统计建模、机器学习、深度生成模型等方向日益碎片化，缺乏统一视角，也缺少面向具体任务与领域的方法选择依据。

Method: 提出以不确定性引入位置与方式为核心的分类法：模型无关方法（集成、无分布校准）与模型内在方法（贝叶斯建模、参数化预测分布、分布回归、现代生成模型），并考察时间序列基础模型的新兴作用；同时梳理各范式的假设、计算需求与所表征的不确定性类型，并在单变量、多变量与时空预测任务上开展跨范式实证对比。

Result: 实证表明没有任何单一不确定性量化范式在所有设定中占优；校准、锐度、预测精度与计算效率会导致显著不同的模型偏好；表达能力强的生成模型与零样本基础模型在精度—效率权衡上差异明显。

Conclusion: 该综述提供了概率预测研究的概念框架与实践路线图，并指出若干未解挑战：演化依赖结构中的不确定性、物理信息预测分布、极端事件预测、计数型/方向型/连续时间序列的处理，以及统一软件资源的建设。

Abstract: Probabilistic forecasting is central to decision-making under uncertainty, yet its methodological landscape has become increasingly fragmented across temporal and spatiotemporal forecasting, statistical modeling, machine learning, and deep generative modeling. This survey develops a unified perspective by organizing probabilistic forecasting methods according to where and how uncertainty is introduced into the forecasting pipeline. Our taxonomy connects model-agnostic approaches including ensembles and distribution-free calibration, with model-intrinsic approaches spanning Bayesian modeling, parametric predictive distributions, distributional regression, and modern generative models, and further examines the emerging role of time series foundation models. Beyond methodological synthesis, we identify the assumptions, computational demands, and forms of uncertainty represented by different paradigms, and translate these distinctions into data-driven and domain-specific guidance for method selection. We complement the survey with a cross-paradigm empirical study on univariate, multivariate, and spatiotemporal forecasting tasks. The results reveal that no single uncertainty-quantification paradigm dominates across settings. Calibration, sharpness, predictive accuracy, and computational efficiency can lead to substantially different model preferences, while expressive generative models and zero-shot foundation models exhibit markedly different accuracy-efficiency trade-offs. Lastly, we identify unresolved challenges surrounding uncertainty in evolving dependency structures, physics-informed predictive distributions, forecasting extreme events, handling count-valued, directional, and continuous-time series, and the development of unified software resources. Our survey provides both a conceptual framework and a practical roadmap for probabilistic forecasting research.

</details>


### [411] [A pullback-corrected scalar auxiliary variable optimizer with momentum and adaptive mobility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13569)
*Jiahao Zhang,Shiheng Zhang,Guang Lin*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文将PB-SAV方法中的曲率校正引入带动量与自适应移动率的优化器，在单次隐式求解中同时作用于梯度与动量，建立精确修正能量律与局部稳定性/几何收敛判据，并在Burgers正问题中以四分量显著降低尾部目标与解误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学机器学习的目标函数常为多项损失之和（如PINN的残差、边界、初始与数据损失），各分量的尺度与曲率差异使优化困难。PB-SAV方法虽用标量跟踪平移目标并构造低秩半正定曲率校正，但尚缺乏将其与动量及自适应移动率结合的优化器设计，以及相应的能量稳定性与收敛理论。

Method: 在PB-SAV框架下，以一个标量跟踪平移目标，分量梯度构造秩至多为分量数的半正定曲率校正，并将其带入带动量与自适应移动率的优化器中，在单次隐式求解中同时更新梯度与存储动量。对移动率施加Loewner序非增条件；固定移动率时给出基于Hessian减两倍校正的局部稳定性充要条件，并证明其对任意标量松弛序列的局部几何收敛性。隐式求解化为阶数等于分量数的稠密线性系统。

Result: 非增（Loewner序）移动率给出精确的修正能量律，涵盖欧氏与AMSGrad型选择；而求解后再附加动量的恒等式带有不定号交叉项。所得稳定性充要条件同时保证局部几何收敛。Burgers正问题对比中，相同学习率与动量设置下，四分量相较单分量使平均尾部目标降低64.7%、最终解误差降低50.2%。

Conclusion: 该工作将PB-SAV的曲率校正从梯度层推广到带动量与自适应移动率的隐式优化器，提供了能量律与局部收敛理论，并以低维稠密求解保持计算可行性；实验验证了多分量校正对科学机器学习多项目标的显著优化增益。

Abstract: Objectives in scientific machine learning are often prescribed as a sum of several terms, such as the residual, boundary, initial, and data losses of a physics-informed neural network. In the pullback-corrected scalar auxiliary variable (PB--SAV) method, one scalar tracks the shifted objective while the component gradients build a positive semidefinite curvature correction of rank at most the number of components. We carry that correction into an optimizer with momentum and an adaptive mobility, applying it to the gradient and the stored momentum in a single implicit solve. A mobility that is nonincreasing in the Loewner order yields an exact modified energy law, covering Euclidean and AMSGrad-type choices; the corresponding identity for momentum appended after the solve carries a cross term of indefinite sign. For a fixed mobility we give a necessary and sufficient condition for local stability at a stationary point, depending on the Hessian minus twice the correction, and show that it also gives local geometric convergence for every scalar relaxation sequence. The implicit solve reduces to a dense system whose order is the number of components. In the forward Burgers comparison, four components reduce the mean tail objective by 64.7% and the final solution error by 50.2% relative to one component at the same learning rate and momentum settings.

</details>


### [412] [Resolution-Independent Analysis of Encoder--Decoder Operator Learning via Limiting Kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13798)
*Lei Shi,Jia-Qi Yang,Ding-Xuan Zhou*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文研究编码器-解码器算子学习的逼近与优化理论：编码空间上的矩阵值核诱导原函数空间上的算子值核，二者RKHS等距同构，且随分辨率增大的诱导核在算子范数意义下收敛到极限核；对正则化SGD给出下降/固定步长的上界并将编码与正则化项同优化项分离，还证明编码诱导项一般不可避免，并推广到编码器-解码器NTK。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算子学习理论上定义在函数空间上，但训练数据只能以有限维表示获得，因此编码-解码带来的表示误差与正则化、优化误差如何相互作用缺乏清晰的理论刻画，尤其缺少与编码分辨率相关的、分辨率无关的 regularity 假设与可证明的收敛性与复杂性分析。

Method: 在编码器-解码器架构下，将编码空间上的矩阵值核通过编码/解码映射诱导为原函数空间上的算子值核，并证明相应RKHS间的等距同构；分析随输入输出分辨率提高时诱导核的极限核及其相关积分算子的算子范数收敛；对正则化随机梯度下降（正则化SGD）分别在递减步长与固定步长下建立误差上界；进一步构造下界证明编码诱导误差项一般不可避免；最后利用极限神经正切核（NTK）将分析推广到编码器-解码器神经网络，得到含有限宽度项的误差界，并在编码误差代数衰减时给出多项式参数与样本复杂度保证。

Result: 得到随分辨率一致的极限核与相关的算子范数收敛结论，使正则性假设可独立于编码分辨率表述；在递减与固定步长下给出误差上界，将编码项与正则化项同阶为 t^{-θ} 和 T^{-θ'}（任意 θ,θ'∈(0,1)）的优化项分离；证明编码诱导项在一般情况下不可消除；对编码器-解码器神经网络，误差界包含额外有限宽度项，并在编码误差代数衰减时获得多项式参数和样本复杂度保证；框架覆盖由径向核与点积核构造的矩阵值核、宽编码器-解码器网络的NTK，以及基于傅里叶、勒让德多项式、小波、PCA和逐点采样表示的编码器-解码器对。

Conclusion: 该工作为有限维编码下的算子学习建立了统一的理论框架，论证了编码分辨率、正则化与优化误差的分离与不可约性，并将结果通过极限NTK推广到编码器-解码器网络，给出参数/样本复杂度保证，适用于多种核构造与编码表示。

Abstract: Operator learning is formulated on function spaces, but training data are typically available only through finite-dimensional representations. In encoder--decoder architectures, a matrix-valued kernel on the encoded space induces an operator-valued kernel on the original function spaces, and the corresponding reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces are isometrically isomorphic. As the input and output resolutions increase, the induced kernels converge to a limiting kernel, in the sense of operator-norm convergence of their associated integral operators, allowing regularity assumptions to be stated independently of the encoding resolution. For regularized stochastic gradient descent, we establish upper bounds for decreasing and fixed step sizes, separating the encoding and regularization terms from optimization terms of order \(t^{-θ}\) and \(T^{-θ'}\), respectively, for any \(θ,θ'\in(0,1)\). We further prove lower bounds showing that these encoding-induced terms are generally unavoidable. The analysis is further extended to encoder--decoder neural networks through the limiting neural tangent kernel (NTK), yielding error bounds with an additional finite-width term and polynomial parameter and sample complexity guarantees when the encoding errors decay algebraically. The framework covers matrix-valued kernels constructed from radial and dot product kernels, NTKs arising from wide encoder--decoder neural networks, and encoder--decoder pairs based on Fourier, Legendre polynomial, wavelet, PCA, or pointwise sampling representations.

</details>


### [413] [Just add noise: Debiasing tree-based variable importance in mixed data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14083)
*Jiahe Li,Omar Melikechi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该文针对随机森林等树模型变量重要性评分偏向连续预测变量、低估分类预测变量的问题，给出理论分析并提出对分类变量加入少量噪声的简单校正方法，并在模拟与真实数据上验证，结合integrated path stability selection实现带错误发现控制的混合数据变量选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 树模型（如随机森林）的变量重要性评分存在系统性偏差：偏好连续预测变量而低估分类预测变量。这一偏差会影响重要性排序与后续变量选择的可靠性，尤其当数据同时包含连续与分类变量时，需要理论解释和简便的校正手段。

Method: 对上述偏差进行理论分析；提出简单校正：给每个分类预测变量加入少量噪声；在多种模拟数据和真实世界数据集上验证该校正；并将其与integrated path stability selection结合，用于混合数据下具有错误发现控制（false discovery control）的变量选择。

Result: 理论分析揭示了树模型重要性评分对分类变量的偏差机制；所提出的加噪校正方法在多种模拟与真实数据集上均得到验证，表明可有效缓解该偏差；与integrated path stability selection结合后，能在混合数据上实现具有错误发现控制的变量选择。

Conclusion: 对分类预测变量加入少量噪声是一种简单有效的偏差校正手段，可提升树模型变量重要性的公平性，并可嵌入integrated path stability selection框架，实现混合数据类型下的、带错误发现控制的稳健变量选择。

Abstract: Variable importance scores from tree-based methods such as random forests favor continuous predictors over categorical ones. We present a theoretical analysis of this bias and propose a simple remedy: add a small amount of noise to each categorical predictor. The correction is demonstrated on a variety of simulated and real-world datasets and combined with integrated path stability selection to perform variable selection with false discovery control for mixed data.

</details>


### [414] [Exact Finite Attention Responses From RoPE Derivatives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14127)
*Julie Huang,Maggie Chlon,Gregory Gutin,Leon Chlon*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文提出基于RoPE导数精确响应公式的注意力干预分析方法，用一次反向传播即可从缓存基线评分候选编辑，并揭示键值同时编辑中的交互项不可忽略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有注意力归因或位置编辑评分方法常对旋转与归一化做线性化近似，且将键编辑与值编辑的贡献简单相加，忽略二者交互，导致预测偏差较大。论文旨在给出无需线性化的精确局部响应，以提升编辑评分的准确性与效率。

Method: 从RoPE导数 ∂_p z(p)=A z(p) 出发，积分得到有限位置位移，并将其完整穿过softmax而不线性化旋转或归一化；对键与值同时编辑，采用dividing-difference微分计算分离出交互项 C_KV=Σ_j(p'_j−p_j)ε_j；下游预测由基线梯度收缩该响应，并以原生执行评估。方法还给出局部近似误差的KL证书、精确查询条件梯度步表示、识别注意力保持的查询方向及最小范数查询控制。

Result: 在768个留出提示集、92,160次已执行位置编辑上，符号准确率95.36%–96.52%，答案边际MAE相对位置Jacobian降低73.6%–82.5%，相对零基线降低36.2%–50.9%。键值同时编辑时，保留交互项在5,120次干预扫描（两种Qwen规模、两个任务、多层）中使下游边际MAE降低超过九倍，相对二次交互校正降低75.9%–98.5%。

Conclusion: 精确局部响应的微分演算可在无需线性化近似的情况下高精度评分注意力编辑，并证明键值交互项在同时编辑中不可或缺。稀疏评估支持在明确局部失真准则下进行候选排序与缓存决策。

Abstract: We derive exact local responses for attention interventions, allowing candidate edits to be scored from a cached baseline and one backward pass. The starting point is the RoPE derivative $\partial_p z(p) = A z(p)$: its integral gives the finite positional displacement, which we carry through the softmax without linearising either rotation or normalisation. The resulting predictions achieve 95.36--96.52% sign accuracy across 92,160 executed positional edits on 768 held-out prompt sets, reducing answer-margin MAE by 73.6--82.5% against the positional Jacobian and by 36.2--50.9% against zero. For simultaneous key and value edits, the same divided-difference calculus isolates the interaction term $C_{KV} = \sum_j (p'_j - p_j)\,\varepsilon_j$, which is omitted by adding separate attributions. Retaining it reduces downstream margin MAE by more than a factor of nine in every setting of a 5,120-intervention sweep across two Qwen sizes, two tasks, and multiple layers; reductions against a quadratic interaction correction are 75.9--98.5%. Exactness concerns the edited attention write; downstream predictions contract that response with a baseline gradient and are evaluated by native execution. The calculus also yields a KL certificate for local approximation error, an exact query-conditioned gradient-step representation whose curvature identifies attention-preserving query directions, and minimum-norm query control. Sparse evaluation supports candidate ranking and cache decisions under explicit local distortion criteria.

</details>


### [415] [Multi-source conformal prediction: leveraging heterogeneity via localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14531)
*Rohan Hore,Anirban Chatterjee,Sayantan Choudhury*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出MS-RLCP方法，将随机局部化保形预测扩展到多源异构数据，通过数据自适应源选择在共享条件响应假设下实现有限样本覆盖界与渐近条件覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代预测任务常涉及多个异构数据源，且测试分布可能显著偏离任一单一源。异构性虽带来挑战，但也提供了机遇：不同源在特征空间的不同区域各有优势，可提供互补信息。

Method: 提出多源随机局部化保形预测（MS-RLCP），基于随机局部化保形预测（RLCP）的局部覆盖性质，通过数据自适应源选择将其扩展到多源场景。引入可解释的包络分布刻画各源在特征空间上的聚合表示。

Result: 在源与测试总体共享条件响应分布的假设下，建立了有限样本覆盖界，允许测试特征分布关于包络分布绝对连续，超越源分布混合的情形；在额外正则条件下，进一步建立了渐近的测试条件覆盖。仿真和真实实验验证了MS-RLCP在不同数据异构程度下的有效性。

Conclusion: MS-RLCP通过数据自适应源选择有效利用多源互补信息，在异构数据下提供具有理论保证的覆盖性能，是对RLCP向多源场景的推广。

Abstract: Many modern prediction tasks involve data from multiple heterogeneous sources, while the test distribution may differ substantially from any individual source. Although heterogeneity poses challenges, it also offers an opportunity: different sources may provide complementary information, with some regions of the feature space better represented in one source than another. We propose Multi-Source Randomly Localized Conformal Prediction (MS-RLCP), which builds on the local coverage properties of randomly localized conformal prediction (RLCP) (Hore and Barber, 2025) and extends it to multiple sources through data-adaptive source selection. Under the widely adopted assumption of a shared response distribution conditional on the features across sources and the test population, we establish finite-sample coverage bounds using an interpretable notion of envelope distribution that captures their aggregate feature-space representation. Our analysis allows the test feature distribution to be absolutely continuous with respect to the envelope, extending beyond mixtures of source distributions. Under additional regularity conditions, we also establish asymptotic test-conditional coverage. Simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of MS-RLCP across varying levels of data heterogeneity.

</details>


### [416] [Evaluation of optimisation and Bayesian inference methods for reaction rates in atmospheric chemical mechanisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14569)
*Valery Ashu,Wenqing Peng,Zhi-Song Liu,Heikki Haario,Andreas Rupp,Taiwo Ashu,Petri Clusius,Lukas Pichelstorfer,Zihao Fu,Michael Boy*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本研究以已知真值的合成数据为基础，构建玩具模型自氧化机制，比较ODE约束神经网络优化与MCMC两种速率系数约束方法。低噪声下两者均能收敛，神经网络更快；高噪声（S/N≈1）下MCMC更稳健。后验分析揭示质谱聚合会加宽可信区间，高噪声质谱导致许多速率弱可辨识，但后验预测仍能重现可观测质谱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 显式大气化学机制中反应速率系数的约束是核心难题，自氧化体系中许多反应路径仅能通过高分辨率质谱间接观测，参数可辨识性与不确定性量化缺乏系统评估。因此需要一个具有已知真值的受控案例，来对比点估计与贝叶斯采样方法在不同噪声与观测类型下的表现。

Method: 构建玩具案例自氧化机制，用合成数据（真值已知）评估两类速率系数优化方法：(1) ODE约束神经网络优化，给出不确定速率系数的高效点估计；(2) MCMC，采样速率系数后验分布并量化参数不确定性。测试条件包括直接浓度观测与质谱观测，并设置不同噪声水平（含S/N≈1的高噪声情形）。同时开展后验分析与后验预测验证。

Result: 在无扰动与低噪声合成观测下，两种方法均收敛到已知速率系数，神经网络优化器给出更快的点估计。在高噪声条件（S/N≈1）下，MCMC恢复速率系数明显更稳健。后验分析表明：即使在低噪声下，质谱聚合也会加宽可信区间；高噪声质谱下许多单个反应速率呈弱可辨识。后验预测验证显示，MCMC约束下的宽参数不确定性仍与可观测质谱的准确再现相一致。

Conclusion: 点估计与贝叶斯采样方法提供互补信息：神经网络优化适用于信息量充足的数据，而MCMC在噪声或聚合反问题中对诊断不确定性、非唯一性与可辨识性不可或缺。

Abstract: Constraining reaction rate coefficients is a central challenge in the development of explicit atmospheric chemical mechanisms, particularly for autoxidation systems where many reaction pathways are only indirectly observed through high-resolution mass spectrometry. In this study, we evaluate rate-coefficient optimisation methods for a toy-case autoxidation mechanism using synthetic data with known ground truth. Two complementary approaches are compared: ODE-constrained neural-network optimisation, which provides efficient point estimates of uncertain rate coefficients, and the Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) approach, which samples the posterior distribution of rate coefficients and quantifies parameter uncertainty. The methods are tested using direct concentration observations and mass-spectral observations under different noise levels. For unperturbed and low-noise synthetic observations, both methods converged towards the known rate coefficients, with the neural-network optimiser providing faster point estimates. Under high-noise conditions (with the signal-to-noise ratio approximately S / N = 1), however, MCMC was substantially more robust in recovering the rate coefficients. The posterior analysis shows that mass-spectral aggregation broadens credible intervals even at low noise, and that high-noise mass spectra can leave many individual reaction rates weakly identifiable. Posterior predictive validation nevertheless shows how broad parameter uncertainty constrained by MCMC remains consistent with accurate reproduction of the observable mass spectrum. These results demonstrate that point-estimation and Bayesian sampling methods provide complementary information: neural-network optimisation is effective for informative data, whereas MCMC is essential for diagnosing uncertainty, non-uniqueness, and identifiability in noisy or aggregated inverse problems.

</details>


### [417] [PU classification under Non-SCAR: clustering-assisted logistic model with oversampling enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14675)
*Konrad Furmańczyk,Kacper Paczutkowski*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该研究在违反SCAR假设的PU分类场景下，将SMOTE与基于逻辑回归的聚类方法（含严格/非严格Lasso扩展）结合，并在13个真实数据集和1个合成数据集上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PU分类通常依赖SCAR假设，但实际中该假设常被违反，导致分类性能下降，同时类不平衡问题也会进一步影响算法表现。

Method: 先对训练集使用SMOTE重平衡；再通过2-means聚类进行标签清洗；随后在清洗后的数据上训练逻辑回归，将识别出的正例与额外真实正例合并，其余样本视为负例；方法涵盖聚类法及带严格与非严格Lasso正则化的扩展。

Result: 在13个真实基准数据集和1个合成数据集上，与朴素方法和Spy-EM对比，加入SMOTE在SCAR条件被违反时能提升分类性能，LassoJoint方法在该设置下表现出中等稳健性。

Conclusion: SMOTE的引入可缓解类不平衡并改善违反SCAR假设时的PU分类效果，LassoJoint具备一定鲁棒性，为相关场景提供了可行方案。

Abstract: This study addresses the PU classification problem under violations of the SCAR assumption. We investigate logistic regression-based approaches, namely the cluster method and its extensions with strict and non-strict Lasso regularization. The primary contribution of this work is the integration of the SMOTE technique to alleviate class imbalance and systematically assess its impact on the performance of the considered algorithms. SMOTE is first applied to rebalance the training dataset. Next, cleaning labels are derived via 2-means clustering. Logistic regression is then trained on the cleaned data, where identified positive instances are augmented with additional true positives and the remaining observations are treated as negative. The experimental evaluation is conducted on 13 real benchmark datasets and one synthetic dataset. For comparison, we include the naive approach and the Spy-EM method. The results demonstrate that incorporating SMOTE improves classification performance when the SCAR condition is violated and indicate moderate robustness of the LassoJoint method in this setting.

</details>


### [418] [From matrix inversion to constraints: provably tighter confidence regions for importance weights in label shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14802)
*Mushan Li,Kihyun Han,Yanyuan Ma*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文针对标签偏移下领域自适应中重要性权重估计的有限样本不确定性问题，提出从基于求逆的推断转向直接矩阵约束框架，构建联合置信区域并通过线性规划提取边际区间，得到可证明更紧的权重界，且保持精确的有限样本有效性，并在多类基准上验证了更短的置信区间与更小的预测集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重要性权重在标签偏移下的领域自适应中至关重要，但其效用常因估计所伴随的有限样本不确定性而受损。现有方法通常通过对区间值线性系统进行高斯消元来分析该不确定性，导致置信区域过于保守、下游应用效率低下。

Method: 提出从基于求逆的推断到直接矩阵约束框架的范式转变：利用该框架定义联合置信区域，并通过线性规划提取边际区间，从而为重要性权重推导可证明更紧的界，同时保持精确的有限样本有效性；此外还分析置信区域的几何结构，并给出其直径界的理论结果。

Result: 在文本、图像、多模态基准（包括 AGNews、MNIST、CIFAR-10、N24News 以及真实世界自动驾驶数据集 nuImages）上评估，该方法相比基于求逆的方法持续产生更短的置信区间和更小的预测集。

Conclusion: 直接的矩阵约束框架在标签偏移领域自适应中为重要性权重提供了更紧且有限样本有效的置信界，优于传统基于求逆的不确定性分析方法。

Abstract: Importance weights are essential in domain adaptation under label shift, yet their utility is often undermined by the finite sample uncertainty associated with their estimation. Existing methods typically analyze this uncertainty through Gaussian elimination on interval-valued linear systems, which leads to overly conservative confidence regions and inefficient downstream applications. We propose a paradigm shift from inversion-based inference to a direct matrix constraint framework. We use this framework to define a joint confidence region and extract marginal intervals via linear programming, deriving provably tighter bounds for importance weights while maintaining exact finite-sample validity. Furthermore, we analyze the confidence region's geometry and provide the theoretical results for its diameter bounds. Evaluated across text, image, multimodal benchmarks, including AGNews, MNIST, CIFAR-10, N24News, and a real-world autonomous driving dataset, nuImages, our approach consistently yields shorter confidence intervals and smaller prediction sets than inversion-based methods.

</details>


### [419] [A Functional SVD Framework for Regularized Multivariate Functional PCA with Dual Penalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14815)
*Yue Zhao,Hossein Haghbin,Rebecca Sanders,Mehdi Maadooliat*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出ReMFPCA框架，基于泛函奇异值分解（SVD）实现多元函数主成分分析的双重正则化，同时惩罚函数主成分与其得分，提升可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MFPCA方法多基于协方差特征分解，仅对函数主成分进行惩罚，无法过滤与受试者个体无关的变异，导致结果可解释性不足。

Method: 在Hilbert空间框架下引入广义泛函SVD，将正则化扩展至函数主成分及其得分，并对PC得分施加稀疏惩罚；提出序列式与联合式两种幂算法实现，并采用基于迭代回归的交叉验证选择最优平滑参数。

Result: 模拟研究与真实数据应用表明，该框架能显著改进信息丰富、可解释成分的提取效果。

Conclusion: 双惩罚策略相较传统协方差特征分解具有方法学优势，为多元函数数据分析提供实用价值。

Abstract: This paper introduces a novel framework for Regularized Multivariate Functional Principal Component Analysis (ReMFPCA) via Functional Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). The proposed method extends existing MFPCA approaches by incorporating a generalized functional SVD within a Hilbert space framework, enabling simultaneous regularization of both functional principal components (PCs) and their associated PC scores. A key innovation of this framework is the inclusion of a sparsity penalty on the PC scores, which enhances interpretability by filtering out irrelevant subject-specific variations. This dual-penalization strategy represents a significant advancement beyond existing covariance-based eigen decomposition methods, which penalize only the functional PCs. Two power algorithm implementations, sequential and joint, are proposed, together with a cross-validation approach based on iterative regression for optimal smoothing parameter selection. Comprehensive simulation studies and real data applications demonstrate that the proposed framework substantially improves the extraction of informative and interpretable components, offering methodological and practical benefits for analyzing multivariate functional data across diverse domains.

</details>


### [420] [Shapley Value Estimation for Multi-Site Data with Blockwise-Missing Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14902)
*Siqi Li,Wangxuan Fan,Yiming Li,Doudou Zhou,Molei Liu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文指出多站点场景下标准Shapley值估计因块状缺失而存在偏差，提出无需插补的FUSHAP方法，通过部分观测辅助站点降低方差并筛除分布不兼容站点，在合成与真实数据上显著降低MSE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Shapley值的特征归因方法通常假设评估联盟博弈的观测在统一特征空间下完全观测。但在生物医学、社会科学和环境监测的多站点研究中，各机构按不同协议记录不同特征，产生系统性的块状缺失。作者首先证明，先插补缺失特征再计算Shapley值这一常规做法会引入系统性的、依赖联盟的偏差，因此需要一种无需插补即可利用部分观测数据的方法。

Method: 提出FUSHAP（Fusion Shapley Attribution from Partially-observed data）。该方法以单站点的初步Shapley估计为起点，利用部分观测的辅助站点在不进行插补的情况下降低估计方差。同时设计基于置换的筛选步骤，检测并排除数据分布与目标总体不兼容的站点，以避免引入偏差。

Result: 合成实验中，FUSHAP相比单站点估计器MSE降低3–8倍，相比插补基线降低2–3倍，且不引入插补导致的偏差；筛选程序在中等错位下达到82%的检验功效，强错位下达到100%。在多站点空气质量数据和多中心临床数据上，FUSHAP相对单站点估计器将MSE降低约3–7倍；在临床应用中，标准插补方法甚至可能使MSE高于单站点基线。

Conclusion: FUSHAP为部分观测多站点数据提供了一种无插补、低方差且能自动排除分布不兼容站点的Shapley归因框架，优于单站点估计和插补基线，适用于跨机构协作的特征归因任务。

Abstract: Shapley value (SV)-based methods are the prevailing framework for feature attribution in machine learning, yet existing population-level Shapley estimators generally assume that observations used to evaluate the coalitional game are fully observed under a common feature space. This assumption is routinely violated in multi-site studies across biomedicine, social science, and environmental monitoring, where institutions record different features under different protocols, producing systematic blockwise missingness across sources. We first show that the standard remedy of imputing missing features before computing Shapley values introduces systematic, coalition-dependent bias into the resulting attributions. We then propose \textbf{FUSHAP} (\textbf{Fu}sion \textbf{Sh}apley \textbf{A}ttribution from \textbf{P}artially-observed data), a method that leverages partially-observed auxiliary sites to reduce the variance of a preliminary single-site Shapley estimate without imputation. A permutation-based screening step detects and excludes sites whose data distributions are incompatible with the target population. In synthetic experiments, FUSHAP achieves $3$--$8\times$ lower MSE than the single-site estimator and $2$--$3\times$ lower MSE than imputation baselines without incurring imputation-induced bias, and the screening procedure identifies misaligned sites with $82\%$ power at moderate misalignment and $100\%$ for strong misalignment. On multi-site air quality and multi-center clinical data, FUSHAP reduces MSE by approximately $3$--$7\times$ relative to the single-site estimator; in the clinical application, standard imputation can increase MSE above the single-site baseline.

</details>


### [421] [Steady-State Convergence of Stochastic Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14922)
*Yixuan Zhang,Qiaomin Xie*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该文为常步长收缩型随机逼近（SA）建立了统一的稳态收敛（SSC）理论，允许马尔可夫、乘性噪声及局部不可微均值算子，并借助多步普适性框架得到最优 $O(\sqrt\alpha)$ 速率的 Gaussian 逼近，进而应用于 Markovian 线性 SA 与异步 Q-learning。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有 SSC 理论依赖 i.i.d. 或加性噪声、均值算子全局可微，且所得速率次优，无法覆盖马尔可夫乘性噪声与局部不可微均值算子等实际场景（如 Markovian 线性 SA、异步 Q-learning）。

Method: 提出多步普适性框架（multi-step universality framework），逐步将原始随机递推化为可处理的辅助动力学并保持其稳态极限；在不动点处进行局部二次线性化，分析尺度化稳态分布。

Result: 在局部二次线性化下，以 Wasserstein-2 距离得到尺度化稳态的 Gaussian 逼近，速率达最优 $O(\sqrt\alpha)$，并给出原始迭代的有限时间 Gaussian 逼近；在局部不可微情形下建立一般 SSC 结果，且主阶渐近偏差可达 $\sqrt\alpha$ 阶，与光滑情形的 $\alpha$ 阶偏差形成对比；理论应用于 Markovian 线性 SA 与异步 Q-learning。

Conclusion: 该统一 SSC 理论推广了现有结果并给出最优速率；进一步提出无需知晓局部光滑性机制的 Q-learning 偏差缩减方案，并经数值实验验证。

Abstract: For constant-stepsize stochastic approximation (SA), the iterates converge in distribution to a stationary law that depends on the stepsize $α.$ Steady-state convergence (SSC) concerns the limit of the scaled stationary distribution as $α\downarrow 0.$ Existing SSC theory requires i.i.d. or additive noise and global differentiability of the mean operator, and yields suboptimal rates. We develop a unified SSC theory for constant-stepsize contractive SA driven by Markovian, multiplicative noise, covering both locally differentiable and locally nondifferentiable mean operators. A key methodological contribution is a multi-step universality framework that progressively reduces the original stochastic recursion to tractable auxiliary dynamics while preserving its steady-state limit. Under local quadratic linearization at the fixed point, we obtain a Gaussian approximation of the scaled steady state at the optimal rate $O(\sqrtα)$ in Wasserstein-2 distance, which further gives finite-time Gaussian approximations for the raw iterates. In the locally nondifferentiable regime, we establish a general SSC result and show that the leading-order asymptotic bias can be of order $\sqrtα$, in contrast to the $α$-order bias in the smooth regime. We apply the theory to Markovian linear SA and asynchronous Q-learning, neither of which is covered by prior results. We further propose a bias-reduction scheme for Q-learning that requires no knowledge of the local smoothness regime, validated by numerical experiments.

</details>


### [422] [Data Attribution at Scale via Influence Matrix Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15044)
*Yuxi Chen,Hamza Golubovic,Han Tong,Arian Maleki,Andrew Ilyas*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文将预算受限的数据归因问题形式化为从小规模测量中估计大型影响矩阵的问题，指出最优测量集合与归因本身所需的测量不同，并提出MAGE（面向重构）与SPELL（面向归因）两种算法，可在现有metagradient框架上无额外成本运行，在多种训练规模与测量预算下优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据归因对数据估值、机器遗忘与模型可解释性至关重要，但神经网络非凸性使可扩展方法难以准确预测移除训练数据的影响。基于metagradient的方法（如MAGIC）能通过贯穿整个训练过程微分来精确计算影响，但每个预测都需一次独立训练运行，计算成本过高。因此需要降低这一成本。

Method: 将预算受限归因建模为从少量测量中估计大型影响矩阵的问题；分析并证明最适合恢复该矩阵的测量与最适合归因本身的测量并不相同；据此提出两种算法：MAGE用于矩阵重构，SPELL用于归因，二者均可直接运行于现有metagradient机制之上而不增加额外开销。

Result: 实证研究显示，在不同训练规模与测量预算下，所提方法相较现有基线均取得较强性能。

Conclusion: 通过将精确metagradient归因重构为影响矩阵的低成本估计问题，并区分重构与归因所需的测量策略，可在不增加计算成本的前提下显著提升预算受限数据归因的效果。

Abstract: Data attribution seeks to quantify how individual training examples shape a model's predictions and underpins problems including data valuation, machine unlearning, and model interpretability. Despite having a long line of work, computationally scalable methods often struggle to predict the effect of removing training data in neural networks due to their non-convex nature. To overcome this challenge, metagradient-based methods such as MAGIC (Ilyas and Engstrom, 2025) differentiate each prediction through the entire training run and compute its exact influence with respect to the training data, but require a separate run for every prediction. To reduce this cost, we cast budgeted attribution as estimating a large influence matrix from a small number of measurements. We show that the measurements most appropriate for recovering this matrix differ from those best suited for attribution itself. We then present two algorithms, MAGE and SPELL, suited for reconstruction and attribution respectively, that run on existing metagradient machinery at no extra cost. Empirical studies demonstrate strong performance over existing baselines across training scales and measurement budgets.

</details>


### [423] [Conformal Individual Treatment Effect Estimation under Networked Interference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15254)
*Matteo Zecchin,Osvaldo Simeone*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出干扰调整加权共形预测方法，在存在干扰（个体结果依赖他人处理与协变量）的条件下，为反事实结果与个体处理效应构建具有有限样本边际覆盖保证的预测集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有共形反事实预测依赖无干扰假设，并要求通过倾向得分重加权恢复加权可交换性。当个体潜在结果受他人处理与协变量影响时，该假设不再成立，倾向得分重加权无法恢复加权可交换性，现有方法可能无法达到有效覆盖。

Method: 提出干扰调整加权共形预测：通过对目标干预下理想但不可观测的共形p值构造可观测上界来校正干扰影响。方法同时适用于转导与归纳设定，并在干预引起的非一致性得分变化有界时，进一步推导出更紧（更锐利）的预测集构造。

Result: 理论上，所构造的预测集对反事实结果和个体处理效应在转导与归纳两种情境下均提供有限样本边际覆盖保证；有界变化情形下构造更紧。数值实验表明，本方法保持名义覆盖水平，而现有方法可能无法达到。

Conclusion: 放松无干扰假设后，干扰调整加权共形预测可为反事实结果与个体处理效应提供有效的有限样本覆盖，弥补了倾向得分重加权失效的缺陷，并在有界条件下进一步提升预测集效率。

Abstract: Conformal counterfactual prediction constructs prediction sets with finite-sample coverage guarantees for counterfactual outcomes and individual treatment effects under the no-interference assumption. In this work, we relax this assumption by allowing each unit's potential outcomes to depend on other units' treatments and covariates. In this setting, propensity-score reweighting does not restore weighted exchangeability, and existing methods may fail to achieve valid coverage. To address this issue, we develop interference-adjusted weighted conformal prediction that accounts for interference by constructing an observable upper bound on the ideal and unobserved conformal $p$-value under the target intervention. The resulting prediction sets provide finite-sample marginal coverage guarantees for counterfactual outcomes and individual treatment effects in both transductive and inductive settings. We also derive a sharper construction when intervention-induced changes in nonconformity scores are bounded. Numerical experiments show that our methods preserve nominal coverage, whereas existing methods may not.

</details>


### [424] [ReLU Neural Network Approximation to Smooth Functional Operator: Dimensional Decay and Error Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15355)
*Shuhao Jiao*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该研究用深度ReLU网络逼近无穷维可分Hilbert空间上的光滑标量泛函，通过坐标截断、各向异性划分、局部Taylor展开与ReLU网络实现，给出非渐近上界与基于伪维数的下界，证明在广义指数坐标衰减下达到近乎最优的拉伸指数逼近速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无穷维泛函输入（如函数型数据）的神经网络逼近理论尚不完善，尤其缺乏通过坐标幅度与方向灵敏度的联合衰减来显式刻画逼近误差的结果。作者希望量化每个坐标的重要性并给出最优逼近速率。

Method: 将输入写为X(t)=∑ξ_dν_d(t)，用w_d s_d衡量第d个坐标的重要性（s_d限制基得分幅度，w_d控制目标泛函的方向Fréchet灵敏度）。构造性分析结合坐标截断、各向异性划分、局部Taylor逼近与ReLU网络实现，允许保留坐标间的任意交互；推导一般非渐近上界，并结合伪维数得到最坏情况逼近误差的下界。

Result: 建立了统一的非渐近上界与互补的伪维数下界；在广义指数坐标衰减w_d s_d≍exp(-cd^ρ)（ρ>0）条件下，上下界在主阶上匹配，得到近乎最优的逼近速率——以网络预算的对数为变量的拉伸指数速率。

Conclusion: 首次通过坐标幅度与方向灵敏度的联合维度衰减，显式刻画无穷维泛函输入的神经网络逼近误差，并为该类泛函逼近奠定了近乎最优的速率理论基础。

Abstract: We study the uniform approximation of smooth scalar-valued functionals on an infinite-dimensional separable Hilbert space by deep ReLU neural networks. Writing the functional input as $X(t)=\sum_{d\geq1}ξ_dν_d(t)$, we quantify the importance of coordinate $d$ through $w_ds_d$, where $s_d$ bounds the magnitude of the corresponding basis score and $w_d$ controls the directional Fréchet sensitivity of the target functional. Our constructive analysis combines coordinate truncation, anisotropic partitioning, local Taylor approximation, and ReLU network realization, while allowing unrestricted interactions among the retained coordinates. We establish a general nonasymptotic upper bound for the uniform approximation error and a complementary pseudo-dimension-based lower bound for the worst-case approximation error. Under generalized exponential coordinate decay $w_ds_d\asymp\exp(-cd^ρ)$, with $ρ>0$, the upper and lower bounds match at the leading order and thus yield the nearly optimal approximation rate, which is stretched-exponential in the logarithm of the network budget. This is the first work to characterize neural network approximation error for infinite-dimensional functional inputs explicitly through the joint dimensional decay of coordinate magnitudes and directional sensitivities.

</details>


### [425] [Graph Matching Relaxations and Amortization for Supervised Graph Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15437)
*Federico Méndez,Paul Krzakala,Gabriel Melo,Charlotte Laclau,Rémi Flamary,Florence d'Alché-Buc*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究端到端监督图预测(SGP)中的置换不变损失问题，提出用参数化匹配器摊销图匹配过程，基于可微Sinkhorn算法提供传输方案，与图预测模块联合学习，并在多个任务上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端监督图预测需要置换不变的损失函数来比较预测图与任意节点排序的目标图，而此类损失通常涉及代价高昂的图匹配问题。为避免对每个训练样本求解内层优化，需要一种更高效的方法。

Method: 首先研究该问题的三种最优传输松弛，从理论和实验上证明Gromov-Wasserstein(GW)目标最适合SGP。然后提出摊销图匹配(节点对齐)问题：对每个训练样本，损失函数利用一个参数化匹配器提供的传输方案，该匹配器基于作用于经验节点分布的可微Sinkhorn算法。图预测模块与匹配器联合学习。

Result: 在复杂度递增的玩具和真实世界SGP问题上展示了该方法的效率，包括作者新引入的质谱到骨架(Mass-spectra to Scaffold)任务。

Conclusion: GW目标最适合SGP；通过摊销图匹配并联合学习参数化匹配器与图预测模块，可高效解决端到端SGP问题。

Abstract: End-to-end Supervised Graph Prediction (SGP) requires a permutation-invariant loss to compare predicted and target graphs with arbitrary node orderings. Such losses typically involve a costly graph-matching problem. We first study three Optimal Transport relaxations of this problem and show, theoretically and empirically, that the Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) objective is the most suitable for SGP. Then, to avoid solving the resulting inner optimization for every training example, we propose to amortize the graph matching (node alignment) problem. For each training sample, the loss function leverages a transport plan provided by a parametric matcher based on the differentiable Sinkhorn algorithm applied on empirical node distributions. The graph prediction module and the matcher are jointly learned. We showcase the efficiency of this approach on toy and real world SGP problems of increasing complexity including a novel Mass-spectra to Scaffold task that we introduce.

</details>


### [426] [Predictive Likelihood Ratios for Language Model Watermark Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15657)
*Li Ma*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该文在Li et al. (2025)框架上构建对不确定概率缺口与残尾分布做平均的预测似然比，用尾部形状与有效宽度的混合先验（及分层扩展）实现无需单一信号强度调参的稳健水印检测，并在条件枢轴零假设下获得具测试鞅性质的贝叶斯因子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 键控水印检测依赖观测token与由密钥重建的伪随机变量之间的依赖性；既有方法常需设定单一信号强度调参，且在不同备择设定下检测功效不稳健，因此需要一种能跨备择规格保持稳健功效、并具备明确错误控制保证的检测方法。

Method: 构造对不确定概率缺口与残尾分布进行平均的预测似然比；采用混合先验同时刻画尾部形状与有效宽度，并用分层扩展允许文档内缺口或宽度的变化；依据精确条件枢轴零假设，使用在每次观测前选定的归一化预测备择，得到既是贝叶斯因子又是测试鞅的统计量；Gumbel边际似然通过固定求积法计算。

Result: 在所评估的尾形与尾宽备择及三个时间跨度下，union-tail混合的最大观测Type II错误后悔为.0080，而equal-tail混合为.0962（相对最佳被测试规则）。在两个开放模型的温度匹配输出上，该方法在全部八个非饱和模型—温度单元中AUC均优于equal-tail基线，尽管领先参考分数通常AUC更高。补充实验显示在独立类零假设替换下功效得以保持，分层依赖建模带来的变化较小。Type I错误控制不受备择误设影响且在可选停止下仍有效，但该保证不覆盖条件零假设的违反，插值实现无认证的任意时间保证。

Conclusion: 证据支持该方法在所评估备择下具有稳健性，但不构成一致功效保证，也不代表对任意文本编辑的抵抗能力；该检验在固定水平下最大化先验平均功效，但一般并非一致最优或极小极大。

Abstract: Keyed watermark detection tests dependence between observed tokens and pseudorandom variables reconstructed from a secret key. Building on the pivotal framework of Li et al. (2025), we construct predictive likelihood ratios that average over uncertain probability deficits and residual-tail distributions. The aim is robust detection power across alternative specifications without requiring a single signal-strength tuning. A mixture prior combines tail shape and effective width; hierarchical extensions allow within-document variation in deficit or width. The test maximizes prior-averaged power at a fixed size, but is not generally uniformly most powerful or minimax. Under the exact conditional pivot null, normalized predictive alternatives selected before each observation yield a Bayes factor that is also a test martingale: Type I error control is unaffected by alternative misspecification and remains valid under optional stopping. This guarantee does not cover violations of the conditional null, and the interpolated implementation has no certified anytime guarantee. Gumbel marginal likelihoods are evaluated by fixed quadrature. Across the evaluated tail-shape and tail-width alternatives and three horizons, the union-tail mixture has maximum observed Type II error regret .0080, compared with .0962 for the equal-tail mixture, relative to the best tested rule. On temperature-matched outputs from two open models, it improves AUC over the equal-tail baseline in all eight non-saturated model-temperature cells, although the leading reference score generally has higher AUC. Supplementary experiments show retained power under independent null-like replacement and smaller changes from hierarchical dependence modeling. The evidence supports robustness across the evaluated alternatives, not uniform power guarantees or resistance to arbitrary text edits.

</details>


### [427] [Learning under Target Shift: Optimal Density Ratio Estimation and Importance-Weighted Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15785)
*Ren-Rui Liu,Zheng-Chu Guo*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 研究连续输出下的目标偏移（target shift）问题，提出RKHS谱正则化方法估计连续密度比，给出有限样本收敛率，并将其用于重要性加权回归，达到极小化最大最优速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标偏移下输入给定输出的条件分布不变、输出边缘分布变化。离散输出情形已有充分研究，但连续输出情形理解不足：重要性权重由未知密度比函数决定，现有估计方法缺乏显式有限样本收敛率。

Method: 在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中提出谱正则化方法来估计连续密度比，利用带标签训练样本和无标签测试输入；在源条件（source condition）与正则参数ι>0下进行理论分析；再将估计的密度比嵌入重要性加权回归，刻画密度比估计误差向最终预测器的传播。

Result: 建立了高概率有限样本保证，估计器达到容量无关的极小化最大最优RKHS范数速率O(n_η^{-ι/(2ι+2)})；当密度比估计样本足够多时，所得回归估计器达到标准核回归的极小化最大最优速率。

Conclusion: 本文为连续密度比估计及目标偏移下的重要性加权学习建立了有限样本理论。

Abstract: We study density ratio estimation and importance-weighted regression under target shift with continuous outputs. Under target shift, the conditional distribution of the inputs given the outputs remains invariant across the training and test distributions, while the output marginal distribution may change. Although this problem has been extensively studied for discrete outputs, the continuous setting is substantially less understood: the importance weights are determined by an unknown density ratio function, for which existing estimation methods lack explicit finite-sample convergence rates. We propose a spectral regularization method in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) for estimating the continuous density ratio from labeled training samples and unlabeled test inputs. Under a source condition with regularity parameter $ι>0$, we establish high-probability finite-sample guarantees and show that the estimator achieves the capacity-independent minimax-optimal RKHS-norm rate $O(n_η^{-ι/(2ι+2)})$. We then incorporate the estimated density ratio into importance-weighted regression and characterize the propagation of density-ratio estimation error to the final predictor. When sufficiently many samples are available for density ratio estimation, the resulting regression estimator attains the minimax-optimal rates of standard kernel regression. These results establish a finite-sample theory for continuous density ratio estimation and importance-weighted learning under target shift.

</details>


### [428] [Quenched Ensemble Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15894)
*David Yallup*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该文提出 Quenched Ensemble Sampling，将嵌套采样中的硬能量约束放宽为一族能量边界上的排斥势，从而保留能量单调递减的 quenched 路径，同时使受约束目标可用可扩展的梯度核采样，成功处理相位跃迁并用于贝叶斯神经网络与格点场论的配分函数估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理系统能量函数采样中最困难的场景是相变，态密度骤变会导致多数采样算法停滞。嵌套采样虽对相变稳健，但因为需要在硬能量约束下采样，在高维中难以应用，受限于约束采样本身的可扩展性。

Method: 将嵌套采样中的硬能量约束推广为能量边界上的一族排斥势，形成 Quenched Ensemble Sampling。该松弛保留了能量单调下降的 quenched 路径，同时把约束目标变为适合可扩展梯度型采样核（kernel）的形式。

Result: 在合成相变模型上，方法能在 tempering 等常见替代方法失败的一阶相变处估计边际似然并抽取后验样本；在贝叶斯神经网络中用于边际似然估计，实现网络结构间的模型比较；在高维连续格点场论中穿越一阶相变并估计配分函数。

Conclusion: Quenched Ensemble Sampling 通过将硬约束松弛为排斥势，兼顾了嵌套采样对相变的稳健性和梯度采样在高维中的可扩展性，是一个可用于高维相变系统边际似然、后验与配分函数估计的通用框架。

Abstract: Some of the sharpest challenges in sampling from the energy functions of physical systems arise at phase transitions, where the density of states changes abruptly and many sampling algorithms stall. Nested sampling is a particle method that traverses the density of states under a hard energy constraint and is known to be robust to such transitions, but its application in high dimension is limited by the difficulty of sampling under that constraint. In this work we introduce Quenched Ensemble Sampling, which generalises the hard constraint to a family of repulsive potentials at the energy boundary. This preserves the quenched path of monotonically decreasing energy while making the constrained target amenable to scalable gradient-based kernels. We demonstrate on synthetic models of phase transitions that our method estimates the marginal likelihood and draws posterior samples across a first-order transition where popular alternatives such as tempering fail. We apply the procedure to marginal likelihood estimation in Bayesian neural networks, enabling model comparison between network architectures. Finally, in a high-dimensional continuous lattice field theory, we show that this method traverses a first-order transition and estimates the partition function.

</details>


<div id='math.ST'></div>

# math.ST [[Back]](#toc)

### [429] [A new six parameters generalized Weibull-Kumaraswamy-{Lomax) Distribution with a Novel Linear Series Expansion of Its Probability Density](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13316)
*Iman Mohamed Attia*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文通过T-X{Y}族方法，以Lomax分布为连接、Weibull分布为生成器，对定义在单位区间上的两参数Kumaraswamy基线分布引入新参数，构造了一个新的六参数广义Weibull-Kumaraswamy-Lomax分布，并给出了PDF、CDF、分位函数、线性级数展开及Shannon熵等结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推广分布的一种常用途径是向基线分布增加新参数。作者希望利用T-X{Y}族方法获得一个具有更强灵活性和拟合能力的分布，从而拓展Kumaraswamy分布在建模中的适用性。同时，作者希望寻找一种不需要特殊函数、形式简单的PDF线性级数展开，以简化如原始矩等计算统计量的推导。

Method: 作者采用T-X{Y}族建模框架：基线分布为定义在单位区间上的两参数Kumaraswamy分布，形状参数为a、b>0；生成器分布为两参数Weibull分布，形状参数c>0、尺度参数γ>0；并通过两参数Lomax分布（尺度参数α>0、形状参数λ>0）将基线与生成器联系起来，最终形成具有六个参数的新分布。作者推导了该分布的PDF、CDF和分位函数，并采用一种新的线性级数展开技术展开PDF，使其无需特殊函数即可表达。

Result: 作者构造出新的六参数广义Weibull-Kumaraswamy-Lomax分布，并给出了其PDF、CDF与分位函数的解析表达式。所提出的线性级数展开形式简单且不依赖特殊函数，使原始矩等计算统计量的处理更加简便。文中还讨论了Shannon熵，并通过图形展示了该分布的PDF、CDF和分位函数形态。

Conclusion: 通过T-X{Y}族方法并结合Lomax连接分布与Weibull生成器，可有效推广Kumaraswamy分布并获得一个六参数新分布。该分布具备可解析处理的PDF、CDF和分位函数，其简洁的级数展开降低了计算复杂度，为后续矩、熵等统计性质研究提供了便利。

Abstract: One method of generalizing a distribution is to add new parameter to the baseline distribution. In this paper the author discusses this methodology to create a new six parameters generalized Weibull-Kumaraswamy-{Lomax) Distribution. The author utilizes the approach of the T-X{Y} family to add new parameters the baseline distribution Kumaraswamy distribution defined on the unit interval with two shape parameters a & b>0. The author used the Lomax distribution with two parameters α & λ>0 , scale and shape parameters respectively, to link the baseline distribution with the generator distribution. The generator distribution is the Weibull distribution with the two parameters, c & γ>0 , shape and scale parameters respectively as will be explained in the paper. The result is a new distribution with six parameters. The author derived the PDF, CDF, and quantile functions. The author used a new technique to expand the pdf in a linear series expansion that is simple and does not require special function. This makes the computational statistics for the raw moments easier and simpler. The author discusses the Shannon entropy and the paper contains figures for the PDF, CDF and the quantile functions.

</details>


### [430] [Generative bootstrap processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13471)
*Ziming Lin,Fang Han*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文研究从拟合生成分布重采样得到的生成bootstrap过程，建立其条件弱收敛到P-布朗桥的充要条件，并应用于多种主流生成模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典bootstrap的经验过程理论已较成熟，但当数据由生成模型拟合分布而非经验分布重采样时，其条件弱收敛性质缺乏统一的理论刻画，尤其在有限维收敛之外的等度连续性问题上尚不清晰。

Method: 通过有限维条件弱收敛与条件渐近等度连续性给出对P-布朗桥条件弱收敛的充要条件；进一步给出一般充分条件，并建立Giné-Zinn型刻画，将其与P-Donsker性质相联系。

Result: 得到了生成bootstrap过程条件弱收敛的充要条件、充分条件及Giné-Zinn型刻画；验证了三角归一化流、flow matching、基于分数的扩散模型和Wasserstein GAN等生成模型满足这些条件。

Conclusion: 该工作为生成bootstrap过程提供了系统的条件弱收敛理论框架，并将其P-Donsker性质与有限维收敛、等度连续性联系起来，覆盖多类重要生成模型。

Abstract: We study generative bootstrap processes obtained by resampling from fitted generative distributions.
