We establish necessary and sufficient conditions for their conditional weak convergence to the $P$-Brownian bridge, formulated in terms of finite-dimensional conditional weak convergence and conditional asymptotic equicontinuity. We further provide general sufficient conditions and a Giné-Zinn-type characterization relating this convergence to the $P$-Donsker property. As applications, we verify these conditions for prominent classes of generative models, including triangular normalizing flows, flow matching, score-based diffusion models, and Wasserstein generative adversarial networks.

</details>


### [431] [A dynamic residual measure of inaccuracy based on varextropy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13855)
*Faranak Goodarzi*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文基于varextropy提出一种针对顺序统计量的基于方差的失真度量，研究其变换性质、上下界、动态残差版本及刻画结果，并给出非参数估计与实证应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需要一种能够量化顺序统计量与其父分布之间失真函数变异性的度量工具，以补充现有基于熵和extropy的不精确性度量框架。

Method: 基于varextropy概念构造顺序统计量的方差型失真度量；推导其在严格递增可微变换下的变换性质；建立理论上下界；发展动态残差版本并给出分布刻画结果；推导基于extropy和varextropy的动态残差失真度量界；构造非参数估计量。

Result: 建立了该度量的变换性质与理论上下界，得到动态残差情形的分布刻画结果及基于extropy和varextropy的界，并提出可应用于实际数据的非参数估计量。

Conclusion: 所提度量可用于评估候选分布的拟合优度并辅助模型选择，拓展了顺序统计量失真分析的理论与应用工具。

Abstract: In this paper, we introduce a variance-based inaccuracy measure for order statistics based on the concept of varextropy. The proposed measure provides a framework for quantifying the variability of the inaccuracy function between an order statistic and its parent distribution. We establish a transformation property of the proposed measure under strictly increasing differentiable transformations. We establish theoretical upper and lower bounds for this measure. We further develop a dynamic residual version of the proposed inaccuracy measure and establish characterization results for the underlying distribution. Furthermore, we derive bounds for the dynamic residual inaccuracy measures based on extropy and varextropy. Finally, a nonparametric estimator of the proposed measure is developed and applied to real data to assess the goodness-of-fit of candidate distributions and facilitate model selection. 1.

</details>


### [432] [Risk comparison theorems and application to deep learning of diffusion coefficients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13898)
*Arnaud Gloter,Nakahiro Yoshida*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 该论文在具有多维强混合协变量过程的随机微分方程中研究扩散矩阵的非参数估计，提出不依赖线性基表示的通用函数类框架，适用于深度神经网络估计器。方法采用两步估计：先构造非参数拟似然估计，再用β-Hölder类逼近进行正则化。建立了任意估计器经验风险与泛化风险之间的一般比较定理，并给出了刻画T-速率（混合行为）与n-速率（波动率估计）内在交互的上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在随机微分方程中估计扩散矩阵时，协变量过程往往具有多维、强混合的复杂依赖结构，传统方法通常依赖线性基表示，难以直接应用于深度神经网络等现代估计器。作者希望建立一个不依赖具体概率结构、通用且灵活的统计框架，从而拓展适用范围并支持神经网络估计。

Method: 基于一般函数类的灵活统计框架，不要求线性基表示。采用两步估计程序：第一步构造初步的非参数拟似然估计器；第二步通过β-Hölder类逼近对其正则化。同时建立经验风险与泛化风险之间的一般风险比较定理，不依赖底层过程的具体概率结构。

Result: 在基于时间区间[0,T]上n+1个观测的扩散矩阵学习中，推导出的上界刻画了T-速率（与协变量过程的混合行为相关）与内在n-速率（支配波动率估计）之间的内在交互作用。

Conclusion: 该框架适用于包括深度神经网络在内的通用估计器，所建立的风险比较定理和速率上界为强混合协变量下扩散矩阵的非参数估计提供了理论保证，并揭示了时间尺度T与样本量n之间的权衡关系。

Abstract: We investigate the nonparametric estimation of the diffusion matrix in stochastic differential equations featuring multidimensional, strong mixing covariate processes. We propose a flexible statistical framework based on general function classes that does not require a linear basis representation, rendering our results directly applicable to deep neural network estimators. Our approach employs a two-step estimation procedure: constructing a preliminary nonparametric quasi-likelihood estimator and subsequently regularizing it via a $β$-Hölder class approximation. We establish general risk comparison theorems between empirical and generalization risks for arbitrary estimators without relying on a specific probabilistic structure of the underlying process. In diffusion matrix learning based on \(n + 1\) observations over the time interval \([0,T]\), the derived upper bounds capture the intrinsic interplay between the \(T\)-rate, associated with the mixing behavior of the covariate process, and the intrinsic \(n\)-rate governing the volatility estimation.

</details>


### [433] [Can one regularizer reproduce posterior means at two noise levels?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13926)
*Kang Liu*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 论文研究固定正则化器能否恢复后验均值，证明除非先验为点质量，否则不存在单一正则化器在两个不同正噪声方差下同时成立。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高斯去噪中，最大后验估计（MAP）使用先验负对数作为固定正则化器，仅二次数据项权重随噪声方差变化。作者追问：固定正则化器是否也能恢复后验均值（而非仅MAP），以厘清固定正则化器在贝叶斯去噪中的适用范围与本质局限。

Method: 针对固定先验、变噪声方差的高斯去噪，考察以后验均值/贝叶斯估计为目标时，是否存在与方差无关的固定正则化器。允许正则化器为非凸且非光滑；通过构造性分析并利用两次去噪器评估之差构造残差，推导均匀逼近误差与过量均方误差的下界。

Result: 每个方差下都存在合适的正则化器（先验有密度时），但对任意紧支撑先验（除点质量外），证明不存在单一正则化器在两个不同正噪声方差下同时成立。由两次去噪器评估计算的残差给出正的下界，量化了使用共同正则化器的估计器的均匀逼近误差与过量均方误差。数值实验验证了这些下界及跨噪声级别重用正则化器的代价。

Conclusion: 固定正则化器无法普遍恢复后验均值：除点质量外，不存在对多噪声级别通用的正则化器。该不可能性结果对非凸非光滑正则化器依然成立，并通过可计算的误差下界表明跨噪声级别复用正则化器存在不可避免的性能损失。

Abstract: Consider Gaussian denoising with a fixed prior and varying noise variance. When the prior has a density, maximum a posteriori estimation uses its negative logarithm as a fixed regularizer; only the weight of the quadratic data term changes with the noise variance. We ask whether a fixed regularizer can also recover the posterior mean. Although a suitable regularizer exists at each variance, we prove that no single regularizer works at two distinct positive variances for any compactly supported prior other than a point mass. This holds even for nonconvex and nonsmooth regularizers. A residual computed from two denoiser evaluations gives positive lower bounds on the uniform approximation error and excess mean squared error of estimators using a common regularizer. Numerical examples illustrate these bounds and the cost of reusing a regularizer across noise levels.

</details>


### [434] [The Minimax Rate of Denoising Flows on Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14091)
*Sichen Wang*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 该论文完整解决了树上流恢复（flow on a tree）在几何约束下的极小极大风险问题，证明风险阶为 min{V²H_T, σ²k₀}，给出达到该阶的确定性估计器，并证明最小二乘法在最坏情况下次优(log n)^{2/5}。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 等渗回归（路径上的经典问题）与单纯形上的均值估计（星形图上的经典问题）是最基础的几何约束去噪问题。Chatterjee与Lafferty将其推广为有根树上从高斯噪声恢复流的问题，但其结果仅覆盖特殊树形；一般树的极小极大风险已悬而未决十年。本文旨在彻底解决这一问题，并统一两个经典理论。

Method: 在任意含n个顶点的树上，对任意预算V与噪声水平σ，证明极小极大风险阶为 min{V²H_T, σ²k₀}，其中H_T为树的直径，k₀为截断祖先轮廓（truncated ancestor profile）的交叉指标。构造确定性估计器——整数状态上的指数加权聚合（exponentially weighted aggregate），其算术复杂度为O(n²log(n+1))。同时分析已知预算下的最小二乘凸规划，给出其与最优风险的差距。核心工具是截断祖先轮廓这一泛函，充当覆盖半径、正锥中的填充熵，以及精确计算所依赖的一维状态取值域。

Result: 极小极大风险被完全刻画为 min{V²H_T, σ²k₀}；所提确定性指数加权聚合估计器达到该最优阶，计算复杂度O(n²log(n+1))；已知预算下的最小二乘凸规划在最坏情况下次优，差距阶为(log n)^{2/5}。截断祖先轮廓同时决定风险率、估计器构造与最小二乘比较。

Conclusion: 两个经典理论（等渗回归与单纯形估计）在树上统一为一个受同一泛函（截断祖先轮廓）支配的理论，且在任意树形上既紧确又可计算，结束了该问题十年悬而未决的状态。

Abstract: Isotonic regression and mean estimation over a simplex are among the most classical denoising problems under geometric constraints. Chatterjee and Lafferty generalized both to the recovery of a flow on a rooted tree from Gaussian noise, with isotonic regression on a path and the simplex on a star. Their results reach only special trees; on a general tree the minimax risk remained unknown for a decade. We settle the question in full. On every tree with $n$ vertices, at every budget $V$ and noise level $σ$, the minimax risk is of order $\min\{V^2H_T,\ σ^2k_0\}$, with $H_T$ the diameter and $k_0$ the crossing index of a truncated ancestor profile. A deterministic estimator, an exponentially weighted aggregate over integer states, attains it in $O(n^2\log(n+1))$ arithmetic operations. Least squares at a known budget, the natural convex program for the model, is suboptimal in the worst case by a factor of order $(\log n)^{2/5}$. One functional, the truncated ancestor profile, carries the rate, the estimator, and the least squares comparison. It serves as covering radius, as packing entropy in the positive cone, and as the range of the one-dimensional state behind the exact computation. Two classical theories become one on trees, sharp and computable throughout.

</details>


### [435] [Likelihood-Coin Poisson Sampling for Bayesian Inverse Problems: Exact Sampling and Sharp Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14225)
*Zhiliang Deng,Xiaomei Yang*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 提出精确直接抽样框架，用Bernoulli事件构造Bernstein–Poisson似然硬币，稀释先验Poisson过程得到后验点过程，并给出早停计算量的锐利分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对有界前向可观测量只能通过Bernoulli事件查询、无法数值求值的贝叶斯反问题，需要无需离散化与参数截断的精确后验直接抽样方法。

Method: 以Bernstein–Poisson构造把Bernoulli事件转为缩放高斯似然硬币；对基于先验的Poisson点过程做稀释，得到后验点过程。采用Feynman–Kac表示、Poisson killing与惰性随机级数求值，为椭圆预解问题类构造精确连续Bernoulli oracle。多元扩展处理相关高斯观测误差并做精度加权分配。

Result: 稀释后点过程在给定基数条件下位置独立且服从后验；基数给出缩减证据的无偏估计。早停工作量的锐利分析显示小噪声下由精确拟合集附近的局部先验预测质量支配，呈现独立于未知函数名义维数的预测维数效应。数值实验验证后验稀释、工作区域与函数值PDE构造。

Conclusion: 该框架实现了对Bernoulli查询型贝叶斯反问题的精确直接抽样，避免了空间离散化和固定参数截断，并以早停工作量的锐利刻画揭示了预测维数效应。

Abstract: We develop an exact direct-sampling framework for Bayesian inverse problems whose bounded forward observables can be queried through Bernoulli events rather than numerically evaluated. A Bernstein--Poisson construction converts these events into scaled Gaussian likelihood coins. Thinning a prior-based Poisson point process with these coins yields a posterior point process whose locations, conditional on its cardinality, are independent posterior draws; the cardinality also provides an unbiased estimator of the reduced evidence. The main theoretical contribution is a sharp analysis of the actual early-stopped computational work. In the small-noise regime, the work is governed by the local prior-predictive mass near the exact-fit set, revealing a predictive-dimension effect distinct from the nominal dimension of the unknown. A multivariate extension accommodates correlated Gaussian observation errors and gives a precision-weighted allocation of factory effort. For a bounded class of elliptic resolvent problems, Feynman--Kac representations, Poisson killing, and lazy random-series evaluation provide exact continuum Bernoulli oracles without introducing a spatial discretization or a fixed parameter truncation in the posterior target. Numerical experiments illustrate posterior thinning in parameter space, confirm the sharp work regimes, and validate the function-valued PDE construction.

</details>


### [436] [Hermite Spectra and Kernel Factorization for Gaussian-Weighted Tests of Normality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14395)
*Nikolaos Gkoumas,Nickos Papadatos,Samis Trevezas*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文研究带位置与尺度估计的高斯加权一元正态性检验的渐近零谱，给出了Hermite系数方程、特征值单性与交错性、扰动谱参数定位、有符号全正性论证及谱尾控制，并通过数值计算评估渐近校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高斯加权正态性检验中，位置与尺度参数需估计，导致零分布协方差发生扰动，其谱结构（特征值单性、交错性、参数依赖）尚缺乏系统的渐近刻画，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。

Method: 采用封闭Hermite系数建立无扰动极点处及远离极点处的方程；利用有符号全正性（signed total-positivity）论证连续高斯协方差修正与正偶可积权重下特征值的单性；从标准化观测处退化核直接导出极限二次型；引入导数可和性条件控制完整谱尾（含符号核），并对有限四阶权重矩的特征函数核加以验证；借助实Hilbert空间分解识别观测谱与Fourier谱。

Result: 完全标准化协方差的每个正特征值均为单重，奇偶特征值严格交错；除最大无扰动偶极点外，每个偶极点恰有一个权重参数使其属于扰动偶谱，这些参数严格有序并收敛到参数区间边界；导数可和性条件可控制含符号核的完整谱尾，且在有限四阶权重矩的特征函数核下成立；实Hilbert空间分解实现了观测谱与Fourier谱的对应。

Conclusion: 本文系统刻画了高斯加权正态性检验估计情形下的渐近零谱结构，建立了单性、交错性与参数有序性等一般性结论，并给出一套可验证的谱尾控制条件；数值计算进一步评估了渐近校准的表现。

Abstract: We study the asymptotic null spectrum of Gaussian-weighted tests of univariate normality with estimated location and scale. Closed Hermite coefficients give equations both away from and at the unperturbed poles. Every positive eigenvalue of the fully standardized covariance is simple, and the odd and even eigenvalues alternate strictly. For each unperturbed even pole except the largest, there is exactly one weight parameter at which it belongs to the perturbed even spectrum. These parameters are strictly ordered and converge to the boundary of the parameter interval. A signed total-positivity argument proves simplicity more generally for consecutive Gaussian covariance corrections and positive even integrable weights. We also derive the limiting quadratic forms directly from degenerate kernels at standardized observations. A derivative summability condition controls the complete spectral tail, including signed kernels, and is verified for characteristic-function kernels with a finite fourth weight moment. A real Hilbert-space factorization identifies the observation and Fourier spectra. Numerical calculations assess asymptotic calibration.

</details>


### [437] [Unrestricted conditional maximum likelihood estimation for a Fréchet regression model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14607)
*Marcio Reverbel,Johan Segers*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 针对Fréchet回归模型（尺度参数对数线性依赖于协变量、尾参数为常数），在完整的非紧参数空间上建立条件极大似然估计的相合性与渐近正态性，渐近协方差矩阵为Fisher信息矩阵的逆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重尾响应变量的回归建模中，现有渐近理论通常将参数限制在紧集内以回避技术困难，但该紧集并非自然参数空间，因此结果受限且不自然。本文旨在在真实的非紧参数空间上给出估计量的渐近理论。

Method: 考虑尺度参数对数线性依赖于协变量、尾参数恒定的Fréchet模型，联合研究尾参数与回归系数的条件极大似然估计。相合性通过基于欧氏空间“宇宙闭包”（cosmic closure）的特定紧化实现，并将Wald相合性定理从单观测推广到观测块；渐近正态性以Fisher信息矩阵的逆为极限协方差矩阵。

Result: 证明该条件极大似然估计在完整的非紧参数空间上相合，且渐近正态，极限协方差矩阵为Fisher信息矩阵的逆。

Conclusion: 通过宇宙闭包紧化技术与推广的Wald相合性定理，可在自然（非紧）参数空间上建立重尾回归模型极大似然估计的完整渐近理论；其中从单观测到观测块的Wald定理推广具有独立价值。

Abstract: Heavy-tailed response variables are routinely modeled as a function of covariates, but the asymptotic theory available for the resulting maximum likelihood estimators sidesteps certain technical difficulties by restricting the parameters to a compact set, which is not the natural parameter space. We consider a Fréchet model whose scale parameter depends log-linearly on a vector of covariates, while the tail parameter is constant, and we study the conditional maximum likelihood estimator of the tail parameter and the regression coefficients jointly. We show that this estimator is consistent over the full, noncompact parameter space, and that it is asymptotically normal, with the inverse Fisher information as limiting covariance matrix. Consistency is obtained by a specific compactification of the parameter space relying on the cosmic closure of Euclidean space. The extension of Wald's consistency theorem needed for that step, from single observations to blocks of observations, is stated in an abstract setting and is possibly of independent interest.

</details>


### [438] [Two short proofs of incompatibility for correlation matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14610)
*Cedric Phillips*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 该论文给出两个简短证明，确定了相关矩阵集合 $S_d^F$ 与椭球体 $P_d$ 相等当且仅当 $d\le5$，解决了Devroye与Letac的猜想。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究固定边际分布 $F$ 的随机向量相关矩阵集合 $S_d^F$ 与所有 $d\times d$ 相关矩阵构成的椭球体 $P_d$ 之间的关系，并解决Devroye与Letac提出的关于二者何时相等的猜想。

Method: 构造性反例：1）利用 $|x|^4$ 在 $\mathbb{R}^4$ 上表示为11个线性形式四次幂之和，证明均匀边际下 $S_{11}\neq P_{11}$；2）利用正二十面体的六条对角线，证明反正弦边际下 $S_6^F\neq P_6$。结合Devroye与Letac的已有结果推出等价条件。

Result: 证明了对均匀边际 $S_{11}\neq P_{11}$，对反正弦边际 $S_6^F\neq P_6$；结合已有结果得出 $S_d^F=P_d$ 当且仅当 $d\le5$。

Conclusion: $S_d^F=P_d$ 的充要条件是维数 $d\le5$，从而证实了Devroye与Letac的猜想。

Abstract: Let $P_d$ be the elliptope of $d \times d$ correlation matrices, and, for a standardised law $F$, let $S_d^F$ be the set of correlation matrices of random vectors with all margins $F$. We give two short proofs. First, an eleven-term representation of $|x|^4$ as a sum of fourth powers of linear forms on $\mathbb{R}^4$ yields $S_{11} \neq P_{11}$ for uniform margins. Second, the six diagonals of the regular icosahedron yield $S_6^F \neq P_6$ for arcsine margins. Together with a result of Devroye and Letac, this gives $S_d^F = P_d$ if and only if $d \le 5$, settling a conjecture of theirs.

</details>


### [439] [Low Dimensional Sampling under Reconstructed Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14837)
*Imon Banerjee,Riddhiman Bhattacharyya*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 研究从未知紧致 $d$ 维 $C^2$ 流形上采样的问题：通过自适应局部凸包估计器重建约束，并对到重建集的平方距离施加惩罚，证明重建的 Hausdorff 精度足以控制 Wasserstein 误差，最优调参下误差为 Hausdorff 误差的平方根量级，并将重建、逼近与混合性组合为显式有限时间保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标分布支撑在未知的紧致低维流形 $M\subset\mathbb{R}^D$ 上，且仅能观测到 $M$ 上独立同分布的均匀点。直接从该分布采样困难，因此需要从数据重建约束并在环境空间中进行采样，同时量化重建精度与采样误差之间的权衡。

Method: 采用自适应局部凸包估计器从均匀观测点重建约束集合；在环境空间上以到重建集的平方距离作为惩罚构造目标分布；分析重建精度与惩罚强度之间的权衡关系；并证明高斯随机游走 Metropolis–Hastings 采样器的均匀几何遍历性，将重建、逼近与混合三部分结合。

Result: 重建集可能非光滑甚至不是流形，但其 Hausdorff 精度已足以控制 Wasserstein 误差；最优调参下误差与 Hausdorff 误差的平方根成正比，且平面例子证明该依赖关系对该方案是紧的；由 $N$ 个观测重建 $d$ 维约束时误差为 $\mathcal{O}((N/N)^{1/d})$；并给出了显式的有限时间保证。

Conclusion: Hausdorff 精度是控制采样误差的充分条件，重建—逼近—混合的分解可导出显式有限时间采样保证；误差对 Hausdorff 误差的平方根依赖在所提方案下是尖锐的。

Abstract: We study sampling from a distribution supported on an unknown compact $d$-dimensional $C^2$ manifold $M\subset\mathbb{R}^D$, observed only through i.i.d. uniform points from $M$. We reconstruct the constraint using an adaptive local-convex-hull estimator and target an ambient distribution penalized by squared distance to the reconstruction. Although the reconstructed set may be nonsmooth or fail to be a manifold, its Hausdorff accuracy alone suffices to control the Wasserstein error. We quantify the tradeoff between reconstruction accuracy and penalty strength and show that optimal tuning gives an error proportional to the square root of the Hausdorff error. A planar example proves that this dependence is sharp for the proposed scheme. For a $d$ dimensional constraint reconstructed from $N$ observations, the error becomes $\mathcal{O}( (N/N)^{1/d})$. Finally, we prove uniform geometric ergodicity of a Gaussian random-walk Metropolis--Hastings sampler and combine reconstruction, approximation, and mixing into an explicit finite-time guarantee.

</details>


### [440] [Nonparametric Regression with Measurement Error in Banach Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14844)
*Pratim Guha Niyogi,Priyadarshi Dey*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文在一般可分Banach空间取值的预测变量下研究非参数回归，建立不依赖内积结构的回归算子估计统一框架，发展大样本理论并处理测量误差与部分污染模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典与函数型非参数回归多依赖Euclidean或Hilbert空间的内积结构，当预测变量取值于一般Banach空间且存在测量误差时，缺乏统一估计与推断框架，故需突破内积限制。

Method: 提出基于Banach空间几何与局部集中条件的回归算子估计量；以预测变量的几何和局部浓度刻画条件建立大样本理论；研究逐点估计与推断，构造逐点置信区间与一致置信带；扩展到变量含误差（测量污染）设定，研究逆加权函数构造引发的逆问题并考虑部分污染模型。

Result: 建立所提估计量的基本性质及其在Banach值预测变量几何与局部集中条件下的渐近理论；给出逐点置信区间与一致置信带的构造；在预测变量受污染时扩展框架，并分析逆加权函数相关的逆问题及部分污染模型。

Conclusion: 为复杂无限维预测变量的非参数回归与推断提供一般框架，并指出在缺乏Hilbert空间结构时出现的若干统计与数学挑战。

Abstract: We consider nonparametric regression with a Banach-space-valued predictor where the covariate takes values in a general separable Banach space. Our primary objective is to develop a unified framework for estimating the regression operator without relying on an inner-product structure, thereby extending classical and functional nonparametric regression beyond Euclidean and Hilbert spaces in the presence of measurement error. We establish the fundamental properties of the proposed estimator and develop its large-sample theory under conditions formulated in terms of the geometry and local concentration of the Banach-valued predictor. In particular, we study pointwise estimation and inference and discuss the construction of pointwise confidence intervals and uniform confidence bands. Our proposed framework is further extended to accommodate error-in-variables settings, where the predictor is observed with contamination. We also investigate related inverse problems arising from the construction of inverse weighting functions and consider partial contamination models. These developments provide a general framework for nonparametric regression and inference with complex infinite-dimensional predictors and identify several statistical and mathematical challenges that arise when the usual Hilbert-space structure is unavailable.

</details>


### [441] [Fractional Cumulative Past Inaccuracy in the Quantile Framework and its Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15204)
*Iona Ann Sebastian,S. M. Sunoj*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文基于逆Mittag-Leffler函数（分数阶对数）提出分位数形式的分数累积过去不精确度（FCPI）及其动态版本（DFCPI），给出性质、非参数估计、模拟验证与实际数据应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分数阶信息度量因对复杂系统信号的高敏感性而受到关注；既有分数累积过去熵和动态分数累积过去熵已有研究，但缺乏分位数版本及其对应的不精确度度量，需要扩展以刻画复杂系统。

Method: 以逆Mittag-Leffler函数（分数阶对数函数）为基础，构造分位数版本的FCPI与DFCPI；推导其性质；提出非参数估计量，并通过模拟研究进行验证，最后开展实际数据应用。

Result: 给出了分位数FCPI及其动态版本的多项性质；所提非参数估计量在模拟研究中得到验证；新分位数FCPI在实际数据应用中展示了适用性。

Conclusion: 分位数FCPI与DFCPI为分数阶信息度量提供了新扩展，可有效补充分数累积过去熵框架，并具备估计与实证应用价值。

Abstract: Fraction-based information measures have received considerable attention for describing complex systems, as they enable the investigation of signals with high sensitivity \citep{machado2014fractional}. In this paper, we introduce quantile versions of fractional cumulative past inaccuracy (FCPI) and dynamic fractional cumulative past inaccuracy (DFCPI) measures based on the inverse Mittag-Leffler function (MLF) or fractional logarithm function, which are the extensions of the fractional cumulative past and dynamic fractional cumulative past entropies, respectively. The various properties of quantile-based FCPI and its dynamic version are provided. We also propose a nonparametric estimator for the proposed measure, and simulation studies are carried out for validation. Finally, we bring out real data application of the newly introduced quantile-based FCPI.

</details>


### [442] [Extension of Likelihood Ratio Analysis Method to Skorokhod $M_1$ Topology (with Application to Poissonian Smooth Change-Point Model)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15585)
*Arij Amiri,Sergue{ï} Dachian*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文将 Ibragimov-Khasminskii 似然比分析方法（一维参数情形）推广到基于 Skorokhod M_1 拓扑的框架，给出了似然比过程在 càdlàg 空间（M_1 拓扑）中弱收敛的充分条件，并据此得到 MLE 的渐近性质；作为应用，研究了非齐次 Poisson 过程在快速变化点（过渡区间收缩快于 1/n）下的光滑变化点模型，证明 MLE 的渐近行为与"纯"变化点模型相同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 Ibragimov-Khasminskii 方法基于一致拓扑或 Skorokhod J_1 拓扑，要求归一化似然比过程与极限似然比过程在连续性上"匹配"。但在一些统计模型中，归一化似然比过程连续而极限过程不连续，这超出了经典框架的适用范围，因此需要引入更弱的拓扑（M_1）来刻画弱收敛并推导 MLE 的渐近性质。

Method: 将 Ibragimov-Khasminskii 似然比分析推广到 Skorokhod M_1 拓扑：在 R 上在 ±∞ 消失的 càdlàg 函数空间（赋予 M_1 拓扑）中，给出似然比过程弱收敛的充分条件，并建立该收敛与 MLE 渐近行为之间的联系；同时提出控制 M_1 连续模的新技术，适用于所有跳跃与陡峭连续过渡同向的模型。

Result: 建立了 M_1 拓扑下似然比过程弱收敛的充分条件，并证明该收敛可导出 MLE 的渐近行为。作为应用，在非齐次 Poisson 过程的快速光滑变化点模型中（过渡区间收缩快于 1/n），证明 MLE 在相合性、收敛速率、极限分布及矩收敛方面与"纯"变化点模型具有相同渐近行为。

Conclusion: Skorokhod M_1 拓扑为处理归一化似然比连续而极限似然比不连续的统计模型提供了有效框架，扩展了经典方法的适用范围；所提出的 M_1 连续模控制技术具有独立价值，并可推广至更一般的模型。

Abstract: We extend the Ibragimov-Khasminskii likelihood ratio analysis method, in the one-dimensional parameter case, to a framework based on the Skorokhod $M\_1$ topology. The proposed framework applies to a broad class of statistical models, including those for which the normalized likelihood ratio processes are continuous while the limiting likelihood ratio process is discontinuous, a setting outside the scope of classical approaches based on the uniform or Skorokhod $J\_1$ topologies. We derive sufficient conditions for the weak convergence of likelihood ratio processes in the space of c{à}dl{à}g functions on $\RR$ vanishing at $\pm\infty$, endowed with the Skorokhod $M\_1$ topology, and show how this convergence yields the asymptotic behavior of the maximum likelihood estimator. We also introduce new techniques for controlling the $M\_1$ modulus of continuity. Although these techniques are particularly well suited to models in which all jumps and steep continuous transitions are in the same direction, they are of independent interest and may prove useful beyond this setting. As an application, we study a smooth change-point model for inhomogeneous Poisson processes in the fast regime, where the transition interval shrinks faster than $1/n$. We establish that in this case the maximum likelihood estimator has the same asymptotic behavior (consistency, rate of convergence, limiting distribution and convergence of moments) as in the corresponding ''pure'' change-point model.

</details>


### [443] [Nonparametric Regression on Fixed-Cardinality Subsets:Minimax Risk and Random-Design Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15592)
*G{é}rard Biau*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 研究以固定大小子集为协变量的回归问题，借助Johnson图谱调和分解定义内在Johnson–Sobolev尺度，给出风险界与极小极大刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该问题源于组合筛选、捆绑偏好建模等，响应是输入子集的未知函数，观测为均匀采样固定基数k子集上的含噪评估。固定基数约束耦合了成员坐标，标准乘积域上的交互与光滑性概念无法直接套用，需要建立适配的结构理论。

Method: 利用Johnson图的调和分解定义内在Johnson–Sobolev尺度，确定低阶交互空间的精确维数；推导调和投影的有限样本风险界；在Johnson–Sobolev能量预算相对噪声方差受控时建立非渐近极小极大刻画；证明当经验Gram矩阵条件良好时，稳定最小二乘消除经验投影中依赖信号的波动；对任意信噪比，用秩亏分析量化随机设计未能识别的成分。

Result: 得到调和投影的有限样本风险界与非渐近极小极大刻画；证明稳定最小二乘在Gram矩阵条件良好时消除信号相关波动；秩亏分析与中心化补全估计量结合，给出的极小极大界在min(k,d−k)与光滑阶固定时达到常数级匹配。

Conclusion: 为固定基数子集协变量回归建立了基于Johnson图调和分析的内在尺度与最优率理论，数值实验（见补充材料）验证了不同交互轮廓下的估计，并区分了观测噪声、随机设计波动与覆盖不完整的影响。

Abstract: We study regression with subsets as covariates. The response is an unknown function of the input subset, and observations consist of noisy evaluations at uniformly sampled subsets, each containing exactly \(k\) items from a ground set of size \(d\). This problem arises in combination screening, bundle preference modeling, and other settings in which outcomes depend on collections of prescribed size. The fixed-cardinality constraint couples the membership coordinates, so standard product-domain notions of interaction and smoothness cannot be imported unchanged. We use the harmonic decomposition of the Johnson graph to define an intrinsic Johnson--Sobolev scale and determine the exact dimensions of low-order interaction spaces. We derive finite-sample risk bounds for harmonic projection and establish a nonasymptotic minimax characterization when the Johnson--Sobolev energy budget is controlled relative to the noise variance. We also show that stable least squares removes the signal-dependent fluctuation of empirical projection when the empirical Gram matrix is sufficiently well conditioned. For arbitrary signal-to-noise ratios, a rank-deficiency analysis quantifies the components left unidentified by the random design. Together, the rank-deficiency analysis and a centered completion estimator yield minimax bounds that match up to constants whenever \(\min(k,d-k)\) and the smoothness order are fixed. Numerical experiments reported in the Supplementary Material illustrate estimation under different interaction profiles and distinguish the effects of observation noise, random-design fluctuation, and incomplete coverage.

</details>


### [444] [Resolvable Fourier Degree and Minimax Estimation on theBoolean Hypercube](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15595)
*G{é}rard Biau*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文研究布尔超立方体上带Fourier–Sobolev预算的高维非参数回归，给出可分辨Fourier阶数D*(d,n)下极小极大风险阶B/D*(d,n)，并对单调回归（已知与未知支撑）建立匹配率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维非参数回归在布尔超立方体上受维数灾难困扰，需在Fourier–Sobolev预算（总二次影响有界）下明确估计的统计可见交互阶与可达风险，并刻画单调性对风险的改善。

Method: 定义可分辨Fourier阶数D*(d,n)（使degree-D Fourier–Walsh空间维数不超过n的最大交互阶）；在Fourier–Sobolev椭球上推导极小极大风险；随后在相同预算下分析单调回归，分别处理已知s个坐标支撑（s同阶于log n）与未知支撑（函数单调且至多依赖s个坐标）两种设定。

Result: Fourier–Sobolev椭球上极小极大风险阶为B/D*(d,n)；单调且已知s坐标支撑（s同阶log n）时匹配率为B/s；未知支撑且至多依赖s个坐标时，风险由内在维数s及选择活跃支撑的对数代价共同决定。

Conclusion: 估计可达统计可见的交互阶，预算B控制高阶交互的残差质量；单调性与低内在维数可显著降低风险，未知支撑仅引入选择活跃坐标的对数代价。

Abstract: We study high-dimensional nonparametric regression on the Boolean hypercube \(\{0,1\}^d\), from a sample of size \(n\), under a Fourier--Sobolev budget, i.e., a bound \(B\) on the total quadratic influence of the regression function. The central object is the resolvable Fourier degree \(D^*(d,n)\), defined as the largest interaction order \(D\) such that the dimension of the degree-\(D\) Fourier--Walsh space does not exceed \(n\). We prove that the minimax risk over Fourier--Sobolev ellipsoids is of order \(B/D^*(d,n)\): estimation is possible up to the statistically visible interaction order, and the budget controls the residual mass carried by higher-order interactions. We then study monotone regression under the same budget. For monotone functions supported on a known set of \(s\) coordinates, with \(s\) of order \(\log n\), we obtain a matching minimax rate of order \(B/s\). Finally, we consider an unknown-support model in which the function is monotone and depends on at most \(s\) coordinates; its minimax risk is governed by the intrinsic dimension \(s\) together with the logarithmic cost of selecting the active support.

</details>


### [445] [Covariance and Principal Component Analysis on Riemannian Manifolds and Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15753)
*Luiz Hartmann,Wenwen Li,Washington Mio*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文提出黎曼流形上有界几何概率测度的协方差与主成分分析（PCA）新框架，放弃以Fréchet均值为锚点，转而对每一点建模变异，经热核导出向量场表示，将流形映射到Hilbert空间，并给出GraphPCA离散版本与数值实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统黎曼流形PCA以Fréchet均值为中心，但其唯一性与有效性在该设定下可能失效，因此需要一个不依赖Fréchet均值的协方差与PCA框架。

Method: 提出流形上协方差与PCA概念：不再锚定Fréchet均值，而考察每一点处的变异；利用热核导出向量场，将流形映射到向量场的Hilbert空间，使欧氏协方差与PCA可直接迁移。并发展两种计算约简：RiePCA（有限点支撑向量场的有限维约简）与GraphPCA（加权图顶点测度的离散形式，向量场为边赋予方向与大小）。同时证明映射到向量场空间的嵌入定理。

Result: typically获得无穷多个主成分，可捕捉高度非线性的几何特征与变异模式；证明了嵌入定理；在合成与真实数据上的数值例子与实验展示了方法行为。

Conclusion: 所提框架为黎曼流形与加权图上的概率测度提供了一种不依赖Fréchet均值的协方差与PCA表示，能够刻画非线性变异，并通过RiePCA与GraphPCA实现计算落地。

Abstract: We develop notions of covariance and principal component analysis (PCA) for probability measures on Riemannian manifolds of bounded geometry and a discrete counterpart for distributions on the vertex sets of weighted simple graphs. Rather than anchoring variation at the Fréchet mean, whose uniqueness and usefulness can fail in this context, we consider variation about every point. This leads to a representation of each point on the manifold by a vector field derived from the heat kernel and thus to a map of the underlying manifold into a Hilbert space of vector fields, in which covariance and PCA carry over from the Euclidean setting. A distinguishing feature of this formulation is that one typically obtains infinitely many principal components, capable of capturing highly nonlinear geometric features and patterns of variation. We prove an embedding theorem for the mapping into the space of vector fields and develop two computational reductions of the theory: RiePCA, a finite-dimensional reduction based on vector fields supported on finitely many points, and GraphPCA, a discrete formulation for measures on weighted graphs in which vector fields assign orientations and magnitudes to edges. Numerical examples and experiments illustrate the behavior of the proposed methods on both synthetic and real data.

</details>


### [446] [Gaussian Comparison Theorems for High-Dimensional Posterior Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15791)
*Wenxuan Zou,Galen Reeves*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文为非高斯高维模型的后验推断建立了高斯比较理论，允许模型误设定，通过在可分离函数空间上直接处理似然过程，给出由前两阶矩差异和局部三阶矩控制的非渐近自由能界，并借助扰动-凸性论证导出后验均方误差与后验方差的夹逼界，在乘积模型中化为局部矩控制与特征半径尺度条件，应用于稀疏Bernoulli超图推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维后验推断中，高斯近似（如Bernstein-von Mises）通常要求真实后验本身近似高斯且模型正确设定，这在实际复杂模型（存在误设定、非光滑相变）中往往不成立。作者希望建立一个不依赖后验高斯性、能容忍模型误设定的比较框架，从而将非高斯模型的后验行为归约到高斯参考，并刻画其普适性边界。

Method: 在可分离函数空间上直接分析似然过程，建立由一二阶矩差异与局部三阶矩控制的显式非渐近自由能界；采用扰动-凸性论证将自由能比较传递为后验均方误差与后验方差的夹逼界，并处理不可微相变点处的单侧结论；在高维乘积模型中将条件约化为局部矩控制与一个标准的特征半径尺度条件。

Result: 得到了非渐近的自由能比较界与后验均方误差、后验方差的上下夹逼界，在不可微相变处给出单侧结论；在高维乘积模型中证明所需条件退化为局部矩控制与特征半径尺度；在弱正则性条件下该普适性理论适用于从指数族到一般正则局部对数似然的一大类模型，并以稀疏Bernoulli超图推断为例进行了说明。

Conclusion: 该框架将高维非高斯后验推断的比较问题归约为矩条件，放宽了对后验高斯性与模型正确设定的要求，为误设定下的后验均值与方差提供了可控的夹逼刻画，并具备跨模型的普适性；稀疏Bernoulli超图推断展示了其可操作性。

Abstract: We develop a Gaussian comparison theory for posterior inference in non-Gaussian high-dimensional models. The framework allows for model misspecification and does not require the posterior distribution itself to be approximately Gaussian. Working directly with likelihood processes on separable function spaces, we establish explicit nonasymptotic free energy bounds controlled by first two moment discrepancies and local third moments. A perturbation-and-convexity argument transfers these comparisons to sandwich bounds for posterior mean squared error and posterior variance, including one-sided conclusions at nondifferentiable phase transitions. In high-dimensional product models, these conditions reduce to local moment controls and a canonical feature-radius scaling. Under weak regularity requirements, the resulting universality theory applies to a broad class of likelihood models, ranging from exponential families to more general regular local log-likelihoods. The framework is illustrated on sparse Bernoulli hypergraph inference.

</details>


### [447] [A Threshold Constant for Exact Community Recovery in the Degree-Corrected Poisson Stochastic Block Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15793)
*Lucie Arts*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文通过最大轮廓似然估计研究度修正泊松随机块模型(DC-SBM)中的精确社区恢复，识别出显式复杂度常数 C(π,S)，证明 C(π,S)>1 时可实现对数稀疏尺度下的精确恢复，并猜想 C(π,S)=1 为信息论阈值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社区恢复是网络科学核心问题，DC-SBM 引入异质度参数使问题更具现实性，但异质权重改变了恢复问题的几何与集中性质，现有理论难以刻画精确恢复阈值。

Method: 采用最大轮廓似然估计器；构造显式复杂度常数 C(π,S)，融合社区间加权 Chernoff–Hellinger 分离度与度归一化块体积诱导的 KL 修正；对异质度参数下轮廓似然进行新的集中与几何控制。

Result: 严格证明 C(π,S)>1 保证估计器强相合，实现对数稀疏尺度下的精确恢复；给出精确恢复转变的上界；在平均度发散时建立弱相合，统一稀疏与稠密情形。

Conclusion: C(π,S) 精确刻画 DC-SBM 精确恢复阈值，猜想 C(π,S)=1 为锐信息论阈值；结果与二元 SBM、二元 DC-SBM 形成类比，构建了跨稀疏—稠密机制的统一图景。

Abstract: We study exact community recovery in the Degree-Corrected Poisson Stochastic Block Model (DC-SBM) through the maximum profile likelihood estimator. Our main contribution is identifying an explicit complexity constant $C(π,S)$, which closely captures the exact recovery threshold. This constant combines a weighted Chernoff--Hellinger separation between communities with a Kullback--Leibler correction induced by the degree-normalized block volumes. We rigorously prove that $C(π,S)>1$ ensures the strong consistency of the maximum profile likelihood estimator, yielding exact community recovery down to the logarithmic sparsity scale. We conjecture that $C(π,S)=1$ represents the sharp information-theoretic threshold, providing an upper bound on the exact-recovery transition, and we discuss analogies with the binary SBM and binary DC-SBM cases. Additionally, we establish weak consistency when the average degree diverges, offering a unified picture across sparse and dense regimes. The proofs require new control of the profile likelihood in the presence of heterogeneous degree parameters, whose node-specific weights fundamentally alter the geometry and concentration of the recovery problem.

</details>


### [448] [When Is a Relevance Threshold Statistically Resolvable? Minimax Limits for Effect Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15811)
*Subir Hait*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 论文提出"相关性分辨指数"$\\lambda_n=\\sqrt{nI_0}\\Delta_n$，刻画科学相关性阈值$\\Delta_n$与统计精度$n^{-1/2}$的相对尺度，并在三类极限情形下给出分类问题的相变与极小极大下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统计精度与科学相关性处于不同尺度：常规问题中抽样不确定性以$n^{-1/2}$收缩，而"科学上可忽略"的效应阈值$\\Delta_n$可能固定或随信息变化。二者缺乏统一度量，导致无法判断科学意义上的效应何时可被统计分辨。

Method: 在正则标量模型（Fisher信息$I_0$）中定义相关性分辨指数$\\lambda_n=\\sqrt{nI_0}\Delta_n$，针对分离的"可忽略"与"有意义"参数类构造分类问题，建立极小极大风险下界；在$\\lambda_n\\to\\kappa$情形下刻画其收敛到的非退化高斯移位决策问题；对$\\Delta_n=dn^{-\\gamma}$分析临界速率；并推广至非对称移动相关性区域与异质真实效应（显著性饱和极限）。

Result: 当$\\lambda_n\\to\\kappa$时得极小极大下界$\\liminf_{n\\to\\infty}R_n^*\\ge 2\\{1-\\Phi(\\varepsilon\\kappa)\\}$；$\\lambda_n\\to 0$时实验合并，一致分类不可能；$\\lambda_n\\to\\kappa\\in(0,\\infty)$时问题收敛为非退化高斯移位，可非平凡判别但不可一致；$\\lambda_n\\to\\infty$时在一致估计-分辨条件下可实现一致分类。$\\Delta_n=dn^{-\\gamma}$的临界速率为$\\gamma=1/2$。非对称移动相关性区域由到两边界标准化距离而非总宽度决定；异质效应下点零显著性在中等信息量时对科学相关效应最具选择性。

Conclusion: 该框架以共同的信息尺度统一了效应量、功效、局部渐近理论与实际显著性，明确了科学相关性何时在统计上可被分辨，并揭示一致性分类存在以$\\gamma=1/2$为界的相变结构。

Abstract: Statistical precision and scientific relevance operate on different scales. In regular problems, sampling uncertainty contracts at rate $n^{-1/2}$, whereas the magnitude below which an effect is scientifically negligible may be fixed or may vary with information. Let $Δ_n$ denote a relevance threshold and $I_0$ Fisher information in a regular scalar model, and define the relevance-resolution index $λ_n=\sqrt{nI_0}Δ_n$. For separated negligible and meaningful parameter classes, we establish the minimax lower bound $\liminf_{n\to\infty}R_n^*\ge 2\{1-Φ(\varepsilonκ)\}$ when $λ_n\toκ$. If $λ_n\to0$, the experiments merge and consistent classification is impossible. If $λ_n\toκ\in(0,\infty)$, the problem converges to a nondegenerate Gaussian-shift decision problem: nontrivial discrimination is possible, but consistency is not. If $λ_n\to\infty$, consistent classification is attainable under a uniform estimation-resolution condition. For $Δ_n=dn^{-γ}$, the critical rate is $γ=1/2$. We also show that moving asymmetric relevance regions are governed by standardized distances to their two boundaries rather than by total width alone. For heterogeneous true effects, we derive a significance-saturation limit and show that point-null significance can be most selective for scientifically relevant effects at intermediate information. The framework characterizes when scientific relevance is statistically resolvable, linking effect size, power, local asymptotic theory, and practical significance through a common information scale.

</details>

### [449] [BudgetBench: A Budget-Tiered Protocol and Pilot Harness for Memory Strategy Evaluation in Local Large Language Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13149)
*Aditya Karnam Gururaj Rao,Arjun Jaggi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 BudgetBench：一种以“每次调用的输入 token 预算”为自变量的主动预算协议与参考测试框架，用于在固定模型/任务/采样/解码条件下比较记忆策略；并报告了多项试点研究，重点贡献是可复用的测量面与预算违规报告机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向本地大语言模型智能体，主动上下文是稀缺资源：记忆容量、预填充延迟、缓存增长与服务目标都限制单次调用的可承受输入 token 数。现有评估通常只采用单一预算，掩盖了不同预算下的质量曲线、预算利用率与违规情况，因此需要一个可复用、可比较的固定预算评测协议。

Method: 将“每次调用输入 token 预算”设为独立变量，固定模型、任务、采样器与解码设置，扫描 2K/4K/8K/16K/32K 预算，记录质量、预算利用率、延迟以及作为一级结果的预算违规率。框架提供可替换的 MemoryStrategy 契约、显式预算强制、确定性或版本化评分器、提示审计元数据与可复现工件。用三类试点加以验证：本地 qwen2.5:1.5b（SWE-bench Verified 与 LongBench v2 各 89 项）、托管 Qwen3 30B-A3B 的 50 项 LongBench 复现（精确分词），以及 500 项 LongMemEval oracle 研究（官方 GPT-4o 评估器打分）。

Result: 框架暴露出预算合规失败、非单调质量曲线以及单预算评估所隐藏的操作点。预算化与全上下文的方向仍未定论：本地切片接近零效应，托管复现的点估计更偏向全上下文。作者透明披露早期试点的分词器近似会低估部分服务模型提示的 token 数，因此相关违规行仅为分词器近似诊断，不作为可承载结论的结果；所有计时均为操作性诊断。

Conclusion: 可复用贡献是协议、测试框架与失败报告规范，用于将固定预算下的记忆策略评估规模化；该方法定位为试点验证与测量基础设施，而非最终排名。

Abstract: For local large language model agents, active context is a scarce resource: memory capacity, prefill latency, cache growth, and service objectives all constrain how many input tokens each call can afford. We present BudgetBench, an active-budget protocol and reference harness that treats the per-call input-token budget as the independent variable when comparing memory strategies. Holding the model, task, sampler, and decoding fixed, it sweeps budgets over 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, and 32K tokens and records quality, budget utilization, latency, and, as a first-class outcome, budget-violation rates. The core contribution is this reusable measurement surface: a swappable MemoryStrategy contract, explicit budget enforcement, deterministic or versioned graders, prompt-audit metadata, and reproducibility artifacts, released at https://github.com/aviskaar/budgetbench.
  We substantiate the protocol with pilot studies rather than final rankings. Across a local qwen2.5:1.5b pilot (89 items each on SWE-bench Verified and LongBench v2), a hosted 50-item Qwen3 30B-A3B LongBench replication with exact tokenization, and a 500-item LongMemEval oracle study scored by the official GPT-4o evaluator, the harness exposes budget-compliance failures, non-monotonic quality curves, and operating points that single-budget evaluation hides. The budgeted-versus-full-context direction remains unresolved: the local slice is near-null and the hosted replication favors full context in point estimate. We report results transparently, including that the early pilot's tokenizer approximation undercounts some served-model prompts, so its violation rows are tokenizer-approximation diagnostics, not claim-bearing results; all timings are operational diagnostics. The reusable contribution is the protocol, harness, and failure-reporting discipline needed to scale fixed-budget memory-strategy evaluation.

</details>


### [450] [A derivative-fidelity failure mode in physics-informed neural networks: strengthened benchmark evidence from function-value training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13171)
*Koji Koyamada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文识别PINN中"函数值拟合准确但导数不可靠"的失败模式，并通过一维基准实验（sin(x)、exp(x)）验证自动微分所得二阶导数误差显著大于函数值误差，提出诊断协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINN依赖自动微分施加微分方程残差，但函数值上的良好一致性并不必然意味着导数准确；这一潜在失败模式此前缺乏系统刻画。

Method: 以多层感知机在一维基准sin(x)和exp(x)上仅用函数值进行训练，随后单独评估自动微分得到的二阶导数；并考察训练点密度、激活函数、端点密集评估以及L2与最大误差两类诊断指标的影响。

Result: 实验显示函数近似在视觉上准确的同时，二阶导数误差可显著更大，尤其在高曲率边界区域附近更为明显。

Conclusion: 论文为区分"数值精度"与"物理残差可靠性"提供了一套诊断协议，揭示导数保真度是PINN的独立失败模式，需单独评估。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) use automatic differentiation to impose differential-equation residuals, but good agreement in function values does not necessarily imply accurate derivatives. This paper formulates derivative fidelity as a failure mode of PINNs and tests it with one-dimensional benchmarks. Multilayer perceptrons are trained only on function values for sin(x) and exp(x), while second derivatives obtained by automatic differentiation are evaluated separately. The hypothesis is strengthened by additional tests over training-point density, activation functions, endpoint-dense evaluation, and both L2 and maximum-error diagnostics. The results show that visually accurate function approximation can coexist with substantially larger second-derivative errors, especially near high-curvature boundary regions. The experiment provides a diagnostic protocol for distinguishing value accuracy from physics-residual reliability.

</details>


### [451] [Certifiably Interpretable Training of ReLU-MLPs for Boolean Tasks with Guaranteed Truth-Table Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13439)
*Hrad Ghoukasian,Anastasis Kratsios*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MACCHIATO算法，联合构建显式结构ReLU-MLP与布尔电路证书，在合成random-junta任务上于数据稀疏或投影对齐场景超越Adam训练MLP，并提供统计泛化保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着算力、模型与训练算法的发展，AI系统能力增强但其可解释性正在被侵蚀。为保障可解释性，需要一种能同时给出显式结构与可验证计算证书的训练算法。

Method: MACCHIATO训练算法：迭代地将布尔函数的残差投影到低维{AND,OR,XOR}电路类上，并精确编译为ReLU-MLP；结合ReLU-MLP电路编译、ESPRESSO逻辑最小化与基于影响的变量选择。网络为六层ReLU-MLP（含输入层），宽O(mB)。

Result: 在合成random-junta任务上，网络在若干数据稀疏或投影对齐场景中优于深度与隐藏宽度匹配的Adam训练MLP；在truth-table误差容忍下，其他场景Adam-MLP更强。PyEDA实现中迭代过程可在平面环境维度ESPRESSO超过三小时预算的场景下完成。理论保证：在影响恢复条件下，若每个阶段残差最多依赖log2(B)位，样本分裂变体在T个观测上返回truth-table误差O(√(m(B+log(m/δ))/T))。

Conclusion: 该工作通过显式结构MLP与布尔电路证书的组合，在可解释性与统计保证之间建立联系，并在效率上优于直接高维ESPRESSO求解。

Abstract: As compute scales, models evolve, and training algorithms advance, our ability to explain the increasingly powerful AI systems they enable is eroding. To help safeguard interpretability, we introduce a specialized training algorithm (MACCHIATO) that jointly constructs (i) an explicitly structured $\operatorname{ReLU}$-MLP from partial truth-table observations and (ii) an explicit Boolean circuit over signed literals with $\{\operatorname{AND},\operatorname{OR},\operatorname{XOR}\}$ gates certifying what its subnetworks compute and how they compose. Intuitively, we iteratively project the residuals of a Boolean function onto low-dimensional $\{\operatorname{AND},\operatorname{OR},\operatorname{XOR}\}$-circuit classes and exactly compile the resulting circuit into a $\operatorname{ReLU}$-MLP; we combine $\operatorname{ReLU}$-MLP circuit compilation, ESPRESSO logic minimization, and influence-based variable selection.
  Roughly speaking, our interpretability certificate is complemented by a statistical guarantee: under the theorem's influence-recovery conditions, if each of the $m$ stage-wise residuals depends on at most $\log_2(B)$ bits, a sample-splitting variant of our algorithm trained on $T$ observations returns a six-layer $\operatorname{ReLU}$-MLP (counting the input layer) of width $\mathcal{O}(mB)$ with truth-table error $\mathcal{O}\bigl(\sqrt{m(B+\log(m/δ))/T}\bigr)$.
  On synthetic random-junta tasks, our networks outperform depth- and hidden-width-matched Adam-trained MLPs in several data-sparse or projection-aligned regimes, while the trained ReLU-MLPs are stronger in others. Moreover, in our explicit PyEDA truth-table implementation, the iterative procedure completes in regimes where flat ambient-dimensional ESPRESSO exceeds the three-hour computational budget.

</details>


### [452] [Land Art as a Big-Data Climate Sensor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13182)
*Alev Cinbarci,Sean Kalaycioglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究利用1984–2025年1,744景Landsat与Sentinel-2影像，构建14维复杂度特征并联合气候水文数据，揭示Spiral Jetty影像复杂度可作为湖泊水位的领先指标，并将"艺术即温度计"修正为"艺术即水文状态先行指标"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Robert Smithson的《螺旋堤》（1970）位于大盐湖北岸，随湖泊严重萎缩反复淹没与出露。已有小样本研究曾提出其影像特征与全球气温正相关，但样本有限、结论存疑，需要更大规模、跨传感器、跨年份的严格再检验，并厘清影像复杂度与气候/水文变量之间的真实关系及时间先后。

Method: 构建1984–2025年逐年逐月共1,744个配准的Landsat 4-9与Sentinel-2影像切片；提取14维复杂度特征，涵盖Shannon熵、多尺度排列熵、分形维数、空隙度、灰度共生矩阵纹理、强度统计量及ImageNet预训练ResNet50特征；与NASA GISTEMP、USGS NWIS、Open-Meteo、Global Carbon Budget的42年月度气候水文面板对照。采用Bootstrap、Spearman/Pearson相关、主成分分析、滞后互相关、STL分解及偏相关（控制月份与传感器）进行分析。

Result: Bootstrap表明Shannon熵是弱代理，不支持早先小样本关于其与全球气温正相关的结论。粗尺度排列熵与平均强度强跟踪湖面高程，Spearman相关为0.85–0.88，95%置信区间不含零。ResNet50嵌入的第三主成分无监督地成为"AI气候轴"，与累积CO2相关0.86、与湖面高程相关-0.83。影像复杂度领先湖泊水位约三年（滞后+3时Pearson r=0.58，95%CI 0.40–0.73）。STL分解显示非单调趋势：1984–2015上升，此后在逼近历史低水位时急剧下降。偏相关证实结果对季节与传感器效应稳健。

Conclusion: 研究将"艺术即温度计"的隐喻修正为"艺术即水文状态领先指标"的解释框架。数据集、特征管线与分析代码作为公共基准发布。

Abstract: Robert Smithson's 1970 land artwork Spiral Jetty, located in the north arm of Utah's Great Salt Lake, has alternated between submergence and exposure during severe lake decline. We analyze 1,744 co-registered Landsat 4-9 and Sentinel-2 image chips spanning every year and calendar month from 1984 to 2025. A 14-feature complexity signature combines Shannon entropy, multiscale permutation entropy, fractal dimension, lacunarity, gray-level co-occurrence texture, intensity statistics, and ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 features. These measurements are compared with a 42-year monthly climate and hydrology panel from NASA GISTEMP, USGS NWIS, Open-Meteo, and the Global Carbon Budget. Bootstrap analysis shows that Shannon entropy is a weak proxy and does not support an earlier small-sample claim of positive correlation with global temperature. By contrast, coarse-scale permutation entropy and mean intensity track lake elevation strongly, with Spearman correlations of 0.85 to 0.88 and 95 percent confidence intervals excluding zero. The third principal component of the ResNet50 embeddings emerges without supervision as an AI climate axis, correlating 0.86 with cumulative CO2 and -0.83 with lake elevation. Image complexity leads lake stage by about three years, with Pearson r = 0.58 at lag +3 and a 95 percent confidence interval of 0.40 to 0.73. STL decomposition reveals a non-monotonic trend that rises from 1984 to 2015 and declines sharply thereafter as the lake approaches record-low elevations. Partial correlations controlling for month and sensor confirm robustness to seasonal and sensor effects. These results refine the art-as-thermometer metaphor into an art-as-leading-indicator-of-hydrological-state interpretation. The dataset, feature pipeline, and analysis code are released as a public benchmark.

</details>


### [453] [Toward Optimal Switching Regret for Multi-Armed Bandits with Oblivious Adversary](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13547)
*Mengxiao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究对抗多臂老虎机中的切换遗憾：在未知切换次数 S 且面对 oblivious 对手时，用单一算法对所有 S 同时达到 Õ(√((S+1)KT)) 期望遗憾，解决了 Auer 等人的开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当 S 已知时，最优期望遗憾 Õ(√((S+1)KT)) 可由 Auer 等（2002）实现；但当 S 未知时，Marinov 和 Zimmert（2021）证明在自适应对手下该保证不可能。因此，在 oblivious 对手下能否用单一算法匹配该最优界，是 Auer 等（2019b）提出的开放问题，本文旨在解决这一问题。

Method: 算法结合了以较小学习率初始化的 fixed-share 学习器，以及若干 dyadic 区间子程序，这些子程序使用随机化学习率和隐式探索来搜索局部改进；同时采用非均匀先验以偏好跟随主学习器，从而将维护大量子程序的开销保持在较低水平。当子程序相对主学习器累积足够改进时，主学习率加倍，从而适应未知的比较器切换次数 S。

Result: 单一算法在 oblivious 对手下对每个 S 均达到 Õ(√((S+1)KT)) 期望遗憾，匹配已知 S 时的最优保证。

Conclusion: 该工作解决了 Auer 等（2019b）的开放问题：在 oblivious 对抗设置下，未知 S 的切换遗憾可达到与已知 S 相同的最优速率，说明自适应对手下不可实现的最优界在 oblivious 对手下是可达的。

Abstract: We study switching regret in adversarial multi-armed bandits, where the learner competes with an arm sequence that changes at most $S$ times. When $S$ is known, an optimal expected regret of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{(S+1)KT})$ is obtainable [Auer et al., 2002]. However, when $S$ is unknown, Marinov and Zimmert [2021] show that this guarantee is impossible under an adaptive adversary. In this paper, we show that a single algorithm achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{(S+1)KT})$ expected regret for every $S$ against an oblivious adversary, resolving an open problem of Auer et al. [2019b]. Our algorithm combines a fixed-share learner initialized with a small learning rate and dyadic-interval subroutines that search for local improvements using randomized learning rates and implicit exploration. Importantly, a non-uniform prior favors following the main learner, keeping the cost of maintaining many subroutines small. When the subroutines accumulate sufficient improvement over the main learner, its learning rate doubles, allowing adaptation to the unknown number of comparator switches $S$.

</details>


### [454] [LLMs or Naive Bayes? Old Gems or New Ways](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13185)
*Mohammad Firas Sada,Dmitry Mishin,John Graham,Seungmin Kim,Mahidhar Tatineni,Frank Würthwein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统对比了Complement Naive Bayes与零样本/少样本大语言模型在文本分类任务上的表现，发现NB在有标注数据时仍具竞争力，在HPC场景下是更优选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM的兴起引发了一个问题：在科研计算中，像Naive Bayes这样的经典方法是否应该被淘汰？作者希望系统性地检验经典方法与LLM的优劣边界，为资源受限的HPC从业者提供决策依据。

Method: 对Complement Naive Bayes与零样本/少样本LLM进行基准测试，覆盖4个模型家族、27B到1T参数混合专家模型的37倍规模跨度，测试多项文本分类任务，并测量GPU吞吐量、能耗，分析任务依赖的决策边界（标注样本量N），同时提供Kubernetes Helm operator自动化模型选择。

Result: LLM仅在零数据场景占优（Amazon Polarity情感任务98.0% vs 88.2%），但该优势易受数据污染影响：低污染情感任务中NB反超（81.7% vs 73.0%）。有标注数据时（如AG News），NB达89.1%，与零样本27B LLM（89.0%）统计无差异，优于397B前沿模型（84.8%），且CPU吞吐达数千样本/秒。微调DistilBERT达90.6%但吞吐远低于NB。GPU吞吐分析显示小LLM批量推理比NB CPU推理慢40-486倍，每样本能耗约低两个数量级。

Conclusion: 对于有标注数据的文本分类任务，资源受限的HPC从业者应选择NB。决策边界依赖于任务：主题分类中NB约在N~10^4标注样本时达到LLM水平，而零数据情感任务中LLM在所有测试N值下均占优。作者提供Kubernetes Helm operator以可配置阈值和Prometheus指标自动化模型选择。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) prompt a recurring question in research computing: should classical methods like Naive Bayes (NB) be retired? We benchmark Complement Naive Bayes against zero-shot and few-shot LLMs spanning four model families and a 37x range in scale (27B to a 1T-parameter mixture-of-experts) across text classification tasks. LLMs dominate only in zero-data regimes (98.0% vs 88.2% on Amazon Polarity sentiment), and even that win is contamination-prone: on a low-contamination sentiment task NB beats the zero-shot LLM (81.7% vs 73.0%). However, once labeled data is available (e.g., AG News), NB reaches 89.1% accuracy, statistically indistinguishable from the zero-shot 27B LLM (89.0%) and better than the 397B frontier model (84.8%), at thousands of samples/sec on a commodity CPU. Fine-tuned DistilBERT reaches 90.6% but at far lower throughput than NB at batch size 1 (Table 2). Our measured GPU throughput analysis shows small-LLM batched inference is 40-486x slower than NB CPU inference (the multiplier depends strongly on the host CPU), exposing a structural gap bounded by memory bandwidth, with roughly two orders of magnitude lower energy per sample. For resource-constrained HPC practitioners performing text classification with labeled data, NB remains the optimal choice. We show the decision line is task-dependent (NB reaches LLM parity around $N \sim 10^4$ labels for topic classification, while zero-data sentiment favors the LLM at all N tested) and provide a Kubernetes Helm operator that automates model selection using configurable thresholds and verifiable Prometheus metrics.

</details>


### [455] [Curvature-Independent Regret Bounds for Distributed Online Optimization on Hadamard Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13646)
*Zhanyuan Cai,Emre Sahinoglu,Shahin Shahrampour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究Hadamard流形上的去中心化在线Riemannian优化，针对horospherical凸（h-convex）函数类提出D-ROGD算法（局部Riemannian h-次梯度更新+隐式Fréchet均值一致性），在h-convex和强h-convex情形分别得到O(√T)与O(log T)静态regret，且网络依赖仅由谱隙决定，首次实现曲率无关的regret保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有测地凸（g-convex）框架下的去中心化在线Riemannian优化分析通常需要曲率信息（如截面曲率的有限下界），曲率还可能进入步长或Riemannian一致性方案的收缩因子，导致算法对曲率敏感。作者希望放宽曲率依赖，针对更窄的h-convex函数类实现曲率无关分析。

Method: 提出分布式Riemannian在线梯度下降（D-ROGD）：每个节点执行局部Riemannian h-次梯度更新，并通过隐式Fréchet均值进行一致性融合；在h-convex与强h-convex局部目标下进行regret分析。

Result: 对h-convex局部目标获得O(√T)静态regret，对强h-convex局部目标获得O(log T)静态regret，与欧氏对应速率在T上一致；网络依赖仅由谱隙决定。在双曲嵌入实验上与预测速率吻合，未观察到曲率导致的性能退化。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了Hadamard流形上去中心化在线优化首个曲率无关的regret保证，说明在h-convex函数类下可摆脱曲率依赖，同时保持与欧氏情形相同的T阶速率。实验验证了理论速率。

Abstract: This work addresses decentralized online Riemannian optimization on Hadamard manifolds. Prior work under geodesic convexity (g-convexity) may require curvature information in the optimization analysis, typically through a finite lower bound on the sectional curvature. Curvature may also enter the step size or contraction factor of tangent-space Riemannian consensus schemes. In this work, we relax the curvature dependence for a narrower class of horospherical convex (h-convex) functions. We study Distributed Riemannian Online Gradient Descent (D-ROGD), which combines local Riemannian h-subgradient updates with an implicit Fréchet-mean consensus. For h-convex and strongly h-convex local objectives, we establish $O(\sqrt{T})$ and $O(\log T)$ static regret, respectively, matching the corresponding Euclidean rates with respect to $T$, with network dependence governed solely by the spectral gap. To our knowledge, these are the first curvature-independent regret guarantees for decentralized online optimization on Hadamard manifolds. Experiments on hyperbolic embeddings corroborate the predicted rates, with no observable degradation due to curvature.

</details>


### [456] [Early Prediction of Satellite Collision Probability Using a Hybrid TCN-Transformer Model for a CDM-Based Conjunction Analysis Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13191)
*Rabia Tüylek Tok,Burak Yağlıoğlu,Enes Dağ,Emre Onur Kahya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于学习的卫星会合风险评估框架，通过预测同一接近事件下一次CDM更新中的PoC，实现对LEO电推进卫星会合风险的早期预警。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LEO运行卫星与轨道碎片数量快速增长，接近事件频发，加重卫星运营者负担；电推进卫星的低推力机动能力对碰撞规避规划增加了时间约束。连续CDM中轨道不确定性的非线性传播及PoC对协方差演化的敏感性，使序贯CDM的解读困难，亟需更早期的风险预测手段。

Method: 1) 采用无迹变换（Unscented Transform）的传播与反向传播框架评估碰撞风险指标对CDM参数的敏感性；2) 对数值CDM参数进行主成分分析（PCA），识别与PoC变化最相关的特征；3) 基于敏感性与PCA结果，筛选原始CDM参数并构造表征相对运动、交会几何与协方差不确定性的衍生指标；4) 构建序贯增强会合数据集，训练混合TCN-Transformer模型学习会合风险的时间演化。

Result: 在TÜBİTAK UZAY接收与分析的实际CDM数据上应用该框架，验证了其在LEO卫星会合场景中实现更早、更一致操作风险评估的潜力。

Conclusion: 所提学习型框架通过预测后续CDM的PoC并融合敏感性与PCA驱动的特征构造，能够有效支持LEO卫星会合的早期风险预警，特别适用于受低推力机动时间约束的电推进卫星。

Abstract: The rapid expansion of operational satellites and orbital debris has increased the frequency of close approach events in low Earth orbit (LEO), creating a higher operational burden for satellite operators. This problem is especially critical for satellites using electric propulsion, where low-thrust maneuver capability imposes additional time constraints on collision avoidance planning. In current practice, Conjunction Data Messages (CDMs) provide relative state, covariance, miss distance, time of closest approach, and probability of collision (PoC) information for conjunction assessment. However, the nonlinear propagation of orbital uncertainties and the sensitivity of PoC to covariance evolution make the interpretation of sequential CDMs challenging. This study proposes a learning-based framework for early prediction of satellite conjunction risk by estimating the PoC expected in the subsequent CDM update of the same close approach event. In the proposed methodology, an Unscented Transform-based propagation and backpropagation framework is first used to evaluate the sensitivity of the collision risk metric to CDM parameters. In addition, Principal Component Analysis is applied to the numerical CDM parameters to identify the features most relevant to PoC variation. The results obtained from the sensitivity analysis and PCA are then used to justify the selected raw CDM parameters and to construct derived metrics representing relative motion, encounter geometry, and covariance-related uncertainty. Using the resulting sequential enriched conjunction dataset, a hybrid Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN)-Transformer model is trained to learn the temporal evolution of conjunction risk. The framework is applied to CDMs received and analyzed within TÜBİTAK UZAY, demonstrating its potential for earlier and more consistent operational risk evaluation for LEO satellite conjunctions.

</details>


### [457] [Online Bayesian Node Classification on Inductive Graphs under Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13655)
*Jinwen Xu,Gonzalo Mateos Buckstein,Qin Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出在线 GVBLL 方法，通过变分贝叶斯末层训练与测试时 Laplace 在线更新，在演化图节点分类中同时实现归纳泛化与不确定性校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 演化图上的节点分类需同时满足两个要求：对分布漂移下新到节点的归纳泛化，以及面向安全敏感应用的校准不确定性；而标准 GNN 一次训练完成，两者均无法满足。

Method: 在确定性 GNN 编码器之上放置随机末层参数以适配贝叶斯末层（BLL）模型。由于分类所需的类别 softmax 似然破坏高斯共轭性，训练后验与测试时流式更新均无闭式解：为此提出变分贝叶斯末层（VBLL）目标，以蒙特卡洛期望对数似然最大化 ELBO，联合训练编码器与近似末层后验；测试时冻结编码器，对末层后验施加在线 Laplace 更新，该更新等价于带指数遗忘与对训练后验 KL 锚定的 power-prior 贝叶斯模型。

Result: 在五个分布漂移下的节点分类基准上，online GVBLL 是唯一在每个数据集上都取得最优准确率与负对数似然的方法；相较最强的非 GVBLL 基线，Cora 准确率提升最高达 17 个百分点，ogbn-arxiv 提升 14 个百分点，同时在校准上可与 MC Dropout、Deep Ensembles、Temperature Scaling 及高斯过程分类器竞争。

Conclusion: 将变分贝叶斯末层与测试时在线 Laplace 更新结合，可有效应对演化图上的分布漂移，在保持校准质量的同时显著提升节点分类准确率。

Abstract: On evolving graphs, node classifiers must satisfy two key requirements: inductive generalization to newly arriving nodes under distribution shift and calibrated uncertainty for safety-sensitive applications. Standard graph neural networks (GNNs) are typically trained once and address neither requirement. We adapt the Bayesian last-layer (BLL) model by placing random last-layer parameters on top of a deterministic GNN encoder for uncertainty quantification. The categorical softmax likelihood required for classification breaks Gaussian conjugacy, so neither the training posterior nor the test-time streaming update has a closed-form solution. To address both challenges, we introduce a variational Bayesian last-layer (VBLL) objective that jointly trains the encoder and an approximate last-layer posterior by maximizing an evidence lower bound with a Monte Carlo expected log-likelihood. At test time, we freeze the encoder and apply an online Laplace update to the last-layer posterior. This update corresponds to a power-prior Bayesian model with exponential forgetting and a Kullback-Leibler anchor to the training posterior. Across five node-classification benchmarks under distribution shift, online GVBLL is the only method to achieve the best accuracy and negative log-likelihood on every dataset. It improves accuracy by up to 17 percentage points on Cora and 14 percentage points on ogbn-arxiv over the strongest non-GVBLL baseline, while remaining competitive in calibration with MC Dropout, Deep Ensembles, Temperature Scaling, and Gaussian-process classifiers.

</details>


### [458] [Evaluating LLM-Generated Rules for Heart Disease Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13192)
*Feisal Alaswad,Batoul Aljaddouh,Maher Alrahhal,Wafaa Al Nassan,Talal Bonn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究对比传统机器学习模型与基于大语言模型生成规则的系统在心脏病预测上的表现，发现传统模型性能更优但LLM规则可解释性更强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究传统机器学习与LLM生成规则系统在心脏病预测中的性能与可解释性权衡，为医疗AI系统设计提供参考。

Method: 使用UCI心脏病数据集，评估逻辑回归、KNN、SVM、朴素贝叶斯、决策树、随机森林等分类器，并对比GPT-4o与Claude Sonnet 4.6生成的规则系统，采用准确率、精确率、召回率和F1分数进行评估。

Result: 传统模型整体优于LLM规则系统：随机森林最佳（准确率90.2%，精确率0.829，召回率1.0，F1 0.906），朴素贝叶斯次之（88.5%，F1 0.881）；Claude Sonnet 4.6达80.3%（F1 0.833），GPT-4o仅70.5%（F1 0.690）。

Conclusion: 医疗AI中存在预测性能与可解释性的权衡，LLM生成规则虽性能较低但提供可解释的IF-THEN诊断逻辑，增强临床决策透明度。

Abstract: This study compares traditional machine learning models and Large Language Model (LLM)-generated rule-based systems for heart disease prediction using the UCI Heart Disease dataset. Several classifiers, including Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naive Bayes, Decision Tree, and Random Forest, were evaluated alongside rule-based systems generated using GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet 4.6. Model performance was assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score metrics. Experimental results show that traditional machine learning models consistently outperform LLM-generated rule-based systems in predictive performance. Random Forest achieved the best overall performance with 90.2% accuracy, a precision of 0.829, perfect recall of 1.0, and an F1-score of 0.906. Naive Bayes followed closely with 88.5% accuracy and an F1-score of 0.881. In contrast, the LLM-generated rule models achieved lower performance, with Claude Sonnet 4.6 reaching 80.3% accuracy (F1-score: 0.833) and GPT-4o obtaining 70.5% accuracy (F1-score: 0.690). Despite the performance gap, the LLM-generated rules provide interpretable IF-THEN diagnostic logic that enhances explainability and transparency in clinical decision-making. These findings highlight the trade-off between predictive performance and interpretability in medical artificial intelligence systems. The complete implementation of all experiments, including machine learning models and LLM-derived rule classifiers, is publicly available in the GitHub repository at https://github.com/FeisalAlaswad/LLM-Rule-ML-Heart-Disease-Prediction .

</details>


### [459] [Linear Ensemble Sampling with Smaller Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13954)
*Taehyun Hwang,Min-hwan Oh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种仅在正则化 Gram 矩阵发生显著变化时才刷新集成的 ensemble sampling 算法，将充分集成规模从 Θ(d log T) 降至 Θ(d log d + d log log T)，同时保持任意有界臂集下 Õ(d^{3/2}√T) 的遗憾，并在有限臂集（基数 K）下达到 Õ(d√(T log K))。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集成采样是随机探索的实用方法（维护一组模型），但现有保证需要 Θ(d log T) 的集成规模，与内在的 Ω(d) 集成规模下界之间存在关于时域 T 的对数差距。作者希望缩小这一差距。

Method: 提出一种集成刷新机制：仅当正则化 Gram 矩阵发生实质性变化时才刷新集成。该机制将扰动分析局部化到 Gram 矩阵漂移受控的 epoch 上，从而降低所需的充分集成规模至 Θ(d log d + d log log T)。算法还支持无需重置历史数据的 anytime 实现。

Result: 在任意有界臂集下保持最优的 Õ(d^{3/2}√T) 遗憾；当臂集有限且基数为 K 时，取得更紧的 Õ(d√(T log K)) 遗憾。这是首个同时恢复随机线性 bandit 算法两个经典遗憾尺度（任意有界臂集的 Õ(d^{3/2}√T) 与有限臂集的 Õ(d√(T log K))）的集成采样保证。实验表明，在集成规模显著更小的情况下仍与基线具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 通过将集成刷新与正则化 Gram 矩阵的显著变化绑定，作者在保持最优遗憾的同时显著缩小了集成规模的理论下界差距，并首次使集成采样同时匹配随机线性 bandit 的两种经典遗憾尺度；算法支持 anytime 实现，且实验验证了其在小集成规模下的竞争力。

Abstract: Ensemble sampling offers a practical approach to randomized exploration by maintaining a collection of models, but how small an ensemble can be while retaining strong regret guarantees remains unresolved. In particular, the existing guarantees use an ensemble size of $Θ(d\log T)$, leaving a logarithmic gap in the horizon $T$ relative to the intrinsic $Ω(d)$ ensemble-size barrier. We aim to narrow this gap by proposing an ensemble sampling algorithm that refreshes the ensemble only when the regularized Gram matrix changes substantially. This mechanism localizes the perturbation analysis to epochs with controlled Gram-matrix drift and reduces the sufficient ensemble size to $Θ(d\log d+d\log\log T)$, while preserving the state-of-the-art $\tilde O(d^{3/2}\sqrt T)$ regret for ensemble sampling with arbitrary bounded arm sets. We further show that, when the arm set is finite of cardinality $K$, the proposed algorithm achieves the sharper regret bound $\tilde O(d\sqrt{T\log K})$. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first ensemble-sampling guarantee that simultaneously recovers both canonical regret scalings known for randomized linear bandit algorithms: the $\tilde O(d^{3/2}\sqrt{T})$ rate for arbitrary bounded arm sets and the $\tilde O (d\sqrt{T\log K})$ rate for finite arm sets. The algorithm also admits an anytime implementation without resetting past data, and experiments show that it remains competitive with baselines while using substantially smaller ensembles.

</details>


### [460] [Diagnosing Faults in Reinforcement Learning Simulators and World Models with Canonical Polynomial Invariants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13194)
*Tesfay Zemuy Gebrekidan,Hadush Hailu Gebrerufael*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文用精确多项式不变量（$\\mathbb{Q}$ 上的约化Gröbner基）检验"尊重物理结构的模型预测更好"这一前提，发现精确性对预测几乎无益，但精确规范不变量在故障诊断（约束筛查与参数归因）上价值显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大量文献将物理结构嵌入学习动力学，前提是尊重底层物理的模型预测更准。作者希望直接检验这一前提是否成立，并探究精确不变量真正的用途所在。

Method: 从轨迹中恢复精确多项式不变量并规范化为$\\mathbb{Q}$上的约化Gröbner基；在Acrobot上测试一致性正则化与整形势对预测/学习的影响；提出筛查（定位被违反的物理约束）与归因（恢复故障不变量并识别责任物理参数）两个流程，借助正规形deflation与商空间恢复；在15个注入故障及350对发布版本、11个RL环境上进行评估。

Result: 精确性对预测收益甚微：一致性正则化降低代数残差但rollout保真度基本不变，来自100%质量误差系统的整形势与正确势加速学习效果相当。筛查在15个注入故障中全部定位且无误报，观测空间基线无法定位；归因在全部7个参数故障上恢复责任参数。配对差异检验可检测所有故障，说明优势在于定位而非检测。参考生成器扰动$10^{-4}$仍保留14–15/15定位，而理想等式判定只能区分$10^{-12}$的扰动。350对发布版本中未发现模拟器动力学改变的证据，反而揭示了基准实现自身的性质。

Conclusion: 精确物理不变量的核心价值不在提升预测，而在诊断：筛查与归因能精确定位违反的约束与责任参数。筛查不依赖精确性，而代数的理想等式比较需要精确性。该框架可用于审计基准实现的物理一致性。

Abstract: A large literature builds physical structure into learned dynamics on the premise that models respecting the underlying physics predict better. We test that premise using exact polynomial invariants recovered from trajectories and canonicalised as reduced Gröbner bases over $\mathbb{Q}$. On Acrobot, exactness provides little benefit for prediction: a consistency regulariser reduces algebraic residual while leaving rollout fidelity essentially unchanged, and a shaping potential recovered from a system with a 100% mass error accelerates learning as effectively as the correct potential. Exact canonical invariants instead prove valuable for diagnosis. We develop two procedures: screening, which identifies the violated physical constraint, and attribution, which recovers the faulty invariant and identifies the responsible physical parameter. To enable this, we introduce normal-form deflation and quotient-space recovery. Across fifteen injected faults, screening localises every broken constraint with no false alarms, whereas observation-space baselines do not localise any; attribution recovers the responsible parameter on all seven parameter faults. Paired difference tests detect all faults, showing that the advantage is localisation rather than detection. Perturbing reference generators by $10^{-4}$ preserves 14--15/15 localisations, showing that screening does not require exactness, whereas ideal-equality decisions distinguish perturbations of only $10^{-12}$, showing that exactness is required for algebraic comparison. Applied to 350 release pairs across eleven RL environments, the diagnostic finds no evidence of changed simulator dynamics, instead revealing properties of the benchmark implementations themselves.

</details>


### [461] [Nonparametric Variance-Penalized Actor-Critic: Statistical Inference for Risk-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14327)
*Saunak Kumar Panda,Tong Li,Yisha Xiang,Ruiqi Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出无参数方差惩罚actor-critic（VPAC）框架，用基于bootstrap与random scaling的在线统计估计器替代专门的方差critic，保持单critic架构并实现有界方差惩罚；通过ODE方法证明方差惩罚Q-learning与双时间尺度actor-critic的几乎必然收敛，仅要求方差估计有界而非一致；在离散与连续随机环境中性能匹配或超过双critic基线，并在高温超导制造案例中实现稳态临界电流变异性降低74%、回合回报标准差降低63%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 风险敏感强化学习中的方差惩罚方法能显式地在期望回报与策略稳定性之间权衡，但现有方法需要额外的第二个critic在线估计回报方差，带来架构复杂性增加与估计误差累积的问题。作者希望消除辅助critic，从而简化结构并提升学习稳定性。

Method: 提出非参数方差惩罚actor-critic（VPAC）框架，将方差critic替换为来自随机逼近统计推断文献的、具有统计基础的在线估计器：bootstrapping与random scaling（VPAC-RS）。这些估计器不需要辅助网络，仅维持单critic架构，且构造上方差惩罚有界。随后采用常微分方程（ODE）方法，分别在方差惩罚Q-learning算法与双时间尺度actor-critic变体上建立几乎必然收敛性，收敛条件仅要求方差估计有界而非一致。

Result: 在离散与连续随机环境中评估，所提方法在方差削减方面匹配或超过现有双critic VPAC基线，同时消除第二critic的开销。在高温超导（HTS）制造案例研究中，VPAC-RS将稳态临界电流变异性降低74%，回合回报标准差降低63%，直接转化为良率一致性的提升。

Conclusion: 研究确立了非参数统计推断作为风险敏感强化学习中辅助critic的实用且理论完备的替代方案，表明无需专门方差critic即可实现有理论保证的方差惩罚学习。

Abstract: Variance penalization is a principled approach to risk-sensitive reinforcement learning (RL) that explicitly trades expected return for policy stability. Existing methods require a dedicated second critic to estimate return variance online, adding architectural complexity and compounding estimation error during learning. We propose a nonparametric variance-penalized actor-critic (VPAC) framework that replaces the variance critic with statistically grounded online estimators based on bootstrapping and random scaling, techniques drawn from the statistical inference literature for stochastic approximation. These estimators require no auxiliary network, maintain a single-critic architecture, and produce variance penalties that are bounded by construction, enabling clean convergence analysis. We establish almost-sure convergence for both a variance-penalized Q-learning algorithm and a two-timescale actor-critic variant via the ordinary differential equation (ODE) method, requiring only that variance estimates remain bounded rather than consistent. Empirically, we evaluate across discrete and continuous stochastic environments, demonstrating that the proposed methods match or exceed the variance reduction achieved by the existing dual-critic VPAC baseline while eliminating the overhead of a second critic. We further validate on a high-temperature superconductor (HTS) manufacturing case study, where VPAC-RS (Random Scaling) achieves a 74% reduction in steady-state critical current variability and a 63% reduction in episode return standard deviation, translating directly to improved yield consistency. Our results establish nonparametric statistical inference as a practical and theoretically sound alternative to auxiliary critics for risk-sensitive RL.

</details>


### [462] [Machine Unlearning for Speech Question Answering in Large Audio-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13195)
*Zhe Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）语音问答场景下的机器遗忘，评估梯度上升、任务算术与对齐微调等策略，可在隐私泄漏率下降约80%的同时保持核心能力基本不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LALMs在语音理解与问答上表现强劲，但继承了大规模训练数据的隐私风险，存在对敏感信息的非预期记忆。相比文本LLM或ASR，语音问答的遗忘更具挑战性，因为声学感知与事实知识紧密耦合。

Method: 提出并评估多种遗忘策略，包括梯度上升（gradient ascent）、任务算术（task arithmetic），以及强制安全拒绝响应的对齐式微调方法；在语音问答数据集上进行大量实验。

Result: 这些遗忘方法可将隐私泄漏率最多降低80%，同时在非隐私语音问答与通用语音理解基准上保持接近中立（near-neutral）的性能。

Conclusion: 语音问答场景下的机器遗忘在LALMs中可行，能够在显著抑制隐私泄漏的同时基本保持模型核心能力。

Abstract: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) have recently shown strong capabilities in speech understanding and question answering (QA), but they also inherit privacy risks from large-scale training data, including the unintended memorization of sensitive information. In this work, we study machine unlearning for speech QA in LALMs, a setting that is more challenging than prior work on text-based Large Language Models (LLMs) or Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) due to the tight coupling between acoustic perception and factual knowledge. We present and evaluate multiple unlearning strategies, including gradient ascent, task arithmetic, and alignment-based fine-tuning methods that enforce safe refusal responses, to remove private knowledge while still preserving performance on core capabilities. Through extensive experiments on speech QA datasets, we show that these unlearning methods can reduce the privacy leakage rate by up to 80% while maintaining near-neutral performance on non-private speech QA and general speech understanding benchmarks.

</details>


### [463] [Algorithmic Information Dynamics of Learning: A Certified, Differentiable Complexity Controller for Grokking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13197)
*Luan Ozelim,Hector Zenil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文用可微的认证算法复杂度估计器 K^CDM_sF 将算法信息动力学引入学习动力学，通过瞬态损失踢作为控制器加速 grokking，并系统刻画其数据依赖的 Occam 边界、门控机制与核化样响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算法信息动力学（AID）通过扰动系统并测量算法复杂度变化来研究系统，但其常用估计器（块分解法）是分段常数，使微积分只能限于有限差分。作者希望把"复杂度微积分"真正带入学习动力学，针对 grokking 这一已有复杂度序参量却尚未被"驱动"的现象，构建可微、可认证的复杂度控制器。

Method: 采用可微且具认证性的估计器 K^CDM_sF 替代分段常数的块分解法；以瞬态损失踢（transient loss kick）作为扰动，使估计器充当控制器；研究数据依赖的 Occam 边界及其有限尺度趋势 f_c ~ ln p / p；进行消融实验对比复杂度门控与训练损失门控；检验认证先验与逐参数 ∇K 归因的可替换性（均匀先验传感器与随机支撑）；对 Occam 场做直接场扰动，考察核化样响应；并测试向稀疏奇偶校验任务与 transformer 的迁移。

Result: 瞬态损失踢使估计器可在 Levin 的描述长度–时间意义下加速 grokking，且受数据依赖的 Occam 边界限制，其有限尺度趋势 f_c ~ ln p / p 与优惠券收集者解释一致。消融显示复杂度门控在挽救失败随机种子时与训练损失门控表现相当，但干预量减少 27%；在被测信号中只有映射复杂度能标记转变完成；认证先验与 ∇K 逐参数归因均可替换（均匀先验传感器给出逐位相同的门控决策，随机支撑在稀疏阈值以上可与 ∇K 选择的支撑匹配）；直接场扰动对 Occam 场呈核化样响应，在所探测振幅范围内未分辨出线性区，因此不支持涨落–耗散替代；有限场响应在接近相变时增长数个数量级。测量结果解释了经验调优的阶梯式脉冲：bang–bang 脉冲在产出时触发、停顿时释放。该方法可迁移至稀疏奇偶校验任务与 transformer；持续的权重空间损失则失败。

Conclusion: 算法估计器的独特贡献在于"计时"——何时触发与何时释放——而非归因。复杂度微积分可微分化为学习动力学中的控制器，且其核化样场响应与数据依赖 Occam 边界共同解释了阶梯式 bang–bang 干预的有效性。

Abstract: Algorithmic Information Dynamics (AID) studies systems by perturbing them and measuring changes in algorithmic complexity, but its usual estimator, the Block Decomposition Method, is piecewise constant, restricting the calculus to finite differences. We use $K^{\mathrm{CDM}}_{\mathrm{s}F}$, a certified, differentiable estimator, to bring the calculus into learning dynamics: grokking, where a complexity order parameter is known but has not been made to act. A\empts a transient loss kick, the estimator becomes a controller that accelerates grokking in Levin's description-length--versus-time sense, within a data-dependent Occam boundary whose finite-size trend, $f_c\sim\ln p/p$, is consistent with a coupon-collector interpretation. Ablations show that a complexity gate matches a train-loss gate in rescuing failing seeds with $27\%$ less intervention; among the tested signals, only map complexity marks the transition's completion; the certified prior and the per-parameter $\nabla K$ attribution are both fungible (a uniform-prior sensor makes bit-identical gate decisions, and random supports match $\nabla K$-selected ones above a sparsity threshold); and direct field perturbation shows a nucleation-like response to the Occam field (no linear regime is resolved over the probed amplitudes, so these measurements do not justify a fluctuation--dissipation surrogate), with a finite-field response growing by orders of magnitude toward the transition. These measurements account for the empirically tuned staircase: bang--bang pulses, stall-fired and released on yield, whose iteration plausibly builds the response it exploits. The kick transfers to sparse parity and to a transformer; a sustained weight-space loss fails. The algorithmic estimator's distinct contribution is timing (when to fire and when to release), not attribution.

</details>


### [464] [Structured Features Overfit Where Random Features Grok](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15047)
*Chon-Fai Kam,Miloud Bessafi,Frederic Cadet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Xu, Vardi and Safran (ICML 2026) prove that over-parameterized ridge regression over an unstructured random Gaussian feature map groks, with the delay between memorization and generalization growing as $1/λ$ in the weight decay. We show that on a structured feature map the same delay does not appear. For a band-limited Fourier feature map over $\mathbb{Z}_p^2$ carrying a single-character target that lies inside the expressible class, enlarging the band at fixed positive weight decay drives peak held-out accuracy monotonically from $1.00$ to $0.07$, with no memorize-then-generalize regime anywhere along the sweep. The degradation is not an interpolation effect. It sets in at capacity ratio $q/n = 0.638$, far below the interpolation threshold, on separate grounds from the exact null space that appears above it. What does have a sharp boundary is the active support. Holding the nominal dimension fixed and masking the band back to $1089$ active modes restores held-out accuracy of $1.000$ with zero variance across seeds, while the full $4225$-mode band collapses to $0.185$. The number of active modes acts through the teacher-weighted spectrum of the empirical Gram matrix and not through the capacity ratio, which makes this a statement about feature geometry and not a restatement of double descent.

</details>


### [465] [Retrieval-Guided Fine-Tuning as Noisy Estimation: Risk bounds and Architectural Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14485)
*Bhargav Lad,Yifan Hao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将 RAG-FT 建模为多任务线性回归估计问题，用 OLS 代理单层线性自注意力得到有限样本风险界，证明检索失败随任务分离指数衰减，并揭示注意力估计器的固定无权聚合是训练不稳定的根源，而非检索噪声本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG-FT 将检索数据直接纳入训练目标，但训练过程中噪声检索的统计后果在理论上刻画不足，缺乏对其风险行为的有限样本分析与稳定性来源的明确归因。

Method: 将 RAG-FT 形式化为多任务线性回归的估计问题，以 OLS 代理单层线性自注意力（LSA）前向过程；在同方差检索噪声下推导有限样本风险界与优于 target-only、full-corpus 训练的显式条件；进一步提出距离比例噪声（DPN）模型，令检索质量随排序下降，在同一检索过程下对比 OLS 代理与字面均匀权重 LSA 前向两个估计器。

Result: 同方差噪声下检索失败风险随任务分离与噪声之比指数衰减；给出 RAG-FT 风险低于 target-only 与 full-corpus 训练的有限样本条件。在 DPN 模型下，即使精确检索，注意力估计器偏差以 Θ(n^{2q}) 发散，而 OLS 风险对所有噪声指数 q>0 保持 Θ(d/n)。仿真验证了预测的速率分离。

Conclusion: 不稳定性的根源不在噪声检索本身，而在字面 LSA 前向中固定、无权的聚合方式；按可靠性重加权可在经验上消除该不稳定性。

Abstract: Retrieval-Guided Fine-Tuning (RAG-FT) incorporates retrieved data directly into the training objective, but the statistical consequences of noisy retrieval during training remain theoretically undercharacterized. We study this question by modeling RAG-FT as an estimation problem in a multi-task linear regression framework, using an OLS proxy for single-layer linear self-attention to obtain finite-sample risk bounds. Under homoscedastic retrieval noise, we show that retrieval failure decays exponentially with task separation relative to noise, and derive explicit finite-sample conditions under which RAG-FT achieves lower risk than both target-only and full-corpus training. We then introduce a Distance-Proportional Noise (DPN) model, in which retrieval quality degrades with rank, and compare two estimators under the same retrieval process: the OLS proxy and the literal, uniform-weight forward pass of linear self-attention. We prove that the attention estimator's bias diverges as $Θ(n^{2q})$ even under exact retrieval, while OLS risk remains $Θ(d/n)$ for every noise exponent $q>0$. These results locate the instability not in noisy retrieval itself, but in the fixed, unweighted aggregation of the literal LSA forward pass, which reweighting by reliability empirically removes. We validate the predicted rate separation through direct simulation of the DPN model.

</details>


### [466] [SPICE: Simple Polysemantic Feature Interpretation via Clustering-based Explanation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13198)
*Sehyun Lee,Dahee Kwon,Damin Lee,Jaesik Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出SPICE框架，用于通用化分析深度视觉网络中的多义性神经元，避免架构依赖并自动确定概念簇数量，实现对CNN与Transformer的系统比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络可解释性中的多义性问题突出：单个神经元被多个不相关概念激活，影响功能理解。现有方法依赖特定架构和人工启发式（如固定概念簇数K），通用性与可扩展性不足，尤其难以适用于Transformer模型。

Method: 提出SPICE（基于聚类的简单多义特征解释）框架：摒弃架构相关的传播规则，自动确定每个神经元的概念簇数量，不依赖预设K，从而支持大规模模型的可扩展分析，并可跨CNN与Transformer进行统一比较。

Result: SPICE实现了首次在CNN与Transformer之间对多义性进行系统比较，并能自动确定每个神经元的概念簇数，支持大型模型的可扩展分析。

Conclusion: 利用SPICE对多义性的产生机制、随深度与架构的变化、以及经由不同计算路径形成的过程进行了全面研究，为深度视觉架构的多义性分析提供了通用且可扩展的方案。

Abstract: One of the pivotal recent challenges in neural network interpretability is polysemanticity, where a single neuron is activated by multiple, often unrelated concepts, hindering clear functional understanding. Although prior work has explored this phenomenon, existing approaches remain architecture-specific and depend on manual heuristics such as a fixed number of concept clusters ($K$), limiting their generality and scalability--especially for modern Transformer-based models.
